title: Where to Split and When to Charge: Optimal Route Construction from Customer Permutations in Electric Vehicle Routing
summary: Permutation-based metaheuristics are widely used for electric vehicle routing, where candidate solutions are represented as ordered sequences of customers. Such sequences, however, do not directly define feasible vehicle routes: they must be decoded by choosing where to split the permutation into routes and where to insert charging-station visits, subject to cargo capacity and battery constraints. These decisions are inherently interdependent, since each return to the depot both separates consecutive routes and restores the vehicle battery. This paper formalizes the task as the Fixed-Permutation Splitting and Charging Problem and proposes an exact forward labeling algorithm that constructs a minimum-distance feasible decoding of a fixed customer permutation using dynamic programming with dominance pruning. We further derive restricted variants representing increasingly simplified decoding strategies: first separating route splitting from charging-station insertion, and then additionally limiting each inter-customer segment to at most one charging-station visit. Computational experiments on benchmark and randomly generated instances, including comparisons with heuristic decoders from the literature, confirm that the exact decoder remains tractable in practice and reveal a clear hierarchy among decoding strategies. The most restrictive variant achieves runtimes close to those of heuristic decoders while delivering substantially higher decoding success rates and better solution quality. Less restrictive variants further improve quality and robustness at the cost of additional runtime. The exact joint decoder provides the optimal reference for each fixed permutation, clarifying the trade-offs introduced by common decoding simplifications.

AI.tldr: 论文针对电动汽车路径问题中排列解码的内在依赖性挑战，提出固定排列分割与充电问题形式化模型，设计精确前向标记动态规划算法，并建立多层限制性解码变体进行系统比较，揭示解码策略简化与解质量之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 基于排列的元启发式算法在电动汽车路径问题中广泛应用，但排列本身不能直接定义可行车辆路径，需要通过路径分割和充电站插入决策将其解码。这些决策之间存在内在依赖性——每次返回仓库既分隔连续路径，又恢复车辆电池。然而，现有方法通常采用简化解码策略，可能牺牲解的质量和可行性。
AI.method: 提出一种精确前向标记算法，使用带支配剪枝的动态规划来构建固定客户排列的最小距离可行解码。进一步推导出三种限制性变体，代表逐步简化的解码策略：(1) 将路径分割与充电站插入分离；(2) 进一步限制每个客户间段最多访问一个充电站；(3) 精确联合解码。
AI.result: 最严格变体运行时间接近启发式解码器，但具有更高解码成功率和更好解质量。精确联合解码器可作为最优参考基准，揭示了常见解码简化的权衡取舍。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明：(1) 精确解码器在实践中具有可处理性；(2) 解码策略存在明显的层次结构；(3) 最严格变体在接近启发式解码器运行时间的同时，获得更高的解码成功率和更好的解质量；(4) 逐步放宽限制可进一步提升质量和鲁棒性，但需牺牲运行时间；(5) 精确联合解码器为每个固定排列提供最优参考，明确揭示了常见解码简化策略带来的权衡取舍。

title: Parsimonious Learning-Augmented Online Metric Matching
summary: Learning-augmented algorithms have received significant attention in recent years, particularly in the context of online optimization. Motivated by the high computational cost of generating predictions, a growing line of work studies the tradeoff between performance guarantees and the number of predictions used in learning-augmented algorithms for problems such as caching and metrical task systems. In this paper, we extend this line of research to online metric matching by developing parsimonious learning-augmented algorithms and establishing lower bounds on their performance. Our approach extends the Follow-the-Prediction framework to the parsimonious setting by filling in a virtual prediction in the absence of an actual prediction, using an online metric matching algorithm that maintains good intermediate matchings throughout its execution. We complement our theoretical results with an empirical evaluation, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: This paper extends learning-augmented algorithms to parsimonious settings for online metric matching, where only limited predictions are available. They modify the Follow-the-Prediction framework to use virtual predictions when needed and maintain quality throughout execution, achieving both theoretical lower bounds and empirical validation.
AI.motivation: The high computational cost of generating predictions in learning-augmented algorithms creates a need to study tradeoffs between performance guarantees and the number of predictions used. Existing work on caching and metrical task systems needs to be extended to online metric matching.
AI.method: Extended the Follow-the-Prediction framework to the parsimonious setting by: (1) using virtual predictions when actual predictions are unavailable, (2) employing an online metric matching algorithm that maintains good intermediate matchings throughout execution.
AI.result: Developed parsimonious learning-augmented algorithms with performance guarantees and lower bounds for online metric matching, with empirical evaluation demonstrating practical effectiveness.
AI.conclusion: The proposed parsimonious learning-augmented approach for online metric matching is both theoretically sound and practically effective.

title: Virtual-Memory Powersort
summary: We give a more space-efficient implementation of adaptive mergesort: Virtual-Memory Powersort. Using internal buffering techniques, we significantly reduce the memory consumption of the algorithm; specifically, for sorting $n$ objects the required buffer area is reduced from space for $n/2$ objects to $O(\sqrt{n \log n})$ objects. While this space-efficiency can be achieved (indeed reduced to $O(1)$) conceptually very easily with known inplace merging algorithms, using these as a drop-in replacement for the standard merge algorithm incurs a substantial slow-down. Virtual-Memory Powersort, by contrast, uses the same number of moves and comparisons as previous Powersort implementations up to an additive $O(n)$ term. We report on an empirical running-time study comparing our implementation against other Powersort variants and state-of-the-art stable sorting methods, demonstrating that almost in-place stable sorting can be achieved with negligible overhead in many scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Virtual-Memory Powersort，通过内部缓冲技术在保持原有算法效率的前提下，将排序所需的缓冲区从n/2降低至O(√(n log n))，实验证明可实现开销极小的近乎原地稳定排序。
AI.motivation: 现有Powersort实现需要n/2个对象的存储空间，虽然已知原地归并算法可将空间降低至O(1)，但直接替换标准归并算法会导致显著的性能下降。
AI.method: 采用内部缓冲技术实现Virtual-Memory Powersort，保留了原有Powersort实现相同的移动和比较次数（至多附加O(n)项），同时显著降低缓冲区空间需求。
AI.result: 成功将缓冲区大小从n/2个对象降低至O(√(n log n))个对象，在保持比较次数和移动次数不变的情况下实现了空间效率的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验研究表明，Virtual-Memory Powersort在多种场景下能以极小的开销实现近乎原地稳定排序，为内存受限环境下的高效排序提供了可行方案。

title: On the Detection of Commutative Factors in Factor Graphs: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions
summary: Exploiting the indistinguishability of objects in a probabilistic graphical model such as a factor graph is key to lifted probabilistic inference algorithms and allows for tractable probabilistic inference problems with respect to domain sizes. A central building block for the exploitation of indistinguishable objects in factor graphs is the identification of commutative factors, i.e., factors whose output values are invariant under permutations of input values assigned to a subset of their arguments. In this paper, we revisit the theoretical foundations underlying the state-of-the-art algorithm to detect commutative factors. Specifically, we show that in its current form, the state-of-the-art algorithm relies on a central theorem that is mistakenly regarded as a sufficient condition to identify commutative factors, while it actually only implies necessary condition. Consequently, the state of the art might, as we show in this paper, deliver incorrect results. To fix the flaws currently present in the state of the art, we prove a slightly modified version of the aforementioned theorem, which serves as a necessary condition to identify commutative factors. Moreover, we present a corrected version of the state-of-the-art algorithm, which keeps its efficiency while ensuring correctness and introduce a complementary algorithm with tighter worst-case bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前检测可交换因子的最先进算法存在理论缺陷——其核心定理仅为必要条件而非充分条件，可能导致错误结果。作者通过证明修正版定理并提出修正算法（保持效率）和更紧致最坏情况界限的补充算法来解决此问题。
AI.motivation: 提升概率图模型（如因子图）中可交换因子的检测能力，这是提升概率推理算法的关键，但现有最先进算法存在理论缺陷可能产生错误结果。
AI.method: 理论分析发现原定理仅提供必要条件而非充分条件；通过证明修正版定理作为必要条件来修复理论缺陷；相应修正算法设计。
AI.result: 识别出原定理仅为必要条件而非充分条件，实际应用中可能产生不正确结果；提供修正定理及相应修正算法，保证正确性且保持效率；额外提出具有更优最坏情况界限的补充算法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了修正版本的算法（保持效率且确保正确性）以及具有更紧致最坏情况界限的补充算法，填补了原算法的理论缺陷。

title: Generalized Range Filtering Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search: Containment and Overlap [Technical Report]
comment: The paper has been accepted by KDD 2026
summary: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search with range filters has recently garnered significant attention. This paper delves into a generalized form of this problem, i.e., ANN search with exact range-range (RR) predicates on a range-valued attribute, named RR filtering ANN (RRANN). Specifically, given $n$ vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, each vector $v_i$ is associated with a numeric range $[l_i, r_i]$, symbolizing aspects like a price range or time interval. An RRANN query $(v_q, l_q, r_q)$ aims at finding $k$ vectors closest to $v_q$ within the vectors satisfying an arbitrary RR predicate defined between the query range $[l_q, r_q]$ and the object range $[l_i, r_i]$. The RR predicate remains unspecified, enabling user-defined conditions. It may encompass containment ($[l_i, r_i] \subseteq [l_q, r_q]$ or $[l_q, r_q] \subseteq [l_i, r_i]$), overlap ($l_i \le l_q \le r_i \le r_q$ or $l_q \le l_i \le r_q \le r_i$), or a disjunction of them. RRANN has broad applications in queries related to price ranges or time intervals, and it generalizes existing variants of ANN search with range filters. However, existing dedicated approaches for these problems lack the capacity to support queries with arbitrary RR predicates. Hence, we introduce a new approach, labeled multi-segment tree graph. It efficiently handles arbitrary RR predicates by avoiding traversal through non-predicate-satisfied nodes, and keeps equivalent index size and construction time to state-of-the-art methods for RFANN. Extensive experiments on real-world data demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in RRANN queries, achieving up to 12.5x speedups with the same accuracy as the baselines. Moreover, our approach attains comparable RFANN search performance and notably superior IFANN and TSANN search performance compared to the respective state-of-the-art approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/FanEDG/MSTG.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了带范围-范围（RR）谓词的近似最近邻搜索问题（RRANN），每个向量关联一个数值范围，查询需要找出满足任意RR谓词条件的最近邻向量。为此提出了多段树图（MSTG）方法，通过避免遍历不满足谓词的节点来高效支持任意RR谓词，在真实数据上实现最高12.5倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有近似最近邻搜索方法无法支持任意定义的RR谓词（如包含、重叠或其组合），而实际应用中对价格区间、时间间隔等范围查询需求广泛，需要一种通用方法来处理用户自定义的任意RR谓词条件。
AI.method: 采用多段树图（MSTG）结构，通过避免遍历不满足谓词的节点来高效处理任意RR谓词。该方法保持了与RFANN最优方法相当的索引大小和构建时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在RRANN查询上实现了最高12.5倍的加速且保持相同精度；在RFANN上达到可比性能，在IFANN和TSANN上显著优于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的多段树图（MSTG）方法，能够高效处理任意RR谓词，保持与现有最优方法相当的索引大小和构建时间，在RRANN查询上实现最高12.5倍的加速，同时在RFANN、IFANN和TSANN等变体搜索任务上也表现优异或更优。

title: LearnedCache: An eBPF-Integrated Perceptron-Based Eviction Policy for the Linux Page Cache
comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 4 listings. Policies and harnesses: https://github.com/JayAndJef/cache_ext_lc . Model and visualizations: https://github.com/JayAndJef/learnedcache
summary: Linux is the foundation of the digital age, accounting for the majority of the cloud and mobile OS markets. Any device that runs Linux uses the Linux page cache, a central pillar in OS and application performance, serving to reduce extraneous disk access. Many page cache eviction policies have been developed but remain bound by the rigidity of heuristics. The rise of AI-driven tools in recent years, melded with the ever-increasing variety of workloads for Linux devices, sets the stage for machine-learning-driven cache eviction policies. Promising research has been done in this field, but only in the field of user-space applications such as CDNs. We develop LearnedCache, an eBPF-integrated single-layer perceptron-based cache eviction policy for the Linux page cache, trained on real kernel data from diverse workloads. We demonstrate median AUCs of nearly 80% over multiple linear models modeling page reuse time, then take a step further by embedding these models inside the Linux kernel for real-time performance evaluation. Through statistical testing over 50 paired trials against a baseline of FIFO for each workload, LearnedCache reveals that machine-learning-derived cache eviction policies are practical in the Linux kernel under representative empirical workloads and are able to surpass conventional FIFO by statistically significant margins of up to 10% in insertion rate, a frequency-adjusted derivation of cache hit rate, in specific workloads while incurring minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LearnedCache，一种基于单层感知机的Linux页面缓存驱逐策略，通过eBPF集成到Linux内核中，在真实工作负载下可将插入率提升最高10%，同时开销极小。
AI.motivation: Linux页面缓存是操作系统性能的核心支柱，但现有驱逐策略受限于固定启发式规则。随着AI工具的发展和工作负载多样化，基于机器学习的缓存驱逐策略具有显著潜力，但此前研究仅停留在用户空间应用（如CDN），尚未在Linux内核层面实现。
AI.method: 1) 设计基于单层感知机的缓存驱逐模型；2) 使用真实内核数据对多样化工作负载进行训练；3) 通过eBPF将模型嵌入Linux内核进行实时性能评估；4) 对50组配对试验进行统计检验。
AI.result: 模型中位数AUC接近80%；在特定工作负载下，插入率相比FIFO基线提升最高10%，且开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习驱动的缓存驱逐策略在Linux内核中具有实际可行性，可在代表性经验工作负载下以统计显著优势超越传统FIFO策略。

title: The Environmental Costs of Surveillance Capitalism: A Case Study of Social Media Platforms
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, submitted to the International Conference on ICT for Sustainability (ICT4S) 2026, for associated code, see https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20384405
summary: The business model of surveillance capitalism, premised on the extraction of behavioral data and its predictive potential for profit, relies on extensive material infrastructure. Such profit is typically driven by practices such as telemetry, user tracking, data analytics, secondary data uses, increased user engagement, and AI model training, as well as large-scale data storage systems that retain personal information for sale or reuse. This paper is motivated by the question: how much of the rising carbon impact of ICT can be attributed to this material infrastructure? Such an inquiry provides a foundation for quantifying the environmental costs of surveillance capitalism by proposing a conceptual framework and research direction that link processes of surveillance with their underlying material realities. To demonstrate the applicability of this framework, we examine the proportion of network traffic caused by surveillance capitalism processes through a comparative case study of a corporate social media platform, X/formerly Twitter, and a decentralized, non-commercial alternative, Mastodon. Our findings highlight the existence of corporate overhead: excess resource consumption driven by corporate social media practices, which is used as an initial proxy for the activities of surveillance capitalism. Our findings further demonstrate how the corporate overhead of X can be used to establish a lower bound in CO2e emissions attributable to for-profit activities that do not contribute to the user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将“监控资本主义”过程与其物质基础设施（服务器、存储、网络、数据中心）相连接的概念框架，并以此作为研究议程；随后通过比较企业社交媒体平台 X（原 Twitter）与去中心化非商业的 Mastodon，量化 X 上由监控资本主义活动产生的“企业开销（corporate overhead）”网络流量，进而给出归属于 X 营利性活动、不服务于用户体验的 CO2e 排放下界。
AI.motivation: 监控资本主义依赖大量物质基础设施（遥测、用户追踪、数据分析、二次数据利用、互动优化、AI 训练、大规模存储），其环境代价一直缺乏实证量化；而 ICT 碳足迹持续上升（数据中心占全球用电约 1.5%，2030 年可能翻倍）。本文追问：ICT 上升的碳影响中有多少可归因于监控资本主义的物质基础设施？同时指出 CSM 主动制造知识不对称（数据收集方式与规模被刻意遮蔽），使公众无法获得准确环境报告，因此需要一套透明的、可复现的测量方法来打破这一不对称。
AI.method: 1) 概念框架：借鉴 C4 软件架构图风格，绘制数字平台参与监控资本主义的构成要素图，每个要素标注“可满足功能（sufficient）”与“开销功能（overhead）”，并按功能视角将计算资源分为三类：核心与导航功能、用户生成数据与内容、监控与追踪（外加“其他”不确定类）；框架聚焦 LES 生命周期的第一层（生命周期影响），亦可扩展至使役与结构性影响。2) 案例研究：自建用户旅程（user journey）测量工具，由 WebDriver（Playwright + Firefox）、HTTPS 代理（MitmProxy）与 SQLite 数据库三部分组成；设计 3 条用户旅程（主feed滚动约5分钟、发帖并打开、TechCrunch 信息流滚动），每条重复 100 次（约 75 小时）取均值。3) 指标：URL、Cookies、请求/响应总大小、时间戳；提出两个新指标——企业开销（X 流量超出 Mastodon 基线的部分）与用户追踪开销（经细粒度分类归入监控与追踪的流量，如 X 的 /i/api/1.1/graphql/user_flow.json POST 请求，含 action: "impression"、"become_inactive" 等字段）。4) 排放换算：采用 Istrate 等的互联网能耗强度 0.0177 kWh/GB（核心网）+ 0.0414 kWh/GB（数据中心）= 0.0591 kWh/GB，全球电网碳强度 445 gCO2e/kWh，并按 X 公布的每日 80 亿活跃分钟与每日 5 亿条推文放大到年度尺度。
AI.result: 企业开销占 X 流量比例为：旅程1（主feed滚动）86.04%（117.66 MB / 6 分钟，0.019156 GB/min）、旅程2（发帖）49.78%（6.77 MB，0.006612 GB）、旅程3（TechCrunch 滚动）55.15%（10.92 MB / 6分38秒，0.001608 GB/min）。用户追踪开销占比分别为 1.66%、1.09%、6.65%（0.000370、0.000145、0.000193 GB/min 等）。年化排放下界：企业开销按旅程2+3 得 414.222 tCO2e + 123.465 ktCO2e = 至少 123.879 ktCO2e；若以旅程1为代表性样本，则 X 企业开销年排放至少 1.471 MtCO2e。用户追踪开销下界为 14.886 ktCO2e/年（9.110 t + 14.877 kt）。作者强调结果保守：仅计入传输能耗，未计计算、存储、分析、重组、复制与出售带来的额外足迹；Mastodon 工程投入较低，故基线偏保守（使开销成为低估）。
AI.conclusion: 监控资本主义的碳足迹确实存在且不可忽略，X 的“企业开销”年排放下界约 1.471 MtCO2e，仅属用户追踪的下界也达 14.886 ktCO2e。作者提出可推广方向：以 FOSS 替代社交媒体（Fediverse 配对：X–Mastodon、YouTube–PeerTube、Instagram–PixelFed、Reddit–Lemmy）为对照继续测量客户端 UI、服务器端与存储层的影响，并比较 GoToSocial、Snac2 等更“轻量”实现；同时指出 CSM 的遮蔽（需配置 HTTPS 代理、请求功能不透明、Cookie 二义性）削弱问责，呼吁监管强制数据中心资源使用与排放透明。政策含义：仅削减用户追踪开销（碳减排效益低一个数量级）易陷入“守护现状”，需以“促成安全涌现（safe emergence）”的取向，结合社会—生态—技术系统（SETS）与注意力能动性 Push/Pull 框架，把数字充足性作为减碳与社会减害的共同杠杆。

title: From user-understandable to technical process model: a model-driven approach using cuta4bpm
summary: For business process modeling, we can choose between graph-oriented and block-oriented languages. Block-oriented languages are more structured and therefore better understandable for domain experts, while graph-oriented languages allow more modeling freedom and technical versatility for process designers. To bridge this gap between understandability and technical versatility, we propose a participative forward engineering approach. It uses our block-oriented CUTA4BPM language to support high level process modeling together with domain experts, while graph-oriented BPMN is used for further detailed process design and automation. To support smooth transition from the high level modeling step to the detailed one, CUTA4BPM process models are automatically transformed to BPMN models using model driven engineering techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种参与式正向工程方法，使用块导向的CUTA4BPM语言支持与领域专家的高层过程建模，再通过模型驱动工程自动转换为图导向的BPMN模型用于详细设计，从而弥合可理解性与技术灵活性之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 当前块导向语言虽结构化程度高、易于领域专家理解，但技术灵活性不足；而图导向语言虽技术灵活却缺乏结构性，双方存在可理解性与技术通用性之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 采用模型驱动工程(MDE)技术，将CUTA4BPM块导向语言的过程模型自动转换为BPMN图导向模型。
AI.result: 实现了从CUTA4BPM高层建模到BPMN详细设计的高效平滑过渡，兼顾了领域专家的可理解性需求和技术设计人员的灵活性需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过CUTA4BPM到BPMN的自动模型转换，实现了从高层领域建模到详细技术设计的平滑过渡，弥合了可理解性与技术灵活性之间的差距。

title: ATOM: Instantiating Budget-Controllable Multi-Agent Collaboration via Nucleus-Electron Hierarchy
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems rely on optimized collaboration topologies to balance performance and communication costs. However, current methods struggle with the inherent stability-extensibility trade-off and often misalign computational budgets with query difficulty. We propose \textsc{ATOM}, an adaptive framework that generates budget-controllable collaboration graphs via a novel task-driven reinforcement learning paradigm. Inspired by atomic structures, \textsc{ATOM} employs a nucleus-electron hierarchy: it maintains a stable, offline-learned collaboration backbone (the nucleus) while dynamically activating query-conditioned agents (electrons) during inference. Crucially, a complexity-aware budgeting strategy aligns resource consumption with task demands by estimating query difficulty to strictly regulate electron instantiation. Extensive experiments across six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ATOM} achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving token efficiency by up to $30\%$ compared to strong baselines.

AI.tldr: ATOM(Adaptive Topology Optimization Mechanism)提出用"原子式"核-电子层级结构组织LLM多智能体系统：离线学习稳定的核心骨干(nucleus)，推理时按查询难度动态激活外围智能体(electrons)，并通过复杂度感知预算严格约束实例化规模。在六个基准上取得SOTA精度，同时token消耗比强基线最多降低30%。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统(MAS)的性能高度依赖协作拓扑，但现有方法存在两大局限：(1) 稳定性—可扩展性权衡：手工静态模板(Chain/Star/Complete)无法适配不同难度；模板修改法(AgentPrune/AgentDropout)依赖全连接超图导致巨大前置通信开销；纯生成式方法(G-Designer/ARG-Designer)从零搜索组合空间、搜索空间指数爆炸。(2) 预算错位：现有方法将拓扑规模与查询复杂度解耦，缺少显式难度估计——修改法在简单问题上先超支再简化，生成式方法陷入"平均复杂度陷阱"(简单问题过度配置、复杂问题配置不足)。作者通过自建复杂度标注元数据集按Easy/Medium/Hard分层观测到明显的资源利用率分化，证明静态稠密拓扑在根本上低效。
AI.method:
形式化：MAS被建模为空间-时间复合有向图 G=(V_q, E_q^(S), E_q^(T))；空间边为轮内同步通信且严格构成DAG以避免逻辑死锁，时间边为跨轮异步记忆检索；优化目标为预算约束下的期望效用最大化 max E[U(G|q)] s.t. C(G) ≤ B(q)。

(1) 离线阶段—原子核构建：在全连接超网上以 REINFORCE 优化空间/时间边的结构化logits，激活概率 ρ=σ(θ)，目标为期望效用减去稀疏先验 λ_sparse·边激活均值；收敛后以空间子图上的"期望度中心性"(EDC)作为节点显著性 S_node(v_i)=Σ_j(ρ_ij^(S)+ρ_ji^(S))，取Top-K_nuc构成稳定原子核，其余进入电子储备池。注意原子核仅指节点划分，其内部及所有边在在线阶段仍完全动态、查询条件化。

(2) 在线阶段—电子激发：以激活智能体数作为token消耗的确定性代理，学习条件于查询的路由策略 π_θ(G|q)，约束 |V_elec(q)| ≤ K(q)。复杂度感知预算：构建复合特征 x_q=[W_PCA f_enc(q) ‖ Φ(q)]（Φ为符号/逻辑密度，如数值变量与逻辑算子），并用域门控 g_d=σ(MLP_φ(e_d)) 抑制跨域混淆，输出归一化难度 C̄(q)，据此 K(q)=⌊K_max·C̄(q)⌋。动态实例化：以 O(N) 行级门控注入查询语义，α_i = Φ_node(Ψ_rel(h_i, W_ctx f_q)) + cos(ψ_K(e_i), ψ_Q(f_q))（余弦项刻意使用原始特征以避免查询信息重复注入）；通过条件Bernoulli采样并配合动态规划后缀配分函数 Z_i^(b) 精确采样满足"≤K"约束的激活集合，避免Top-K截断导致的概率失真。关系拓扑合成：z_ij=Ψ_rel(h_i,h_j) 映射为空间/时间双通道路由logit，空间边在DAG无环约束下顺序采样，时间边独立采样。

(3) 训练目标：REINFORCE，奖励 R=r_task − λ_cost·(|E_active|/|E_max|)，采用移动基线的标准化优势与长度归一化的顺序对数概率代理；再叠加结构层级正则化 L_struct，以对偶间隔排序损失鼓励核内/核-电子边概率高于电子-电子边，为早期探索提供连续信号。
AI.result: 在 Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，MMLU 72.55、GSM8K 84.00、HumanEval 71.90、AQuA 66.36、MultiArith 96.61、SVAMP 87.40，平均79.80，全面超越 Vanilla/CoT、Chain/Star/Random/Complete、LLM-Debate、AgentPrune、AgentDropout、G-Designer、ARG-Designer；相对最强学习式基线ARG-Designer在MMLU上领先5.23个百分点，HumanEval上token消耗从约5.3×10^5降至3.7×10^5(降逾30%)，整体token效率最高提升30%。消融显示：固定/随机预算导致token翻倍并掉点(HumanEval降至63.64)，零预算(仅原子核)HumanEval下降6.61%；去掉原子核识别MMLU降至68.63(-3.92)、HumanEval降4.96；去掉结构正则MMLU崩至64.05、HumanEval 62.81；去掉成本惩罚则GSM8K prompt token由3.88升至5.23且HumanEval降至69.42。扩展到DeepSeek-V3.2仍保持最高精度而开销接近单智能体(其他MAS框架需多达4倍token)；MMLU上预测复杂度与实际token消耗显著正相关(Pearson r=0.737)；对prompt注入攻击性能仅下降6.4%，明显优于全动态拓扑的灾难性退化。案例显示简单算术题(复杂度0.331)仅实例化两智能体链，复杂金融题(复杂度0.493)额外招募"Programming Expert"，而ARG-Designer对不同难度生成完全相同的三智能体拓扑。
AI.conclusion: ATOM通过将离线结构学习与在线查询条件扩展解耦，在保持核心推理通道稳定的同时按需扩展协作规模，化解了MAS拓扑设计的稳定性—可扩展性权衡；复杂度感知预算机制使计算资源与任务难度严格对齐，突破了"平均复杂度陷阱"。实验证明其在六个基准上以SOTA精度实现最高30%的token效率提升，形成新的Pareto前沿，并在更强骨干模型上保持可扩展性与抗提示注入鲁棒性。局限方面：预算粒度受限于激活智能体数量这一粗略代理，依赖难度预测器与复杂度标注元数据，原子核为领域特定且需离线训练。

title: Credit-assigned Policy Gradient for Early Stage Retrieval in Two-stage Ranking
summary: Large-scale search, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically employ a two-stage architecture: an early-stage ranker (ESR) generates a candidate set, which is subsequently re-ranked by a late-stage ranker (LSR). While there are many reinforcement learning (RL) methods for training the LSR, end-to-end training of the ESR has proven challenging. In particular, naive application of "vanilla" policy gradient (V-PG) is not scalable for candidate-set sizes relevant for practical use due to exploding variance. This issue arises because V-PG propagates the gradient to the joint probability of the candidate sets, ignoring the contribution of each specific item in the candidate set to the reward. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel "credit-assigned" policy gradient (CA-PG), which computes gradients with respect to the probability that the target item is chosen in any candidate set, i.e. marginalizing over all candidate sets that contain it. Our theoretical analysis reveals that CA-PG significantly reduces the variance of V-PG by marginalizing over the specific composition of the candidate set, while preserving the ability to learn the correct ranking of items under a reasonably aligned LSR policy. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that CA-PG improves the convergence speed and training stability for ESRs utilizing the canonical Plackett-Luce model, especially when the candidate-set size is large.

AI.tldr: 论文针对两阶段检索系统中早期排序器（ESR）的训练难题，提出信用分配策略梯度（CA-PG）方法，通过边际化候选集组成来降低策略梯度方差，在保持与后期排序器对齐的前提下，显著提升大规模候选集场景下的训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有策略梯度方法（V-PG）在大规模候选集场景下梯度方差爆炸，难以规模化应用。原因在于V-PG将梯度传播到候选集的联合概率分布，忽略了个别候选项对奖励的独立贡献。
AI.method: 提出信用分配策略梯度（CA-PG），通过将梯度计算从联合概率转换为目标项被选中的边际概率（即对所有包含该目标的候选集求边际），实现方差缩减。
AI.result: 实验证明，CA-PG在Plackett-Luce模型下显著提升收敛速度和训练稳定性，尤其在大规模候选集场景。
AI.conclusion: CA-PG显著改善了大规模候选集场景下ESR训练的收敛速度和稳定性，为两阶段检索系统的端到端优化提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Xe-Forge: Multi-Stage LLM-Powered Kernel Optimization for Intel GPU
summary: Porting deep learning algorithms to new hardware accelerators requires developers to repeatedly apply the same low-level optimizations -- quantization, memory access coalescing, tile size tuning, and architecture-specific workarounds -- to every Triton kernel in their code-base. This manual, repetitive effort is a major bottleneck: each kernel demands the same cycle of trial-and-error profiling against hardware constraints that vary across devices, yet the underlying optimization patterns remain largely consistent. We present Xe-Forge, a multi-stage LLM-powered pipeline that automates this process for Intel GPU. Given a functionally correct Triton kernel, the system applies up to nine optimization stages -- from algorithmic restructuring and operator fusion through block pointer modernization, GPU-specific tuning, and open-ended discovery -- each driven by a Chain-of-Verification-and-Refinement (CoVeR) agent that generates candidates, validates them on real hardware, and iterates on failures. A curated knowledge base encodes Intel GPU constraints (power-of-two warp counts, GRF modes, SLM sizing) that are absent from LLM training data, keeping the model within architecturally valid bounds. We evaluate Xe-Forge on 97 Level-2 KernelBench kernels and Flash Attention on the Intel Arc Pro B70, achieving a 1.17x geometric mean speedup over PyTorch eager with 67% of kernels improving, nine kernels exceeding 5x (up to 82x), and 2--13.3x speedups on Flash Attention across all tested configurations without regression -- demonstrating that structured domain knowledge with hardware-in-the-loop verification can systematically eliminate the repetitive porting effort that currently gates algorithm deployment on new accelerators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Xe-Forge：一个面向 Intel Xe GPU 的多阶段 LLM 自动化 Triton kernel 优化流水线。它在已功能正确的 Triton kernel 上，自动执行“分析 + 九大优化阶段”（算法重构、开放发现、dtype 修正、算子融合、访存优化、block pointer 现代化、persistent kernel、GPU 专属调优、autotuning），每个阶段由自研的 CoVeR（Chain-of-Verification-and-Refinement，DSPy 实现）代理驱动：生成候选→在真实硬件上按“语法/结构与硬件约束/正确性/性能”四级验证→依据具体错误反馈迭代精修；并以 YAML 知识库编码 LLM 训练数据中缺失的 Intel GPU 约束（warp 数为 2 的幂、GRF 模式、SLM 容量、GROUP_SIZE_M swizzle），由 LLM planner 在硬依赖约束下决定阶段顺序并跳过无问题阶段。在 Intel Arc Pro B70 上对 97 个 KernelBench Level-2 kernel 与 16 组 Flash Attention 配置评测：相对 PyTorch eager 几何均速 1.17×，67% kernel 提升，9 个 kernel 超 5×（最高 82×），Flash Attention 全配置 2–13.3× 且无回退，正确率 100%。核心论点是：面向特定硬件的 kernel 优化中，结构化领域知识 + 硬件在环验证的收益高于单纯扩大模型规模。
AI.motivation:
将深度学习算法迁移到新加速器（如 Intel Arc/Arc Pro）时，开发者必须对代码库中每个 Triton kernel 重复执行同一套底层优化：量化、访存合并、tile 尺寸调优、架构特定 workaround。这些工作高度重复，且每个 kernel 都要经历“试错—剖析—修复”的循环，构成算法落地的主要瓶颈。

现有 LLM-based kernel 工作存在三个空白：(1) 几乎全部聚焦于“kernel 生成”（PyTorch→Triton 或自然语言→新 kernel），而非“对已有 kernel 做目标架构特化优化”；现实中大量组织维护的是功能正确但性能次优的 Triton 库，需要的是精修而非重写。(2) 目标硬件集中在 NVIDIA（少量 AMD），Intel GPU 完全空白。(3) Intel Xe 的关键约束——warp 数量、tile 尺寸、GRF 模式、SLM 容量与层级结构——既不在 LLM 训练语料中，也不被现有智能体的知识库覆盖，导致模型退回到 NVIDIA 中心化启发式（如 num_warps=8、128×128 tile）。此外，传统自动调优器（OpenTuner、Kernel Tuner、Ansor）只能搜索固定 kernel 结构内的数值参数，无法做算法重构、dtype 变更、算子融合或 block pointer/GRF 注解等架构化变换。
AI.method:
一、总体架构（分阶段流水线）
输入为功能正确的 Triton kernel。先经分析阶段（LLM 分析器输出带严重度 1–5、修复建议与预期加速区间的问题清单，固定分类法 30+ 类），随后由 LLM planner 在“硬依赖约束（语义作用域递减原则）”下决定阶段顺序：Algorithmic/Discovery → Dtype → Fusion；Memory access → Block pointers；Fusion/Block pointers → GPU-specific → Autotuning。planner 失败时回退默认序列 Algorithmic→Discovery→Dtype→Fusion→Memory→Block Pointers→Persistent→GPU-specific→Autotuning。问题类型通过固定路由表确定性映射到唯一阶段，无关联问题的阶段被跳过（降低 LLM 成本与代码震荡）；每阶段结束后重新调用分析器同步问题集（既可消解跨阶段问题，也可发现新引入的如寄存器压力问题）。支持 best-of-k 独立重跑整条流水线并按实测加速挑选最优候选（默认 k=1）。

二、CoVeR 代理
DSPy Module，参数为 signature（原始代码/当前代码/阶段/问题/知识模式/GPU 配置 → 优化后代码）、工具集（compile_and_verify）、成功哨兵字符串。维护增长式 key–value 轨迹（thoughts、工具调用、观测），每步将完整轨迹拼入 prompt。循环 T=5：LLM 产出 next_thought 与候选代码 → 送入所有工具 → 若返回成功哨兵立即返回；否则将结构化错误作为下一步上下文。若耗尽迭代，调用 ChainOfThought 抽取器做 best-effort 输出，并仍经四级验证，验证失败则返回原 kernel（保证流水线不降级已可用 kernel），失败样本连同阶段与时间戳落盘。轨迹超长时按“thought/工具名/参数/观测”四元组从最旧端截断，若仅剩一次调用仍超限则报错而非无诊断上下文运行。

三、四级验证级联
(1) 语法：ast.parse，失败返回行号、错误类型与出错源码行；(2) 结构与硬件约束：Triton/triton.language 导入、@triton.jit 装饰、Model 包装类存在，num_warps 必须为 2 的幂，block 维度为 2 的幂且 ≤256，违规给出可执行修复提示（如 “INVALID num_warps=24…”）；(3) 正确性：原始与优化 kernel 用同一权重（seeded 初始化 + state_dict 拷贝）同输入运行，torch.allclose（rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-5）比对，不匹配时给出可能原因（stride 错误、load 转置、缺边界检查）；(4) 性能：硬件事件计时（含 warmup、L2 cache flush、同步屏障），若变慢则回传两次时间、TFLOPS 与替代优化建议。仅“正确且更快”才返回成功哨兵——按严重度递进避免无效测量。

四、九大优化阶段
(1) Analysis（不改代码，仅产出问题清单）；(2) Algorithmic：利用矩阵对称性、公共子表达式消除、循环不变量外提、代数化简、树形归约替代串行累加等降低 FLOP 与访存；(3) Discovery：处理 open_ended 问题，要求给出变更内容、数学有效性论证、前后代码草图与加速估计（如把 sum(x@W.T, dim=1) 改写为 x@W.sum(dim=0) 以消除 O(MNK) GEMM、跨 forward 缓存权重统计）；(4) Dtype fix：消除 float64 浪费、去除多余精度、冗余输入转换（输入/输出 fp16/bf16、累加 fp32，在敏感边界插 cast）；(5) Fusion：合并独立 kernel 与 elementwise 链、归约与后续 pointwise 折叠、消除 noop，并处理寄存器压力超限与“融合替代厂商库调用”等子类；(6) Memory access：合并访问、边界掩码、prefetch、非连续输入、寄存器生命期与压力（重排 load/store）；(7) Block pointers：将手工指针算术改写为 tl.make_block_ptr，并修正 boundary_check 传布尔（应为整数元组）、tl.multiple_of 误用于标量等误用（shape/strides/order 错误会造成静默正确性失败）；(8) Persistent kernel：固定线程块数遍历全部 tile 以摊薄 launch 开销、支持跨 tile SLM 复用，并把硬编码 program 数改为按 EU 数运行时推导；(9) GPU-specific：Intel 专属调优（32 warps 达到峰值占用、large/small GRF 模式注解、shape-aware tile 尺寸、GROUP_SIZE_M swizzle、权重重排/转置缓存、tile 串行化、sigmoid 慢路径）；(10) Autotuning：基于硬件查询生成至多 12 个架构合法且按预期性能排序的配置网格。

五、知识库
YAML 组织为 constraints / patterns / full-code examples 三类共 84 条、6 个文件（gpu_optimizations、memory_patterns、fusion_patterns、persistent_kernel、correctness、dtype_optimizations）。constraints 编码硬规则（critical/info 分级 + 正误示例），如 boundary_check 必须是整数维度元组、autotune 参数不得在签名中重复声明默认值、启用 swizzle 时 launch grid 必须一维、batch 偏移需转 int64 防指针溢出、Stream-K 原子累加需预清零输出。patterns 为带目标阶段、理由、预期加速区间与适用性列表（gemm/compute_bound 等）的前后变换，其中 memory access 21 条、GPU 专属 20 条最多。examples/ 提供 9 组完整“未优化→已优化”kernel 对（GEMM+激活融合、转置矩阵乘 + block pointer 等），作 few-shot 演示。format_for_llm(stage) 按阶段选择性注入（critical 约束始终注入），加载器归一化阶段别名并跳过未知阶段标签；新增硬件目标只需新增 YAML，无需改代码。

六、GPU 硬件查询系统
主路径 torch.xpu.get_device_properties()，备路 xpu-smi JSON 解析；获取 EU 数、subslice/slice 数、最大 CU、work group 与 subgroup size、全局与 SLM 容量、FP16/BF16/FP64 支持标志，按 GPU 家族（Arc/Arc Pro/集显）选择默认 warp 数、GRF 模式与基础 tile。get_optimal_params() 做形状感知调优：tile 尺寸夹取为不超过对应维度的最大 2 的幂以免 padding 浪费线程；瘦长矩阵用非对称 tile（BLOCK_M 或 BLOCK_N 偏大）；估测 tile 内存 (BLOCK_M×BLOCK_K+BLOCK_K×BLOCK_N)×bytes 超过 GRF 容量（large 64KB / small 32KB）则缩减 BLOCK_K；GROUP_SIZE_M 在 tile 数 <16 时取 1，否则目标每 SM 约 4 组；warp 数与流水级数分别随 tile 与 K 维度伸缩。

七、AI Bench 验证基础设施
将执行、计时、正确性检查与优化逻辑解耦。harness core 定义 YAML 问题契约（inputs 块含符号维度/dtype/取值范围/10 种初始化变换如 scale、softmax、triu、rademacher；variants 块绑定具体维度并以安全 AST 求值器计算 FLOP 与字节公式；ci / bench-cpu / bench-gpu 三档）；runner 层提供 KernelRunner 与 KernelBenchRunner；testing 层提供统一 time(fn,args,device)。GPU 计时流程：warmup（GPU 默认 200 次，迭代间刷新 256MB L2 buffer）、预分配 torch.Event 对、测量循环（默认 100 次，每次先清 L2 cache，再用 1024³ dummy matmul 填充命令流使 CPU 有足够时间入队计时事件，最后统一同步），剔除极值后取均值；CPU 路径用 ProfilerActivity.CPU 同策略。指标含 TFLOPS 与内存带宽（FLOP/字节数可由 spec 声明或用 FlopCounterMode / MemoryCounter 估算，估算值加警告标记）。正确性检查跨后端统一播种、state_dict 拷贝（失败则按形状匹配的位置拷贝）、输入克隆防就地修改、no_grad 下前向，allclose 不匹配时输出最大/平均绝对差、最大相对差与超容元素计数比例，并检查 NaN/Inf。结果经 CSVLogger 落盘为每变体一行（含 TFLOPS、带宽、微秒耗时、维度 JSON、note），并自动捕获 AIBENCH_ 前缀环境变量列以追踪硬件配置。优化器仅通过两个接口消费它：KernelBenchExecutor.compare_kernels() 返回含两次计时、加速比、正确性标志与面向 CoVeR 的反馈信息的 ComparisonResult；spec loader 转换 YAML 为形状/FLOP/dtype。

八、Harness 隔离（对抗性优化防护）
Model(nn.Module) 包装、输入生成与执行路径由 KernelBench 规格与 AI Bench 固定，LLM 只能修改 @triton.jit 函数体与 autotune 配置，无法通过动态导入/字符串拼接（文中给出用 __import__('torch').nn.functional 与 ''.join(['fu','nctional']) 规避过滤的示例）把 kernel 偷换为 PyTorch 分派，从而消除“优化成功信号而非任务本身”的规避面。

九、实验配置
Intel Arc Pro B70（Battlemage，32 Xe2 核、256 XMX 引擎、32GB GDDR6、256-bit、608 GB/s）；Intel Triton GPU 后端经 SPIR-V，PyTorch 2 + torch.xpu；基线为 torch.compile(TorchInductor)；LLM 为 GPT-5.4（temperature 1.0，56k 上下文），DSPy 3.x，AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS=3，MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_STAGE=5，k=1；初始 Triton kernel 由 KernelFalcon（KernelAgent）生成（其对 250 个 KernelBench 问题 100% 功能正确）。
AI.result:
1) KernelBench Level-2 共 97 个 kernel（GEMM 19、MatMul 17、BMM 1、Conv2D 21、Conv3D 12、ConvTranspose2D 10、ConvTranspose3D 17），对比 PyTorch eager、torch.compile、未优化 KernelFalcon Triton 三基线：相对 PyTorch eager 几何均速 1.17×，67% kernel 获得提升；9 个 kernel 超 5×（9×–82×，最大为 Matmul_Min_Subtract 的 82×）；GEMM/MatMul 相对最优基线几何均速分别 1.28× 与 1.76×。BMM 家族单例 BMM_InstanceNorm_Sum_ResidualAdd_Multiply 达 23×（torch.compile 仅 1.1×），源于把 post-BMM 归约+归一化链融合为单趟、消除中间张量物化。Conv2D 多数 1.0–2.2×（个别到 2.8×），kernel 44（ConvTranspose2d_Multiply_GlobalAvgPool_Mean）7.5×；Conv3D 带宽受限，0.9–1.3×；ConvTranspose3D 0.5–1.2×；少量卷积 kernel 出现 0.5–0.8× 的温和回退（回退来自 CoVeR fallback 返回原 kernel，而 KernelFalcon 起点本身不适配 Intel）。

2) 正确性 100%：所有 kernel 通过 rtol=1e-2/atol=1e-5 的 allclose 检查，回退均为“正确但较慢”，非正确性失败。

3) Roofline 分析（FP16 峰值 ~160 TFLOPS，带宽 608 GB/s）：GEMM/MatMul 处于计算受限（10²–10⁴ FLOP/Byte），三后端多数聚集在 60–160 TFLOPS；kernel 14/76/68/18/98 等“超峰值”点源于算法重构（如 GEMM+归约折叠为向量–矩阵乘）降低有效 FLOP 而原 FLOP 计数不变，故并非真实硬件吞吐超越。Conv2D 跨越带宽/计算过渡区（10¹–10³），低强度端贴带宽斜率；Conv3D 沿带宽斜率 3–90 TFLOPS；ConvTranspose3D 分布 10⁰–10³，低强度端各后端均远低于 roofline（launch 开销与不规则访问）。

4) Flash Attention（16 组 LLM serving 配置，覆盖 7B–70B 模型、S=2048–32768、非 2 的幂头数 A=71 与非标准头维 D=96、批量 B=2/4/8）：全部配置 2–13.3× 加速且无回退；S≥16384 达 9–13.3×，S=2048–4096 为 2–4.4×；roofline 上原 kernel 仅 5–15 TFLOPS（低于峰值 5–30×），优化后升至 40–90 TFLOPS，残留 1.5–3× 差距；S=32768 时朴素实现每头需约 4GB 分数矩阵（FP16），经 SLM 尺寸约束下的分块与 persistent 阶段改造后 32k 上下文在 32GB 设备上可行。

5) 成本：最坏情况每 kernel 约 40–50 次 LLM 调用（9 阶段×5 次 CoVeR 迭代 + 分析 + 重分析），典型 kernel 因跳阶段降至 10–20 次；按 API 价约 $0.50–2.00/kernel。

6) 失效模式归纳：(a) 训练数据中不存在的新型算法模式（自定义 attention 变体、稀疏算子、新激活）优化质量差；(b) 复杂多 kernel 交互（Level-3 架构中一个 kernel 的优化改变下游 kernel 期望的内存布局）当前 per-kernel 流水线无法跨 kernel 推理；(c) 编译器级失败（某些在 NVIDIA 合法的 Triton 构造如特定 tl.atomic 变体、tl.reduce 分解在 SPIR-V lowering 时失败）在 T=5 迭代预算内无法诊断 opaque 编译器错误。
AI.conclusion:
本文的核心主张是：面向特定硬件的 kernel 优化中，“结构化领域知识 + 硬件在环验证”的收益高于单纯扩大模型规模——LLM 已掌握 Triton 语法与通用优化原则，仅缺 Intel Xe 特有约束；用数百行 YAML 知识库补齐该缺口（32 warps、large GRF、SLM 容量、swizzle 条件）比在 Intel 专用 kernel 语料上微调更经济。

主要贡献：(1) 提出“Triton-to-Triton 优化”形式化，与既有 PyTorch-to-Triton 生成互补，在保留原语义前提下做架构特化；(2) 首个面向 Intel GPU 的 LLM kernel 优化系统，附硬件感知知识库；(3) 多阶段 CoVeR 流水线，把优化分解为有依赖约束与独立验证标准的子问题；(4) AI Bench 测量框架，将执行/计时/正确性与优化逻辑解耦，支持 PyTorch、torch.compile、Triton 等后端与 YAML 问题契约；(5) kernel harness 隔离，从架构上消除“模型绕过 benchmark 走捷径”的对抗性优化面。

局限与后续：(1) 近期最有价值的方向是降低回退率——引入逐阶段的 pre/post 性能比较与回滚机制；(2) 扩展知识库与 planner 至更多 Intel 架构、Xe 世代与非 Intel 目标以检验阶段分解的通用性，估算移植新 Triton 后端约需 2–3 天工程量（主要花在 pattern 撰写上）；(3) 从优化历史中学习，把成功变换作为未来 kernel 的 few-shot 示例，提升首轮成功率并降低 LLM 成本；(4) 引入跨算子边界的多 kernel/模型图级优化；(5) 引入 SOL-ExecBench 式硬件在环（speed-of-light）指标替代单纯相对软件基线的加速比；(6) 以蒸馏小模型承载流水线决策以压缩每 kernel 成本。

title: BrickAnything: Geometry-Conditioned Buildable Brick Generation with Structure-Aware Tokenization
summary: Generating physically buildable brick structures from 3D shapes requires more than geometric reconstruction: the output must also satisfy discrete part constraints and structural stability. Existing brick generation methods either rely on heuristic optimization, which can break down when the target 3D shape does not admit a feasible structure under predefined constraints, or generate brick sequences without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D geometry and assembly relations. In this work, we present BrickAnything, a geometry-conditioned autoregressive framework for generating buildable brick structures from diverse 3D representations. BrickAnything uses point clouds as a unified geometric interface and predicts brick sequences that reconstruct the target shape under assembly constraints. To model structural dependencies among bricks, we introduce a structure-aware tree tokenization, which represents brick structures through local attachment relations. This formulation makes sequence generation more consistent with the physical construction process, and reduces invalid intermediate states. We further introduce preference-based alignment post-training, validity-constrained decoding and adaptive rollback to improve buildability objectives such as stability and geometric fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BrickAnything produces geometrically faithful and physically realizable brick structures, and that the proposed tokenization effectively reduces rollback and regeneration compared with conventional ordering strategies.

AI.tldr: BrickAnything是一种几何条件自回归框架，用于从各种3D表示生成可构建的砖块结构。该方法使用点云作为统一接口，通过结构感知树分词化表示砖块结构的局部连接关系，使序列生成更符合物理构建过程。结合偏好对齐后训练、有效性约束解码和自适应回滚策略，提高了结构的稳定性和几何保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有砖块生成方法存在局限性：启发式优化在目标3D形状无法满足预定义约束时会失效；而生成砖块序列的方法未显式建模底层3D几何和装配关系。
AI.method: 提出一种几何条件自回归框架BrickAnything，使用点云作为统一几何接口，预测重建目标形状的砖块序列；引入结构感知树分词化方法，通过局部连接关系表示砖块结构；采用基于偏好的对齐后训练、有效性约束解码和自适应回滚策略来增强可构建性。
AI.result: BrickAnything能生成几何保真且物理可实现的砖块结构；所提出的分词化方法相比传统排序策略有效减少了回滚和重新生成。
AI.conclusion: BrickAnything能生成几何准确且物理可实现的砖块结构，其提出的分词化方法相比传统排序策略有效减少了回滚和重新生成的情况。

title: Self-Verified Distillation: Your Language Model Is Secretly Its Own Synthetic Data Pipeline
summary: Can post-trained large language models (LLMs) further improve themselves using only unlabeled prompts, without external teachers or feedback from tools? We study this setting starting only from unlabeled seed questions with no ground-truth solutions, across three reasoning domains: math, science, and coding. We propose Self-Verified Distillation, a simple post-training refinement algorithm in which the model generates candidate solutions to these seed questions, filters them using prompt-based self-verification, and trains on the resulting self-curated dataset. Inspired by the UQ benchmark's use of multiple validators to screen candidate answers to hard unsolved questions, we adapt this validation-based filtering idea to self-training: the model filters its own generated solutions through a three-stage cascade of cycle-consistency, factuality, and correctness checks, accepting a solution only if it passes all stages with unanimous judge votes. We find that sampling more candidate generations and using a larger verification budget during training data construction produces higher-quality self-curated data and, in turn, better reasoning models. We then train Qwen3 models at multiple scales with Self-Verified Distillation and obtain gains across all three domains. For Qwen3-4B, our method improves aggregate held-out pass@1 by +16.7 points in math (AIME26 and HMMT), +11.1 points in science (GPQA Diamond and HLE), and +8.3 points in coding (LCBv5 and LCBv6), with gains also extending to 0.6B and 8B models. Compared to our test-time-only baseline (UQ-TTC), which improves performance by spending extra compute at inference time, Self-Verified Distillation achieves better performance in most settings while requiring only a single inference call at test time.

AI.tldr: Self-Verified Distillation通过自生成-自验证-自训练的三阶段流程，实现LLM的纯自我提升，采样更多候选解和使用更大验证预算可提升数据质量和模型性能。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM能否仅依靠无标注提示词进行自我提升，无需外部教师或工具反馈。
AI.method: 提出自验证蒸馏(SVD)：模型生成候选解，通过三轮级联过滤(循环一致性、事实性、正确性)，仅当所有验证器一致通过时接受解，然后用自筛选数据微调模型自身。
AI.result: Qwen3-4B在三个领域均获显著提升：数学AIME26/HMMT +16.7分，科学GPQA Diamond/HLE +11.1分，编程LCBv5/LCBv6 +8.3分；0.6B和8B模型也有提升。
AI.conclusion: SVD在数学(+16.7)、科学(+11.1)、编程(+8.3)领域均取得显著提升，优于测试时计算方法(UQ-TTC)，推理时仅需单次调用。

title: GEM: Geometric Entropy Mixing for Optimal LLM Data Curation
summary: LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume. Yet, optimal mixing is hindered by categorization flaws: human taxonomies suffer from ontological misalignment, and Euclidean clustering fails to address embedding anisotropy. We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer. By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics. We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation. Experiments with 1.1B-parameter models demonstrate that GEM establishes a new state-of-the-art when integrated into mixing strategies like DoReMi and RegMix, improving average downstream accuracy by up to 1.2% and offering a robust coordinate system for predictable data mixing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GEM（Geometric Entropy Mixing）：一个面向 LLM 预训练数据混合（data mixing）的几何感知型无监督分类框架。核心思想是把"数据分类/聚类"从欧氏空间 K-Means 转为单位超球面上的变分问题——用 von Mises–Fisher (vMF) 混合模型建模文本嵌入的方向分布，固定均匀生成先验 α_k=1/K 以解耦"生成先验"与"经验簇质量"，并加上一项 mixing-balance 正则（惩罚簇质量偏离均匀分布），从而抑制嵌入各向异性（cone effect）导致的簇塌缩（cluster collapse），发现欧氏方法看不见的细粒度长尾语义结构。方法上推导了可证明单调上升的 MM（Minorize-Maximize）算法：E 步用正则项的全局二次下界构造 MM surrogate，M 步对 (μ_k, κ_k) 做闭式更新；再以 Teacher–Student 蒸馏（GEM 作 Teacher，FastText 作 Student）实现对万亿 token 级语料的线性时间扩展；并提出 Geometric Influence Score (GIS) 依据"分配确定性 + 方向一致性 + 簇内局部支撑"挑选代表样本，交由 LLM 汇总生成可解释的语义分类体系。在 1.1B 参数模型、25B token 预算、RefinedWeb 清洗的 CommonCrawl 上，OLMES 9 个基准的三维度平均分在 DoReMi / Perf / RegMix 三种混合框架下分别达 43.95 / 44.79 / 41.45，优于 K-Means、Spherical K-Means、TOS、WebOrganizer（Topic/Format），最高提升约 1.2%；RegMix 可预测性探针显示 GEM 诱导的混合坐标 Spearman 相关更高且方差更小；消融显示从欧氏几何到黎曼几何再到加入正则呈单调增益。局限：仅在 1.1B/25B token 的早期缩放区间验证，尚未在多万亿 token 与更大架构上检验。
AI.motivation: LLM 预训练效果越来越取决于数据"配方"而非单纯的数据规模，任何有原则的混合策略都前提于把海量无结构语料切分为语义可分、规模均衡的簇。但现有两类分类范式存在根本缺陷：(1) 基于人工分类体系的方法（如 WebOrganizer、TnT-LLM、TOS）存在"本体错位"——人类中心类别不反映模型自监督学习所需的潜在语义粒度，且标注一致性低、LLM 大规模标注成本不可持续；(2) 无监督欧氏聚类（K-Means、HDBSCAN）与现代神经嵌入（BGE、RoBERTa）的内在几何不匹配——嵌入位于为余弦相似度优化的高维超球面，并存在各向异性（"锥形效应"）与 hubness，导致距离集中、欧氏邻近失去语义意义，引发"簇塌缩"，主流簇吞并语义长尾，损害多样性。现有混合算法（DoReMi、DoGE、Aioli、RegMix、SampleMix、TikMix、QuadMix）普遍把分类当作外生常量，其效果被初始划分质量上界限制。
AI.method: GEM 把无监督语义划分重构为单位超球面 S^{d-1} 上的变分问题：以 von Mises–Fisher 混合模型（movMF）为方向似然，生成先验 α_k ≡ 1/K 固定（切断标准 EM 中混合权重的"富者愈富"反馈），并把 mixing-balance 正则项加在经验质量 π(Γ) = (1/N)Σγ_ik 上：max ELBO − (λ/2)‖π(Γ) − u‖²（λ>0）。理论方面：Lemma 3.1（Ledoux 超球面集中现象，P(|⟨x,p⟩| ≤ ε) ≥ 1 − 2exp(−dε²/2)）；Proposition 3.2 证明平衡正则 R(π) 为凹、梯度 ∇π_k R = −λ(π_k − u_k)、且 λ-光滑（Hessian = −λI_K），从而获得全局二次下界 minorizer；Theorem A.1 证明 MM 迭代给出目标值的单调非减序列。推断：E-step 构造 MM 代理函数（凹，用投影/镜像上升近似求解），M-step 闭式更新 μ_k = r_k/(‖r_k‖+ε)、κ_k ≈ R̄_k(d − R̄_k³)/(1 − R̄_k²)（高维近似）。可解释性：提出 Geometric Influence Score，GIS_k(x_i) = log(γ_ik+ε) + log f_vMF(x_i|μ_k,κ_k) + β log(ρ_k(x_i)+ε)，其中 ρ_k 为簇内受限的 M 近邻余弦局部密度，用于挑选代表样本并提示 LLM 生成语义标签，构成可解释分类体系。系统扩展：Teacher–Student 蒸馏——GEM 在种子语料上作 Teacher，按 GIS 做簇内均衡 Top-M 采样生成伪标签，蒸馏到轻量 FastText 学生分类器（全语料推理近线性、常数级延迟），并输出 K 个主题上的概率分布供下游混合使用。实验设定：CommonCrawl 经 RefinedWeb 式清洗，1.1B 参数 LLaMA 风格 Transformer，固定 25B token 预算（AdamW，峰值 lr 4e-4，2k 步线性 warmup + 余弦退火，global batch 256，序列长 2048，8×RTX 5090，Llama-Factory）；主实验 K=24、λ=5000；下游用 OLMES 框架 9 个零样本基准分三组（Science QA / Commonsense Reasoning / Logic & Linguistics）；基线含 K-Means、Spherical K-Means、TOS、WebOrganizer Topic/Format，混合策略含 DoReMi、Perf、RegMix；另设 RegMix 可预测性探针（256 个混合向量、1M 参数代理模型、80/20 划分、10 次划分平均 Spearman ρ）、主题一致性 NPMI/C_V、GIS 选样消融（720 样本标注）、λ 与种子语料规模敏感性、AIGC 污染鲁棒性（掺入 Cosmopedia 合成语料）、下采样 5B→25B 试点实验。
AI.result: 1) 下游表现（Table 1）：GEM 在三种混合框架下均取得最佳平均分——DoReMi 43.95（最强基线 WebOrganizer Format 42.79，+1.16；Commonsense +1.23、Logic & Linguistics +1.76）、Perf 44.79（基线 44.25，+0.54）、RegMix 41.45（基线 40.77，+0.68）。2) 消融（Fig.6）呈单调提升：K-Means 38.5 → Spherical K-Means 40.6 → Vanilla vMF 41.3 → GEM 42.1（Science QA 36.0、Logic & Linguistics 57.0），表明几何替换与正则项各自有效。3) 学生分类器测试精度：GEM 伪标签 75.13% vs K-Means 72.92%，说明 GEM 划分边界更清晰、标签噪声更低。4) 主题一致性：GEM NPMI −0.0728 / C_V 0.4928，与 WebOrganizer Topic（−0.0700 / 0.4943）相当但完全无监督。5) GIS 选样消融：随机 80.41、仅置信度 80.83、仅中心度 81.67、GIS 84.17（最高）。6) 可预测性探针（Fig.4）：GEM 的 RegMix 预测损失与真值 Spearman ρ 更高且分布更紧，说明混合单纯形条件数更好、因子纠缠更少。7) 敏感性：λ=5000 最佳（43.68→44.79，λ=10000 回落至 44.05）；K 在 12→36 单调上升、36 处峰值 41.21%、48 时略降（过碎片化）；种子语料 1B token 已具竞争力（44.37），3B 默认最优（44.79），10B 仅微弱提升（44.86）；学得 κ 均值 881–943、随 K 增大而升高，说明簇在球面上紧致。8) 鲁棒性：RefinedWeb 过滤后 Binoculars 估计 AIGC 占比 <0.5%；混入 Cosmopedia 时 K-Means 把 37.5% 合成数据塞进两个巨簇，而 GEM 保持均衡无全局塌缩。9) 试点实验：5B→25B token 平均精度 41.05%→42.12% 单调上升，其中 Science QA/Commonsense 持续增益，Logic & Linguistics 在 5B 后较早平台期。10) 3D t-SNE 显示多个可分辨局部邻域与稠密区重叠，符合真实语义邻近而非标签噪声。
AI.conclusion: GEM 提供了一个几何感知的预训练数据无监督分类框架：将语义划分与超球面嵌入结构对齐，通过 vMF 混合 + 显式 mixing-balance 正则化 + MM 推断（单调上升可证）抑制各向异性引发的簇塌缩，得到语义连贯且规模均衡的划分；再通过 Teacher–Student 蒸馏（FastText）扩展到网络级语料，并用 GIS 支撑可解释分类体系。1.1B/25B token 实验显示其在 DoReMi、Perf、RegMix 三类混合框架下一致提升下游平均精度（最高约 +1.2%），并提供条件数更好、可预测性更强的"混合坐标系"。局限与展望：当前仅为早期缩放信号，需在多万亿 token、多架构上验证；GIS 作为独立选样原语待挖掘；需监控 AIGC 污染等分布漂移；并可探索分类体系发现与下游目标的双层协同优化，形成自改进闭环。需注意的文本瑕疵：附录表号引用有误（Table 5/6 标题重复）、正文有"An Minorize–Maximize"等笔误，且 Fig.5 的 K=36 峰值（41.21）与主表 Perf 设置（44.79）不在同一口径，消融数值亦与主表不同，比较时需核对实验配置差异。

title: RT-RkNN: Reverse k Nearest Neighbor Queries as a Graphics Ray Casting Problem
summary: Reverse k nearest neighbor (RkNN) queries are fundamental in spatial databases, location-based analytics, and recommendation systems. Existing state-of-the-art techniques rely on spatial pruning supported by R-trees and their variants. However, their pruning effectiveness degrades significantly in challenging scenarios where the number of facilities is small, the user population is dense, or the value of k is large. To overcome these limitations, this work reformulates the RkNN query problem in two-dimensional geometric spaces as a graphics ray-casting problem, where users are modeled as rays and facilities are represented as geometric primitives. Based on this formulation, the first algorithm and implementation exploiting dedicated hardware ray-tracing cores on modern GPUs are developed. This novel approach preserves strong filtering performance even for large values of k, dense user populations, and highly sparse facility distributions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms across diverse settings, particularly in scenarios where traditional pruning strategies become inefficient.

AI.tldr: 本文将RkNN查询问题创新性地转化为GPU光线投射问题，利用GPU专用光线追踪硬件实现高效查询，在传统R树方法表现不佳的挑战性场景中展现出显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有基于R树及其变体的空间剪枝技术的剪枝有效性在以下场景中显著下降：设施数量少、用户群体密集、或k值较大。这些挑战性场景限制了传统方法的应用范围。
AI.method: 将二维空间中的RkNN查询问题重新建模为图形光线投射问题：用户建模为射线(rays)，设施表示为几何图元(geometric primitives)。基于此公式化，开发了首个利用现代GPU专用硬件光线追踪核心的算法和实现方案。
AI.result: 该方法在大k值、密集用户群体和高度稀疏设施分布等场景下均优于现有最优算法，尤其是在传统剪枝策略失效的情况下表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 首次利用现代GPU专用硬件光线追踪核心实现RkNN查询算法，在大k值、密集用户群和稀疏设施分布等挑战性场景中显著优于现有最优方法。

title: Examining the Challenges of Intellectual Property in AI-Generated Productions
summary: With the advancement of artificial intelligence systems capable of autonomously generating artistic, literary, musical works, and even inventions without direct human intervention, the intellectual property (IP) regime faces unprecedented questions and challenges. The most critical issue concerns the ownership of moral and economic rights in the absence of a human creator, and how such outputs can be granted legal protection. This paper first reviews the theoretical foundations and existing literature in this domain, then comparatively examines Iranian legal frameworks such as the 1969 Law for the Protection of Authors, Composers, and Artists Rights and the Patent and Trademark Registration Law-alongside other legal systems, including the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Furthermore, existing legal perspectives on the intellectual property of AI-generated works and the related enforcement challenges are analyzed. The findings reveal significant regulatory gaps within the current Iranian legal framework. To balance the promotion of innovation with the preservation of human creativity, revising existing laws and introducing novel approaches such as defining a specific intellectual property right for AI-generated works or designating ownership among associated human agents appears to be essential.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了AI自主生成作品情境下的知识产权保护问题，比较分析了伊朗法律框架（1969年版权法和专利商标注册法）与欧盟、英国、美国等体系的差异。研究发现伊朗现行法律存在显著监管缺口，建议通过修订现有法律或引入AI生成作品专项知识产权权利来解决归属问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统能够自主生成艺术、文学、音乐作品甚至发明成果，在缺乏人类创作者的情况下，知识产权制度面临道德权利和经济权利归属的前所未有的问题，以及如何为此类产出提供法律保护的挑战。
AI.method: 比较法研究方法：对照伊朗1969年《作者、作曲家和艺术家权利保护法》及《专利和商标注册法》与欧盟、英国、美国等法律体系，系统梳理现有法律视角下AI生成作品的知识产权保护问题及执法挑战。
AI.result: 揭示了现行伊朗法律框架中存在重大监管空白。
AI.conclusion: 建议修订现有法律框架，引入新型知识产权权利或指定相关人类主体作为所有权人，以平衡创新激励与人类创造力保护之间的张力。

title: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
summary: We present VISTA (VIsual Spec-To-App Benchmark), a benchmark for evaluating the end-to-end web-app generation capabilities of LLM-based agents. Unlike prior code generation benchmarks that focus on algorithmic tasks, VISTA targets realistic UI-centric development, where agents must produce functional, visually coherent applications from underspecified inputs. We define five prompt-information conditions that vary along two axes, visual/structural fidelity and stack constraint: (1) text only with free stack choice, (2) text with reference screenshots under three specified stacks, (3) text with reference screenshots under free stack choice, (4) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under a single specified stack, and (5) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under free stack choice. To enable robust evaluation, each page in the benchmark is manually annotated with interactive UI components and around three visual anchor points, addressing the well-known limitations of script-based testing tools such as Playwright in open-ended code generation settings. Evaluation combines DOM-grounded reference matching, behavior-specific browser tests, and CLIP-based visual similarity, jointly measuring structural alignment, behavioral completeness, and overall visual fidelity. We use VISTA to assess four agent systems drawn from two model families and two harnesses, finding that visual fidelity and functional correctness are partially decoupled across both input conditions and agents, and that agent editing style varies sharply but is largely orthogonal to task quality. VISTA establishes a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing agent-based software engineering research.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一个评估LLM智能体端到端Web应用生成能力的基准，通过多维度的信息条件和评估方法揭示了视觉保真度与功能正确性的解耦特性。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准聚焦于算法任务，缺乏对真实UI开发场景的评估；脚本化测试工具（如Playwright）在开放式代码生成场景中存在局限性，无法准确评估视觉保真度和功能正确性。
AI.method: 设计了5种提示信息条件（沿视觉/结构保真度和技术栈约束两个轴向变化），结合DOM参考匹配、浏览器行为测试和CLIP视觉相似度三种评估方法，对4个智能体系统进行评估。
AI.result: 发现视觉保真度与功能正确性在输入条件和智能体间呈现部分解耦；智能体的编辑风格差异显著但与任务质量基本正交。
AI.conclusion: VISTA为LLM智能体在UI开发任务中的能力评估提供了标准化、可复现的基准，推动基于智能体的软件工程研究的发展。

title: AgentSociety: Incentivizing Agentic Social Intelligence
summary: The success of deployed agents relies on their ability to handle open-ended user requests using their inherent capabilities, not only in solving requests directly but also in effectively leveraging inter-agent communication channels and feedback signals over time. This requires a multi-agent environment where agents can operate autonomously, strategically communicate, behave collaboratively and be driven by economic incentives, much like humans in society. Towards this vision, we propose $\mathtt{AgentSociety}$, a mechanism that enables decentralized agentic collaboration grounded in liquid democracy and information diffusion from social choice theory. We show that $\mathtt{AgentSociety}$ provides an environment for agents to make autonomous decisions utilizing their local context to maximize their utility while achieving collective outcomes through incentivized collaboration. Specifically, we prove that delegation to more competent neighbor agents is incentive compatible and naturally generates multi-agent routing path by consensus. Additionally, our mechanism incentivizes agents to selectively disclose information to their neighbor agents when doing so aligns with their self-interest, so as to garner influence. We characterize the Nash equilibrium showing that agent payoffs are reflective of their marginal contributions. We compare and benchmark strategy profiles adopted by open and proprietary state-of-the-art language models deployed in $\mathtt{AgentSociety}$ against best response. Finally, we evaluate collaborative performance from consensus-based routing among self-interested heterogeneous agents in $\mathtt{AgentSociety}$ on real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentSociety：一个面向 LLM 多智能体系统（LaMAS）的去中心化激励机制，其理论基础是社会选择论中的「流动民主」（liquid democracy）与信息扩散（diffusion auctions）。机制把用户请求分解为多任务后广播给所有异构智能体，智能体在本地信息下自主决定「投票委托（delegation）」与「能力信息扩散（diffusion）」，由一个透明账本（ledger）按票数共识生成跨任务的路由路径，并按「边际贡献」分配经济报酬。作者证明：向更具能力的邻居委托是激励相容的（弱占优）；过度扩散与欠度扩散都不可取，纳什均衡下智能体只披露刚好能赢得委托的最小能力值（c_i+ε）；均衡报酬反映真实边际贡献。实验显示，该机制在 MMLU-Pro、Open LLM Leaderboard v2、SWE-bench 上均优于「最优单智能体」基线（+1.9~+8.3pp），且任务越复杂增益越大（最高 +7.1pp），并可作为 LLM「社会智能」诊断基准（如 gpt-5-mini 委托一致性 81%，而 gpt-4o-mini 仅 45.7%）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测多集中于单智能体基准，或在（半）竞争型游戏环境中考察个体策略推理，均无法反映真实部署场景：智能体的成功不仅取决于独立解题，还取决于能否长期利用智能体间的通信渠道与历史反馈信号来完成超出自身能力的开放式请求。已有 LLM 多智能体系统多在训练阶段学习通信协议、强调 token 效率，未刻画交互的经济结构，异构智能体（乃至来自不同模型供应商）之间的跨任务补偿与激励驱动的涌现行为仍是空白；而 Dec-POMDP 类合作式形式化假设共享全局奖励，抹平了异质激励与局部目标，与真实去中心化部署不符。作者的核心目标是：仅用本地信息与经济激励，就诱导自利智能体产生「社会性」协作行为（引用 Castelfranchi：智能体不是因沟通而成为社会性主体，而是因具备社会性才去沟通），实现可持续的测试时（test-time）去中心化多智能体协作。
AI.method:
【形式化】将多智能体系统建模为无向图 G=(N,E)，社区结构划分智能体；每个智能体 n_i={base_i, state_i, tools_i, role_i}；整体建模为部分可观测随机博弈 POSG（各智能体有独立奖励函数，取决于能力、邻域与图中位置），而非共享全局奖励的 Dec-POMDP。状态 s^τ 含三部分：私有真实能力向量 c_i、邻居扩散而来的能力信号 ĉ_{j→i}^{<τ}、自身历史报酬 Π_i。任务 Ω(Q) 广播给全部智能体；仅具备该任务能力的智能体 T_{t_k} 可参与；委托仅限社区内边 E_intra，扩散可跨任意边 E。
【动作】a_i^τ = (c'_i, v_i, r_i)：向账本提交策略性能力报告、投票委托对象（保留自投或委托给邻居）、以及可选的跨任务连接声明。
【账本】透明非强制聚合器（common knowledge）：保留自投票者为 guru；V(g)=|D(g)|+1 为传递票数；跨任务通过代表委托者 n_d*=argmax 累计报告能力来桥接 guru；可行路径集 F 中选总票数最大者 P*。
【报酬】定义「关键节点」反事实审计（若某智能体改为自投则获胜路径改变则其为 critical），Theorem 4.2 证明关键集合构成连续委托链；报酬按单调函数 f(·) 的能力增量分配：p = I{c'_{i+1}>c'_i}·(f(c'_i) − f(c'_{i−1}))，guru 额外获得基础执行成本 c；总报酬 ∑p − p_mis（虚报惩罚，区分「许可的策略性信号」与「misreporting」）− p_inf（不可行连接惩罚）；总报酬与所执行 guru 的能力挂钩（∑p = c + f(c_g)），用户成本与所交付能力成正比。
【扩散】报酬作为反馈驱动下一轮的社会动作 h_j^τ（可附私密消息），扩散信号不直接影响报酬，仅前瞻性地影响邻居的委托，从而影响自己未来票数与报酬；核心张力是「影响力 vs 暴露」。
【理论结果】Theorem 4.1 委托激励相容（真报/高报/低报三情形穷举证明，委托给能力更高的邻居弱占优于自投）；Theorem 4.2 关键链连续性；Theorem 4.3 纳什均衡下的报告、扩散、委托规则（自投当 c_i ≥ max 邻居扩散值，否则委托给观测扩散值最大者；扩散值为 c_i+ε 的最小充分披露）；附录给出单任务最佳反应引理（A.4）与伪代码（Algorithm 1，四阶段：委托与报告→共识路由→报酬计算→扩散与状态更新）。
AI.result: 1) 机制表征实验（17 节点、50 轮、100 次随机重复、log-normal 能力分布）：局部效用最大化推动网络逼近全局性能前沿，用户实际获得能力随中介扩散而上升、中介报酬同步提高；对节点 10 的微观分析显示报酬与扩散强度呈非单调关系——扩散不足（<0.6）无法获得任何票数与报酬，扩散 0.7–0.8 才进入可行/获胜路径并获得正报酬，过度扩散反而侵蚀自身边际价值。2) LLM 社会智能基准（其余节点均为最佳反应者，α=100）：gpt-5-mini 最接近最优（策略报告 MAE 0.0325、协作扩散 MAE 0.0406、委托一致率 81.0%），随后为 gemini-2.5-pro（72.33%）、gemini-2.5-flash（65.33%）；gpt-4o-mini（45.67%）、llama-3.1-8b（46.67%）、qwen-2.5-7b（47.0%）明显偏离；Llama2.5-7b-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7b-Instruct、gpt-4o-mini 完全无法获得报酬，Llama3.1-7b 出现非理性自投，多个模型存在偶发的非理性委托，且在增强配置下存在「过度披露」。3) 真实数据集协作性能（6 智能体、随机图拓扑、能力向量由 30% 训练集估计、70% 测试集评估）：MMLU-Pro 0.7754 vs BS 0.7568（+1.86pp，Oracle 0.7821）；Open LLM Leaderboard v2 0.6547 vs 0.5714（+8.33pp，Oracle 0.6565）；SWE-bench 强/通才组 0.7341 vs 0.7024（+3.2pp），弱/互补组 0.5635 vs 0.5079（+5.6pp）。多任务可扩展性（30 节点）：两/三/四任务请求的增益分别为 +3.31/+5.43/+7.1pp，即任务复杂度越高增益越大。噪声鲁棒性：训练比例 10%/20%/25%/30% 对应 +4.58/+6.79/+7.96/+8.33pp，逼近 Oracle 的性能随估计噪声下降而单调提升。与 Oracle 的差距主要源于训练集能力估计不准导致的能力反转，以及最优智能体位于团内部导致缺少可行路径。4) 开销：每任务每智能体额外 2 次 API 调用，委托约 1200 输入/20 输出 token，扩散约 1400 输入/45 输出 token，单次成本 USD 0.0001–0.001，最高延迟约 14s（Gemini API）。
AI.conclusion: AgentSociety 将社会选择论的流动民主与扩散拍卖机制落地为可执行的测试时协作机制：自利、异构（可跨模型供应商）的智能体仅凭本地信息与经济激励即可自发形成共识式多智能体路由路径，实现「用户—执行者—中介」三方共赢。理论侧证明了委托的激励相容性、关键链连续性与纳什均衡下的均衡披露与边际贡献报酬；实验侧证明该机制在能力异构的真实任务上稳定优于最优单智能体基线，且随任务复杂度增益放大，并可用作衡量 LLM 社会智能的新基准。作者指出局限：机制依赖智能体对自身任务能力的估计（仍是开放问题，但机制因采用能力向量抽象而与具体估计方法解耦）；因前沿模型在现有数据集上排名近乎一致，为展示互补协作，真实数据实验有意选用了能力互补的较弱模型。展望上，该工作为具备经济自主性、可验证奖励的去中心化智能体经济提供了机制设计基础。

title: Plans for Evaluating Structured Generative Search Summaries
summary: We propose a framework for evaluating structured generative search summaries that are placed atop organic web search results. A structured summary, generated by a large language model, typically consists of an overview, several sections with section titles, and a list of source documents that are cited within the summary. We then describe our plans for implementing and evaluating the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文（Tetsuya Sakai 等，Waseda University / Naver Corporation，arXiv 预印本）提出并"设计"了一个用于评价搜索结果页（SERP）顶部由大语言模型生成的结构化搜索摘要的框架 SGSS，并详细给出后续的实现与验证计划。核心是由 XUX（Expected User Experience，期望用户体验）与 Comp（Comprehensiveness，全面性）两大部分组合而成的 SGSS 总分；本文仅是框架与计划论文，实验结果留待他文报告。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 被搜索引擎部署到 SERP 顶部，在自然（organic）结果之上生成"概览 + 若干小节（标题+陈述）+ 引用文档列表"的结构化摘要，传统二十余年沿用的 nDCG 等度量只能评价文档列表（doclist），无法评价生成内容本身。更关键的是：(1) LLM 存在"幻觉"，即使源文档准确，生成步骤仍可能注入错误信息，因此除相关性（relevance）外还必须考察忠实性（faithfulness/groundedness）；(2) 开发者视角还需要知道摘要"漏掉了什么"，即全面性（comprehensiveness，对应传统 IR 的 recall 概念）；(3) 真实检索场景中任意查询往往不存在人工参考摘要，因而只能采用 reference-free 的评价方式；(4) 已有工作（如 Gienapp et al., 2024 的 reading model）多针对"扁平"的带引用文本，未利用结构化摘要的层级特性。
AI.method: 框架把 doclist 视为给定条件，聚焦评价结构化摘要本身。① 阅读模型与用户模型：把摘要按"行"切分——概览 1 行、每个小节标题 1 行、每条陈述 1 行，总行数 L = 1 + I + ΣJ_i；引入最大阅读行数 L_max（可用真实点击/滚动/悬停日志，或按阅读速度常数×时间窗 M 估算，如韩语约 500 字符/分钟，L_max ≈ 500M/avlen）进行截断惩罚。② 放弃概率分布（APD）与 XUX：假设一群体用户在摘要中不同位置放弃阅读，先用 L' = min(L, L_max) 上的均匀分布实例化，XUX = (1/L')Σ_{l=1}^{L'} X(l)；并给出 XUX_F（仅在概览行或小节末行放弃）与 XUX_G（任意 APD 的一般化）变体。③ 质量基元（由人工或 LLM 标注，3 级 Perfectly/Partially/No，映射到 0–1）：概览层面 OS（Overview Sufficiency，对应 query-overview）、OF（Overview Faithfulness，doclist 是否 entail 概览断言）、OR（Overview Representativeness，概览是否概括了各小节），加权得 OQ(o)；标题层面 HR（Heading Representativeness，第 i 小节各陈述对标题的平均相关性）；陈述层面 SRel（Statement Relevance，对 query）与 SF（Statement Faithfulness，对引用文档）。④ Top-heavy 的 XUX 实例化：X(l) = X'(l)/l，X'(l) = OQ(o) + w_HR·ΣHR + w_SRel·ΣSRel + w_SF·ΣSF（只累加行号 ≤ l 的成分），从而奖励"好内容前置"，类似 AP 的 top-heaviness；文中以 Figure 3 的重排示例说明。⑤ Comp（全面性）：对同一查询收集 N>1 个不同生成器产出的摘要，抽取其小节构成池 P（K=|P| 个小节），对每个摘要与每个池中小节做 3 级相关性标注（自身小节记为 Perfectly），归一化为概率分布 F^n，以池上的均匀分布 U 为"gold"分布，定义 Comp(S^n) = 1 − JSD(F^n, U)，奖励"覆盖各视角且均衡"的摘要。⑥ 总分：SGSS(S) = XUX(S) + w_Comp·Comp(S)。⑦ 实施计划：构建数据集（真实查询的生成输出、至少两个不同生成摘要器、退化版本 NoHeadings / NoSection1、类似 ten-blue-links 的并排标注界面、H>2 名标注者给出 OS/OF/OR、HR、SRel/SF、绝对全面性及 LEFT/RIGHT 偏好标签，并由 LLM 产生同套标签；训练/测试划分用于调参）；用逻辑回归拟合 ΔSGSS = SGSS(S_LEFT) − SGSS(S_RIGHT) 与偏好标签以确定各权重 w_OS…w_Comp，并做准则精简的模型选择；用查询日志估计 L_max；评价用 agreement rate（AR）与 Mean AR（MAR），并检验 LLM 标注能否替代人工。
AI.result: 论文本身不含实验结果，属于"提出框架 + 实施计划"性质：给出了 SGSS 的完整形式化定义（XUX 系列公式、OQ/HR/SRel/SF 标注与权重约束条件、Comp 的 Jensen–Shannon 散度形式、SGSS 线性组合）、数据构造与标注方案、权重学习与验证方法论，并以 Figure 3/4 的小例子说明 top-heaviness（(a) 优于 (b)）与 Comp 计算（示例中 a=0.983、b=0.792）。文中亦讨论了若干开放问题：XUX 的 APD 目前取均匀分布、非均匀情形留待未来；XUX 无法量化"缺失的相关信息"与"多方面的均衡覆盖"，故必须引入 Comp；是否可去掉某些评价准则以简化 SGSS 尚待实验。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个面向 SERP 顶部结构化生成摘要的、可解释、reference-free 的评价框架：XUX 通过行级用户放弃模型与 top-heavy 加权刻画"用户实际看到什么"的精确性/忠实性体验，Comp 通过小节池化与 Jensen–Shannon 散度刻画系统开发者视角的全面性，SGSS 将二者线性组合。标注环节主张"分而治之"（divide and conquer），把复杂评价分解为可简单控制的人工或 LLM 子任务，并兼顾与对话式检索用户模型、S-measure/U-measure、SWAN 等既有框架的衔接。作者正在准备数据，计划以逻辑回归调权重、以 MAR 验证 SGSS 与人类偏好的一致性，实施与评估结果将另行报告。

title: Edge AI Deployment Beyond Models: A BSP-Aware Systems Framework for Industrial Embedded Platforms
summary: Industrial Edge AI programs often begin with the model and only later confront the platform. That sequencing is attractive because it allows early demonstrations, but it breaks down when the deployment target is an embedded system with long product lifecycles, vendor-specific kernels, heterogeneous accelerators, safety constraints, and nontrivial I/O paths. In that environment, a model is only one component of a larger execution chain that begins at the sensor, traverses the board support package (BSP), and ends in a production service loop. This paper argues that robust Edge AI deployment must be treated as a systems problem rather than a late-stage application packaging exercise. The paper presents a BSP-aware framework for industrial embedded platforms organized around five layers: hardware, BSP/operating-system adaptation, runtime and acceleration, application/inference, and operations/validation. The discussion is grounded in vendor architecture documentation for Android, NXP i.MX, NVIDIA Jetson, ONNX Runtime, and TensorRT, and in systems literature on embedded AI benchmarking, device instability, and heterogeneous edge fleets. The result is a practical framework that connects low-level platform work to measurable deployment outcomes such as reproducibility, diagnosability, sustained throughput, and field reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文论证了工业Edge AI部署应被视为系统问题而非后期应用打包练习，并提出了基于五层架构（BSP感知）的工业嵌入式平台部署框架，连接底层平台工作与可测量部署结果。
AI.motivation: 当前工业Edge AI项目往往先开发模型，后期才考虑平台部署。这种顺序虽便于早期演示，但在面对嵌入式系统的长生命周期、厂商特定内核、异构加速器、安全约束和复杂I/O路径等挑战时失效。此时，模型只是执行链的一个组件，需从传感器经板级支持包(BSP)到生产服务环。
AI.method: 提出了一个BSP感知的五层框架：(1)硬件层；(2)BSP/操作系统适配层；(3)运行时与加速层；(4)应用/推理层；(5)运维/验证层。该框架基于Android、NXP i.MX、NVIDIA Jetson、ONNX Runtime和TensorRT等厂商架构文档，以及嵌入式AI基准测试、设备不稳定性和异构边缘集群的相关文献。
AI.result: 提出了一个实用的五层框架，将底层平台工作与可量化的部署结果相连接，涵盖可重复性、可诊断性、持续吞吐量和现场可靠性等关键指标。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为工业嵌入式平台上的Edge AI部署提供了系统性指导，将底层平台工作与可量化的部署结果（可重复性、可诊断性、持续吞吐量和现场可靠性）联系起来，对工业AI落地具有重要实践意义。

title: Can LLMs Introspect? A Reality Check
summary:
Can large language models detect and report their own internal states? A number of studies have argued that the answer to this question is yes. We argue, based on lessons from human metacognition research, that this conclusion may be premature: to be convinced of this conclusion we need to distinguish genuine introspection from pattern matching based on surface-level cues. Furthermore, we argue that behavioral evidence alone is inherently insufficient to establish strong introspective claims.
  We re-examine two recently introduced evaluation paradigms in light of this consideration. In the first paradigm, models are expected to detect whether their internal states have been tampered with. We find that models cannot reliably distinguish such interventions on their internal states from manipulations of the input, suggesting that their success in the original studies reflects their ability to detect anomalies more generally, as opposed to interventions on their internal states in particular. In the second paradigm we examine, models are tasked with predicting labels derived from their own hidden states. Here, we find that classifiers that only have access to the input achieve equivalent performance to the model's own in-context predictions, indicating that the original results do not conclusively demonstrate that the model has privileged access to its internal representations. We further introduce a relabeled control setting, where models cannot rely on the semantics of the task to solve it, and instead must rely on the internal representation; models perform closer to chance on this better-controlled version of the task. Taken together, these results indicate that current evidence is insufficient to establish that LLMs display metacognitive monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑大语言模型是否真正具备元认知监控能力，通过重审两项评估范式发现：模型在干预检测中无法区分内部状态篡改与输入操作，在自我预测任务中仅用输入特征的分类器即可达到同等表现。结论认为现有行为证据不足以确立LLMs具有真正的内省能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为大语言模型能够检测和报告自身内部状态，但作者认为这一结论可能为时过早。原因在于：需要区分真正的内省与基于表面线索的模式匹配；且仅凭行为证据无法建立强有力的内省主张。
AI.method: 批判性重审两个评估范式：1) 干预检测范式——检验模型是否能区分内部状态篡改与输入操作；2) 自我预测范式——对比模型自身预测与仅能访问输入的分类器的表现。此外引入重新标注的对照设置，排除语义线索干扰。
AI.result: 在两个范式中均发现不支持强元认知主张的证据：1) 干预检测范式中，模型无法可靠区分内部状态干预与输入操作，表明其成功源于一般性异常检测而非内部状态感知；2) 自我预测范式中，仅访问输入的分类器达到与模型自身预测相当的表现，且在语义线索被控制的版本中模型表现接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据不足以证明大语言模型具备元认知监控能力；当前的评估范式存在缺陷，无法区分真正的内省与基于表面线索的模式匹配。

title: Pretraining Data Exposure in Large Language Models: A Survey of Membership Inference, Data Contamination, and Security Implications
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have become the predominant paradigm in NLP, advancing both research and industry. As model sizes and pretraining data grow, concerns about Pretraining Data Exposure (PDE) increase due to the scale and opacity of training datasets.
  PDE refers to determining whether specific data appeared in an LLM's pretraining corpus. It is critical for ensuring evaluation integrity and protecting privacy, intersecting two key areas: data contamination and membership inference. Though conceptually related, these areas have often been studied in isolation. This paper offers the first unified survey of both under the PDE framework. We formalize PDE across exposure levels, review attack and defense methods, synthesize empirical findings, and highlight open challenges and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在预训练数据暴露(PDE)统一框架下综述了数据污染与成员推断两类相关研究，形式化定义了暴露级别，系统回顾了攻击防御方法，为LLM评估完整性与隐私保护提供了整合性视角。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM模型规模和预训练数据规模扩大，预训练数据暴露问题日益突出，但此前数据污染与成员推断研究相互割裂，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 在PDE框架下对数据污染与成员推断攻击/防御方法进行统一综述，形式化定义不同暴露级别。
AI.result: 系统梳理了攻击与防御方法，综合了实证研究发现，识别了开放性挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该框架整合了数据污染与成员推断两个相关领域，为LLM安全研究提供了统一视角。

title: The Constraint Tax: Measuring Validity-Correctness Tradeoffs in Structured Outputs for Small Language Models
summary: Production LLM systems increasingly require machine-readable outputs: JSON objects, typed traces, regex-constrained fields, and tool-call schemas. This paper targets on-device and low-cost small language model (SLM) deployments, where sub-3B models are attractive for privacy, latency, and commodity hardware but have limited capacity to satisfy schemas while solving tasks. The usual engineering assumption is that hard output constraints improve reliability without changing the underlying answer. We show that this assumption is unsafe for small models. We introduce \emph{constraint tax}, a measurement protocol for isolating the answer and executable-accuracy loss caused by structured-output constraints at fixed model, fixed task distribution, and fixed problem instances. Across 15,000 commodity-GPU generations with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and SmolLM2-1.7B, hard answer-only schema decoding raises schema validity from 61.5\% to 100.0\%, but lowers answer accuracy from 19.7\% to 11.0\% and increases wrong-valid-schema outputs from 49.5\% to 88.9\%. The strongest industry analogue is a deterministic calendar tool-call task: Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 91.5\% executable accuracy with prompt-only JSON but only 48.0\% under the same hard tool-call schema, while both modes are 100.0\% schema-valid. The error is semantic, not structural. We also show that the 3B boundary still pays a direct-schema tax and that delayed packaging supports a constructive design pattern: reason free, constrain late. The practical conclusion is direct: production systems should report schema validity, answer accuracy, executable accuracy, and wrong-valid-schema rate separately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“约束税”（constraint tax）测量协议，证明对 3B 以下小模型施加硬性结构化输出约束（JSON Schema/工具调用 schema）虽把 schema 有效率提升到 100%，却使答案准确率与可执行准确率显著下降（主套件答案准确率 19.7%→11.0%；日历工具调用可执行准确率 91.5%→48.0%，两者均 100% 合法），错误从“解析失败”转移为“合法但语义错误”（wrong-valid-schema 从 49.5% 升至 88.9%）；结论是生产系统应分开上报 schema 有效率、答案准确率、可执行准确率与 wrong-valid-schema 率，并遵循“先自由推理、后约束封装”（reason free, constrain late）的设计模式。
AI.motivation: 生产级 LLM 系统日益依赖机器可读输出（JSON 信封、类型化 trace、正则约束字段、工具调用 schema），产品代码常把“可解析”当作执行前的唯一门槛。然而通常的工程假设是：硬输出约束只改善答案的外壳包装，不改变答案本身；该假设对 sub-3B 的小模型（端侧/低成本部署，受隐私、延迟、显存与商品化硬件限制）并不成立——受限解码会屏蔽违规 token、压缩中间表示空间，把本可用于外化算术、符号状态等“草稿纸”推理的生成预算挪去满足语法；于是出现“wrong answer, valid schema”的静默失败，而只看 parse 成功率的面板会变好、下游执行却变差。作者将问题定位为“测量问题”而非解码器设计问题：需要在固定模型、固定任务分布、固定问题实例下，配对地量化结构化约束造成的语义正确性损失。
AI.method:
1) 概念与指标：定义约束税 Tax(m,t,c;b)=max(0, Acc(baseline)−Acc(constrained)) 及归一化形式 Tax_norm，Acc 可取答案准确率或可执行准确率，零截断意味着“约束带来提升”记为收益而非负税；分开记录 schema validity、answer correctness、executable accuracy、trace correctness、wrong-valid-schema rate、结构开销、延迟与 token 数，并给出错误分类（correct_valid、invalid_json、parse_failure_freeform、schema_validation_error、trace_answer_contradiction、wrong_answer_valid_schema）。
2) 基准：StructReason-Small，使用确定性合成任务生成器（arithmetic_two_step、symbolic_string、object_tracking、boolean_logic、tool_call_argument 五族），每实例含标准答案与类型化 trace 步骤，用规范化/执行器/trace 检查器判定，避免用 LLM-as-judge。
3) 接口模式（9 种）：freeform、freeform_direct、freeform_brief_reasoning、prompt_json、final_only_regex、answer_only_schema、rationale_answer_schema、typed_trace_schema、delayed_constraint。
4) 后端：本地 MLX/HF 跑自由解码，商品 GPU 上 vLLM/SGLang 做约束解码；每条记录保存 prompt、schema、backend、原始生成、解析结果、执行器与 trace 检查结果、延迟、token 数，实现跨引擎配对比较。
5) 五个结果设置：主 GPU 套件（3 个 sub-3B 检查点 × 1000 实例 × 5 任务族 × 5 模式 = 15,000 次生成）、日历工具调用类比（200 例可执行 checker）、后端复现（vLLM vs SGLang）、3B 边界检查、MLX 本地扩展接口研究；配对差值 + 95% 非参数 bootstrap 置信区间。
AI.result: 主套件（Table 3）：answer_only_schema 相对 prompt_json 使 schema 有效率 61.5%→100.0%（+38.5 pts），但答案准确率 19.7%→11.0%（−8.7 pts），wrong-valid-schema 49.5%→88.9%（+39.4 pts）；可执行准确率仅 −1.0 pts，因 prompt_json 有大量正确内容被畸形 JSON 掩盖。分任务族：算术与物品追踪答案税最高（26.8 / 12.5 pts），符号串接近地板，布尔逻辑为反例（有效率提升且无执行准确率损失）。分模型：Qwen2.5-1.5B 税最大（答案税 20.0、执行税 12.6 pts），Qwen2.5-0.5B 答案税 11.9 pts，SmolLM2-1.7B 因基线弱而为 0（约束反而增益）。日历工具调用类比（Table 6）：prompt_json 与硬 schema 均 100% schema 合法，但可执行准确率 91.5%→48.0%，配对差 −43.5 pts [−51.0, −36.0]，wrong-valid +43.5 pts，延迟仅 +0.06 s；失败分类显示硬 schema 的 104 例失败中 102 例为单一 duration_minutes 字段错误（如 30 分钟被写成 180），即语法完全合法但语义决策错误。3B 边界（Table 9）：Qwen2.5-3B 仍付出 15.3 pts 答案税 [−19.2, −11.2]，wrong-valid +31.6 pts，说明该问题不限于极小模型。后端：Qwen 在 vLLM/SGLang 上完全复现（0.5B 均 2.7%，1.5B 均 11.7%），SmolLM2 对后端敏感（18.7% vs 25.7%），且 SGLang 复现需 RMSNorm 兼容性补丁，凸显约束解码是“服务栈属性”而非纯权重属性。扩展接口研究（Table 10）：delayed_constraint 以 100% 有效率取得最高 40.7% 答案/执行准确率，rationale_answer_schema 为 36.5%，均优于 answer_only_schema 的 26.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结论：结构化输出对 SLM 而言不仅是接口契约，更是推理期干预；schema validity 是“传输/接口 SLO”而非任务成功度量，若约束把可见的格式失败转化为“合法但错误的决策”，就是可靠性回退。因此生产评测应做成配对、接口感知的形式，分别上报 schema 有效率、答案准确率、可执行准确率与 wrong-valid-schema 率，尤其把 wrong-valid-schema 作为一等可靠性指标；部署建议为：先测 prompt-only JSON 基线再决定是否硬约束、需要推理时优先用 final-answer 或 delayed 约束、在目标服务后端上复现受限模式、以及“先自由推理后约束封装”（reason free, constrain late）的封装模式。论文明确声明的局限：合成任务仅为受控压力测试而非真实用户负载，日历任务是类比而非线上 agent 流量，扩展接口研究每族样本量小（仅作设计证据而非显著性主张），尚未建立该效应何时消失的规模律，且模型覆盖限于低算力可及检查点。

title: Knowledge Graphs as the Missing Data Layer for LLM-Based Industrial Asset Operations
comment: 16 pages, 12 tables. Positions a typed knowledge-graph data layer orthogonally to the LLM-orchestration paradigms (Agent-As-Tool vs Plan-Execute) compared in AssetOpsBench (KDD 2026). Adds a same-model gpt-4.1 NLQ row and the IBM 3-axis rubric re-scoring. Code: https://github.com/samyama-ai/assetops-kg
summary:
LLM-based agents for industrial asset operations show limited accuracy when reasoning over flat document stores. AssetOpsBench (KDD 2026) establishes that GPT-4 agents achieve 65% on 139 industrial maintenance scenarios backed by CouchDB, YAML, and CSV. It compares LLM orchestration paradigms (Agent-As-Tool vs Plan-Execute) on a fixed data layer; we ask a complementary, orthogonal question: how much does the data model behind the tools affect agent performance?
  Building on the same scenarios, we introduce a knowledge graph layer (781 nodes, 955 edges, 16 relationship types) and evaluate three architectures: (1) deterministic graph handlers (no LLM) at 99% (137/139); (2) LLM-generated Cypher over the graph at 82-83% with the same GPT-4 model the baseline uses; and (3) the original tool-augmented LLM baseline at 65% (91/139, matching the published KDD 2026 leaderboard ceiling).
  Our key finding is inverted LLM usage: rather than asking the LLM to reason over raw data, we ask it to generate structured queries from a typed schema. The graph executes deterministically. We additionally contribute 40 graph-native scenarios (multi-hop dependency, vector similarity, PageRank criticality), and evaluate against the expanded HuggingFace AssetOpsBench release (467 scenarios, 6 domains), where deterministic handlers achieve 100% (467/467) with average score 0.848.
  These results suggest that for structured operational domains, the data layer -- not the LLM orchestration -- is the primary bottleneck, and that knowledge graphs serve as an integration layer between raw industrial data and LLM-based reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文通过知识图谱增强工业资产运营智能体性能，颠覆传统LLM推理范式：让LLM生成结构化查询而非直接推理原始数据，确定性图谱执行。该方法将准确率从65%提升至99-100%，证明在结构化运营领域数据层是主要瓶颈而非LLM编排模式。
AI.motivation: KDD 2026的AssetOpsBench表明GPT-4智能体在工业维护场景中准确率仅65%。现有研究比较LLM编排范式，但未探索数据模型对性能的影响。该文提出正交问题：工具背后的数据模型如何影响智能体性能？
AI.method: 构建知识图谱层（781节点、955边、16种关系类型）；提出三种架构对比：确定性图谱处理器、LLM生成Cypher查询、原始工具增强LLM基线；在AssetOpsBench的139个原始场景和467个扩展场景上评估。
AI.result: 确定性图谱处理器达99%(137/139)，扩展后达100%(467/467)；LLM生成Cypher达82-83%；原始基线仅65%。引入40个图原生场景（多跳依赖、向量相似性、PageRank关键性分析）。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱数据层比LLM编排模式更重要；确定性图谱处理（无需LLM）达100%准确率。知识图谱作为原始工业数据与LLM推理之间的集成层，可有效解决结构化运营领域的性能瓶颈。

title: Generative artificial intelligence and the marginalization of minoritized knowledges in higher education: the case of disability
summary: Generative artificial intelligence redefines higher education by restructuring the processes through which scientific knowledge is produced and validated. These systems are not neutral; they actively contribute to the marginalization of non-hegemonic epistemologies. This research draws upon educational sciences, critical technology studies, and disability studies to demonstrate that training datasets, which remain predominantly Anglophone and Western-centric, reinforce epistemic coloniality. The situation of persons with disabilities provides a particularly clear illustration of this phenomenon. Technological architectures frequently confine these individuals to reductive stereotypes or exclude them from the design process, leading to a double marginalization. This article examines whether a hybridization between the researcher and the machine might preserve epistemic plurality, while acknowledging the structural limitations inherent in algorithmic correction when used as a purely palliative strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式AI对高等教育认识论结构的影响，指出以英语和西方为中心的数据集强化了认识论殖民性，导致非主流知识体系被边缘化。研究以残疾人群体为例，说明技术设计如何通过刻板印象化或排斥性参与造成双重边缘化，并提出研究者与机器的杂交是否能维持认识论多元性的开放性问题，同时承认算法校正的姑息性局限。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能正在重构高等教育中科学知识的生产和验证方式，但这种技术系统并非中立，而是积极排斥非主流认识论，尤其对残疾人群体造成双重边缘化。作者认为有必要揭示这一现象背后的认识论殖民性机制。
AI.method: 研究整合了教育科学、关键技术研究和残疾人研究三个学科视角，通过跨学科框架分析生成式AI对认识论结构的影响，并以残疾人群体为典型案例进行论证。
AI.result: 研究表明训练数据集的盎格鲁中心和西方中心特性强化了认识论殖民性；技术架构常将残疾人限定在简单刻板印象中或排斥于设计过程之外，导致双重边缘化。算法校正作为补救策略存在结构性局限。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出了"研究者和机器的杂交"是否能保留认识论多元性这一问题，并审慎地承认当算法校正被用作纯粹姑息策略时存在结构性局限。这一结论既肯定了混合路径的可能性，又保持了批判性距离，为后续研究提供了有价值的张力空间。

title: Augment Engineering: A Methodology for Multi-Tool AI Orchestration Across Professional Domains
comment: 60 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Companion to arXiv:2604.04258 (Context Engineering). Formatted for the Journal of Systems and Software (In Practice track)
summary: Organizations increasingly deploy separate purpose-built AI tools across professional domains, often hiring domain specialists for each, recreating the staffing models AI was expected to transform. Yet the meta-skills that make these tools effective, prompt engineering (interaction-level optimization) and context engineering (structured input pipeline design), are domain-portable: a practitioner who masters them can apply them to any purpose-built AI tool in any domain. This paper defines Augment Engineering as the discipline of orchestrating multiple purpose-built AI tools across distinct professional domains, applying prompt and context engineering as portable competencies that transfer across tool boundaries. We present a six-phase orchestration methodology and four portability metrics. A 5-month formative case study (November 2025 to March 2026) documents a single practitioner applying these skills across a ten-component orchestration stack spanning seven professional domains, producing work products that would traditionally involve separate domain specialists. Two quantitative observations are consistent with the framework's predictions: a Cochran-Armitage trend test (n = 200 interactions across two chat LLMs, p < 0.01) shows first-pass acceptance rising with prompt-sophistication level, and a Wright's Law fit (n = 82 artifacts, p < 0.01) shows production acceleration across the artifact portfolio. Because all observations come from a single practitioner, the inferential statistics are exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory; portability across the full portfolio awaits multi-practitioner replication. Augment Engineering completes a three-discipline progression: Prompt Engineering (one tool), Context Engineering (reproducible pipelines), Augment Engineering (a portfolio of tools across domains).

AI.tldr: This paper defines "Augment Engineering" as the discipline of orchestrating multiple purpose-built AI tools across distinct professional domains, leveraging domain-portable meta-skills (prompt engineering and context engineering). A 5-month single-practitioner case study spanning seven domains provides exploratory quantitative evidence supporting the framework's predictions.
AI.motivation: Organizations increasingly deploy separate purpose-built AI tools across professional domains, often hiring domain specialists for each, recreating the staffing models AI was expected to transform. The paper identifies that meta-skills (prompt engineering and context engineering) are domain-portable, enabling a practitioner to apply them across any purpose-built AI tool.
AI.method: 5-month formative case study (November 2025 to March 2026) documenting a single practitioner applying skills across a ten-component orchestration stack spanning seven professional domains. Two quantitative tests: Cochran-Armitage trend test (n=200 interactions across two chat LLMs) and Wright's Law fit (n=82 artifacts). Six-phase orchestration methodology and four portability metrics were developed.
AI.result: Cochran-Armitage trend test shows first-pass acceptance rising with prompt-sophistication level (p<0.01); Wright's Law fit shows production acceleration across the artifact portfolio (p<0.01). Note: all observations from single practitioner, statistics are exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory.
AI.conclusion: Augment Engineering completes a three-discipline progression: Prompt Engineering (one tool) → Context Engineering (reproducible pipelines) → Augment Engineering (portfolio of tools across domains). This framework enables a single practitioner to leverage domain-portable meta-skills across multiple purpose-built AI tools in different professional domains.

title: Decoupled Delay Compensation: Enhancing Pre-trained MARL Policies via Learned Dynamics Filtering
summary: Real-world multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems must often operate under stale observations, stochastic communication delays, and intermittent packet loss. Policies trained under idealized synchronous conditions frequently exhibit significant performance degradation in these regimes because they act on outdated feedback. We propose a modular execution-stage state-estimation layer that replaces delayed communicated observations with current belief-state estimates. The framework integrates a learned Gated transition model with a recursive Kalman filtering layer to estimate instantaneous states from asynchronous measurements. A primary advantage of this approach is its modularity, The estimator serves as a plug-in for pre-trained policies, requiring no modifications to the original MARL training algorithm, architecture, or reward structure. Evaluation across diverse multi-agent and continuous-control benchmarks demonstrates that the proposed layer consistently enhances robustness to communication latency and message loss. The most significant performance gains are observed in coordination-intensive and dynamically unstable tasks where temporal consistency is critical for control.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多智能体强化学习中通信延迟和陈旧观测问题，提出一种基于门控过渡模型与卡尔曼滤波的模块化状态估计层。该方法可作为预训练策略的即插即用组件，无需修改原有训练流程，在协调密集型和动态不稳定任务中展现出显著的鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: 现实多智能体强化学习系统常面临陈旧观测、随机通信延迟和数据包丢失等问题。在理想同步条件下训练的策略在面对这些非理想通信条件时往往性能显著下降，因为其基于过时的反馈进行决策。
AI.method: 提出一个模块化的执行阶段状态估计层，将延迟的通信观测替换为当前信念状态估计。该框架集成了学习型门控过渡模型（Gated Transition Model）与递归卡尔曼滤波层，利用异步测量值估计即时状态。
AI.result: 该方法在多种多智能体及连续控制基准测试中一致地提升了系统对通信延迟和消息丢失的鲁棒性。在协调密集型和动态不稳定任务中性能提升最为显著，这些任务对时间一致性要求较高。
