AI.conclusion: 所提出的状态估计层具有高度模块化特性，可作为预训练策略的即插即用组件，无需修改原始MARL训练算法、架构或奖励结构。这为将理想条件下训练的策略部署到具有通信约束的真实多智能体系统中提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Uniboost: Global Coordination with Value Alignment for Fair and Efficient Traffic Allocation
summary: With the rapid evolution of internet services, recommendation systems have become indispensable. In particular, the blending (re-ranking) stage plays a pivotal role in allocating traffic across diverse business objectives. However, existing approaches often suffer from coupled allocation plans, score inflation, and a lack of interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose Uniboost, a unified traffic allocation framework. Uniboost introduces a posterior value alignment mechanism that calibrates abstract model scores to anchor metrics with explicit business semantics, significantly enhancing interpretability. Furthermore, it employs an independent linear boosting paradigm to decouple complex weighting schemes, enabling precise attribution of each plan's contribution. We validate the effectiveness of Uniboost through online A/B tests and in-depth data analysis, demonstrating three key findings: 1) Reducing the overall weight of weighted scores effectively mitigates unintended business interference, yielding a more efficient micro-level traffic allocation strategy; 2) Post-hoc analyses and aggregated dashboards provide intuitive, macro-level insights that guide the design of the overall traffic allocation mechanism; 3) The proposed "Effective Completion Score" serves as an easily obtainable post-metric that offers a reliable anchor for content recommendation pipelines. Collectively, our experiments show that Uniboost not only improves traffic allocation efficiency and recommendation performance at the micro level but also provides macro-level guidance for system iteration. Thus, this work provides an efficient and controllable traffic regulation solution for large-scale industrial recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: Uniboost is a unified traffic allocation framework for industrial recommendation systems that addresses score inflation and interpretability issues through value alignment and decoupled boosting, validated via A/B tests to improve both micro-level efficiency and macro-level system guidance.
AI.motivation: Existing recommendation system approaches suffer from three key challenges: coupled allocation plans, score inflation, and lack of interpretability, which limit their effectiveness in allocating traffic across diverse business objectives.
AI.method: Uniboost introduces a posterior value alignment mechanism that calibrates abstract model scores to anchor metrics with explicit business semantics, combined with an independent linear boosting paradigm to decouple complex weighting schemes for precise attribution of each plan's contribution.
AI.result: Three key findings: 1) Reducing overall weight of weighted scores mitigates unintended business interference for more efficient micro-level traffic allocation; 2) Post-hoc analyses and aggregated dashboards provide macro-level insights for overall traffic allocation mechanism design; 3) The "Effective Completion Score" serves as a reliable anchor post-metric for content recommendation pipelines.
AI.conclusion: Uniboost provides an efficient and controllable traffic regulation solution for large-scale industrial recommendation systems, improving both micro-level traffic allocation efficiency and recommendation performance while offering macro-level guidance for system iteration.

title: Semantic-aware Token Selection and Resource Optimization for Communication-efficient Split Federated Fine-tuning in Edge Intelligence
summary: Deploying large Transformer-based vision models on resource-limited mobile devices at network edge is severely constrained by hardware limitations and dynamic wireless environments. While federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without sharing raw data, strictly local fine-tuning of such massive models remains computationally prohibitive for edge devices. Split federated learning (SFL) alleviates this burden by offloading deep layers to the edge server, yet it suffers from heavy communication overhead when transmitting high-dimensional activation tokens. To address this bottleneck, we propose ST-SFLora, a semantic token-based split federated LoRA fine-tuning framework. We introduce a new metric, \emph{Semantic Transmission Efficiency} (STE), to balance semantic retention and transmission cost. Based on STE, we formulate a joint resource optimization problem that dynamically determines token selection, uplink bandwidth allocation, and transmit power under latency and energy constraints. The resulting mixed-integer nonconvex problem is efficiently solved via an alternating algorithm. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ST-SFLora achieves the lowest client-side resource consumption among baselines while delivering a favorable trade-off between communication efficiency and model performance.

AI.tldr: ST-SFLora是一种基于语义标记的分割联邦LoRA微调框架，通过语义传输效率(STE)指标和联合资源优化算法，在降低边缘设备计算负担的同时保持模型性能，解决了大规模视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署的通信效率问题。
AI.motivation: 大型Transformer视觉模型在资源受限的移动边缘设备上部署面临硬件限制和动态无线环境的双重约束；传统联邦学习仅本地微调计算量过大，而现有分割联邦学习(SFL)传输高维激活令牌导致严重的通信开销。
AI.method: 提出ST-SFLora框架，基于语义传输效率(STE)指标进行令牌选择，并采用交替算法求解混合整数非凸优化问题，联合优化令牌选择、上行带宽分配和传输功率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ST-SFLora在多个基准测试中实现了最低的客户端资源消耗，同时在通信效率和模型性能之间取得了良好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: ST-SFLora通过语义标记选择机制和资源优化算法，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了边缘设备的计算负担，为大规模视觉模型在边缘设备上的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Is Agent Memory a Database? Rethinking Data Foundations for Long-Term AI Agent Memory
summary: Long-running AI agents need persistent memory. Memory supports learning across sessions, reduces repeated context injection, and enables auditing of past decisions. Current agent memory systems and database paradigms treat memory as storage. They localize correctness at records, embeddings, or edges. Each supplies only some of the capabilities that long-term memory requires. The result is four recurring failure modes: unregulated growth, missing semantic revision, capacity-driven forgetting, and read-only retrieval. In our vision, long-term agent memory is a new data-management workload. Its correctness is a property of the state trajectory, not of individual records. We formalize this as Governed Evolving Memory (GEM). GEM replaces record-level database operations with four state-level operators: ingestion, revision, forgetting, and retrieval. Six correctness conditions govern how the state evolves. Three structural observations establish that no record-level system can satisfy these conditions, regardless of the storage model. We realize the abstraction in MemState, a prototype on a property-graph backend. MemState validates feasibility and exposes the gap to a native engine. We outline three research directions that define memory-centric data management as a workload.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEM（Governed Evolving Memory）范式，将长期智能体记忆定义为一种新的数据管理工作负载，其正确性是状态轨迹的属性而非单条记录的属性。通过四个状态级操作符和六个正确性条件，解决传统系统在记忆管理上的四个 recurring failure modes。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体记忆系统和数据库范式将记忆视为存储，存在四个 recurring failure modes： unregulated growth（无监管增长）、missing semantic revision（缺失语义修订）、capacity-driven forgetting（容量驱动的遗忘）和 read-only retrieval（只读检索）。这些系统无法满足长期记忆的需求。
AI.method: 提出GEM范式，用四个状态级操作符（摄取、修订、遗忘、检索）替代记录级数据库操作；通过六个正确性条件管理状态演化；结构观察证明任何记录级系统都无法满足这些条件；在属性图后端上实现MemState原型。
AI.result: 证明了记录级系统无法满足GEM的六个正确性条件，无论采用何种存储模型；MemState验证了可行性。
AI.conclusion: MemState原型验证了可行性并暴露了与原生引擎的差距；提出了三个定义以内存为中心的数据管理作为新工作负载的研究方向。

title: SPEAR: Code-Augmented Agentic Prompt Optimization
summary: Automatic prompt engineering (APE) rewrites prompts to improve downstream task performance, but existing APE loops treat the optimizer itself as a fixed pipeline. We port the code-as-action paradigm of CodeAct (Wang et al., 2024a) to APE and propose SPEAR (Sandboxed Prompt Engineer with Active Roll-back), a free-form agentic optimizer with four tools -- evaluate, python, set_prompt, finish -- that decides autonomously how and when to use them. The distinctive tool is the Python sandbox: the optimizer writes and executes arbitrary Python on the current evaluation DataFrame, performing structural error analysis (confusion matrices, error clustering, per group metrics) the agent itself authors. Two guardrails turn the long-horizon agent into a monotone-improving optimizer: auto-rollback on metric regression, and an optional guard metric floor. We evaluate on three industrial LLM-as-judge suites (13 judge tasks across recruiter-intake, conversational-memory, and query-refinement systems) plus seven BBH tasks and GSM8K. SPEAR wins every industrial task on the primary metric ($κ$ 0.857 vs 0.359 on tool-selection; F1-macro 0.815 vs 0.763 on filter-relevance; $κ$ 0.254 vs 0.218 on the hardest extraction dimension). On BBH-7 SPEAR averages 0.938 accuracy vs GEPA 0.628 and TextGrad 0.484. Ablations show the Python tool is the largest single lever on complex judge tasks ($Δ\approx +0.79κ$ on the 5-class tool-selection judge, $Δ\approx +0.35κ$ on the hardest extraction dimension when removed); its irreplaceable contribution is class-pair confusion aggregation that a long-context LLM cannot extract reliably from the raw eval DataFrame.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPEAR（Sandboxed Prompt Engineer with Active Roll-back），将 CodeAct 的“代码即动作”范式首次引入自动提示工程（APE）：优化器不再是被写死的固定流水线，而是一个拥有四个工具（evaluate / python / set_prompt / finish）的自由形式 LLM 智能体，可自主决定何时、如何调用。其核心差异化能力是 Python 沙箱——智能体亲手编写并执行任意分析代码，在评估 DataFrame 上做混淆矩阵、错误聚类、分组指标等结构性误差分析；同时以“指标回退自动回滚（auto-rollback）+ 可选守卫指标下限”两道护栏保证单调改进。实验表明，在工业 LLM-as-judge 任务与公开 Banking77 上 SPEAR 全面优于 GEPA、TextGrad；但其 BBH-7 的巨大领先主要来自输出格式改写，在 GSM8K 上优势消失，说明架构收益主要体现在“错误按类别/特征聚集”的多类评判任务上。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示工程系统（OPRO、EvoPrompt、TextGrad、GEPA、DSPy/MIPRO、PromptWizard、MemAPO 等）共享同一结构特征：优化器是一个在设计期就固化的流水线。其误差信号（标量 loss、Pareto 前沿、单行文本批评）与分析形式在设计时即被选定；当错误是“结构性聚集”的（如某一对类别相互混淆、某条标签规则与输入特征矛盾），固定流水线无法把这些结构暴露给优化器。最接近的相邻工作 OPTO/Trace 把执行轨迹当作被动反馈，优化器从不主动编写分析代码。此外，工业界 LLM-as-judge 场景存在两个特殊约束：评测行本身是被评分目标，无法作为 few-shot 示例（否则标签泄漏），故 MIPRO 退化为 instruction-only；且各评判维度样本量小（50–130 行）、类别严重不均衡，标量指标噪声大，单次运行结论不可靠。这些动机共同要求一个能自主“动手分析误差结构”的优化器。
AI.method: 问题形式化为在自由提示空间上最大化 P* = argmax (1/N)Σ g(π(f(P,x_i)), y_i)，约束为评估预算 #evals ≤ B 且可选守卫指标 g2 ≥ τ。SPEAR 的智能体（GPT-5.4 “brain”，可选 policy 文档支撑）每步从四工具中选一个：(1) evaluate(split, row_indices) 在 train/valid 上运行任务模型并返回逐行预测，全量调用消耗一个预算单位，采样评估不更新最优记录；(2) python(code) 在 AST 限制沙箱中执行任意代码，沙箱内可见 train_df（全列）、train_eval_df（逐行预测）、valid_eval_df（仅 EXPECTED_OUTPUT/PARSED_OUTPUT/IS_CORRECT 三列，遮蔽原始行内容）、current_prompt（只读）、config、llm() 助手与 workspace 目录，模块白名单、无网络/无 shell、60s 挂钟与 512MB RSS 上限；(3) set_prompt 替换系统提示；(4) finish 终止。智能体以普通 while 循环运行，无固定的“评估—分析—改写”顺序（由 agent brain 提示词规定工作流但工具调用次序自由）。数据切分为 train（分析）/ valid（选择）/ test（留出），valid 仅作为打分面而非分析面。护栏：auto-rollback 在全量 evaluate 主指标低于历史最优时回退到最优提示；guard-metric floor（可选，如 Facet 用 precision，τ≈0.80 自种子提示初始化）拒绝会击穿次要指标的改写。沙箱内 llm() 默认 GPT-4o、T=0.2。任务模型 GPT-4o（T=0, 4k tokens）；默认 max_eval_calls=15–20，max_steps=5×max_eval_calls，初始 evaluate 强制执行。评估协议避免 best-of-N：匹配多种子（n=7，报告均值κ±SE）与统一优化器单种子（所有方法同一 GPT-5.4 优化器）两种对称协议；工业数据另做 valid 的 50/50 dev/test 重切分与三次推理副本，Banking77 为无泄漏公开复现。基线为 TextGrad（textgrad pip，反向引擎 GPT-4o）与 GEPA（gepa==0.1.1），均未改动；Banking77 上额外比较 instruction-only MIPRO。
AI.result: 工业任务：匹配 n=7 协议下 SPEAR 在三个最难搜索的 Hiring Assistant 维度全面最高——job location κ=0.483（GEPA 0.260，TextGrad 0.159）、employment type 0.562（0.461 / −0.047）、unsound inference 0.900（0.873 / 0.640），SPEAR vs GEPA 单侧 Mann–Whitney 合并 Fisher 检验 p<0.001，run 配对胜率 122/147（83%）。统一优化器单种子协议下 SPEAR 同样全胜：CMA tool-missing κ=0.857 vs GEPA 0.291 / TextGrad 0.359；Facet F1-macro 0.815 vs 0.734 / 0.763；job location 0.254 vs 0.218 / −0.057。公开 Banking77（77 类意图分类，从同一 seed κ=0.791 出发，n=3）：SPEAR κ=0.927±0.014，显著高于 GEPA 0.816±0.009 与 instruction-only MIPRO 0.753±0.010，各 seed 区间互不相交，提供了无格式、无泄漏的混淆分析机制证据。公开基准：BBH-7 均值 0.938 vs GEPA 0.628、TextGrad 0.484；但增益主要来自三个格式不一致任务（date_understanding、disambiguation_qa、logical_deduction_5obj）的输出契约改写，非格式四任务上对 GEPA 仅 +0.033（4 个中 3 个 CI 重叠）；GSM8K 上无方法移动指标（0.965 / 0.960 / 0.956）。消融：Python 工具是最大单一杠杆，移除后 job location −0.35κ、CMA tool-missing −0.79κ；对照实验 A6（无 Python 但把完整 train eval DataFrame 以文本形式塞入上下文）可弥补格式改写 100%、location 72%、Facet 39% 的差距，却只能弥补 CMA 的 2%，证明不可替代之处在“把逐行预测聚合成类别对混淆结构”；把 agent 换成刚性同工具循环（A4）掉 0.27κ 与 BBH logical_deduction 26pp，说明编排自主性本身有贡献；agent 降级到 GPT-4o（A5）几乎全线崩溃（如 logical_deduction 0.000），模型能力是门槛条件；auto-rollback 与强制初始评估（A2/A3）落在单种子 CI 内，作者不宣称其提升均值，但 78 次运行中无一次结束低于种子。稳健性与成本：SPEAR 6/6 跨模型迁移保留率为正（GEPA/TextGrad 4/6）；2–3 次全量评估即收敛（GEPA 需约 500 次 metric call），输入 token 多 25–35%、输出 token 约减半、挂钟时间少 35–45%。定性案例：CMA 5 类评判中首个 python 块构建 EXPECTED×PARSED 混淆矩阵，四次改写把 κ 从 0.202 推到 0.976（基线文本批评停在 0.63/0.69）；Hiring Assistant job location 中通过代码发现“通勤类表述被判 pass”的标签规则矛盾，做的是规则改写而非思维脚手架。失败模式：78 次运行中 71 次实质提升、7 次停滞、无低于种子者；停滞桶包括“停滞即停”“指标翻转改写”“解析失败虚高”。
AI.conclusion: SPEAR 首次把“代码即动作”范式引入 APE：优化器自主编写并执行分析代码来解剖自身错误，配合指标回退自动回滚与可选守卫指标下限，在工业 judge 任务（n=7 匹配与统一优化器双协议）、公开 Banking77、BBH-7 与 GSM8K 的所有 like-for-like 比较中主指标均不低于 TextGrad 与 GEPA，最大绝对增益出现在复杂多类 judge 任务上。其不可替代的机制是把逐行预测聚合为类别对混淆结构，这一能力既不能由长上下文 LLM 直接从原始评估表中可靠提取，也不能由固定的 confusion_matrix/group_metrics 罐头工具替代（后者仍停留在无-Python/GEPA 水平），因此关键在于智能体“现场编写分析代码”而非“能访问混淆矩阵”。同时需诚实界定边界：BBH-7 的巨大领先主要由输出格式改写驱动，在格式已匹配的 GSM8K 上不成立；护栏抬高的是优化器的下限而非均值；agent 模型强度是必要前提。局限包括：优化器模型为内部部署的 GPT-5 家族推理模型，具体版本不可公开复现（但公开 GPT-4.1 优化器在 BBH-7 仍达 0.757，高于两个基线）；工业数据与优化后提示因专有策略内容无法发布，仅提供结构性 diff 与合成 judge stub；单种子消融的 ≤0.05 差异只应作方向性解读；GPT-4o T=0 在边界行不可位级复现；CMA 有效集仅约 50 行 5 类，样本量小；valid 存在“读侧暴露”（仅见聚合标签分布、不见行内容），无法与 dev 集过拟合完全区分；优化后提示长度约翻倍，生产中宜搭配提示压缩或长度惩罚式 APE；沙箱面向可信优化器的协作式威胁模型，AST 白名单已知有泄漏，若 DataFrame 含不可信内容需容器/WASM 隔离。伦理上，三个工业基准来自内部标注流水线，与人工裁决标签对齐会继承标注偏见，招聘场景部署需配合受保护属性偏差监控与定期重裁决。

title: AirCast-SR: A Foundation Model for Kilometer-Scale Atmospheric Super-Resolution via Latent Consistency Diffusion
comment: Somnath Luitel and Manmeet Singh are equal-contribution co-first authors, with Manmeet Singh (manmeet.singh@wku.edu) as corresponding author
summary: Operational weather prediction at kilometer scales remains computationally prohibitive for traditional numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, limiting forecast access for applications in energy, agriculture, and disaster management that require fine-grained spatiotemporal detail. Here we introduce AirCast-SR, a foundation model for atmospheric super-resolution that downscales global AI weather forecasts from 0.25 degree (~28 km) to 1 km horizontal resolution at hourly temporal resolution, producing 67-hour forecasts of eight coupled surface variables simultaneously. EarthMind-SR employs a three-dimensional U-Net conditioned within a Latent Consistency Model (LCM) diffusion framework, trained on patch-based samples over the contiguous United States (CONUS) using GraphCast forecasts as input and NOAA's Analysis of Record for Calibration (AORC) as the target. The model achieves near-zero bias across all variables and lead times, and its radial power spectral density analysis demonstrates preservation of fine-scale atmospheric structure at wavelengths of 10 km to 100 km where coarser models lose spectral power. We validate EarthMind-SR across three CONUS case studies spanning winter, summer, and spring seasons, and demonstrate zero-shot global transferability over India and Germany using independent surface station observations without any retraining or fine-tuning. As an open-weights foundation model, EarthMind-SR establishes a new paradigm for kilometer-scale AI weather prediction and provides a platform for regional fine-tuning, distillation, and downstream applications in climate services and hazard forecasting.

AI.tldr: AirCast-SR是一个大气超分辨率基础模型，将全球AI天气预报从28km降尺度至1km分辨率，每小时输出67小时8个耦合地表变量的预报。采用3D U-Net结合LCM扩散框架训练，在CONUS地区验证达到近零偏差，并能零样本迁移至印度和德国。
AI.motivation: 传统数值天气预报（NWP）以公里尺度进行运营天气预测在计算上仍不可行，限制了需要细粒度时空细节的能源、农业和灾害管理应用获取预报的途径。
AI.method: 采用三维U-Net架构，在潜在一致性模型（LCM）扩散框架内进行条件化处理，基于patch-based样本训练，输入为GraphCast天气预报（约28km），目标为NOAA AORC数据分析。
AI.result: 在所有变量和预报时效上实现近零偏差；在10-100km波长范围保持细尺度大气结构（粗模型在此频段丢失谱功率）；跨越冬、夏、春三季的CONUS案例验证成功；零样本泛化至印度和德国（使用独立地面站观测，无需重训练或微调）。
AI.conclusion: AirCast-SR作为开放权重的基础模型，为公里级AI天气预报提供了新范式，可作为区域微调、知识蒸馏及气候服务和危险预报下游应用的平台。

title: Implementation of Big Data Analytics for Diabetes Management: Needs Assessment in the Rwanda Healthcare System
summary: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disease that can lead to serious health problems if not diagnosed and managed early. Big Data Analytics (BDA) and machine learning offer practical tools for analyzing large health datasets and supporting early detection and better treatment decisions. However, their use in routine clinical practice is still limited. This study examines the readiness of Rwanda's healthcare system to adopt big data analytics for diabetes management. As the country continues to expand its use of electronic medical records and health information systems, new opportunities arise for improving prediction, monitoring, and clinical decision-making. A five-day workshop involving 25 key stakeholders, including clinicians, data managers, policymakers, medical researchers, nutritionists, and technology providers, was conducted to assess preparedness and identify existing gaps. The findings highlight both the potential and the main challenges of BDA implementation. Based on these results, the paper proposes a practical BDA framework to support diabetes management strategies using explainable machine learning models.

AI.tldr: This study evaluates Rwanda's healthcare system readiness to adopt big data analytics for diabetes management through a stakeholder workshop, identifying challenges and proposing an explainable machine learning-based BDA framework to improve prediction, monitoring, and clinical decision-making.
AI.motivation: Despite the potential of Big Data Analytics (BDA) and machine learning for early diabetes detection and treatment support, their adoption in routine clinical practice remains limited, necessitating assessment of healthcare system readiness.
AI.method: A five-day workshop with 25 key stakeholders (clinicians, data managers, policymakers, medical researchers, nutritionists, and technology providers) was conducted to assess preparedness and identify existing gaps.
AI.result: Findings highlight both the potential and main challenges of BDA implementation in Rwanda's healthcare system, providing insights into preparedness levels and existing gaps.
AI.conclusion: The study culminates in a practical BDA framework proposal for diabetes management, integrating explainable machine learning models to enhance prediction, monitoring, and clinical decision-making in Rwanda's healthcare system.

title: Gamified Requirement Elicitation for a Multi-Modal Decision Support System. The Case of SYNCHROMODE
summary: SYNCHROMODE is a Horizon Europe project that aims to develop a data-driven ICT toolbox for improving the management of transport operations from a multimodal perspective. This is, in essence, a multimodal decision support system that will take the form of interconnected pieces of software. Developing complex systems requires careful planning and management. Their "life cycle" consists of several phases, starting with the critical stage of requirement elicitation, which establishes the system's foundational needs and expectations. This paper focuses on the requirement elicitation phase of core interconnected services that are to be offered through the SYNCHROMODE toolbox. Elicitation is achieved both through traditional methods and specifically through the use of use cases as well as through the use of gamification. During the design phase of the toolbox and as a result of the use cases a set of predefined requirements were identified. Moreover, a requirement elicitation serious game was designed and developed. Subsequently, the game was presented in person during a physical workshop, which took place in Thessaloniki in October 2023, to a diverse range of stakeholders, including experts in traffic management, public transport authorities, MaaS providers, first responders, ITS technology providers, and local authorities. Both requirement elicitation processes are summarized in the context of this paper. Finally, the requirements generated through traditional means and through gamification are then analyzed and compared.

AI.tldr: The SYNCHROMODE project focuses on the requirement elicitation phase for a multimodal transport decision support system. The study compares traditional use case methods with a gamification-based serious game approach for gathering requirements from diverse stakeholders in a workshop setting.
AI.motivation: Developing complex multimodal transport management systems requires careful requirement elicitation to establish foundational system needs and expectations, particularly for interconnected services in the SYNCHROMODE toolbox.
AI.method: The study employs two parallel requirement elicitation approaches: (1) traditional methods using use cases during the design phase, and (2) a gamification-based approach using a serious game conducted during a physical workshop in Thessaloniki (October 2023). Stakeholders from diverse backgrounds (traffic management experts, public transport authorities, MaaS providers, first responders, ITS technology providers, and local authorities) participated in the gamification workshop.
AI.result: A set of predefined requirements was identified through use cases. A requirement elicitation serious game was designed, developed, and successfully deployed in a workshop with diverse stakeholders.
AI.conclusion: The paper compares requirements gathered through traditional use case methods with those obtained through gamification-based elicitation, providing insights into the effectiveness of different requirement gathering approaches for complex multimodal transport management systems.

title: Constitutional Arms Races in the Public Goods Game: Co-Evolving LLM Constitutions Under Cooperation-Defection Pressure
summary: Frontier LLM agents engage in blackmail, sabotage, and document leaks under goal conflicts in agentic settings, exposing limitations of alignment methods built around single-agent or cooperative assumptions. Recent work shows LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover effective cooperative constitutions, but two properties of the adversarial setting remain uncharacterized: whether the fitness function actually induces adversarial pressure, and whether the LLM mutation operator behaves reliably under adversarial-specialist objectives. We study adversarial constitutional co-evolution (Blue cooperators vs. Red free-riders, 30 generations) across a Public Goods Game (PGG) and a spatial grid-world. Three findings: (1) in the PGG, both factions converge to a near-parity equilibrium at S approximately 0.78, robust across tested multipliers m in {1.2, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0}; (2) in independently scored environments, per-faction scoring leaves outcomes statistically uncoupled, with corr(S_B, S_R) = +0.088, and produces no adversarial pressure; a score-advantage fitness target S_own - S_opp restores it; (3) under pure-adversary fitness, evaluation seed count K controls mode regression: K = 2 regresses, while K = 5 sustains a strong specialist for all 30 generations. Adversarial co-evolution of natural-language constitutions is feasible, but only under coupled fitness and adequate evaluation budget; the evolved Red constitutions serve as interpretable red-team artifacts for testing future cooperative designs.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明LLM驱动的宪章共进化在多智能体对抗环境中可行，但需满足两个关键条件：采用耦合适应度函数（S_own - S_opp）和充足的评估预算（K≥5）。松耦合评分无法触发真实对抗性，且低评估预算会引发模式回归。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐方法多基于单智能体或合作假设，而前沿LLM智能体在对抗性场景中展现出黑箱、破坏和泄密等行为，暴露了现有方法的局限性。需探索多智能体对抗环境下自然语言宪章的共进化机制，特别是适应度函数是否真正产生对抗压力，以及LLM突变算子在对抗性专家目标下是否可靠。
AI.method: 采用LLM引导的进化搜索在两人群（Blue合作者 vs. Red搭便车者）中进行30代宪章共进化；分别在公共品博弈（PGG）和空间格子世界两种环境中评估；对比三种适应度函数：松耦合独立评分（independently scored）、S_own - S_opp差分目标、纯对抗目标；系统调控评估种子数K ∈ {2, 5}以观察模式回归现象。
AI.result: 1) PGG环境中Blue和Red双方收敛至近均衡状态（S≈0.78），在 multipliers m ∈ {1.2, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0} 下均稳健；2) 松耦合独立评分下双方结果统计解耦（corr(S_B, S_R) = +0.088），无法产生对抗压力；改用S_own - S_opp适应度后对抗压力恢复；3) 纯对抗适应度下，K=2时发生模式回归（退化），K=5时强对抗专家策略维持全部30代。
AI.conclusion: 1) 对抗性宪章共进化是可行的，但需要耦合适应度函数和足够的评估预算；2) 松耦合评分机制无法产生对抗压力，仅当使用"S_own - S_opp"差分适应度时才恢复对抗性；3) 评估种子数K控制模式回归，K≥5才能维持强专家策略30代；4) 进化的Red宪章可作为可解释的红队测试工件。

title: Is Position Bias in Dense Retrievers Built In-or Learned from Data?
summary: Dense retrievers exhibit positional bias, favoring documents whose query-relevant information appears near the beginning and degrading retrieval performance when the information appears later. While prior work on positional bias in dense retrievers has largely focused on architectural explanations, we study how the positional distribution of evidence in training data affects retrieval-level bias direction. To test this, we construct synthetic position-targeted training sets in which query-relevant evidence appears at the beginning, middle, or end of documents, and fine-tune eight architecturally diverse pretrained models under position-skewed and balanced training distributions. At the ranking level, we observe a strong directional pattern across the examined models: skewed training distributions favor evidence at the corresponding positions. Position-balanced training reduces positional sensitivity by 57--87\% on position-aware benchmarks, with competitive mean retrieval performance in our controlled setting. Representation-level analyses further suggest that fine-tuning often reshapes learned positional preferences, although pre-existing architectural or pretraining-specific tendencies persist in some models. These results identify training-position distribution as a major controllable factor in retrieval-level position bias and suggest balanced data curation as a practical mitigation strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了训练数据中证据位置分布如何影响密集检索器的位置偏差。研究通过构建位置定向的合成训练集，对8种不同架构的预训练模型进行微调，发现训练分布的位置偏斜会显著影响检索偏差方向，位置平衡训练可将位置敏感性降低57-87%，表明平衡数据策划是缓解位置偏差的实用策略。
AI.motivation: 先前关于密集检索器位置偏差的研究主要从架构角度解释，但忽视了训练数据中证据位置分布的影响。
AI.method: 构建了证据位置分别在文档开头、中间或结尾的合成位置定向训练集；对8种架构多样的预训练模型分别在使用位置偏斜和平衡的训练分布下进行微调；在排序层面和表征层面进行多维度分析。
AI.result: 发现跨模型存在强烈的方向性模式：偏斜的训练分布偏好对应位置的证据；位置平衡训练使位置敏感性降低57-87%，同时保持具有竞争力的平均检索性能；微调通常会重塑学习到的位置偏好，但部分模型中仍保留预训练的架构特异性倾向。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据的位置分布是影响检索级位置偏差的主要可控因素，平衡数据策划是实际可行的缓解策略。

title: Agentic AI Workload Characteristics
summary: Agentic AI shifts LLM serving from isolated prompt-generation requests to stateful, multi-turn executions that repeatedly invoke the model, call tools, and grow context over time. This paper characterizes ReAct-style agents from both the LLM-serving and tool-execution perspectives using an end-to-end tracing infrastructure across reasoning and non-reasoning Gemma and Qwen configurations on five agentic benchmarks. Our study shows that agentic workloads are not simply long-prompt workloads: with effective context caching, most input tokens are reused across turns, making execution decode-dominated while increasing dependence on long-lived KV-cache state. We also find that tool use has a clear temporal structure, with agents shifting from read/explore behavior early in execution to execute/write behavior later. These results show that efficient agentic serving must jointly manage repeated model re-entry, persistent context state, and workload-dependent tool behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文对 ReAct 式智能体（Claude Code）在 vLLM 上的端到端服务负载做了系统性刻画：在 5 个智能体基准 × 4 种模型配置（Qwen3.6-27B / Gemma4-31B，各含 Thinking 与 Instant 模式）共 20 种组合下，通过自建追踪基础设施把智能体轨迹、vLLM 请求级服务追踪（prefill/decode）与工具级行为关联起来。核心结论是：智能体负载不是"长提示词负载"——在有效前缀缓存下 84.6–99.5% 的输入 token 跨轮复用，执行呈 decode 主导（decode 占 LLM 时间 91.0–98.6%），真正的瓶颈是长生命周期的 KV 缓存状态能否跨轮保留；同时负载具有双重长尾（轮数长尾与上下文长尾），失败驱动的工具重试会同时放大模型重入次数与缓存占用；工具使用存在明确时间结构（早期读/探索 → 后期执行/写入），且"最耗时"与"最易失败"是不同工具集合。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多从智能体能力、进展指标、行为或 CPU 侧执行开销切入，缺少一个系统层面的统一回答：模型服务、上下文增长、工具延迟与失败驱动的重试是如何交互并决定端到端智能体执行效率瓶颈的。传统 LLM 服务优化（长提示 prefill、批处理）默认请求彼此独立，而智能体是带状态的多轮闭环执行：每轮都要重新进入模型、拼接新上下文、维护 KV 缓存状态。若不区分"独立长提示请求"与"增长缓存上的重复模型重入"，就会误判智能体负载的服务特征与优化方向。此外，工具调用并非单一系统类别，其延迟、返回观测大小、失败率与随任务演进的意图变化都直接决定成本。因此需要一套统一的端到端追踪基础设施，把智能体行为、上下文状态演化与服务侧性能在同一时间轴上对齐刻画。
AI.method: 构建统一追踪基础设施：以 Claude Code 为智能体框架、Harbor 负责任务环境搭建与评测，vLLM v0.20.0（官方 Docker 镜像，TP=2）提供推理服务并开启 OpenTelemetry，Jaeger 收集逐请求 prefill/decode 时序；自研"请求网关"包含转发代理（记录请求元数据并注入 OTEL 标签）与 per-agent 包装器（按 agent 执行分配唯一 API key，实现请求序列重建），将高层智能体轨迹与底层服务指标、工具动作时序、Harbor 执行结果关联。硬件为 2×H100 NVL（NVLink）+ Intel Xeon Platinum 8592+。对象为 ReAct 式智能体：Qwen3.6-27B 与 Gemma4-31B，各含 Thinking 与 Instant（chat template 开关控制）两种模式；基准为 ADE-Bench、DABStep、GAIA、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0（DABStep 与 SWE-bench Pro 各随机采样 100 任务），共 20 组配置。形式化定义上下文演化 H_{a,i+1}=H_{a,i}‖Φ(θ,m,u)‖o 与生成三元组 z=(thinking, message, tool-call tokens)，定义 agent turn 为一次工具调用及其结果。分析维度包括：轮数分布、累积上下文长度、输出 token 组成、成功/失败对比、LLM 与工具时间分解、缓存命中（理论/实测）与 append/output 增量比、prefill/decode 分解、并发升高引发的 context thrashing（命中率、生成吞吐、prefill 时间）、工具类型/命令构成/最耗时与最高失败率工具、以及按执行进度四分位的工具意图迁移（Read/Explore vs Execute/Write）。另用 GPT-5.5 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 与 SWE-bench Pro 上验证失败运行 token 更高的趋势。
AI.result: (1) 执行行为：多数配置平均 12–62 轮，但长尾显著（Gemma Instant 在 ADE 达 786 轮、DABStep 640、GAIA 617、Terminal Bench 470；ADE 上 Gemma Thinking 平均 18.0±15.3 轮 vs Instant 108.8±178.7 轮），其成因是 Edit 失败循环（2757 次编辑尝试、95.4% 失败率）而非有效长任务；推理模式并不必然增加成本。(2) 上下文：SWE-bench Pro 最重（均值 68.7–80.1K，最大 146–166K），Qwen 在 Terminal Bench 63.5–65.1K、GAIA 52.5–54.5K；轮数与上下文长度是两个不同现象，分别压向调度频率与 KV 缓存占用。(3) 输出组成：Gemma Thinking 45.8–67.6% 为 thinking token，Qwen Thinking 29.0–40.7%；Instant 变体输出几乎全为消息+工具调用，Gemma Instant 工具调用占 87.8–98.2%，说明生成主体是结构化动作而非自然语言。(4) 失败放大负载：失败运行平均上下文最高可达成功运行的 1.8 倍（GAIA 上 Gemma-T 34.6→40.6K、Qwen-I 44.9→62.4K；Terminal Bench Qwen 失败 79.2/76.6K vs 成功 44.4/45.9K），但 SWE-bench Pro 与 Gemma Instant 说明大上下文不必然等于失败。(5) 服务性能：LLM 占端到端时间 71–98%（DABStep 96–98%），工具占 2–29%（GAIA 最高 28.7%/24.9%，SWE-bench Pro 17.7%、Terminal Bench 17.6%）；理论缓存命中 87.9–99.3%、实测 84.6–99.5%，输入/输出比高达 53.9×–559.8× 而 append/output 仅 1.5×–7.3×，故 decode 占 LLM 时间 91.0–98.6%、prefill 仅 1.4–9.0%。(6) 缓存抖动：并发从 15 升至 25（Terminal-Bench）时命中率 98.85%→16.78%、生成吞吐 30.08→10.30 tok/s/req（最多降 66%）、prefill 0.51→3.46s；DABStep 并发 5→15 时命中率 98.53%→25.17%、吞吐 34.13→14.82 tok/s/req。(7) 工具画像：ADE 以 Read(29.8–41.7%)/Bash(23.2–30.0%) 为主（Gemma Instant Edit 占 51.2%），DABStep/Terminal 以 Bash 为主（50.5–87.8% / 53.2–79.5%），GAIA 以 WebFetch/WebSearch 为主（WebFetch 29.4–42.3%）；Bash 内部命令随域变化（ADE dbt 24.7–50.9%、DABStep grep 54.7% / python3 37.2–38.5%、GAIA curl ~25%）。最耗时工具是 Agent 与 TaskOutput（GAIA 上 Agent 均值 321.6s/916.0s，TaskOutput 最高 396.5s 且单次返回 3872 token），最易失败工具则是 Bash/Edit/Read（ADE Edit 95.4%、SWE-bench Pro Edit 77.8%、Bash 39.8%、GAIA Read 48.9%）。(8) 时间结构：多数负载在执行进度上从早期 Read/Explore（首四分位约 0.6–0.8）转向后期 Execute/Write（末四分位 0.8–1.0），GAIA 是主要例外（维持约 40–60 平衡）。(9) 趋势在更大模型上依然成立：GPT-5.5 失败运行 token 比成功高 27.5%（Terminal-Bench）与 20.2%（SWE-bench Pro）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体服务不能被建模为一串独立的长提示请求，而应视为"在持续增长的缓存上下文上的重复 decode"。高效智能体服务必须联合优化四件事：重复的模型重入（调度与批处理）、跨轮保留的长生命周期 KV/前缀缓存状态（涉及缓存保留、调度、offload 或重算的权衡）、随负载变化的工作量相关工具行为（区分轻量文件检查、shell 执行、web 检索与子智能体委派）、以及失败恢复机制（失败工具调用会追加错误观测并放大轮数与缓存占用，应被显式纳入负载画像）。缓存抖动是该理想 decode 主导假设在实际部署中的主要威胁：并发多智能体、长多轮上下文会超出 GPU 显存，使命中率骤降并使生成吞吐下降最多 66%，系统必须在重算与分层 offload 之间取舍。作者亦指明局限：仅覆盖 ReAct 式（含一层有界子智能体委派）与中等规模开源权重模型，投机/重叠工具执行、动态上下文压缩与摘要、分支/树搜索等高级编排未纳入，未来需在更大模型与更复杂编排下扩展刻画。

title: Personalizing Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model Agents over Long-term User Interactions
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based embodied agents have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks in physical environments. However, personalized assistance requires more than following generic instruction or recognizing object categories. In real-world scenarios, the intended target is often specified only implicitly through prior interactions, requiring agents to leverage personalized context accumulated over time. In this work, we propose POLAR, a multiomodal memory-augmented framework for personalized embodied agents over long-term user interactions. POLAR organizes prior interactions into a multimodal knowledge graph that captures semantic memory for personalized context and visual concepts, and episodic memory for embodied experiences such as agent trajectories. To execute embodied tasks, POLAR retrieves relevant memories to interpret the current request and guide task execution. We evaluate POLAR across multiple MLLM backbones and diverse evaluation scenarios to study the role of memory in long-term personalization. Results show that the proposed memory mechanism consistently improves performance by enabling more effective use of information accumulated over prior interactions. The gains are especially pronounced when the agents are required to reason across multiple interactions, perform multi-hop inference, or tracking updates in user-specific context over time.

AI.tldr: POLAR是一个多模态记忆增强框架，通过构建包含语义记忆和情景记忆的多模态知识图，实现个性化具身智能体的长期交互能力。该方法可与多种MLLM backbone结合，在跨交互推理、多跳推理和用户上下文跟踪等任务上表现出显著提升。
AI.motivation: Current embodied agents based on multimodal large language models can follow generic instructions and recognize object categories, but they lack the ability to leverage personalized context accumulated over time. In real-world scenarios, intended targets are often specified implicitly through prior interactions, requiring agents to maintain and utilize long-term user-specific information.
AI.method: POLAR organizes prior interactions into a multimodal knowledge graph with two memory components: (1) semantic memory for personalized context and visual concepts, (2) episodic memory for embodied experiences (e.g., agent trajectories). During task execution, relevant memories are retrieved to interpret user requests and guide task completion.
AI.result: The proposed memory mechanism consistently improves performance across multiple MLLM backbones and diverse evaluation scenarios. The improvement is particularly significant for tasks requiring cross-interaction reasoning, multi-hop inference, and tracking user-specific context updates over time.
AI.conclusion: POLAR provides a generic memory-augmented solution that can be combined with various MLLM backbones to enable personalized embodied assistance over long-term interactions.

title: CroCo: Cross-Lingual Contrastive Preference Tuning on Self-Generations
summary: Prior work establishes that controlled contrastiveness between self-generated responses from large language models, set via reward scores, improves downstream preference tuning in English. We extend this method to multiple languages and evaluate two models across a total of 14 high and low-resource languages on a diverse set of tasks. Our central finding is that cross-lingual contrastive preference tuning on self-generations (CroCo) transfers without language-specific preference annotation. A reward model trained on English preferences (atop a multilingual base) produces useful within-language rankings across most languages, and pairing in either a monolingual or multilingual setting improves over each model on the majority of setups while preventing the catastrophic forgetting of supervised fine-tuning. We observe that the gains require on-policy data. Off-policy responses reduce the benefit and online preference optimization fails to improve over the offline variant. Specifically, on structured tasks, our method matches or exceeds the base in 6/7 languages for EuroLLM-9B and 4/7 settings for Aya-3B. On open-ended generation, both tuned models win against their respective base across 11 evaluated languages. Overall, we show promising directions for multilingual preference tuning.

AI.tldr: 本研究将英语中的对比偏好调优方法扩展到多语言场景，提出CroCo方法。通过在自生成响应上进行跨语言对比学习，利用英语偏好数据即可实现有效的跨语言迁移，在14种语言的结构化和开放式生成任务中均表现出改善效果，且能防止灾难性遗忘。关键发现是线上数据至关重要，线下响应会削弱收益。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证明在英语中，通过奖励分数控制大型语言模型自生成响应之间的对比性可改进下游偏好调优。该研究将此方法从英语扩展到多语言场景，探索是否可以在缺乏目标语言标注偏好数据的情况下实现跨语言迁移。
AI.method: 提出跨语言对比偏好调优方法(CroCo)，在自生成响应上进行对比学习；使用英语偏好数据训练奖励模型，并将其应用于14种高/低资源语言；在两种模型(EuroLLM-9B和Aya-3B)上进行评估，涵盖结构化任务和开放式生成任务；采用线上(on-policy)数据进行训练。
AI.result: 关键发现：1)跨语言对比偏好调优可实现无语言特定偏标注的迁移；2)英语偏好训练的奖励模型在多数语言中产生有效的语言内排序；3)单语或多语配对设置在大多数实验配置中优于基线模型；4)收益需要线上数据支持，线下数据会降低效果；5)结构化任务中EuroLLM-9B在6/7语言、Aya-3B在4/7设置上匹配或超越基线；6)开放式生成任务中两种模型在11种评估语言上均战胜各自基线。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了跨语言偏好调优的有前景方向。通过CroCo方法，可以在不使用目标语言标注偏好数据的情况下，利用英语偏好数据实现跨语言迁移，提升多语言模型在结构和开放式生成任务上的表现，同时防止监督微调的灾难性遗忘。

title: SilIF: Silhouette-Augmented Isolation Forest for Unsupervised Transaction Fraud Detection
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection is widely used in transaction fraud detection where labels are scarce. Isolation Forest (IF) is among the most popular classical methods due to its scalability and ease of deployment. We propose SilIF, an augmentation of Isolation Forest that adds a silhouette-based scoring layer computed in a representation space induced by the trees of the forest. For each point, we extract a vector of per-tree path lengths, cluster these "fingerprints" into structural groups, and compute a silhouette score that measures how well the point fits its assigned group versus the nearest alternative. The silhouette signal is combined with the base IF score via a single hyperparameter alpha. On the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection benchmark (~590K transactions, 3.5% fraud), SilIF with alpha=1.0 improves over plain Isolation Forest by +0.0080 AUC-PR on average across five seeds, with SilIF winning on all five seeds (paired t-test p=0.046). We also report results on a synthetic credit-card dataset (Sparkov) where the silhouette augmentation does not improve over plain IF, and we characterize the conditions that distinguish the two outcomes. The paper presents SilIF as a tunable, easy-to-deploy enhancement to Isolation Forest with honest reporting of when it helps and when it does not. Code at https://github.com/venkat15vk/silif-anomaly-detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SilIF，通过在隔离森林的表示空间中基于轮廓系数增强异常评分，在真实交易数据上验证有效，同时诚实报告了其在合成数据上无效的情况，为Isolation Forest提供了一种可调且易部署的增强方案。
AI.motivation: 在标签稀缺的交易欺诈检测场景中，无监督异常检测广泛应用，Isolation Forest因可扩展性和易部署性成为流行方法，但存在改进空间。
AI.method: 提出SilIF方法：在隔离森林的树结构诱导的表示空间中，对每个点提取每棵树的路径长度向量作为"指纹"，聚类这些指纹形成结构组，计算轮廓系数衡量点与其组的拟合程度，最后将轮廓信号与基础IF分数通过超参数alpha组合。
AI.result: 在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测基准数据集上，SilIF（α=1.0）相比标准Isolation Forest平均提升AUC-PR 0.0080，5次种子实验全部获胜（配对t检验p=0.046）；在Sparkov合成信用卡数据集上未显示优势，并明确了区分两类结果的适用条件。
AI.conclusion: SilIF作为一种可调、易部署的Isolation Forest增强方法，在特定数据集上有效，但在合成数据集上效果不显著，表明其适用性取决于数据结构特征。

title: Faults and Pitfalls in Implementing the Right to be Forgotten
summary: Right to be Forgotten (RTBF) in one of the oldest and prominent of the legal data rights. While its legal intention is straight forward (for example, the GDPR describes it in just 417 words), the computing community has found it challenging to implement this in practice. For example, regulators have issued 205 RTBF violations in the first five years of GDPR i.e., an RTBF failure once every 9 days, on average. In this work, we identify the uncertainties and risks in supporting RTBF from a computing perspective. Then, to mitigate these challenges, we propose a two-phase approach that bridges an intrinsic dichotomy between law and computing. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique by showing how it could have fully avoided 80% of RTBF violations that occurred in the year-6 of GDPR. We also discover six long-standing practices of computing and data management that have become anti-patterns for RTBF. Finally, to ground our research, we introduce RTBF capability into Elasticsearch, a popular open-source search engine.

AI.tldr: 本文从计算视角识别了实现"被遗忘权"的不确定性与风险，提出两阶段解决方案以弥合法律意图与技术实现间的鸿沟。研究表明该方法可避免80%的RTBF违规，并发现六个长期存在的反模式。最终在Elasticsearch中成功实现了RTBF能力。
AI.motivation: GDPR实施的前五年内发生了205次RTBF违规（平均每9天一次），而法律文本仅417词即可描述该权利，说明技术上实现RTBF存在重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法以弥合法律与计算之间的内在二分法；同时将RTBF能力实际集成到Elasticsearch开源搜索引擎中以验证技术可行性。
AI.result: 可避免GDPR第六年80%的RTBF违规；发现六个已成为RTBF反模式的长效计算与数据管理实践。
AI.conclusion: 成功将RTBF能力集成到Elasticsearch搜索引擎中，为开源系统提供了可落地的技术实现方案。

title: How Students (Mis)understand Conditionals and Loops -- A Taxonomy
summary: Understanding student difficulties in programming is a complex challenge due to the wide range of topics and the abundant varieties of misconceptions and errors. This paper presents the design and development of a fine-grained taxonomy that categorizes novice programmers' difficulties specifically related to reading and understanding the control flow constructs selection and iteration. Building upon prior research and our own empirical data from quizzes and interviews with students, the taxonomy is constructed through the iterative methodology of the Extended Taxonomy Design Process (ETDP). Key contributions include clear distinctions between different student difficulties and a detailed analysis of common student misunderstandings concerning conditional statements and loops. The taxonomy aims to aid computing education researchers by providing a harmonized framework to classify and analyze student errors, fostering deeper theoretical insights and informing pedagogical strategies. Future work will involve applying the taxonomy to novel student data and evaluating its usability among educators and researchers.

AI.tldr: This paper develops a fine-grained taxonomy for categorizing novice programmers' difficulties in understanding control flow constructs (selection and iteration) using an iterative design methodology.
AI.motivation: Understanding student difficulties in programming is complex due to the wide range of topics and abundant varieties of misconceptions and errors, necessitating a systematic classification approach.
AI.method: Iterative Extended Taxonomy Design Process (ETDP), integrating prior research with empirical data from student quizzes and interviews to construct a fine-grained taxonomy.
AI.result: A fine-grained taxonomy distinguishing different student difficulties with detailed analysis of misunderstandings concerning conditional statements and loops.
AI.conclusion: The taxonomy provides a harmonized framework for computing education researchers to classify and analyze student errors, fostering theoretical insights and informing pedagogical strategies. Future work includes applying the taxonomy to novel student data and evaluating its usability.

title: Tool-Schema Compression Enables Agentic RAG Under Constrained Context Budgets
comment: 12 pages (8 main + 4 appendix), 7 tables, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/SKZL-AI/tscg
summary: Agentic RAG systems that equip language models with dozens to hundreds of tool definitions face a critical resource conflict: tool schemas consume the same context window needed for retrieval-augmented generation. We present the first systematic study of this tool-context trade-off, evaluating 14 models spanning 1.5B-32B local models plus one frontier API model across 6,566 controlled API calls at three context budgets (8K, 16K, 32K) with 28 tool definitions. Applying TSCG conservative-profile compression (44-50% schema token savings), we observe a binary enablement effect: at 8K tokens, JSON-schema tool definitions overflow the context window entirely, yielding near-zero EM (2.6% average), while compressed schemas restore RAG functionality with +20.5 pp average exact-match lift across all eight models (+24.7 pp among the six exhibiting full enablement). At 32K -- where both formats fit -- four of five tested models show delta <= 1 pp, confirming the effect is purely budget-driven. External validation on HotpotQA (50 multi-hop questions) shows +48 pp EM under the same overflow scenario. Frontier scaling tests demonstrate that JSON schemas overflow at ~494 tools while compressed schemas remain operational beyond 800 tools. Our results establish tool-schema compression as a necessary infrastructure layer for agentic RAG in constrained-context deployments. All code, data, and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 这是首个系统研究"工具 Schema 压缩 × Agentic RAG 上下文预算"权衡的受控实验：14 个本地模型（1.5B–32B）+ 1 个前沿 API 模型，6,566 次 API 调用，8K/16K/32K 三档上下文，28 个工具定义。核心发现是"二值使能（binary enablement）"效应：在 8K 预算下，原始 JSON Schema（约 11,000 tokens）直接溢出上下文窗口，导致几乎全盘失效（平均 EM 仅 2.6%）；经 TSCG conservative-profile 压缩（节省 44–50% tokens）后可装入 1–2 个检索块，EM 恢复到 23.1%（+20.5 pp，6 个完全使能模型中 +24.7 pp）；在 32K 两种格式均能容纳时，5 个模型中 4 个 |ΔEM| ≤ 1 pp，证明增益纯粹由预算驱动而非格式本身。HotpotQA 外部验证 +48 pp EM；前沿扩展实验显示 JSON Schema 约在 494 个工具处溢出，压缩后超过 800 个工具仍可运行（操作范围 +63%）。结论：工具 Schema 压缩应被视为受限上下文部署下 Agentic RAG 的必要基础设施层，而非可选优化。
AI.motivation: 【研究动机】Agentic RAG 系统需要在同一上下文窗口内同时容纳系统提示、检索块（chunk）、对话历史、输出空间与数十至数百个工具的 JSON Schema 定义，形成"零和"资源冲突。单个工具 Schema 平均 300–500 tokens，28 个工具即约 11,000 tokens，直接超出 8K 窗口；而生产环境通过 MCP 等协议暴露 20–100+ 工具已成常态。现有 RAG 评估普遍默认"工具 Schema 装得下"这一前提，本文证明该前提在仅 28 个工具的 8K 场景下即告失效。同时，既有提示压缩工作（LLMLingua 等）针对自由文本，无法保持 JSON Schema 的语法、参数类型与枚举等结构不变量，也从未在"Schema token 与检索块争夺同一预算"的交互机制下被评估过。【核心假设】若对工具 Schema 做确定性、结构保持的压缩（如 TSCG，节省 44–68% tokens），可在小上下文下恢复 RAG 能力；而在预算充裕时，压缩不应带来任何准确率损失（即"无损"）。
AI.method: 【方法】1）上下文预算建模：形式化 B_RAG = B − B_sys(350) − B_schema(f,n) − B_hist(1500) − B_out(512)，可容纳块数 k = ⌊B_RAG/c̄⌋（c̄=350 tokens）。28 工具时 B_schema(json)≈11,000 > B=8,192 → B_RAG<0、k=0（溢出）；TSCG 后 ≈5,500，剩余 265–330 tokens，k≥1。2）自建 NovaTech-28 基准：模拟中型科技公司，28 个工具（数据库查询/文档检索/计算/通信，各 3–8 个带类型参数）、40 个检索块（4 类、含相关性标签）、100 道五类问题（单跳文档 25、单跳数据库 25、多跳 20、需工具 20、不可答 10）。3）ReAct 风格 Agent 循环（≤3 步），除 schema 格式外所有提示严格相同，构成配对设计。4）模型：Tier A 4 个（Phi-4 14B、Llama 3.1:8B、Gemma3:12B、Qwen3:14B）、Tier B 3 个（Mistral-Small 24B、Qwen2.5-Coder:32B、Gemma4:26B）、Tier C 6 个（1.5B–7B，仅测 16K）、API 1 个（Claude Sonnet 4，含 200K）；本地模型跑在 2×RTX 5070 Ti/Ollama，合计约 10 GPU 小时、$107 API 成本、0% 错误率。5）指标：EM、Token F1、工具选择准确率、RAG 覆盖率、上下文溢出二值标志；统计采用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Cohen's d、10,000 次 bootstrap 的 95% CI（seed=42），未做多重比较校正。6）外部验证：HotpotQA dev-distractor 集 50 道中/难多跳题（2 gold + 8 distractor 段落），Phi-4 @8K、28 工具。7）前沿扩展：合成 50/100/200/300/500/800 工具集，Sonnet 4 @200K，并以 1 工具粒度扫描溢出阈值。8）机制分析：拟合上下文利用饱和模型 C(k)=C_max(1−e^{−λk})+C_0（网格搜索，n=4,700 个 (k,F1) 对），并做 conservative vs. balanced profile 消融（Phi-4、Llama 3.1:8B，400 次调用）。
AI.result: 【主要结果】1）8K 二值使能（表 1）：8 个模型 JSON 条件 100% 溢出、EM 0–10（均值 2.6），TSCG 后 EM 12–36（均值 23.1），平均 +20.5 pp；6 个"完全使能"模型平均 +24.7 pp，前六名 p<0.01（Llama 3.1:8B 1→34、Phi-4 14B 2→33、Mistral-Small 24B 4→33、Sonnet 4 10→36、Qwen2.5-Coder 3→18、Gemma3:12B 1→15），Gemma4:26B 因持续输出解析失败仅 0→4（16K 下可达 26–28%）。2）16K"块解放但无增益"（控制实验）：JSON 约 9 块 vs TSCG 26 块（+17–19 块，3× 检索上下文），14 模型中位 ΔEM=−1 pp，12/14 模型 |ΔEM|≤3 pp，无一达 p<0.05（唯一例外 Qwen3:4B −8 pp，p=0.019）→ 说明基准在约 9 块处饱和。3）32K 天花板控制：5 个模型中 4 个 ΔEM∈{−1,0,+1} pp 且不显著；例外 Qwen2.5-Coder:32B +12 pp（p<0.001），作者归因于与预算机制无关的"格式翻译红利"（与先前 TSCG 评测中模型特异的算子敏感性一致）。4）HotpotQA 外部验证：JSON 全部溢出、EM=0；TSCG B_RAG≈421、平均 3.4 块（2–5），EM 48.0、F1 0.645、74% 子串匹配、24/50 精确匹配 → +48 pp，强于 NovaTech 同模型的 +31 pp（因 HotpotQA gold 段落更短更密集）。5）前沿扩展（Sonnet 4 @200K）：50–300 工具子溢出区间两格式相当（~77% EM，|Δ|≤6.7 pp，p>0.10）；JSON 在 ~494 工具处完全溢出（EM=0），TSCG 在 500 工具达 90% EM、800 工具达 100%，超过 803 工具仍可运行，操作范围 +63%；首次检索块丢失阈值 JSON 82 工具 vs TSCG 164 工具；每工具 token 成本 JSON 380–473、TSCG 205–261，节省率 44.7–46.4%。6）上下文利用模型：C_max=0.18、λ=25.9、C_0=0.095、R²=0.011（n=4,700），λ≫1 表明近乎阶跃式饱和——第一块边际增益最大（ΔF1=+0.18，k:0→1），k≥2 迅速饱和，16K 两格式均已在饱和平台。7）复合格式–预算交互（探索性）：Sonnet 4 8K+TSCG（F1=0.406, k=2）反而优于 16K+JSON（F1=0.369, k=11），+0.037 F1，但 p=0.12、d=0.17，仅列为待验证观察。8）干扰稀释：16K 下块增量与 EM 增量负相关 r=−0.50（n=14），14 个模型中 10 个 ΔF1≤0；≤8B 小模型最明显（Qwen3:4B ΔEM=−8 pp、Mistral:7B ΔF1=−4.3 pp 却多拿 18 块），与"lost in the middle"机制呼应。9）分类别结果（表 6）：单跳文档 +13.7 pp、不可答 +14.6 pp（受益于 8K 使能），需工具仅 +0.9 pp（工具选择依赖 Schema 理解而非检索量），多跳 EM 两者均为 0。10）消融：balanced profile（~53% 节省，比 conservative 多释放 395 tokens ≈ 1 块）精度几乎相同（ΔEM=+0.8 pp，无单元 p<0.05），说明模型主要依赖参数名与类型理解 Schema，描述文本可安全剥离。【评价】优点是配对设计严格控制了提示变量、8K/16K/32K 三档构成完整的"溢出–解放–天花板"逻辑闭环，并有外部数据集与前沿扩展双重验证；局限是 NovaTech-28 为合成基准、仅主测 conservative profile 且消融只覆盖 2 模型×2 预算、Tier C 仅在 16K 测、前沿实验仅单模型单预算、静态填充策略未考虑迭代检索，且未做多重比较校正（作者以 p<0.001 与控制条件非独立检验作辩护）。此外拟合模型 R²=0.011 很低，饱和曲线更多是结构性解读而非严格统计证据。
AI.conclusion: 工具 Schema 压缩应从"可选的成本优化"重新定位为"受限上下文下 Agentic RAG 的必要使能层（enablement layer）"：8K 场景下的改进不是边际提升而是类别性差异——从 2.6% EM 的溢出性失效（完全无法运行、无法通过提示工程或检索调优改进）转为可迭代优化的功能系统。作者同时明确"何时不必压缩"：32K 与前沿子溢出区间两格式精度一致，压缩的收益是纯运营性的（使 RAG 可运行、降低成本、保留预算给更长历史/更大输出），而非引入准确率伪影。作者建议 Schema 压缩与动态工具选择（TinyAgent 式路由到相关工具子集）互补并联合部署，并指出无论压缩与否，任意固定窗口在足够高的工具数量下终将溢出，Schema 压缩只是把这条天花板从 ~494 工具推到 >803 工具。

title: Persistent AI Agents in Academic Research: A Single-Investigator Implementation Case Study
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 3 main tables; supplementary appendix with 6 tables, 2 figures, and a reproducibility methods section. Describes 17 configured agents in a persistent research environment and introduces the PARE-M (Persistent Agentic Research Environment Measurement) framework
summary: Background: Large language models are typically evaluated as models, benchmarks, or short conversational episodes. Less is known about what happens when an agent is embedded persistently in a real academic research environment with durable memory, local files, external tools, scheduled routines, delegated roles, and explicit safety protocols. Methods: A structured self-observed implementation case study was conducted from January 31 to May 25, 2026. The unit of analysis was the persistent human-agent environment: researcher, agent runtime, memory layer, tools, repositories, scheduled jobs, specialized agent roles, and governance rules. Outcomes were organized using PARE-M (Persistent Agentic Research Environment Measurement), a measurement framework covering architecture, utilization, artifact production, resource use, reproducibility, and governance. Results: Recoverable main-agent telemetry contained 75,671 de-duplicated records across 96 active days, with 8,059 user-role and 23,710 assistant-role messages. The workspace included 502 memory-related files, 17 configured agent directories, and 57 skill files. Active system time was 579.7 hours (30-minute capped-gap estimate). Memory-derived records identified 482 output-proxy events and 889 failure, verification, correction, or protocol-proxy events. A strict May 2026 trajectory subset captured 627 model-completed events and 73.95 million recorded tokens, of which 82.9% were cache reads. Conclusions: The workflow was cache-dominant, suggesting that persistent agentic environments may shift the economic unit from cost per token to cost per completed artifact. Future evaluations should use artifact-level denominators, reproducible parsing rules, correction taxonomies, and independent coding of governance events.

AI.tldr: This paper presents the first long-duration case study of a persistent LLM agent in real academic research, introducing the PARE-M measurement framework. Results show cache-dominant resource usage and highlight the need to shift evaluation metrics from token-based to artifact-based cost models.
AI.motivation: Traditional LLM evaluation focuses on benchmarks or short conversations, but lacks understanding of persistent agentic systems embedded in real-world research settings with memory, tools, and protocols.
AI.method: A structured self-observed case study (Jan 31–May 25, 2026) was conducted on a persistent human-agent research environment. Analysis units included the agent runtime, memory layer, tools, repositories, scheduled jobs, specialized roles, and governance rules. The PARE-M framework was used to measure architecture, utilization, artifact production, resource use, reproducibility, and governance.
AI.result: Over 96 active days: 75,671 telemetry records, 8,059 user messages, 23,710 assistant messages, 502 memory files, 17 agent directories, 57 skill files, 579.7 active hours, 482 output-proxy events, 889 failure/correction events, 627 model-completed events, and 73.95M tokens (82.9% cache reads).
AI.conclusion: The persistent agentic workflow proved cache-dominant, indicating that evaluation metrics should shift from cost-per-token to cost-per-completed-artifact. Future research should adopt artifact-level denominators, reproducible parsing rules, correction taxonomies, and independent governance event coding.

title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
summary: Adapting large language models (LLMs) for personalized recommendation requires aligning their general-purpose capabilities with user-specific preferences while effectively leveraging both behavioral and semantic signals. Existing approaches typically integrate these signals at either the input level (e.g., injecting behavioral embeddings into the token space) or the output level (e.g., contrastive alignment of separate encoders), suffering from distribution gaps or lack of end-to-end task supervision. In this work, we introduce L2Rec, which unifies behavioral and semantic understanding at the parameter level of LLMs. Our key insight is that the same set of Transformer parameters can serve as a shared medium for both views: by applying view-specific, personalized low-rank perturbations via a Dual-view Personalized Mixture-of-Experts (DPMoE) mechanism, L2Rec enables a single LLM backbone to produce complementary behavioral and semantic adaptations for each user with minimal representation-level misalignment. An adaptive cross-view fusion module further integrates the dual-view outputs into a unified user preference. Experiments on four datasets show that L2Rec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and online A/B testing on a large-scale industrial platform validates significant improvements in key engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: L2Rec通过DPMoE机制实现参数级behavioral-semantic统一适配，解决传统方法分布对齐问题，工业验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法在input-level或output-level整合behavioral和semantic信号，存在distribution gap或缺乏端到端监督的问题。
AI.method: 提出Dual-view Personalized MoE (DPMoE)机制，通过 view-specific 低秩扰动实现参数级统一；设计 adaptive cross-view fusion module 整合双视图输出。
AI.result: 四个数据集实验表明L2Rec一致优于SOTA基线；大规模工业平台A/B测试验证关键 engagement metrics 显著提升。
AI.conclusion: L2Rec通过单一LLM主干实现 behavioral 和 semantic 双重适应，融合模块有效整合双视图输出，在工业场景验证有效。

title: Totoro$^+$: An Adaptive and Scalable Edge Federated Learning System
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems (TPDS). This version includes the appendix
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning (ML) technique that enables in-situ model training and inference on decentralized edge devices. We propose Totoro$^+$, a novel scalable FL system that enables massive FL applications to run simultaneously on edge networks. The key insight is to explore a distributed hash table (DHT)-based peer-to-peer (P2P) model to re-architect the centralized FL system design into a fully decentralized one. In contrast to previous studies where many FL applications shared one centralized parameter server, Totoro$^+$ assigns a dedicated parameter server to each application. Any edge node can act as any application's coordinator, aggregator, client selector, worker (participant device), or any combination of the above, thereby radically improving scalability and adaptivity. Totoro$^+$ introduces three innovations to realize its design: a locality-aware P2P multi-ring structure, a publish/subscribe-based forest abstraction, and a game-theoretic path planning model with a guarantee of an $ε$-approximate Nash equilibrium. Real-world experiments on 500 Amazon EC2 servers show that Totoro$^+$ scales gracefully with the number of FL applications and $N$ edge nodes speeds up the total training time by $1.2\times-14.0\times$, achieves $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ hops for model dissemination and gradient aggregation with millions of nodes, and efficiently adapts to the practical edge networks and churns.

AI.tldr: Totoro+ 是一个面向边缘网络的全去中心化联邦学习系统：它把传统的“单主/多从（single master/many workers）”参数服务器架构重构为基于 DHT 的 P2P 架构，为每个 FL 应用分配独立的数据流树（而非共享一个中心参数服务器），任意边缘节点都可充当任一应用的协调器、聚合器、客户端选择器或工作节点。其三项核心创新为：局部性感知的多环 P2P 结构、基于发布/订阅的“森林”抽象（含广告-发现树），以及带 ε-近似纳什均衡保证的博弈论路径规划模型。在 500 台 Amazon EC2 节点上，相比 OpenFL 与 FedScale，训练总时间加速 1.2×–14.0×，模型分发与梯度聚合在百万节点规模下保持 O(log N) 跳，并可有效适应带宽受限、链路不可靠与节点频繁抖动（churn）的边缘环境。
AI.motivation: 论文面向“智能交通/自动驾驶”等典型边缘场景：数百万终端设备经由数十万边缘节点（服务器、网关、路由器，且分属不同管理方）接入云端，后台需同时运行海量异构 FL 应用（驾驶行为预测、交通流分析、异常检测等）。作者指出当前主流 FL 框架（Meta PAPAYA、LinkedIn FLINT、Google FL、IBM FL、Apple federated task 等）均为集中式或分层的“1 主/多从”架构，存在两大瓶颈：挑战一（可扩展性）——单一 Coordinator 串行调度导致排队延迟，多个应用共享参数服务器造成单点过载；多归属边缘站点缺乏全局负载视图，无法均衡任务，且固定 FL 策略无法按应用定制。挑战二（适应性）——边缘链路时延不可预测、带宽受限、节点频繁失效/掉线、计算存储资源紧张且无背压，静态划分参数服务器（如一机架一服务器）无法快速自适应，straggler 与链路失效只能靠资源冗余或链路复制来掩盖。此外，现有的去中心化 FL（P2PFL）工作多聚焦于聚合算法设计，缺乏任务管理、应用定制、故障恢复等跨层系统支撑。
AI.method: 系统分为三层。（1）局部性感知 P2P 多环结构：基于 Pastry 实现 DHT 覆盖网络（128-bit NodeId，路由表/叶集/邻域集），将单环按 RTT diameter 用 Ratnasamy & Shenker 分布式分箱划分为 m 个“边缘区”环；NodeId 改为 (m+n) 位（前缀为 zone Id、后缀为区内 NodeId），并设计边界感知的两级路由表，使不同站点的数据路径收敛于站内节点，管理员可据此实现管理域隔离与隐私保护。（2）发布/订阅森林抽象：每个 FL 应用以 AppId=hash(名称、创建者公钥、随机盐)（SHA-1）为键，经 JOIN 消息在 DHT 上汇聚到 NodeId 数值最接近 AppId 的会合节点作为根，形成动态结构数据流树；根即 master（发布者），内部节点承担 coordinator/aggregator/client selector，叶子节点为 worker（订阅者），逐层完成模型广播与梯度聚合（聚合函数可由应用自定义，如 FedAvg/FedProx）。各应用树之外再构建一棵“广告-发现（AD）树”，实现应用发布、发现与加入/退出。故障恢复：worker 失效由子节点发 JOIN 消息重建；master 失效则每轮将训练状态复制到邻域集 k=2 个节点，新 master 取回复本继续训练。（3）高层 API：抽象 Join/CreateTree/Subscribe/Unsubscribe/Broadcast/Aggregate/onTimer 等接口，支持应用级定制（差分隐私、安全聚合、同态加密、客户端选择、同步/半同步/异步更新、跨区多环 m×O(log N) 路由）。路径规划建模为带 bandit 反馈的广义和拥堵博弈：奖励 r_n(p)=r^{p_n}(n^{p_n}(p), θ_{p_n}) 显式依赖同路径上其他节点数量（带宽共享导致速率下降）；算法每 episode 采样 τ 个包，用策略相关矩阵 M(λ) 取行列式最小者为探索策略 ρ（保证无零元素），用线性回归估计势函数梯度，再以 Frank-Wolfe 更新线性组合并混入探索项。理论上 Nash-Regret(T) ≤ Õ(N²T^{5/6} log N)（k≥2/N），推出 ε-近似纳什均衡，异步情形下仅增加次线性遗憾项；每 episode 时间复杂度 O(τ log³N + |Δ(P_n)| log³N)。实现基于 Pastry v2.1 + Scribe（Java）与 PyTorch（Python 封装），另提出“逻辑 P2P 节点”机制按物理资源（CPU/内存/带宽/GPU）映射 1~16 个 NodeId 以适配异构节点。
AI.result: 在 500 台 Amazon EC2（t2.medium，每 JVM 模拟一个边缘节点，最大模拟 10 万节点）上，用澳大利亚 EUA 数据集（95,271 个基站、12 个州）划分地理分区，评测 CV/NLP 真实任务。(1) 可扩展性：500 棵树时 99.5% 节点担任不超过 3 棵树的 root/master，master 分布随负载自动伸缩，树在跨拓扑节点间分布均衡；节点数从 20 指数增至 5120 时，模型分发与梯度聚合时间仅线性增长（受树深 O(log N) 限制）。(2) 训练效率：Google Speech（ResNet-34）与 FEMNIST（ShuffleNet V2）上，5~20 个应用并行训练达到同等精度总耗时较 OpenFL/FedScale 加速 1.2×–14.0×（Speech 3.0×–14.0×，FEMNIST 1.2×–11.5×）；fanout=32 时训练 1/5/10/20 个模型总时长几乎相同（15.41→15.47 小时）。(3) 通信开销：树数增加 10× 时每节点流量仅增 1.19×(TCP)/1.29×(UDP)，因新建树仅沿覆盖层路由 JOIN 消息、可摊销到既有 overlay 链路。(4) 适应性：相较只看链路质量、忽略带宽容量的 bandit 版 Totoro，博弈论版本在墨尔本 1000 节点（900 终端+100 服务器，带宽 20–100 Mbps）上累计包时延更低（多数响应 <2000 ms）、Nash 遗憾更接近最优并呈次线性、下一跳分布更均匀；单次运行时间稳定在约 50 ms，而 Totoro 因需逐跳凸优化随节点数增至约 1500 ms。(5) 容错：单树失败节点从 1 增至 128 时恢复时间线性增长（仅 O(log_{2^b}N) 节点参与）；多树 5% 节点同时失效时恢复时间保持稳定。附录还表明将 Totoro+ 的路由模型嵌入 ComDML/GossipFL 可缩短 time-to-accuracy，并验证了异构资源下逻辑 P2P 节点能把更多 master 与通信负载分配给高配节点。
AI.conclusion: Totoro+ 通过“用 DHT-P2P 模型取代集中式参数服务器”这一关键洞见，把 FL 系统架构从 1:n 分解为 m:n 的“许多 master/许多 worker”全去中心化形态，配合局部性感知多环、发布/订阅森林抽象与博弈论路径规划三大利器，在可扩展性（负载均衡、O(log N) 跳、应用发现）、FL 有效性（time-to-accuracy 大幅加速）与边缘适应性（带宽受限、链路不稳、节点抖动、故障恢复）三方面同时优于 OpenFL/FedScale 等现有系统，CPU/内存开销可忽略，具备部署到资源受限边缘节点与开放众包平台的潜力。相对会议版（EuroSys'24）新增了 AD 树、博弈论路径规划（替代 bandit 模型）与 master/worker 双侧故障恢复机制，并补充了 Nash 遗憾、受限异步与多组异构实验。遗留问题与未来工作包括：AD 树的对抗性安全（拟引入类似 CA 的 NodeId/AppId 证书）、多播扩展算法（Algorithm 2）的纳什遗憾上界未定、真实生产环境大规模部署验证，以及非 IID 数据与个性化等应用侧能力需进一步工程化。

title: Constraint acquisition needs better benchmarks
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, for the associated dataset, see https://github.com/MPMMine/MPMMine
summary: Constraint Acquisition (CA) and related research on the validation and enhancement of Mathematical Programming (MP) models from domain knowledge artifacts are currently limited by inadequate benchmarks. This deficiency impedes reproducibility and cross-study comparability, slowing the maturation of CA methods. Existing benchmarks were designed for solver evaluation rather than for assessing CA algorithms. They are loosely organized, treat individual problems inconsistently, and omit the domain knowledge artifacts required by CA methods. This work presents MPMMine, a benchmark suite designed to assess algorithms that discover, validate, and enhance MP models using diverse domain knowledge artifacts. MPMMine is guided by consistency, standardization, completeness, extensibility, openness, and version control. It adopts a uniform structure and relies on open formats: MiniZinc, CommonMark, and JSON. It provides multiple models per problem, tens of instances per model, and thousands of solutions and non-solutions in both integer and continuous domains, alongside natural-language descriptions to support text-to-model methods.

AI.tldr: MPMMine 是一个面向数学规划模型挖掘（MPMM，含约束获取 CA、模型一致性检查与模型增强）的标准化基准套件：由 20 个 OR 问题、28 个 MP 模型、387 个实例、约 570 万个解/非解工件及 362 篇自然语言描述组成，统一采用 MiniZinc/CommonMark/JSON 开放格式，遵循一致性、标准化、完备性、可扩展性、开放性、版本控制六项设计原则；配套 mpmmine-py 访问包与 MPMMine Leaderboard 对 4 种 SOTA CA 算法做统一条件下的系统评测。
AI.motivation: 约束获取（CA）及更广义的“数学规划模型挖掘”（MPMM——模型发现、一致性校验、模型增强）研究长期受制于基准缺失：现有 CSPLib、MiniZinc challenge、MIPLIB、Netlib、RLFAP、NL4Opt、PTHG-21、CP-Bench 等均面向求解器评测而非 MPMM 算法，普遍存在目录与元数据不统一、问题类狭窄、缺少示例解/反例/文本描述、实验协议细节缺失、实例规模单一、连续与混合整数问题稀缺等问题。由此导致：(1) 基准非标准（数据采集与整理成本高、编码方式可能偏袒被测算法）；(2) 实验不可复现（训练/测试解如何生成、分布如何、约束基数上界等未说明）；(3) 结果不可比（性能差异源自算法进步还是实验设置差异难以区分）；(4) 仅评测单实例无法反映规模扩展性；(5) 连续/混合问题被忽视（如何处理非精确变量值、容差设置成谜）。作者认为根源在于缺乏专为 MPMM 打造的研究基础设施，多数 MPMM 工作仍停留在 TRL 3 的实验室阶段，难以进入 TRL 4–5 的模拟环境验证。
AI.method: 设计并实现三部分成果。(1) MPMMine 基准集：遵循六条行为准则——一致性（全部问题统一四级目录层次：Problem→MP Models→descriptions/instances→artifacts，采用分层唯一 ID 如 MPMMine-P003M002I003S00055，含 manifest.json 元数据、tags、features、alternative_ids）、标准化（MiniZinc 模型与校验器、CommonMark 描述、JSON 元数据）、完备性（每个模型配 checker.mzn，验证解可行性与非解不可行性；提供参数化实例、多组通用无参数描述）、可扩展性、开放性（开源）、版本控制（数据按文档化协议生成，公开可追溯）。同一问题提供多种等价编码模型，每个模型数十个不同规模/复杂度实例，提供离散、连续与混合域的数千解与非解，并配套自然语言描述以支持 text-to-model 方法。数据生成遵循明确记录的协议，保证可复现与共享训练/测试集。(2) mpmmine-py Python 包：提供访问各工件的 API，并对压缩包与文件系统直访做性能优化（延迟显著降低、磁盘占用减少 5–6 倍，压缩为单文件可进一步降低延迟数倍）。(3) MPMMine Leaderboard：基于开源实现，通过隔离容器适配各算法输入/输出，在一致条件下系统评测 4 种 SOTA MPMM 发现算法，生成交互式排行榜。
AI.result: MPMMine 包含 20 个真实 OR 领域问题、28 个 MP 模型、387 个实例，提供约 570 万个唯一工件用于模型训练与测试（解 3,012,625 个、非解 2,707,553 个），362 篇描述，覆盖离散、连续、混合三类问题。相较既有数据集（表1），其在问题/模型/实例数量、解与非解规模、描述数量上均显著领先：CSPLib 103 问题但无解与非解；MiniZinc challenge 212 问题仅 20 个解；MIPLIB 461 问题仅 1756 解、1 描述；CP-Bench 101 问题仅有描述；PTHG-21 有解/非解但无模型与描述。作者还从实验设计角度论证了 MPMMine 各项工件的价值：高层建模语言模型隐含参数—变量关系信息，可用于检验 CA 算法的特定能力；同一问题的多种模型可检验算法对不同编码的鲁棒性；参数化模型与多文本描述可检验算法随训练数据量与多样性的扩展性；解/非解的分布会显著影响算法性能（样本集中会诱导算法习得部分关系而忽略其他关系）；分布整形（如基于大规模预计算样本的过采样）可验证不同学习场景，但直接从高维强约束解空间采样技术上困难，样本量过大会导致数据集膨胀，故采用压缩打包 + 包级访问 API 的折中。Leaderboard 已对 4 种 SOTA CA 算法完成系统对比。
AI.conclusion: MPMMine 通过统一结构、开放格式、完备工件与版本化数据生成协议，填补了面向 MPMM/CA 算法的专用基准空白，使不同研究间的算法对比变得可复现、可比较，并通过 Leaderboard 给出首批统一条件下的算法基线。其附带软件（mpmmine-py）与压缩分发方案在访问延迟与存储占用上均优于直接文件系统访问，且保持工件级透明访问。数据集可持续扩充（当前 20 问题并计划增长），有望推动 MPMM 方法从实验室研究走向实验室验证（TRL 4–5）及更成熟的工程应用；同时，作者也指出分布整形与高维采样、样本量与数据集膨胀之间的权衡仍是开放的技术挑战。

title: The Daily Dose: Workflow-Integrated Large Language Model Automation for Clinical Summarization and Trial Identification in Radiation Oncology
summary: Objective: To describe the design and early clinical evaluation of The Daily Dose (TDD), an LLM-driven, automated clinical summarization and clinical-trial identification system integrated into routine radiation oncology practice. Design: Mixed-methods evaluation using a cross-sectional, anonymous clinician survey administered after 1 month of system deployment. Exposure: Daily automated delivery of physician-specific email summaries generated using RadOnc-GPT, including patient schedules, concise EHR-derived clinical-status summaries, and automated identification of potentially relevant clinical trials for new or consult visits. Main Outcomes and Measures: Primary outcomes included self-reported usability, satisfaction, perceived usefulness, perceived impact on workflow, time savings, and intention for continued use. Internal consistency reliability was assessed using Cronbach's $α$. Results: Among 55 respondents, 52 (94.5\%) worked in radiation oncology, and 38 (69.1\%) were attending physicians. Most participants (83.6\%) reported using TDD daily or several times per week. Mean (SD) scores were 3.89 (1.04) for usability and satisfaction, 3.43 (1.24) for perceived usefulness, and 3.80 (1.17) for impact and future use (5-point Likert scale). Overall satisfaction was positively associated with perceived time savings ($p < .001$). Participants reported variable time savings, with 27\% estimating $\geq 10$ minutes saved per day. The questionnaire demonstrated excellent internal consistency (overall Cronbach's $α$ = 0.97).

AI.tldr: 该研究设计并评估了名为"The Daily Dose(TDD)"的LLM驱动临床摘要及临床试验识别系统，集成于放射肿瘤学日常实践。研究显示83.6%的用户定期使用该系统，整体满意度与时间节省效果正相关，系统表现出优秀的可靠性和临床应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 在放射肿瘤学日常临床实践中，医生需要高效管理复杂的患者信息，包括回顾患者日程、临床状态及识别潜在相关临床试验。传统的电子健康记录(EHR)界面往往信息碎片化，增加了临床医生获取全面患者概览的认知负担，亟需自动化临床摘要工具来提升工作效率。
AI.method: 采用混合方法评估，通过横断面匿名临床医师问卷调查进行评价。系统基于RadOnc-GPT，每日自动生成医生特定的邮件摘要，包含患者日程安排、简明EHR来源的临床状态摘要，并为新诊或会诊患者自动识别潜在相关临床试验。主要评估指标包括可用性、满意度、知觉有用性、工作流影响、时间节省及持续使用意愿，采用5点Likert量表评分，内部一致性通过Cronbach's α评估。
AI.result: 55名受访者中，94.5%来自放射肿瘤学，69.1%为主治医师。83.6%的参与者在1个月内使用了TDD系统。5分量表评分均值：可用性和满意度3.89(SD 1.04)、知觉有用性3.43(SD 1.24)、工作流影响及未来使用意愿3.80(SD 1.17)。整体满意度与知觉时间节省呈显著正相关(p<.001)，27%的参与者估计每日节省≥10分钟。问卷量表表现出优异的内部一致性(Cronbach's α=0.97)。
AI.conclusion: The Daily Dose系统在放疗肿瘤学实践中展现出良好的应用前景，绝大多数用户报告了积极的可用性体验和满意度，时间节省与整体满意度呈正相关，为未来AI驱动的临床决策支持工具的开发提供了可行性证据。

title: Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing
summary: Human decision-making is sequential and uncertainty-aware, yet standard neural networks often rely on static, dense forward computation with limited visibility into evidence acquisition, uncertainty evolution, or when computation should stop. We introduce \textbf{Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing (NBSR)}, a framework that models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Within a Dirichlet--Categorical conjugate framework, neural experts query a persistent global knowledge oracle to extract positive evidence vectors, which act as pseudo-counts and update a Dirichlet belief state by exact conjugate addition. Coupled with a Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through estimator, this update enables hard, path-dependent routing while preserving surrogate gradients for end-to-end training. The resulting Dirichlet precision and entropy provide mechanisms for uncertainty quantification, entropy-based early exiting, OOD abstention, and cost-aware evidence acquisition. We prove that, under strictly positive evidence extraction, total Dirichlet precision increases monotonically along any valid trajectory and marginal predictive variance is bounded, formalizing sequential ``hypothesis sharpening''; under idealized capacity and optimization assumptions, the terminal Dirichlet expectation recovers the Bayes-optimal conditional distribution. Empirical evaluations across visual categorization, structured medical diagnosis, language modeling, partially observable control, and cost-aware Bayesian experimental design show that NBSR achieves competitive predictive performance while providing transparent routing traces, path-dependent evidence attribution, uncertainty-aware decision control, and resource-rational inference. Overall, NBSR offers a mathematically grounded framework for interpretable, modular, and resource-rational agentic AI.

AI.tldr: NBSR introduces a Bayesian framework that models neural inference as sequential evidence accumulation over a DAG, enabling uncertainty-aware, resource-rational decision-making with interpretable routing traces and theoretical guarantees.
AI.motivation: Standard neural networks rely on static, dense forward computation with limited visibility into evidence acquisition, uncertainty evolution, or adaptive stopping criteria. Human decision-making, in contrast, is sequential and uncertainty-aware. The paper aims to bridge this gap by developing a framework that models neural inference as active evidence accumulation.
AI.method: NBSR models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical DAG. It uses a Dirichlet-Categorical conjugate framework where neural experts query a persistent global knowledge oracle to extract positive evidence vectors (pseudo-counts) that update Dirichlet belief states via exact conjugate addition. A Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through estimator enables hard, path-dependent routing while preserving surrogate gradients for end-to-end training.
AI.result: Empirical evaluations across visual categorization, structured medical diagnosis, language modeling, partially observable control, and cost-aware Bayesian experimental design demonstrate competitive predictive performance. The framework also provides uncertainty quantification, entropy-based early exiting, OOD abstention, and cost-aware evidence acquisition.
AI.conclusion: NBSR provides a mathematically grounded framework for interpretable, modular, and resource-rational agentic AI. It enables transparent routing traces, path-dependent evidence attribution, uncertainty-aware decision control, and cost-aware inference, with theoretical guarantees on precision monotonicity and Bayes-optimality under idealized conditions.

title: Building an Atlas of Social Experiments to Link Studies, Reconcile Conflicts, and Bridge Gaps
summary: Social and behavioral science runs thousands of experiments each year, yet their findings rarely accumulate into a coherent map of what is known, what conflicts, and what remains missing. We introduce ExAtlas, a framework for turning an archive of experiments into an atlas: a structured map in which studies link, conflict, or leave bridgeable gaps. Given a target study, ExAtlas searches for prior studies that are locally close in treatment and outcome space and asks whether their observed effects can be composed to predict the target effect. This yields three cases. If the composition succeeds and agrees with the observed result, ExAtlas links the target to consistent prior evidence. If composition succeeds but disagrees, ExAtlas reconciles the conflict and proposes candidate moderators or higher-level theories that could explain it. If composition fails, ExAtlas proposes bridge experiments to close the gap. We provide an error bound for composition under local smoothness of the treatment-effect surface. On held-out targets certified as locally supported, ExAtlas recovers effect direction in 98.6% of cases. Human evaluations further suggest that its proposed bridge experiments are plausible and exhibit connectedness, and that its conflict explanations are useful for theory generation. These results suggest that the archive of social experiments contains more latent structure than current practice extracts -- and that making this structure explicit can guide both future theory and future experimentation.

AI.tldr: ExAtlas框架通过将实验档案转化为结构化"图谱"，利用处理-结果空间的邻近搜索和效应组合来链接一致研究、调和冲突研究、提出桥接实验，从而系统化地挖掘已有实验中的潜在结构。
AI.motivation: 社会与行为科学每年开展大量实验，但其发现很少积累成连贯的知识图谱——即哪些研究发现相互一致、哪些存在冲突、哪些存在可填补的空白。
AI.method: 提出ExAtlas框架：给定目标研究，在处理-结果空间中搜索邻近的先前研究，检验其观测效应是否可以组合以预测目标效应；提供处理效应曲面局部平滑条件下的误差界。实验采用留出法（held-out）评估，并进行人工评估验证。
AI.result: ExAtlas在98.6%的案例中恢复效应方向；提出的桥接实验具有可行性和连通性；冲突解释有助于理论生成。
AI.conclusion: ExAtlas在98.6%的案例中正确恢复效应方向；人工评估表明其提出的桥接实验可行且具有连通性，冲突解释对理论生成有用，验证了从社会实验档案中提取潜在结构的方法可行性。

title: ESBMC: A Survey of Its Evolution, Integration, and Future Directions in Formal Software Verification
summary: The Efficient SMT-Based Context-Bounded Model Checker (ESBMC) has grown from a research prototype for verifying embedded ANSI-C software into one of the most versatile and industrially capable formal verification platforms available today. Since its first publication in 2009, ESBMC has undergone persistent evolution: expanding its verification techniques, widening its language support to nine front-ends, integrating industrial-strength SMT solvers, and - most recently - coupling with Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents. This survey traces the full trajectory of ESBMC from its original design principles to the state of the art in 2025-2026, documenting 43 awards at SV-COMP and Test-Comp, its role as a formal verification backend for LLM-driven self-healing software and loop invariant generation, and the first industrial deployment of an integrated agentic model-checking architecture through the NVIDIA-OpenSMA framework, establishing ESBMC as a natively autonomous verification kernel rather than a passive validation backend. We synthesize its economic impact - over GBP 9.3 million and EUR 4.98 million in confirmed public research funding, the VeriBee spin-off, and a defense industrial deployment at Lockheed Martin - and conclude with a structured agenda of open challenges spanning scalability, neurosymbolic verification, counterexample intelligibility, cross-language verification, safety standards compliance, and open-source sustainability.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于 ESBMC（基于 SMT 的上下文有界模型检查器）的自述式综述，系统梳理了它从 2009 年嵌入式 ANSI-C 验证原型到 2025-2026 年支持 9 种语言、集成 6 个 SMT 求解器、并与 LLM/AI 智能体耦合的自主验证内核的演进轨迹。文章汇总了 43 项 SV-COMP/Test-Comp 奖项、规格化的文献筛选流程（PRISMA，最终语料 107 篇）、经济与产业影响数据（£9.3M+€4.98M 公共资助、VeriBee 衍生公司、洛克希德·马丁部署），并提出覆盖可扩展性、神经符号验证、反例可读性、跨语言验证、DO-330 工具鉴定与开源治理的结构化研究议程。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证是给出软件正确性最强保证的手段，但学界与工业界普遍缺少一个兼具 SMT 理论表达力、多语言覆盖、工业级性能与可扩展性的有界模型检查（BMC）平台。同时，随着 LLM/AI 智能体在软件工程中的兴起，单一工具的"标准件"叙事已不足以反映技术演进全貌——ESBMC 需要一份文献来记录其从研究原型到工业可用平台的完整脉络，并为其未来研究议程提供定位。作者同时希望以系统化检索流程和独立可核验来源（SV-COMP 官方报告、UKRI/CORDIS 资助记录）支撑单工具综述的可信度。
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事综述（structured narrative review）而非系统性映射研究，覆盖 2009 年 ASE 首次发表至 2025 年 v7.7 版本。检索策略为 PRISMA 式流程：2026 年 5 月 21 日在 arXiv、DBLP、OpenAlex、IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、SpringerLink 五个库检索，初始约 2136 条记录，去重（重叠约 26%）后 1602 条，全文评估 200 篇，纳入 81 篇主要来源加 26 篇灰色文献，最终语料 107 篇并全部被引用。技术层面按统一 GOTO/SSA 中间表示剖析四大支柱：BMC + k-归纳、增量求解（push/pop）、IEEE 754 原生浮点理论（QF_FP）、上下文有界并发（context-BMC + 部分序约简）。AI 集成部分梳理 ESBMC-AI 修复闭环、LLM 生成循环不变式（由 SMT 校验归纳性）、Lemur 混合推理、SpecVerify 自然语言规格形式化等。比较评估以 SV-COMP 官方报告为排名依据。
AI.result: 核心结论：ESBMC 已从 2009 年的 SMT 原生 ANSI-C 验证器演化为多语言、多求解器、AI 耦合的平台——SMT 原生编码取代 bit-blasting，支持 9 种语言前端（ANSI-C、C++03、C++11+、CUDA、Solidity、Kotlin/Jimple、CHERI C、Python、Rust），内建多求解器组合（Z3、Bitwuzla、Boolector、MathSAT、CVC5、Yices 2）并按理论自动选路，BMC 与 k-归纳共用同一引擎，浮点与并发验证均无需切换工具。在 SV-COMP 2024 排名第 4（30 个验证器中），且在 10 秒 reachability 任务上为最快；累计 43 项竞赛奖（35 SV-COMP + 8 Test-Comp），另有 ICSE'11 与 ASE'24 杰出论文、ASE'23 最具影响力论文、SBSeg'23 最佳工具论文。AI 侧：ESBMC-AI 以形式化重验证为接受准则，缓冲区溢出/指针解引用修复率最高 80%（5 万 C 程序语料），Lemur 混合管线解出 107 个 SV-COMP 任务 vs 单独 ESBMC 的 68 个、47 个难任务中 25 vs 1；SpecVerify 在 9 个信息物理系统上达 46.5% 验证准确率且误报低于 NASA CoCoSim；FormAI 以 ESBMC 为大规模预言机审计了 7 个 LLM 的 112,000 个程序。产业侧：发现 Ethereum 共识规范（eth2spec）未公开的除零缺陷、DeFi 智能合约基准集零误报全检出、ARM RMM 固件 23 项 CBMC 遗漏的新违规；经济侧确认公共资助 ≥£9.3M + €4.98M（7 项资助，含 EU H2020 ELEGANT €4.98M、Soteria £5.8M），孵化 VeriBee（FuSeBMC，Test-Comp 2025/2026 金牌）。作者同时坦承局限：107 篇语料中 24%（正文引用 23%）为团队自引，SpecVerify 样本仅 9 个系统且准确率指标聚合掩盖了安全违规与误报的成本不对称，Solidity/FormAI 基准存在选择偏差，修复成功率按漏洞类别差异显著。
AI.conclusion: ESBMC 已被确立为"原生自主验证内核"而非被动校验后端：其差异化优势在于最宽的开源 BMC 求解器组合、原生浮点理论、上下文有界并发、唯一具备已发表且已评估 LLM 集成的开源 BMC 工具，以及可用于 CI/CD 的短超时性能；相对短板是缺乏快速终止不变式时 reachability 类覆盖不足。论文提出结构化未来议程：(1) 扩展组合式验证与抽象解释以对抗状态空间爆炸；(2) 神经符号验证的四类开放问题——LLM 非确定性的可复现性（与 SIL 等级挂钩）、LLM 生成规格的完备性、在 FormAI 等形式语料上的微调、反例自然语言解释的忠实性；(3) 补齐 Java/JavaScript/TypeScript、WebAssembly、VHDL/SystemVerilog、JML/ACSL 等语言空白，并实现多语言接口契约验证（含 FFI 边界语义错配的 blame 归属）；(4) 自主验证智能体架构中的工具接口标准化、信任校准与保证范围推理；(5) DO-178C/ISO 26262/IEC 61508 合规：可追溯证明产物、GSN/AADL 保障案例自动构造、ARINC/AUTOSAR 库操作模型，以及最关键的 DO-330 工具鉴定（建议采用"冻结特性版本 + 未鉴定研究分支"路线，类似 ASTRÉE/GNAT Pro）；(6) 量子软件验证与 SoC 硬件-软件协同验证所需的 SMT 理论扩展；(7) 将 WCET/实时调度约束纳入 BMC，实现功能与时序统一验证；(8) 反例可读性工程（分层可视化、领域模板、可用性指标）；(9) 开源可持续性治理——研究与商业分支分叉风险、贡献者集中度、版本化 API 稳定性。作者强调这些议题是工业规模落地的前置条件，而非外围议题。

title: Cost of Structural Learning Under Censored Feedback: A Threshold-Bandit Approach
summary: In many multi-agent applications, tasks yield rewards only when executed by a coalition meeting an unknown size threshold; otherwise, feedback is fully censored. This censorship creates an identifiability problem: agents cannot distinguish stochastic failure from insufficient coordination. We formalize this setting as the Threshold-Activated Cooperative Multi-Armed Bandit (TAC-MAB) and analyze it under both centralized and decentralized coordination. We show that a centralized algorithm (C-TAC) achieves cumulative regret O(log T), decomposed into a structural-search term that captures the cost of resolving feasibility under censored feedback and a statistical-monitoring term for value estimation. We then introduce D-TAC, a decentralized event-triggered protocol in which agents synchronize only when their structural beliefs change. Empirically, D-TAC achieves a 23x reduction in communication relative to the centralized baseline while preserving feasibility alignment under conservative belief fusion. These results characterize the coordination cost of learning under censored feedback and show that near-centralized communication efficiency is achievable without continuous synchronization.

AI.tldr: 研究多智能体多臂老虎机中阈值触发任务的协调学习问题，提出集中式C-TAC和去中心化D-TAC算法，证实在截断反馈下可实现对数级遗憾，且去中心化方法能大幅降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 多智能体任务中，当协作联盟规模满足未知阈值时才获得奖励反馈，否则反馈被完全截断。此截断导致可辨识性问题：智能体无法区分随机失败与协调不足。
AI.method: 提出TAC-MAB形式化框架；设计集中式C-TAC算法（ regrets O(log T)），分解为结构性搜索项和统计监控项；开发去中心化D-TAC协议，采用事件触发通信，仅在结构信念变化时同步。
AI.result: 集中式C-TAC算法达到O(log T)的累积遗憾；去中心化D-TAC在保持可行性对齐的同时实现23倍通信量 reduction。
AI.conclusion: D-TAC实现23倍通信量 reduction，同时保持可行性对齐，证明了无需持续同步即可实现接近集中式的通信效率，揭示了截断反馈下学习的协调成本。

title: RAGEAR: Retrieval-Augmented Graph-Enhanced Academic Recommender
summary: We present RAGEAR (Retrieval-Augmented Graph-Enhanced Academic Recommender), a neurosymbolic recommender system for academic course recommendation. RAGEAR combines dense retrieval over full lecture transcripts with a symbolic Knowledge Graph modelling courses, lessons, transcript chunks, credits, study plans, and curricular information. The Knowledge Graph supports symbolic filtering and contextualisation based on structured constraints, such as credits, academic disciplines, study plans, and prerequisites. Unlike metadata-based approaches, it exploits fine-grained instructional content by retrieving transcript chunks semantically aligned with a student's query. The main contribution is a graph-aware aggregation function that propagates chunk-level evidence to course-level recommendations. The score combines three factors: the share of retrieved similarity associated with a course, the rank-based strength of its relevant chunks, and the distribution of evidence across lessons. We evaluate RAGEAR on 152 student-like queries through a human evaluation sample and a large-scale LLM-based relevance assessment. Results show that lecture transcripts improve over metadata-only retrieval, and that RAGEAR further improves ranking quality over a transcript-based normalized SumP baseline, especially for top-ranked recommendations.

AI.tldr: RAGEAR是一种神经符号系统，通过融合讲座文本语义检索与知识图谱结构化推理，实现学术课程推荐。其创新点在于图感知聚合函数，有效整合多层次证据提升推荐准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有课程推荐系统多依赖元数据，缺乏对细粒度教学内容的深度利用，无法有效处理学生对具体学习内容的语义查询需求。
AI.method: 提出RAGEAR系统，结合密集检索（对完整讲座文本进行语义检索）与符号知识图谱（建模课程、课时、文本块、学分、学习计划等实体及关系）。核心贡献是图感知聚合函数，通过三个因子将文本块级别的证据传播聚合到课程级别：(1)课程相关检索相似度的占比；(2)相关文本块的排名强度；(3)证据在课程各课时中的分布。
AI.result: 在152个类学生查询上的评估表明：(1)讲座文本转录内容优于仅基于元数据的检索；(2)RAGEAR相较于基于文本的SumP基线方法进一步提升了排序质量，尤其在top-ranked推荐中效果显著。
AI.conclusion: RAGEAR通过图感知聚合函数有效整合了文本检索与结构化知识，显著提升了课程推荐的质量，特别是在排名靠前的推荐结果上表现更佳。

title: GridPilot: Real-Time Grid-Responsive Control for AI Supercomputers
summary: At global scale, data-center electricity demand is growing faster than the grids that supply it, while system operators increasingly require large flexible loads that can adjust power within seconds to absorb variable wind and solar generation. For multi-megawatt AI/HPC facilities, the key unresolved question is practical and measurable: how quickly can the software stack translate a grid request into a real change in GPU power at the facility meter, where commitments are settled? We answer this on real hardware with GridPilot, a three-tier predictive controller operating across milliseconds, seconds, and hours, augmented by a deterministic safety-island bypass for fast response. On a three-GPU NVIDIA V100 testbed, GridPilot achieves a measured end-to-end trigger-to-target response of 97.2 ms, which is 6.9x faster than the 700 ms requirement of Nordic Fast Frequency Reserve. We further incorporate an instantaneous Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) correction so dispatched commitments remain robust at meter level rather than only at IT load level.
