In replay experiments across six representative European grids (from Sweden to Poland), the PUE-aware controller closes 2.5-5.8 percentage points of cooling-overhead drag. GridPilot is released as open source and serves as a proof of concept that MW-scale AI/HPC demand can be engineered as controllable, grid-responsive flexibility by design.

AI.tldr: GridPilot achieves 97.2 ms grid-responsive GPU power control (6.9x faster than required), enabling MW-scale AI/HPC facilities to provide grid flexibility services with PUE-corrected meter-level accuracy.
AI.motivation: Global data center electricity demand is outpacing grid capacity, while grid operators increasingly require large flexible loads to absorb variable renewable generation. The core challenge is quantifying and achieving practical, measurable response times for multi-megawatt AI/HPC facilities to provide grid services.
AI.method: GridPilot employs a three-tier predictive controller (milliseconds, seconds, hours timescales) with deterministic safety-island bypass for rapid response. Tested on NVIDIA V100 GPU testbed with real hardware validation. Includes instantaneous PUE correction to maintain commitment accuracy at meter level.
AI.result: Measured end-to-end trigger-to-target response of 97.2 ms on real 3-GPU hardware, achieving 6.9x speedup over Nordic FFR requirement (700 ms). PUE-aware controller reduces cooling-overhead drag by 2.5-5.8 percentage points across six European grid scenarios (Sweden to Poland).
AI.conclusion: GridPilot provides a practical proof of concept that MW-scale AI/HPC facilities can be engineered as controllable, grid-responsive flexibility resources. The system is released as open source, enabling wider adoption and validation of demand-side grid support from computational facilities.

title: Your Agents Are Aging Too: Agent Lifespan Engineering for Deployed Systems
summary: Long-lived AI agents are increasingly deployed as persistent operational systems, yet they are still evaluated like freshly initialized models. Day-one benchmarks miss a basic systems question: how long does an agent remain reliable after deployment? Even when model weights are frozen, an agent's effective state keeps changing as it compresses interaction history, retrieves from a growing memory store, revises facts after updates, and undergoes routine maintenance. Reliability therefore becomes a lifespan property of the full agent harness, not only a snapshot property of the base model. We introduce AgingBench, a longitudinal reliability benchmark for agent lifespan engineering: measuring not only whether deployed agents degrade, but what form the degradation takes and where repair should target. AgingBench organizes agent aging into four mechanisms: compression aging, interference aging, revision aging, and maintenance aging. To diagnose these failures, AgingBench uses temporal dependency graphs and paired counterfactual probes that produce diagnostic profiles for the write, retrieval, and utilization stages of the memory pipeline. Across 7 scenarios, 14 models, multiple memory policies, and both runner-controlled and autonomous agents, over ~400 runs spanning 8 - 200 sessions show that agent aging is not one-dimensional: behavioral tests can remain clean while factual precision decays; derived-state tracking can collapse sharply within a single model; and the same wrong answer can require different repairs depending on what the diagnostic profile points to. These results suggest that reliable agent deployment requires lifespan evaluation, mechanism-level diagnosis, and stage-targeted repair, not only stronger day-one models.

AI.tldr: AgingBench是一个面向智能体寿命工程的长程可靠性基准，揭示了智能体在长期部署中的多维度衰退现象，证明仅靠增强基座模型不足以保证部署可靠性，需要建立生命周期评估、机制级诊断和靶向修复的新范式。
AI.motivation: 现有评估范式存在根本缺陷：智能体被当作"即时部署的静态模型"评估，但实际部署是持续运行的动态系统。智能体的有效状态不断变化（交互历史压缩、记忆库增长、事实更新修订、定期维护），可靠性是系统的全生命周期属性而非模型快照属性。
AI.method: 构建Agent生命周期 aging 的四类机制分类体系：压缩aging、干扰aging、修订aging和维护aging；采用时序依赖图和配对反事实探测方法，诊断记忆管道的写入、检索和利用三阶段的故障；跨7个场景、14个模型、多种记忆策略，进行~400轮实验（8-200个会话）。
AI.result: 智能体aging并非单一维度：行为测试保持通过时事实精度可能已衰减；派生状态追踪可在单个模型内急剧崩溃；同一错误答案的修复策略需根据诊断画像定制而非通用处理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠智能体部署需要生命周期评估、机制级诊断和阶段性靶向修复，而非仅依赖更强的基座模型。行为测试通过并不代表事实准确性未衰减，同一错误答案可能需要不同的修复策略。

title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
summary: Retrieval is increasingly moving from one-shot matching toward interactive reasoning, where language agents iteratively inspect evidence, reformulate queries, and search again. Training such agents raises a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions such as queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by the retriever, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future executable actions. This asymmetry makes outcome-level reward assignment unreliable, as the same final reward may credit reasoning steps that did not actually shape retrieval success. We propose RICE-PO, a critic-free policy optimization framework that converts retrieval interactions into localized learning signals. RICE-PO selects high-uncertainty executable actions as anchors, evaluates local counterfactual branches using retrieval metrics, and propagates credit to latent reasoning steps only when reasoning-to-action influence is strong and future residual effects are stable. On BRIGHT and BEIR, RICE-PO consistently outperforms prompt-based agents and group-based RL baselines under the same retriever setting. These results show that the structure of agent-environment interaction itself can provide useful supervision for training reasoning-based retrieval agents.

AI.tldr: RICE-PO addresses the credit assignment problem in training language agents for interactive retrieval by using localized learning signals through high-uncertainty action anchors and counterfactual evaluation, outperforming existing methods on standard benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Training interactive retrieval agents faces a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions (queries, summaries) can be directly evaluated, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future actions. Outcome-level reward assignment is unreliable since the same final reward may incorrectly credit reasoning steps that did not actually shape retrieval success.
AI.method: RICE-PO converts retrieval interactions into localized learning signals by selecting high-uncertainty executable actions as anchors, evaluating local counterfactual branches using retrieval metrics, and propagating credit to latent reasoning steps only when reasoning-to-action influence is strong and future residual effects are stable.
AI.result: On BRIGHT and BEIR benchmarks, RICE-PO consistently outperforms prompt-based agents and group-based RL baselines under the same retriever setting.
AI.conclusion: RICE-PO demonstrates that the structure of agent-environment interaction can provide useful supervision for training reasoning-based retrieval agents, providing a critic-free solution for credit assignment in iterative retrieval scenarios.

title: TSFMAudit: Data Contamination Auditing in Forecasting Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly pretrained on large corpora, raising concerns that evaluation datasets may have been exposed during pretraining and thus yield overly optimistic performance estimates. Auditing such contamination is challenging in time series because signals are continuous and heterogeneous, and often lack corpus documentation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs. We formalize the problem of pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs and propose TSFMAudit, a method based on probe adaptation dynamics. Our key intuition is that contamination manifests as unusually efficient adaptation: after a fine tuning probe, contaminated datasets tend to exhibit faster loss reduction with smaller backbone movement. We evaluate TSFMAudit on 6 TSFMs and 187 datasets using documented training source evidence as supervision, and compare against 10 competitive baselines adapted from the LLM literature.

AI.tldr: First work on pretraining contamination auditing for time series foundation models (TSFMs). Proposes TSFMAudit using probe adaptation dynamics to detect if evaluation datasets were in pretraining corpus based on unusual adaptation efficiency. Evaluated on 187 datasets across 6 TSFMs.
AI.motivation: As time series foundation models are pretrained on large corpora, evaluation datasets may have been exposed during pretraining, leading to overly optimistic performance estimates. However, auditing such contamination in time series is challenging due to continuous/heterogeneous signals and lack of corpus documentation.
AI.method: TSFMAudit is based on probe adaptation dynamics, leveraging the intuition that contaminated datasets show unusually efficient adaptation—faster loss reduction with smaller backbone movement during fine-tuning.
AI.result: TSFMAudit is evaluated on 6 TSFMs and 187 datasets, demonstrating effectiveness compared to 10 competitive baselines adapted from LLM literature.
AI.conclusion: TSFMAudit outperforms 10 baseline methods, with the advantage of not requiring corpus documentation, making it practical for auditing real-world TSFMs.

title: A Universal Cliff and a Design Fingerprint: Cross-Section Defect Detection Under LLM Orchestration
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20372696
summary:
Production language-model systems answer a request by partitioning it across an invisible orchestration of worker agents that recompose one integrated report. We ask what this does to a class of defect no single worker can see: a contradiction in the relation between two distant sections of a document. Holding the documents, defects, mechanism, scoring, and seed fixed, we vary only the model -- ten systems across five generations from one developer and five providers from distinct alignment paradigms.
  Two layers separate. First, a universal detection cliff: every model that finds these cross-section defects under a single agent loses that ability under orchestration, detection falling two-thirds or more across every paradigm tested. The cliff is mechanism-derived and not closed by scale or extended reasoning. Second, how models behave once fallen. A signal-detection decomposition shows that, among the six models discriminating above chance, only one developer's generations move along the reporting-criterion axis: as alignment is strengthened, the model misses fewer defects yet raises more false alarms on clean documents -- two faces of one criterion shift, scaling with generation within that developer (p < 0.001) and near-absent elsewhere.
  At the floor the missed defect is often not out of view: the model's private record reconstructs the structural fault accurately, while the integrated report signs off on its soundness, its concern spent on the artifact and an absent collaborator. This resists quantification -- an automated judge is unstable (precision 17-50%) and keywords cannot separate it from ordinary agreement -- a resistance we report as a finding. We release all runs, probes, defect keys, scorer prompts, and scripts. An integrated report's confidence is uninformative about partition-spanning defects, the most aligned systems are not the safest, and the cliff is structural.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了LLM编排系统在检测跨文档分区缺陷上的系统性失败：检测悬崖是机制衍生的且不可通过scale解决；最对齐的系统表现出报告标准偏移（漏检减少但误报增加）；集成报告置信度对跨分区缺陷无信息量，自动化检测不可靠。这挑战了"对齐=安全"的假设。
AI.motivation: 研究多智能体编排系统对单一智能体可见的缺陷类别的影响：文档中两个远距离段落之间的矛盾（跨分区缺陷）。当系统通过不可见的worker agents编排来回答请求并重新组合成一份综合报告时，这种缺陷无法被单一worker检测到。
AI.method: 固定文档、缺陷机制、评分和种子，仅变化模型——来自同一开发者的五代十种系统，以及来自不同对齐范式的五个提供商。使用信号检测分解分析模型行为，区分报告标准和辨别能力的轴向变化。
AI.result: 发现两层现象：1）普遍检测悬崖：所有在单智能体下能检测跨分区缺陷的模型，在编排下失去该能力（检测率下降三分之二以上），且该悬崖源于机制本身，不能通过规模化或扩展推理关闭；2）行为分化：六个高于随机水平的模型中，仅有一个开发者的模型沿报告标准轴移动——对齐强化时，漏检减少但误报增加（p<0.001），其他开发者几乎无此现象。底层机制上，模型的私有记录能准确重建结构性故障，但综合报告签字认可其正确性。
AI.conclusion: 编排架构在跨段落缺陷检测上存在结构性缺陷，无法通过扩展推理或规模化解决。集成报告的置信度无法反映分区跨越缺陷，对齐最强的系统并非最安全的系统。检测器的自动化评判不稳定（精确率17-50%），且无法通过关键词与普通一致性区分。

title: ICICLE: Expanding Retrieval with In-Context Documents
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) maps queries directly to document identifiers (docids) using parametric knowledge, However, this design makes corpus expansion costly: adding new documents requires updating model parameters to encode new document-docid associations incurs repeated training and catastrophic forgetting of previously indexed documents. In this work, we revisit incremental GR as an in-context retrieval problem, where newly added documents are supplied as inference-time document-docid evidence. We propose ICICLE, an in-context indexing framework that performs source-aware docid generation over both parametric memory and context-provided document-docid pairs. ICICLE combines a `[COPY]`-based routing mechanism, preference-based calibration, and large context adaptation to distinguish context-grounded retrieval from parametric retrieval. Experiments on MS MARCO and NQ320K show that ICICLE improves retrieval of newly introduced documents while preserving seen-document retention without corpus-specific retraining. Our analysis further shows that high-shot degradation is mainly caused by routing failure, highlighting source-selection calibration as a key bottleneck for scaling in-context generative retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICICLE框架，将增量生成检索重新定义为上下文内检索问题，通过COPY路由、偏好校准和大上下文适应实现无需参数更新的新文档索引。实验表明该方法有效，但路由失败是扩展性的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 生成检索(GR)将查询直接映射到文档标识符，但语料库扩展代价高昂——新增文档需要更新模型参数来编码新的文档-docid关联，导致重复训练和灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 提出ICICLE框架，采用[COPY]路由机制、偏好校准和大上下文适应，将源感知docid生成与上下文提供的文档-docid对结合，实现新文档的上下文内检索。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO和NQ320K上，ICICLE改善了新引入文档的检索性能，同时保持了已见文档的保留率，无需针对语料库的重新训练。
AI.conclusion: ICICLE实现了无需重新训练的增量索引，MS MARCO和NQ320K上的实验表明该方法有效改善了新文档检索同时保留已见文档性能；路由失败是扩展性瓶颈。

title: Configuration-Driven Dynamic API Routing for Resilient Service Integrations
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, anonymized production-inspired case study
summary: Modern online services rely on third-party APIs for authentication, payments, communication, identity verification, fraud detection, observability, and fulfillment. These dependencies are outside the direct operational control of the application owner and may experience regional outages, throttling, latency spikes, quota exhaustion, or behavior changes that surface as user-visible failures. This paper presents configuration-driven dynamic API routing, an architecture for resilient third-party service integration based on pluggable factor lists, real-time telemetry, circuit breakers, bulkhead isolation, and a closed-loop decision engine. A factor list defines operation-specific hard gates and weighted scoring functions that evaluate candidate providers using live metrics, regional policy constraints, quota state, latency, cost, and incident signals. The router separates routing policy from application code, allowing operators to adapt vendor selection at runtime without redeploying applications. We formalize the factor-list model, describe a request-time routing algorithm, present the event pipeline that computes sliding-window provider health metrics, and analyze failover behavior under degraded-provider scenarios. We also describe an anonymized SMS verification case study in which manual vendor switching was replaced by automated routing driven by completion-rate telemetry.

AI.tldr: 本文是 eBay 的工业经验报告，提出"配置驱动的动态 API 路由"：以可插拔因子列表（factor list）把第三方供应商选择从应用代码中抽离到运行时决策层，用硬性门控（区域、合规、配额、凭据、熔断状态）判定可用性，再用归一化加权评分（完成率、p95 延迟、成本、事件惩罚、样本置信度）排序，并结合业务结果遥测、滑动窗口指标、决策日志、流量切换上限、冷却、影子模式与熔断开关形成闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 现代在线服务（登录/注册验证、支付、风控、通知、履约等）在关键用户旅程中依赖第三方 API，但这些依赖不受应用方直接控制，会出现区域性故障、限流、延迟尖峰、配额耗尽或行为变更，表现为用户可见失败。既有工业基线（多供应商 + 主备故障转移 + 超时/重试/熔断/舱壁/runbook）是必要的，但只解决部分问题：熔断状态是二值且本地的，舱壁只隔离资源不决定流量去向，静态主备无法适应部分退化、区域差异、配额耗尽与恢复过程，通用负载均衡也无法纳入业务完成率与合规约束。实践中，当供应商仅在特定区域/运营商/操作类型退化时，最优的流量迁移动作仍依赖事故期间的工程师判断、诊断与配置改动，导致延迟、决策不一致，且每次路由决策的原因未以结构化可查询形式留存，事后分析薄弱。因此需要把"供应商选择"当作受治理的运行时决策，而非静态优先级。
AI.method: 架构分四层：保护层（超时/重试/熔断/舱壁/回退）、决策层（选供应商）、遥测层（发布调用结果并计算滚动健康指标）、配置控制面（存因子列表与安全设置）。因子列表为按操作（operation）划分的配置对象：先 gates 后 scores。硬门控含 supports_region、compliance_allowed、quota_available、circuit_breaker_closed、metric_fresh_or_safe_default；评分项与权重示例为 completion_rate_5m 0.45、p95_latency_5m 0.20、cost_per_request 0.15、recent_incident_penalty 0.10、confidence_from_sample 0.10，安全项含 max_traffic_shift_per_minute 0.50、primary_probe_share 0.01、primary_recovery_cooldown_seconds 300、require_reason_code。原始指标先归一化为 0–100 索引，代表性策略 score(v)=0.40·completion+0.25·latency+0.15·cost+0.10·incident+0.10·confidence（权重由专家评审→影子模式→灰度→事后复盘调优，如 latency 权重 0.15→0.25、hysteresis 2.0→3.5）。请求时算法：应用→决策层请求→门控筛除→对合格者归一化加权评分→按分数与迟滞余量选择→调用供应商→发布业务事件（operation、provider、region、status、latency、error class、retry count、decision reason、policy version）→异步聚合器更新滚动窗口指标并缓存，请求路径不依赖分析管道。遥测区分 provider-call outcome 与 business-completion outcome（失败阶段标注：调用前/调用中/用户操作/下游逻辑/未知），用请求关联、错误分类、重试阶段分离 provider-attributable 失败。恢复侧使用半开熔断、探测流量（探针份额）、冷却窗口、渐进回切（failback）与限速。治理：因子列表版本化、影子模式并行评估不实际切流、灰度逐步放量、限流上限、kill switch、provider pinning、回滚；所有权划分（服务团队负责因子列表、SRE 负责默认安全控制、合规负责区域门控、运营负责人负责覆盖流程）。评估含合成回放：对比静态主用、传统运营故障转移、仅熔断、因子列表四种策略，6 个场景（完全宕机、延迟尖峰、部分退化、配额耗尽、区域故障、遥测过期），每场景每策略 36,000 合成请求，另做权重/限流/陈旧度敏感性分析。
AI.result: 去标识化运营证据（Table 11）：相对传统故障转移基线（T-30d，完成率指数 100.0、p95 380ms、重试 370、回退 112），稳定期自适应路由（T+10d）完成率指数升至 104.1、p95 降至 290ms（-23.7%）、重试降至 70（-81.1%）、回退降至 15（-86.6%），流量分布变为 A 68.5%/B 22.0%；退化期（T+14d_inc）将主供应商份额压至 15%、副供应商升至 75%，完成率指数仍维持 100.0。事件时间线（T-30m→T+30m）：检测退化→分数衰减→熔断打开并限速切流→探测发现恢复→半开→冷却后完成全量回切。影子模式记录显示在两次事故中影子推荐 provider_B 而基线仍路由到已退化的 provider_A。合成评估（Table 14）成功率/退化分钟：完全宕机 静态 66.3%/20min、传统 82.7%/10min、熔断 92.7%/4min、因子列表 96.0%/4min；配额耗尽 47.4%/32min、88.5%/7min、88.6%/7min、99.0%/0min；区域故障 90.1%/20min→97.9%/3min；遥测过期 94.0%/17min→98.4%/2min；延迟尖峰场景因子列表成功率略低（98.8%）但退化时长最短（2min）。敏感性分析显示策略对中等权重变化稳健，但对流量上限（scen_04 移出时间增至 12.0min）与遥测陈旧度（osc=3，移出 8.5min）敏感。
AI.conclusion: 多供应商冗余与常规故障转移本身不构成充分韧性，关键在于把"供应商选择"升级为受治理、可观测、可解释的运行时决策：硬门控表达不可协商约束（区域、合规、配额、凭据、熔断），评分仅在合格候选中表达偏好，业务结果遥测与决策日志（策略版本、门控结果、评分分量、reason code、指标新鲜度）同等重要，影子模式、流量上限、冷却、探测流量与 kill switch 是架构的组成部分而非事后附加。经验教训包括：尽早定义结果指标、把决策日志作为一等需求、在调权重前先厘清策略所有权、像测试故障转移一样测试恢复、明确指出不适合采用的负面场景、不要在可观测性不足时自动化；hysteresis、限流、探测与冷却属于正确性组成部分（防止反馈振荡）。可迁移性取决于操作关键性、是否存在真正合格的替代供应商、流量量级是否足以支撑滚动指标置信度、业务结果是否可埋点、以及组织对策略评审/事故覆盖/合规门控的治理成熟度；低风险或低流量场景更适合超时+重试+熔断+看板+静态优先级+演练 runbook。支付授权、风控、通知与履税等场景迁移需额外引入幂等、对账、审计证据、模型治理与合规门控。局限在于证据为去标识化代表性片段与确定性合成回放，不等同于受控生产实验，完成率并非因果估计；运营风险包括陈旧指标决策、熔断抖动、成本飙升与不稳定流量迁移。作者声明该文基于 eBay 许可授权的匿名化工业经验，论文准备过程中使用了 ChatGPT 辅助评审。

title: Experiments in Agentic AI for Science
summary: This paper details two novel frameworks for developing autonomous, agentic AI in scientific workflows. Both systems leverage a hybrid Local Body, Remote Brain architecture via Google Colab, utilizing Python-based local orchestrators to invoke large language model (LLM) cloud backends. The first agent, DeepTS/DeepCollector, automates the large-scale curation, extraction, and deduplication of time-series datasets. The second, DeepScribe, is an autonomous presentation analyzer that converts visually dense, mathematically complex physics lectures into structured scientific reports. Through practical systems engineering-such as granular attribute extraction (Cellular RAG), remote data inspection, and distributed concurrency controls-we demonstrate how agentic AI can overcome the context and reasoning limitations of current state-of-the-art systems to rigorously support scientific workflows. Finally, we outline a generalization of DeepTS to support deep knowledge graphs and discuss the application of this conceptual approach to high-energy physics (DeepQCD).

AI.tldr: 本文提出两个基于Local Body, Remote Brain混合架构的自主AI Agent框架，通过Cellular RAG、远程数据检查和分布式并发控制等工程方案，突破现有LLM在上下文和推理上的限制。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿系统在上下文窗口和推理能力上存在局限性，无法有效支持科学工作流程的严格要求，因此需要开发具备自主性的AI Agent框架。
AI.method: 采用Local Body, Remote Brain混合架构，通过Google Colab运行；实现Cellular RAG（细粒度属性提取）、远程数据检查和分布式并发控制；开发了时间序列去重 curation pipeline和视觉 lecture-to-report 转换 pipeline。
AI.result: 成功构建两个自主Agent：DeepTS/DeepCollector实现大规模时间序列数据集的自动化采集、提取与去重；DeepScribe实现将视觉密集、数学复杂的物理学讲座转换为结构化科学报告。
AI.conclusion: 两项框架证明了混合架构结合Python编排器与LLM云后端的有效性，DeepTS具备向深度知识图谱（如DeepQCD高能物理应用）扩展的潜力。

title: In-Context Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Gradient-Descent Perspective
summary: In-context learning has recently been linked to implicit gradient descent in linear self-attention models, suggesting that context can induce a forward-pass update. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also relies on context, but retrieved documents are usually treated as static evidence rather than signals for adaptation. We study RAG as an in-context optimization process. First, we show that one linear self-attention layer can implement one gradient-descent step on a unified linearized RAG objective covering both projection-based and dot-product retrieval interfaces. This gives an exact regime where retrieval-augmented prediction and in-context optimization coincide. We use this result not as a literal model of LLM computation, but as a guide for adapting the interaction between queries and retrieved evidence. We then test the boundary of this correspondence: it remains stable under controlled linear extensions, but becomes feature-distribution dependent under nonlinear architectures. Finally, we turn this view into a lightweight method for frozen RAG LLMs. The method keeps the retriever and backbone fixed, and predicts a context-conditioned update to a generator-side evidence-use interface. Across seven QA benchmarks, two retrievers, and two frozen LLM backbones, this forward-only update improves a shared-interface baseline, transfers to held-out tasks, and approaches test-time gradient adaptation at much lower per-query cost.

AI.tldr: 本文将检索增强生成(RAG)建模为上下文内优化过程，证明了单个线性自注意力层可实现针对统一RAG目标的梯度下降一步，并据此提出轻量级方法对冻结的RAG LLM进行前向更新。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG将检索文档视为静态证据而非适应信号；上下文学习已被证明与隐式梯度下降相关，但这一联系尚未应用于RAG领域。
AI.method: 1) 推导统一线性化RAG目标函数，涵盖投影检索和点积检索接口；2) 证明单层线性自注意力可精确实现该目标的一步梯度下降；3) 在受控线性扩展和非线性架构下测试对应关系的边界；4) 基于理论指导，设计前向-only的轻量级更新方法。
AI.result: 1) 精确对应在受控线性扩展下保持稳定，但在非线性架构下变为特征分布依赖；2) 在7个QA基准、2个检索器、2个冻结LLM backbone上，该方法超越共享接口基线；3) 可迁移到留出任务，逼近测试时梯度适应的效果但计算成本更低。
AI.conclusion: RAG与上下文优化的理论对应可指导实践，为冻结LLM提供轻量级适配路径，平衡性能与效率。

title: On the Push-Based Asynchronous Federated Learning: A Bias-Correction Aggregation Approach
comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026). This is the extended version with full appendix
summary: Asynchronous decentralized federated learning (ADFL) eliminates central coordination and global synchronization, making it attractive for large-scale and heterogeneous systems. However, frequent peer-to-peer communication, asynchronous updates on directed topologies, and non-IID data jointly lead to excessive communication overhead, biased aggregation and severe model drift. We propose PushCen-ADFL, a communication-efficient ADFL framework that enables stable training under asymmetric communication and delayed client participation. PushCen-ADFL couples communication, aggregation, and local stabilization in a shared centroid representation space, forming a closed loop between compression and optimization. Clients exchange centroid-form messages, apply average-preserving push-sum mixing to correct aggregation bias, and use a lightweight centroid regularization anchored in the same centroid space to mitigate drift under heterogeneity and staleness. A bounded, sender-deduplicated buffer further improves robustness under irregular asynchronous arrivals. Experiments on vision datasets demonstrate that PushCen-ADFL improves accuracy under data heterogeneity by up to 6\% while reducing per-push communication cost by more than 80\%, achieving a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off.

AI.tldr: 针对异步去中心化联邦学习中通信开销大、聚合偏差及模型漂移问题，提出PushCen-ADFL框架，通过质心空间耦合通信-聚合-稳定化、推-和混合校正偏差及质心正则化抑制漂移，实现精度提升6%且通信成本降低80%以上。
AI.motivation: 异步去中心化联邦学习(ADFL)虽具可扩展优势，但频繁点对点通信、有向拓扑异步更新与非IID数据共同导致通信开销过大、聚合偏差严重及模型漂移剧烈，亟需通信高效且训练稳定的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出PushCen-ADFL框架，核心包括：(1)质心形式消息交换机制，将模型压缩与优化形成闭环；(2)平均保真推-和混合(APS)算法，校正有向拓扑下的聚合偏差；(3)轻量级质心正则化，在统一质心空间锚定本地模型以抑制异构数据和延迟参与下的漂移；(4)有界去重发送缓冲机制，提升异步到达鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和EMNIST数据集上的实验表明，相比基准方法，PushCen-ADFL在数据异构场景下精度提升高达6%，同时每轮通信成本降低超过80%，实现了精度与通信效率的优异权衡。
AI.conclusion: PushCen-ADFL通过共享质心表示空间将通信、聚合与局部稳定化耦合，利用推-和混合校正聚合偏差，采用轻量级质心正则化缓解异构性与延迟导致的模型漂移，在CIFAR-10/100和EMNIST数据集上实现了通信效率与模型精度的双重优化。

title: Queue & AI: When Faster Tasks Slow Down the Workflow
summary: Quantifying the workplace productivity effects of Generative Artificial Intelligence is now central to economics, management, and public policy. The deployment of AI tools in customer service, writing, software development, and consulting operations has been reported to generate large per-task productivity gains, typically measured as tasks completed per worker-hour or reductions in mean handle time. We argue that such mean-based metrics can misrepresent AI's effects in workflows where tasks accumulate and compete for scarce human attention. AI assistance can generate a deceptive productivity signature: average completion times fall because AI tools typically supply a fast first draft, yet workflow-level performance deteriorates when a subset of AI errors escapes review and returns as costly downstream rework. We call this divergence between mean task speed and system-level delay the variance wedge. Depending on the operational parameters, the most time-efficient way to complete a workflow may undergo a transition between two task-processing regimes, a fully AI-assisted and a fully manual one. We formalize the mechanism as a queueing model and derive two main implications analytically. First, under congestion, reviewers rationally raise the risk threshold for checking AI outputs, reducing scrutiny precisely when it would matter the most. Second, AI assistance can stabilize an overloaded workflow only when (i) the fraction of tasks handled by AI exceeds a critical threshold, and (ii) the human attention required for review and expected rework is lower than the attention for manual completion, a requirement substantially more stringent than faster draft generation. These results suggest that AI deployment should be evaluated not only by average task speed, but by its overall effects on congestion, rework, and the robustness of human oversight under load.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI辅助工作流中存在"方差楔"现象——AI工具虽能加快初稿生成使平均任务速度提升，但会导致部分错误逃过审查并引发下游返工，使系统级延迟恶化。通过队列模型证明：拥堵条件下审核者会提高风险阈值削弱审查；在过载工作流中，AI稳定效果需同时满足AI处理比例超临界值且审核注意力成本低于手动完成两个条件。因此AI部署评估应综合考虑拥堵、再加工及人类监督稳健性，而非仅依赖平均指标。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍采用平均任务速度或处理时间等指标衡量AI生产力提升，但在任务累积与人类注意力稀缺的工作流场景中，这类指标可能产生误导性结论。
AI.method: 建立队列模型进行形式化分析，推导出两个解析性命题。
AI.result: AI辅助可产生"生产力假象"：平均完成时间下降源于AI快速初稿，但部分AI错误逃过审查导致下游返工，使系统级延迟增加。拥堵时审核者理性提高风险阈值，削弱审查力度。AI辅助仅在满足两个条件时才能稳定过载工作流：AI处理比例超临界值，且审核注意力成本低于手动完成。
AI.conclusion: AI部署评估应超越平均任务速度指标，需综合考虑拥堵、再加工及负载下人类监督的稳健性。阈值条件：AI处理比例需超过临界值，且人工审核与预期返工所需注意力低于纯手动完成。

title: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
summary: Code agents are currently having skillful performance on repository-level software engineering benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether success on end-to-end tasks such as issue resolution truly reflects repository context reasoning, the ability to identify the task-relevant information across multiple files and reason over the relations among them. To investigate this question, we introduce RepoMirage, a two-stage evaluation suite built on SWE-Bench Verified that adopts perturbation as a diagnostic tool to increase the demand for context reasoning by transforming how the repository is exposed. First, RepoMirage-Perturb applies three types of semantics-preserving repository-level perturbations, revealing a clear performance drop when correct solving requires broader context access. RepoMirage-Extend further turns perturbation-targeted structural bottlenecks into explicit tasks beyond issue resolution, where the average performance declines from 66.8% in the original setting to 25.3%, indicating a significant deficiency in repository context reasoning. Further trajectory analysis reveals an exploration drift, where agents access broader repository context but fail to turn it into effective structure information. Motivated by this observation, we propose RepoAnchor, a structure-first prototype workflow that separates repository exploration from downstream problem solving, and show that explicit structural scaffolding yields notable gains. These results uncover an previously overlooked gap in repository context reasoning for code agents and suggest that stronger structure-aware methods are potential to improve them.

AI.tldr: RepoMirage 是一个基于 SWE-Bench Verified 构建的两阶段扰动式评测套件，用来检验代码智能体（code agents）的"仓库上下文推理"能力是否名副其实。作者发现：仅通过语义保持的仓库级扰动（依赖路径间接化、运行时目标遮蔽、本地值外置），8 个前沿模型的解决率就从平均 66.8% 降到 49.78%；进一步把这些扰动揭示的结构瓶颈改写成显式任务（RepoMirage-Extend）后，成功率降至 25.25%。轨迹分析显示智能体存在"探索漂移"——读更多文件却难以转化为编辑决策。为此作者提出结构优先的 RepoAnchor 工作流，把仓库结构探索与问题求解分离，通过中间 INSTRUCTION.md 传递结构锚点，带来稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体在 SWE-Bench Verified 等端到端仓库级基准上表现出色，但其高分是否真正来自"仓库上下文推理"（跨多文件定位任务相关信息并推理其关系）尚不清楚。初步分析显示：GPT-5 在已解决的实例中 53.8% 只查看了 1 个文件、88.0% 不超过 3 个文件，DeepSeek-V3.2 也有 55.7% 限于 3 个文件内，说明现有成功多依赖局部线索而非真正的多文件推理。若另建新基准又会引入新环境与新任务形式，使失败难以归因。因此作者需要一个受控评测：在保持任务语义与代码库实例不变的前提下，通过改变仓库"被暴露的方式"来选择性提高上下文推理需求，从而检验基准成绩的可靠性。
AI.method:
以 SWE-Bench Verified 为种子基准，所有模型统一用 mini-swe-agent 的标准 bash-only 设置（最多 250 步），保证框架、提示、执行环境与停止条件一致，仅替换后端模型，评测 8 个前沿模型（GPT-4.1、GPT-5、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、MiniMax-M2.7、Qwen3-Coder-Next、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。

（1）RepoMirage-Perturb：三类语义保持的仓库级扰动，均用 LibCST 基于语法树实现。① 依赖路径间接化：把绝对导入重路由为四层代理链（proxy chain），隐藏真实依赖；② 运行时目标遮蔽：重命名目标文件、原位置建同名包目录并用 __init__.py 动态加载重导出，另植入行为相近的诱饵文件（布尔反转、别名打乱、键名错配等）；③ 本地值外置：把目标文件中的常量抽取到外部 JSON（每 3 个一组），代码改为运行时加载合并。功能保持用 PASS_TO_PASS 脚本验证，可解性用"先打金补丁再扰动"后跑 FAIL_TO_PASS 验证。

（2）RepoMirage-Extend：在已扰动仓库上把每个扰动策略转化为显式任务族：多文件问题解决（保留金补丁跨多文件的实例）、代理链补全（抹掉链中间代理文件，需重建转发逻辑）、运行时目标识别（抹掉包装器对真实文件的引用，需在诱饵中判定真目标）、缺失常量恢复（删除 JSON 中的键但保留值，需从代码语义反推键名）。每个原始实例只归入一个任务族，各任务均有确定性 checker，且限制可修改文件范围以防走捷径。

（3）诊断与缓解：将 shell 命令按 edit/test/search/read 规则分类，合并 search+read 为 explore，计算 explore/edit/test 三状态转移概率、探索文件数与首次编辑前步骤占比；再以"结构提示"（只描述扰动机制与结构事实，不给具体答案）做对照实验；最后设计 RepoAnchor 两阶段流程：第一阶段只做结构探索并把结构摘要写入 INSTRUCTION.md（禁止改代码），第二阶段携带该摘要做实现与补丁生成。
AI.result:
（1）RepoMirage-Perturb：8 模型平均解决率由 66.80% 降至 49.78%，相对降幅 15.96%（Claude-Sonnet-4.6）至 52.6%（GPT-4.1）；平均访问文件数由 4.77 升至 13.24（如 Qwen3-Coder-Next 由 4.66 增至 26.90）。消融显示三类扰动各自有效，叠加后低于任一单项。

（2）RepoMirage-Extend：同实例子集上平均成功率由原始 66.80% 降至 25.25%；分任务均值分别为多文件问题解决 17.86%、代理链补全 17.19%、运行时目标识别 28.26%、缺失常量恢复 33.94%。原任务排名与新任务排名不一致（如 MiniMax-M2.7 原始最强但 Extend 仅 14.80%）。

（3）行为诊断：探索文件数与首次编辑前探索占比显著上升，explore→explore 转移概率上升、explore→edit 下降，四个任务族均呈"探索漂移"；任务间还有差异（多文件任务中 test→explore 上升说明失败测试暴露更多相关文件；运行时目标任务更依赖运行时探针；常量恢复任务 test→explore 大幅上升）。

（4）结构提示干预显著提升：GPT-5 平均 27.60%→62.60%，DeepSeek-V3.2 39.80%→76.80%，其中代理链与常量任务提升最大。RepoAnchor 在 4 个模型、全部任务族上均带来稳定增益，且在多文件问题解决上优于仅给提示，说明结构摘要本身有效。
AI.conclusion: 代码智能体在仓库级问题解决基准上的高分并不等价于仓库上下文推理：基准成功往往来自文件名/路径/本地常量等局部线索，而非跨文件理解与推理。RepoMirage 通过语义保持的受控扰动把这一差距量化（66.8%→49.78%→25.25%），并揭示机制性瓶颈——探索漂移：智能体能获取更广上下文却难以把多文件证据组织成可用的结构脚手架，因而停留在反复探索而缺少编辑决策。提供结构提示与结构优先的 RepoAnchor 两阶段工作流（结构摘要作为中间锚点传递给求解阶段）均能显著提升性能，说明显式的结构感知建模是改进代码智能体上下文推理的可行方向。局限：当前仅支持 Python 仓库（语法树变换与运行时验证可行性所限）；任务形式仍偏经典的问题求解式修改，未来可扩展到代码评审、仓库级测试生成、重构与维护任务；工具以可执行生成/评测套件形式发布，不重新分发 SWE-Bench 仓库与镜像。

title: The 2nd EReL@MIR Workshop on Efficient Representation Learning for Multimodal Information Retrieval
comment: Accepted as a workshop proposal at ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Multimodal representation learning has attracted increasing attention in AI, driven by the strong performance of large, pretrained multimodal foundation models such as Qwen, LLaVA, and CLIP. These models deliver impressive performance on a range of multimodal information retrieval (MIR) tasks, including web search, cross-modal retrieval, and recommender systems. Yet their massive parameter counts create major efficiency bottlenecks when adapting their representations for IR tasks during training, deployment, and inference. These limitations hinder the practical use of foundation models for representation learning in information retrieval. To address these issues, we propose organizing the EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026, bringing together researchers from academia and industry to discuss emerging solutions, open challenges, and new efficiency metrics and benchmarks for multimodal IR representation learning in the foundation-model era. The workshop's official website is available at https://erel-mir.github.io/.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes organizing the EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026 to address efficiency challenges when adapting large multimodal foundation models for information retrieval tasks.
AI.motivation: While large multimodal foundation models (Qwen, LLaVA, CLIP) achieve strong performance on various multimodal information retrieval (MIR) tasks like web search, cross-modal retrieval, and recommender systems, their massive parameter counts create significant efficiency bottlenecks that hinder practical deployment in real-world IR applications.
AI.method: The workshop will serve as a platform bringing together academic and industry researchers to discuss and develop solutions, focusing on efficiency challenges in adapting large multimodal models for IR tasks during training, deployment, and inference stages.
AI.result: Workshop organized at MM 2026 with official website https://erel-mir.github.io/
AI.conclusion: The proposed EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026 aims to bridge the gap between the impressive capabilities of multimodal foundation models and their practical deployment in IR systems by fostering collaboration, developing efficiency-focused solutions, and establishing new benchmarks and metrics for the field.

title: Characterization-Guided GPU Fault Resilience in NVIDIA MPS
summary: NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS) enables fine-grained GPU sharing by allowing multiple processes to execute concurrently on the same GPU, making it an important mechanism for improving GPU utilization. However, MPS has weak fault resilience: a fault in one process can terminate all co-running processes, limiting its adoption in resilience-critical settings such as multi-tenant GPU clusters. In this work, we design fault-resilient MPS to solve this problem. Our design is guided by insights from a systematic characterization of GPU faults and a deep analysis of their end-to-end processing pipeline. Based on these insights, we design two complementary mechanisms. A fault isolation mechanism for the dominant memory-related faults that can be fully isolated by software intervention in the open GPU driver kernel module. For other faults whose process is within proprietary software, we design a practical mechanism -- fast recovery using virtual memory based GPU-resident state sharing. Our evaluation on different GPUs and workloads shows that these mechanisms can handle corresponding faults effectively with minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文针对NVIDIA MPS故障韧性弱的问题，通过系统分析GPU故障特征和端到端处理流程，提出了两种互补机制：软件可隔离故障的隔离机制和专有软件故障的快速恢复机制，实现了容错MPS，在保持GPU共享效率的同时保障了故障隔离能力。
AI.motivation: NVIDIA MPS通过允许多进程并发执行于同一GPU实现细粒度GPU共享，可提高GPU利用率。然而MPS存在故障韧性不足的问题：一个进程的故障会导致所有共运行进程终止，限制了其在对弹性要求严格的场景（如多租户GPU集群）中的应用。
AI.method: 提出两种互补机制：1) 针对主要内存相关故障，设计了可在开源GPU驱动内核模块中通过软件干预完全隔离的故障隔离机制；2) 针对存在于专有软件中的其他故障，设计了基于虚拟内存的GPU驻留状态共享的快速恢复机制。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，所设计的两种机制能有效处理相应类型的GPU故障，且开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 设计的故障隔离机制和快速恢复机制能够有效处理相应故障，且开销极小。该方案已在不同GPU和 workloads 上完成评估，展示了在实际部署中的可行性和实用性。

title: Anchor: Mitigating Artifact Drift in Agent Benchmark Generation
comment: Accepted to RLEval '26 (Workshop at ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems 2026)
summary: AI agents are beginning to complete valuable, long-horizon business operations tasks, but training and evaluation environments for enterprise work still struggle to balance realism, verifiability, and scale. Environment and task creation frequently suffers from a failure mode we call artifact drift: when instructions, environments, oracles, and verifiers are created by loosely coupled processes, they frequently disagree on what a task requires, producing environments that are unsolvable, reward-hackable, or inconsistent. We introduce Anchor, a task-generation pipeline that formalizes domain experts' specifications of business workflows into constraint optimization programs. From a single parametric specification, the pipeline jointly produces a natural-language instruction, environment configuration, solver-certified ground-truth solution, and state-based verifier. With Anchor, altering parameters yields new tasks with controlled difficulty and known optimal solutions, producing harness-agnostic environments whose rewards depend solely on end-state business correctness. We apply Anchor to produce ERP-Bench: a benchmark of 300 long-horizon tasks spanning procurement and manufacturing workflows in a production-grade ERP system. We find that generation parameters predict realized difficulty, and that frontier models satisfy explicit task constraints in 26.1% of trials but reach a fully optimal solution in only 17.4% of trials. Overall, we show that Anchor and ERP-Bench offer a concrete recipe for building auditable evaluation environments for economically valuable agent work. We release the task generator and ERP-Bench dataset at erpbench.ai

AI.tldr: This paper introduces Anchor, a task-generation pipeline that formalizes business workflow specifications into constraint optimization programs to jointly produce instructions, environments, ground-truth solutions, and verifiers — addressing "artifact drift" in AI agent evaluation. Applied to produce ERP-Bench, a benchmark of 300 tasks in procurement and manufacturing, demonstrating that frontier models still struggle to reach optimal solutions (17.4% success rate).
AI.motivation: Current training and evaluation environments for enterprise AI agents suffer from "artifact drift" — loosely coupled creation of instructions, environments, oracles, and verifiers leads to unsolvable, reward-hackable, or inconsistent environments.
AI.method: Anchor formalizes business workflow specifications into constraint optimization programs, jointly generating instructions, environment configurations, solver-certified ground-truth solutions, and state-based verifiers from parametric specifications.
AI.result: ERP-Bench contains 300 long-horizon tasks across procurement and manufacturing workflows; generation parameters predict realized difficulty; frontier models satisfy explicit constraints in 26.1% of trials but reach fully optimal solutions in only 17.4% of trials.
AI.conclusion: Anchor provides a concrete recipe for building auditable evaluation environments for economically valuable agent work; ERP-Bench dataset and task generator released at erpbench.ai.

title: Why LLMs Hallucinate on Structured Knowledge: A Mechanistic Analysis of Reasoning over Linearized Representations
comment: To appear in Proceedings of ACL 2026
summary: In many reasoning tasks, large language models (LLMs) rely on structured external knowledge, such as graphs and tables, which is typically linearized into sequential token representations. However, even when sufficient knowledge is available, LLMs can still produce hallucinated outputs, and the underlying mechanisms behind such failures remain poorly understood. We investigate these mechanisms and find that hallucinations arise from systematic internal dynamics rather than random noise. First, attention disproportionately concentrates toward shortcut-like structural cues rather than distributing across the full context. Second, feed-forward representations fail to ground the provided knowledge, causing the model to revert to parametric memory. Moreover, our results indicate that hallucination is consistently associated with failures in semantic grounding within feed-forward layers, while attention allocation exhibits greater task-dependent variability. Finally, we show that these mechanistic patterns generalize beyond single-hop graphs to multi-hop and tabular settings, enabling effective hallucination detection across structured knowledge formats.

AI.tldr: LLM在处理结构化外部知识时产生幻觉的根源在于系统性内部动态，而非随机噪声，主要表现为注意力聚焦偏差和前馈层语义锚定失败。
AI.motivation: LLM在依赖结构化外部知识（如图、表）进行推理时，即使知识充足仍可能产生幻觉，且其失败机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过分析注意力分布模式与前馈层表征来研究LLM处理结构化外部知识时的内部动态机制。
AI.result: 1. 注意力过度集中于捷径式结构线索而非全上下文；2. 前馈层表征未能有效锚定外部知识，导致模型回归参数记忆；3. 幻觉与前馈层语义锚定失败密切相关；4. 注意力分配的task-dependent变异性更高；5. 机制模式可泛化至多跳推理和表格场景。
AI.conclusion: 发现了可跨格式泛化的幻觉产生机制模式，为结构化知识场景下的幻觉检测提供了有效依据。

title: Planning Neural Dynamics with Lie Group Embedding through Supervised Projective Manifold Learning
summary: We propose Lie group embedded dynamical neural networks (LieEDNN) and the corresponding learning algorithms based on gradient descent and metric projection on smooth manifold, where we treat Lie group as an intrinsic representation for continuous symmetry of manifold geometry. Thereby we achieve learnable and stable dynamics on the underlying manifold for general Lie group, and we are able to utilize the powerful representation capability of Lie group such as SO(3) and SE(3) to solve real world engineering problems in areas such as robotics, graphics, and control. Two core challenges are: (i) General Lie groups are incompatible with addition arithmetic, which is necessary for neural network interactions. (ii) The dynamics evolve in the nonlinear representation space of special algebra rather than the normal Euclidean space, which violates the paradigm of common neural ODEs. To address these two challenges, we firstly introduce adjoint Lie group action on the Lie algebra, which induces a linear mapping and transfer to the block-wise structure of weight matrices, such that addition could operate on the Lie algebra as a vector space. Then we parameterize the Lie algebra and the adjoint action as linear transformation so that the architecture is aligned with neural network perceptrons. Explicitly, this embedding appears as block-wise manifold constraints on weights, and we develop algorithms to learn the equilibrium with stability guarantees of the temporal neural network dynamics. Experiments are implemented on a specific Lie group SE(3), with the application scenario of telescopic manipulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LieEDNN（Lie 群嵌入动力学神经网络）：把神经状态从 Lie 群搬到 Lie 代数（向量空间），用伴随作用（adjoint action）诱导出可线性表示的 6×6 块结构权重，权重矩阵按块做流形投影（projective manifold learning），从而在保持欧氏神经动力学（矩阵乘、加权和、梯度学习）可分析性的同时保留 Lie 群几何语义；并给出平衡点存在唯一性与渐近稳定的充分条件，在 SE(3) 上的伸缩机械臂规划原型实验中验证可收敛到目标位姿且权重块结构被保持。
AI.motivation: 多数神经动力学架构（RNN、连续 Hopfield 网络、ResNet、Neural ODE）都在欧氏空间构建，无法直接表达机器人运动、刚体变换、相机位姿等内在 Lie 群几何结构（SO(3)/SE(3)）。核心困难有两点：(i) Lie 群是非线性流形，不存在封闭的加法，无法直接作为神经网络的加权求和交互载体；(ii) 动力学在特殊代数的非线性表示空间上演化，违背了常规 Neural ODE 在欧氏空间的分析范式（平衡点、稳定性、光滑性均难以分析）。此外，已有工作（如四元数 Hopfield 神经网络 QSHNN）仅针对单一超复数代数，缺乏面向一般矩阵 Lie 群的通用嵌入与投影学习算法。
AI.method: 1) 表示层：将神经状态 X_i 与偏置 B_i 置于 Lie 代数 g（向量空间，加法良定义），群权重 θ_ij∈G 通过伴随作用 Ad_θ(X)=θXθ^{-1} 与状态交互；引入可学习标量连接强度 α_ij 以缓解 Lie 群权重学习的不收敛。2) 线性化：用参数化映射 P:g→R^d，定义 L[Ad_g]=P∘Ad_g∘P^{-1}∈GL(d,R)，证明其为 Lie 群同态（Thm D.1），并证明 SE(3) 的诱导像集 L[Ad_SE(3)]={[[R,0],[t^∧R,R]]} 在 GL(6,R) 中拓扑闭，构成矩阵 Lie 群（Thm 3.2），一般群情形用 G/ker L 商群刻画（App. E）。3) 网络架构：经参数化后系统化为 R^{6N} 上的标准 ODE ξ̇=-γξ+μWφ(ξ)+μb，权重块 W_ij=α_ij·L[Ad_θij]，与感知机结构对齐；每 6 个分量对应一个 Lie 群代表神经元。4) 稳定性理论：Thm 3.4/Thm I.1 用 Lipschitz 常数与矩阵范数给出平衡点存在唯一（Banach/Brouwer 压缩映射）以及 Lyapunov 渐近稳定的充分条件（‖W‖₁<γ/μ；‖W‖₁+‖W‖_∞<2γ/μ），并给出轨迹光滑性与曲率上界（App. H）。5) 学习规则：推导平衡点对权重的梯度 ∂E/∂w_ij（含灵敏度矩阵 S=I-(μ/γ)WJ_φ(ξ*)），以及连接强度 α_ij 的梯度；结合 Frobenius 范数度量投影——对 SO(3) 用 SVD 正交极分解 Proj_SO(3)(Π)=U diag(1,1,det(UV^T))V^T（Lemma 3.1），对 6×6 块做分块投影（Thm 3.5）得到 Proj_L(Θ)。6) 算法 Alg.1：Runge-Kutta45 求解 ODE 得平衡点，梯度下降更新权重，每 P 步（周期投影）做一次分块投影重构 W_ij=α_ij·Proj_L(W_ij/α_ij)，配合权重归一化 W=W/(ε+‖W‖₁)。7) 附录 N 额外给出群等变性充分条件：用等变激活 Φ(X)=tanh(‖ω‖)/(‖ω‖+ε)·X（基于 tr(X²) 的等变性）替代逐元素 tanh，可使 LieEDNN 在伴随作用下方变。
AI.result: 在 SE(3) 上以 4 个代表神经元（24 维）构成的伸缩机械臂规划原型上：随机采样 Lie 代数坐标中的目标状态，经指数收缩 Exp 解码为 SE(3) 位姿；训练损失随周期投影 P∈[8,16] 收敛但呈周期性振荡扰动（周期过小训练慢，过大则权重严重偏离流形导致失败），在合适区间内达到 100% 精度、轨迹精确收敛到目标位姿；训练后的权重每个 6×6 块均保持在 L[Ad_SE(3)] 结构内（对称块形式），而关闭投影的消融实验中虽然仍能达到目标平衡点，但权重块结构被破坏，网络的动力学失去几何与物理意义。实验中施加的范数约束满足 Thm 3.4 的稳定性充分条件，故收敛性与稳定性有理论保证；附录给出理想连续时域动力学中平衡点与目标的偏差界以及 δ（平衡点相对目标的偏移）的上界估计。计算开销极低（Apple M1 CPU、8GB 内存，单次完整训练 3–5 分钟）。
AI.conclusion: LieEDNN 通过"状态搬到 Lie 代数 + 伴随作用的线性表示 + 权重分块度量投影"这一组合，在不破坏标准神经网络可加性、矩阵运算与学习规则的前提下，把 Lie 群几何结构内嵌进连续时间动力学网络；配合基于范数约束的稳定性定理，实现了平衡点的全局唯一、可学习且渐近稳定，兼顾了几何一致性、可解释性与可靠性。作者指出该框架可推广到任意矩阵 Lie 群（复数对应 C×≅R+×U(1)、四元数对应 H×≅R+×SU(2)），可作为 DMP/stableDS/RMP/QSHNN 类动力学运动生成器的几何化替代，并有望与轨迹约束（关节限位、避碰）结合。局限与展望：实验仅为原型级、缺乏碰撞规避/关节限位/安全约束；稳定性充分条件与流形投影对优化动力学的相互作用缺乏严格分析；周期投影仅为 Riemann 梯度的近似且引入振荡，与真正 Riemann 梯度方法的对比尚未完成；等变性变体仅在附录中给出理论条件、未做实验；需扩展到 SE(3) 之外的更多 Lie 群实例。

title: Algorithmic Monocultures in Hiring
summary: Many employers screen job applicants with algorithms built by the same few algorithm vendors. We hypothesize that algorithmic monoculture leads to the same individuals and members of the same racial groups facing rejection. We acquire and analyze a novel dataset of 3 million applicants submitting 4 million applications where all the applications are screened by algorithms built by the same vendor. We find clear racial disparities in applicant outcomes. Of all applications submitted by Asian and Black applicants, 14.74% and 25.87% are submitted to positions that adversely impact Asian and Black applicants, respectively, according to U.S. employment discrimination standards. Individuals also receive homogeneous outcomes: 4% of all applicants who apply to 10 positions are recommended for rejection from all positions, a rate higher than expected by chance. To better understand this homogeneity, we leverage the deterministic replicability of hiring algorithms to generate the outcomes applicants would have received if they applied to all positions. We show that applicants would need to apply widely in order to ensure their applications are considered by a human

AI.tldr: Study of 3 million job applicants screened by algorithms from a single vendor reveals significant racial disparities and outcome homogeneity, with racial minority applicants disproportionately subjected to adverse algorithmic recommendations.
AI.motivation: Many employers use hiring algorithms built by the same few vendors, creating algorithmic monoculture that may lead to systematic rejection of the same individuals and racial groups.
AI.method: Analysis of a novel dataset of 3 million applicants submitting 4 million applications, all screened by algorithms from the same vendor. Researchers leveraged the deterministic replicability of hiring algorithms to simulate outcomes if applicants applied to all positions.
AI.result: 14.74% of Asian and 25.87% of Black applicants' submissions were to positions that adversely impact these groups according to U.S. employment discrimination standards. Approximately 4% of applicants who applied to 10 positions were recommended for rejection from all positions—a rate higher than expected by chance.
AI.conclusion: Applicants would need to apply widely in order to ensure their applications are considered by a human reviewer, indicating systemic barriers in algorithmic screening.

title: SetupX: Can LLM Agents Learn from Past Failures in Functionality-Correct Code Repository Setup?
summary: Functionality-correct repository setup aims to configure execution environments (e.g., dependencies, build scripts) to successfully execute a repository's documented features. It presents significant challenges due to diverse, repository-specific failures, including dependency incompatibilities, missing toolchains, incomplete installations, and verification-strategy mismatches. Existing LLM agents struggle to robustly resolve these issues, specifically failing to support (1) cross-repository experience transfer, (2) multi-step trial-and-repair under non-invertible state changes, and (3) robust verification of setup outcomes to distinguish setup-induced failures from repository bugs. To address this, we introduce SetupX, an experiential learning-based setup framework. First, we construct a Self-Evolving Experience Representation (XPU), a dual-modality knowledge unit encoding setup signals, textual guidance, executable actions to dynamically transfer verified environment fixes to unseen repositories. Second, we employ Experience-Augmented Speculative Execution backed by a LIFO Docker snapshot stack, enabling the agent to proactively trial fixes and safely roll back to known-good states. Third, we introduce a Prosecutor-Judge Verification Protocol that separates evidence collection from final judgment, enabling more reliable setup verification beyond superficial build-time metrics. Evaluation results on carefully-crafted benchmarks show SetupX achieves highest performance (e.g., 92% pass rate) and outperforms the strongest baseline by over 19%. Crucially, SetupX excels in complex multi-repository setup requiring coordinating multiple interconnected services across different containers. The code repository is available at https://github.com/OpenDataBox/SetupX.

AI.tldr: SetupX is an experiential learning-based framework for automating repository setup configuration. It addresses three key limitations of existing LLM agents through dual-modality experience representation (XPU), speculative execution with Docker-based rollback (LIFO snapshot stack), and a separated verification protocol (Prosecutor-Judge). The system achieves 92% pass rate with 19% improvement over state-of-the-art baselines.
AI.motivation: Functionality-correct repository setup presents significant challenges due to diverse repository-specific failures (dependency incompatibilities, missing toolchains, incomplete installations, verification-strategy mismatches). Existing LLM agents fail to robustly resolve these issues in three aspects: cross-repository experience transfer, multi-step trial-and-repair under non-invertible state changes, and robust verification to distinguish setup-induced failures from repository bugs.
AI.method: SetupX proposes three core mechanisms: (1) XPU (Self-Evolving Experience Representation) - a dual-modality knowledge unit encoding setup signals, textual guidance and executable actions for cross-repository knowledge transfer; (2) Experience-Augmented Speculative Execution backed by LIFO Docker snapshot stack for safe trial-and-repair with rollback capability; (3) Prosecutor-Judge Verification Protocol separating evidence collection from final judgment for robust outcome verification.
AI.result: SetupX achieves 92% pass rate on carefully-crafted benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 19%. The framework particularly excels in complex multi-repository setup requiring coordination of multiple interconnected services across different containers.
AI.conclusion: SetupX demonstrates significant practical value for automating complex repository setup tasks, particularly excelling in multi-repository scenarios requiring coordination of interconnected services. The open-source availability of the framework enables further research and application.

title: ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence
summary: Autonomous research agents produce competitive solutions and professional-looking manuscripts, yet their outputs contain verifiability failures undetectable by surface-level evaluation: fabricated citations, unreproducible scores, and method descriptions that diverge from the implementation. We address this through three contributions. First, Chain-of-Evidence (CoE), a verifiability framework requiring every claim to be traceable to its evidence source. Second, ScientistOne, an end-to-end autonomous research system that maintains evidence chains by construction throughout literature review, solution discovery, and paper writing. Third, CoE Audit, a post-hoc audit whose four integrity checks -- score verification, specification violation, reference verification, and method-code alignment -- apply uniformly to all systems. Across 75 papers spanning five systems and five frontier research tasks, every baseline exhibits at least one systematic failure mode: hallucinated reference rates reach 21%, score verification passes in as few as 42% of papers, and method-code alignment ranges from 20% to 80%. ScientistOne achieves zero hallucinated references (0/337), perfect score verification (12/12), and the highest method-code alignment (14/15), while matching or exceeding human expert performance on all five tasks. ScientistOne further generalizes to six additional tasks spanning medical imaging, fine-grained recognition, 3D perception, and language modeling, achieving state-of-the-art on Parameter Golf and gold medals on MLE-Bench tasks where baselines fail entirely.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自主研究智能体的可验证性问题提出系统性解决方案。通过Chain-of-Evidence框架、ScientistOne端到端系统和CoE Audit审计方法三措并举，有效解决了AI生成研究中常见的引用伪造、分数不可复现和方法实现不一致等问题，在75篇论文的广泛评估中验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: Autonomous research agents produce outputs with verifiability failures (fabricated citations, unreproducible scores, method-implementation divergence) that are undetectable by surface-level evaluation, yet these systems create competitive solutions and professional-looking manuscripts.
AI.method: Threefold approach: (1) Chain-of-Evidence (CoE) framework requiring traceable evidence for every claim; (2) ScientistOne, an end-to-end autonomous research system maintaining evidence chains throughout literature review, solution discovery, and paper writing; (3) CoE Audit post-hoc methodology with four integrity checks (score verification, specification violation, reference verification, method-code alignment) applied uniformly across all systems.
AI.result: Across 75 papers spanning five systems and five frontier tasks: baseline systems exhibit systematic failures with hallucinated reference rates reaching 21%, score verification pass rates as low as 42%, and method-code alignment ranging 20-80%. ScientistOne significantly outperforms baselines on all verifiability metrics.
AI.conclusion: ScientistOne achieves zero hallucinated references (0/337), perfect score verification (12/12), and highest method-code alignment (14/15). It matches or exceeds human expert performance across all five tasks and generalizes to six additional tasks, achieving state-of-the-art on Parameter Golf and gold medals on MLE-Bench where baselines fail entirely.

title: MuChator: Enabling Active Music Discovery via Conversational Music LLMs in Douyin Music
summary: Douyin Music, a large-scale platform with millions of daily users, adopts an immersive, feed-based discovery paradigm, where users passively explore music through continuous recommendations. While effective for passive music discovery, this paradigm restricts users to recommendation results and provides limited support for explicitly specifying listening intents. Unlike conventional search, where users express well-defined intents through explicit queries such as specific songs or artists, real-world active music discovery is often situational and colloquial, involving vague or underspecified requests. While LLMs enable natural language interaction, their direct use in music discovery remains limited by insufficient music-domain knowledge, lack of music-query collaborative reasoning, and shallow understanding of personalized preferences. To address these challenges, we introduce MuChator, an interactive MusicLLM-based framework that enables users to actively express situational music intents in natural language. MuChator incorporates three key components: (1) Music Knowledge Pre-training, a three-stage scheme that incrementally injects objective music knowledge, subjective music knowledge, and personalized music preferences into LLMs; (2) Context-aware Instruction Tuning, which constructs high-quality user-query-music triplets through an automated synthesis pipeline to align LLMs with active and situational user intents; and (3) Preference Alignment with Hybrid RM, which jointly models intent relevance, personalized preferences, and basic constraints, and is optimized using GRPO-based reinforcement learning. Extensive evaluations on industrial music recommendation datasets demonstrate that MuChator outperforms leading proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro. The model has been deployed on Douyin Music App within ByteDance, with 46.49\% improvement of user active days in online A/B test.

AI.tldr: MuChator是抖音音乐推出的交互式音乐大模型框架，通过音乐知识预训练、上下文感知指令微调和混合奖励模型偏好对齐三个组件，使LLM能够理解情境化音乐意图，实现主动音乐发现。实验证明其性能优于Gemini-3-Pro，线上A/B测试用户活跃天数提升46.49%。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐平台（如抖音）采用被动推荐的沉浸式信息流范式，用户被限制在推荐结果中，难以显式表达听歌意图。实际主动音乐发现往往是情境化和口语化的，涉及模糊或不明确的请求。LLM直接应用于音乐发现受限于领域知识不足、缺乏音乐-查询协作推理能力以及对个性化偏好的浅层理解。
AI.method: MuChator包含三个核心组件：（1）音乐知识预训练，采用三阶段渐进式方案向LLM注入客观音乐知识、主观音乐知识和个性化音乐偏好；（2）上下文感知指令微调，通过自动化合成流水线构建高质量用户-查询-音乐三元组，对齐LLM与主动情境化用户意图；（3）混合奖励模型偏好对齐，联合建模意图相关性、个性化偏好和基本约束，使用GRPO-based强化学习优化。
AI.result: 在工业级音乐推荐数据集上的评估表明，MuChator优于Gemini-3-Pro等领先专有模型。
AI.conclusion: MuChator已在字节跳动抖音音乐App中成功部署，在线A/B测试显示用户活跃天数提升46.49%，证明了该交互式MusicLLM框架在主动音乐发现场景中的实用价值。

title: StreamSplit: Continuous Audio Representation Learning via Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitting
summary: Large-batch Contrastive Learning (CL), the foundation of modern representation learning, is fundamentally incompatible with the volatile resource constraints of edge devices. This conflict creates a dilemma: small on-device batches degrade model fidelity, while offloading to the cloud incurs unacceptable latency and bandwidth costs. Existing solutions often resort to static model compression, which fails to adapt to the runtime volatility of edge environments. To bridge this gap, we present StreamSplit, a novel framework that makes streaming CL practical across heterogeneous ARM client platforms. StreamSplit resolves the conflict between the continuous nature of ambient audio and the discrete batch requirements of models like CLAP and COLA. We introduce: (1) A distribution-based streaming framework that decouples representation quality from local batch size, using a tractable Hybrid Loss to maintain fidelity despite sparse updates; and (2) An Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitter that uses a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy to dynamically partition computation. Uniquely, this policy integrates real-time resource monitoring with embedding ambiguity to optimize the accuracy-latency trade-off on the fly. We evaluate StreamSplit on diverse hardware, from the resource-constrained Raspberry Pi 4 to the high-performance Apple M2. Results demonstrate that StreamSplit reduces per-sample latency by up to 4.7x and cuts bandwidth by 77.1% and energy by 52.3% compared to server-centric baselines. Crucially, it maintains accuracy within 2.2% of server-centric models, proving that adaptive, distributed learning is a viable path for the modern edge ecosystem.

AI.tldr: StreamSplit解决边缘设备上大规模对比学习(CL)的资源限制冲突，通过分布流式框架和强化学习自适应分割器，在Raspberry Pi 4到Apple M2等异构ARM平台上实现4.7倍延迟降低、77.1%带宽节省和52.3%能耗降低，同时保持精度损失在2.2%以内。
AI.motivation: 大规模对比学习（CL）的基础要求与边缘设备资源波动性根本矛盾：本地小批次会降低模型保真度，云端卸载又带来不可接受的延迟和带宽成本。现有静态模型压缩方案无法适应边缘环境运行时波动。
AI.method: 提出两大创新：(1) 基于分布的流式框架，使用可处理的混合损失函数解耦表征质量与本地批次大小；(2) 不确定性引导的自适应分割器，采用轻量级强化学习策略整合实时资源监控与嵌入不确定性，动态优化精度-延迟权衡。
AI.result: 在Raspberry Pi 4到Apple M2等多样化硬件上，StreamSplit相比服务器中心基线实现：单样本延迟降低4.7倍、带宽减少77.1%、能耗降低52.3%，精度损失控制在2.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 自适应分布式学习是现代边缘生态系统的可行路径，证明流式CL可在异构ARM客户端平台上实际部署。

title: OmniToM: Benchmarking Theory of Mind in LLMs via Explicit Belief Modeling
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others' knowledge, intentions, and emotions, is commonly evaluated in large language models (LLMs) using end-point question answering, where performance is judged solely by the final answer to a social reasoning query. This paradigm obscures whether the model actually constructs the underlying mental-state representations required for robust reasoning, particularly in scenarios involving divergent, evolving, or mistaken beliefs. In order to address this research gap, we introduce OmniToM, a benchmark that directly evaluates these representations by requiring explicit modeling of belief structures for all relevant actors within a narrative. These structures are composed of belief propositions: minimal statements of what an actor takes to be true about the world or another actor's mental state, allowing knowledge, intentions, emotions, and false beliefs to be analyzed in a common format. Models are evaluated in two stages: Stage 1: Belief Extraction, which extracts from the story the beliefs relevant to its social dynamics, and Stage 2: Belief Labeling, which assigns each belief a seven-dimensional schema label covering recursive order, truth status, knowledge access, explicitness, content type, mental source, and context. Built from 895 stories from the existing ToMBench story corpus and augmented with 22,343 labeled belief propositions, OmniToM uses a human-calibrated LLM-assisted annotation pipeline. Across diverse models in zero-shot evaluation, OmniToM reveals an actor-specific belief-tracking bottleneck: current LLMs struggle with the knowledge-access and representational decisions required to transform narrative facts into actors' beliefs and shared mental states.

AI.tldr: OmniToM是一个新型ToM基准，通过两阶段评估（信念提取+七维标签标注）直接评估LLM的心理状态表征能力。该基准包含895个故事和22,343个标注信念命题。研究发现当前LLMs在角色信念追踪方面存在特异性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM评估范式仅通过最终答案判断性能，掩盖了模型是否真正构建了稳健推理所需的心理状态表征，尤其在涉及分歧、演变或错误信念的场景中难以揭示模型的真实推理能力。
AI.method: OmniToM采用两阶段评估范式：Stage 1从故事中提取与社交动态相关的信念；Stage 2使用七维模式标签对每个信念进行标注（递归阶数、真值状态、知识获取途径、外显性、内容类型、心理来源、上下文）。该基准基于895个故事和22,343个标注信念命题，通过人工校准的LLM辅助标注流程构建。
AI.result: 零样本评估显示，当前LLMs在将叙事事实转化为角色信念和共享心理状态时，存在知识获取和表征决策方面的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: OmniToM reveals an actor-specific belief-tracking bottleneck in current LLMs, showing they struggle with knowledge-access and representational decisions required to transform narrative facts into actors' beliefs and shared mental states.

title: Cultural Value Alignment Via Latent Activation Steering in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit homogenized cultural perspectives. While the World Values Survey (WVS) provides a gold standard for mapping human values, traditional direct prompting of LLMs on WVS often fails to access the model's latent cultural depth, leading to safety-aligned refusals or neutral responses. Here, we propose a generalizable framework for cultural evaluation and intervention that transitions from abstract queries to scenario-based behavioral probing. By extracting implicit token probabilities across 300 situational dilemmas, we bypass surface-level alignment to map the latent coordinates of LLMs cultural value. We further introduce activation steering to shift these internal alignments during the forward pass without retraining. Across multiple LLMs, we find substantial variation in adaptability and uncover a consistent phenomenon of latent entanglement, where interventions along one cultural dimension induce shifts along another. These results suggest that cultural values are encoded as coupled structures, limiting precise alignment. This work establishes a computationally efficient framework for cultural steering, highlighting the structural complexities when navigating global value with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个从抽象查询转向情境化行为探测的文化评估与干预框架，通过提取隐式 token 概率绕过安全对齐机制，并引入激活 steering 技术实现无需重训练的文化对齐调整。研究发现文化价值观以耦合结构编码，导致精确对齐受限。
AI.motivation: 现有直接提示方法访问 LLM 文化深度时面临安全对齐拒绝或中性响应问题，无法有效映射模型的文化价值观；传统基于 WVS 的直接查询方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 从抽象问卷查询转向情境化行为探测（300个情境困境）；提取隐式 token 概率分布以绕过表面对齐机制；引入激活 steering 技术在推理过程中改变模型内部对齐状态，无需微调。
AI.result: 发现不同 LLM 在文化适应性上存在显著差异；揭示了"潜在纠缠"现象——沿一个文化维度的干预会同时引发其他维度的偏移。
AI.conclusion: 激活 steering 可在推理过程中改变模型的文化价值观，无需重新训练；但文化价值观以耦合结构编码，导致沿一个文化维度的干预会引发其他维度的变化，限制了精确对齐的能力。本框架为文化导航提供了计算效率较高的工具。

title: When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection
summary: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs, but violations of semantic constraints: objects co-occur in structured ways, actions imply preconditions, and events satisfy temporal or relational regularities. We study anomaly detection in this setting, where constraints are given as logical rules over learned visual concepts, but real rule violations are rare or absent during training. We propose a neural rule evaluator that compiles each constraint into a directed acyclic graph and learns feature-aware subtree MLP gates for its internal logical operators. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to a parent representation and a rule-satisfaction probability, with intermediate supervision obtained from exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. The key difficulty is that same-image training data often provide insufficient coverage of informative truth configurations and also allow shortcut solutions. To address this, we introduce chimera training: an operand-level counterfactual construction at the feature level. Instead of mixing input images, we concatenate subtree features from different samples; each operand keeps the hard truth label of the sample it came from, and the chimera target is obtained by applying the node's logical operator to those inherited labels. This supplies supervised logical counterexamples without requiring real anomalous images. Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR, the resulting evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules. The method yields both scalar anomaly scores and rule-level attributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经规则评估器，用于检测违反语义约束的异常。通过将逻辑规则编译为有向无环图，并利用特征感知的子树MLP门控模块学习规则满意度概率。为解决训练数据中真实违规样本稀缺的问题，引入"嵌合体训练"——在特征层面通过拼接不同样本的子树特征构造反事实样本。实验表明该方法在CLEVRER、OpenImages和VidOR数据集上显著提升了组合型和关系型规则的异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs but violations of semantic constraints (object co-occurrence, action preconditions, temporal/relational regularities). The key challenge is that real rule violations are rare or absent during training, making it difficult to learn anomaly detection from insufficient truth configurations and avoid shortcut solutions.
AI.method: The paper proposes a neural rule evaluator that compiles logical constraints into DAGs with feature-aware subtree MLP gates. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to parent representations and rule-satisfaction probabilities, using exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. To address insufficient training data coverage and shortcut solutions, the method introduces chimera training: counterfactual construction at the feature level by concatenating subtree features from different samples, inheriting their truth labels and applying logical operators to derive chimera targets.
AI.result: Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR datasets, the evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules.
AI.conclusion: The proposed neural rule evaluator with chimera training effectively addresses the challenge of learning anomaly detection from rare/absent rule violations. It achieves improved rule-level anomaly AUROC across multiple datasets, particularly for compositional and relational rules. The method provides both scalar anomaly scores and interpretable rule-level attributions.

title: Workflow Closure Is Not Scientific Closure in Auto-Research Systems
summary: This paper argues that workflow closure is not scientific closure in auto-research systems. Current systems can increasingly complete research-like loops internally, moving from idea generation to experiment execution, writing, and self-evaluation. That achievement is real, but it does not by itself give the resulting outputs scientific standing. We argue that trustworthy auto-research should not aim for autonomous self-sufficiency, but should aim for autonomous execution under non-autonomous epistemic control. Based on a survey of more than 100 recent papers and repositories in this rapidly emerging area, together with a structured audit of 21 representative systems, we diagnose a recurring and structurally connected failure pattern: objective collapse, in which single-proxy targets replace multi-objective scientific aims; validation collapse, in which internal self-evaluation replaces independent validation; and acceptance collapse, in which benchmark scores or publication-shaped artifacts replace mechanisms for domain-level critique, reuse, and integration. These collapses are not inherent limits of autonomy but correctable design choices. Accordingly, we outline potential remedies across objective signal, validation, and output pathway to spark community discussion.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张自动科研系统（auto-research systems）实现"工作流闭合"（workflow closure）并不等于"科学闭合"（scientific closure）。作者通过综述100+篇论文与仓库、并对21个代表性系统做结构化审计，诊断出"三层坍塌"（three-level collapse）模式：目标坍塌（L1，多目标科学目标被单一代理指标取代）、验证坍塌（L2，独立验证被系统内部自评取代）、验收坍塌（L3，基准分数或论文形态产出取代领域级批判、复用与整合机制）。三者互为因果，构成"为自主性而闭合"（closure-for-autonomy）的结构性代价。作者主张可信自动科研应追求"非自主认识论控制下的自主执行"，并给出目标账本、验证者溯源记录、声明包三项具体设计建议。
AI.motivation: 自动科研系统（以 Karpathy 的 autoresearch、Nature 发表的 AI Scientist 为代表）已能内部完成"想法生成—实验执行—论文撰写—自评"的端到端闭环。当领域开始以"工作流完成度"和"基准分数"作为科研成功的代理指标时，一个危险的推论正在自然化：闭环即等价于科学成立。本文并非指责任何具体系统夸大，而是要指出这种结构性代理一旦被制度化，就会使系统持续优化"它能测量、验证和封装的东西"，而对科学成立所必需的外部条件（竞争目标、独立验证、领域采纳）暴露不足。作者希望在这一代理被自然化之前提醒社区，并说明这种坍塌是可纠正的设计选择而非自主性的固有极限。
AI.method: 方法上采用"综述+审计+设计建议"三段式：(1) 系统综述附录A，涵盖2025–2026年为主的100余篇论文与开源仓库，按基础模板、出版物形态端到端流水线、元层自改进、多智能体协作四大类梳理，并单独讨论技能系统、记忆系统、领域应用与边界系统；(2) 结构化审计表1/表2，对21个具有充分公开文档、可支撑完整L1/L2/L3编码的系统，按"Strong（完全由内部信号支配）/Weak（以边界内机制模拟外部介入）/Mitigated（真正外部操作被整合为循环有效性的约束条件）"三值编码规则判定，编码仅基于公开材料；(3) 立场性讨论部分界定诊断范围、反驳五类反对意见（工程里程碑论、基准可扩展性论、多样性即独立性论、科学一直依赖代理论、经典系统反例论），并把观测到的共现关系表述为"信息性不对称"而非因果证明或普遍性断言。
AI.result: 审计结果显示三层坍塌在结构上高度不对称：L1-strong 占81.0%（17/21），L2-strong 占71.4%（15/21），L3-strong 占90.5%（19/21）。即验收坍塌是补救最少的层（仅9.5%为weak），验证坍塌是补救尝试最多的层（28.6%为weak，多集中于跨模型评审、引用核验、留出对抗性检查等验证侧措施），目标坍塌居中（19.0%为weak，常见于反思式批判、多目标聚合、并行搜索等扩大决策前信息量的机制）。21个受审系统中无一在任一维度获得mitigated标签。边界对照案例显示，只要外部操作成为循环有效性的架构性组成部分，至少一层坍塌可被缓解：VML均衡半自主形式化（Lean 4验证器+在环数学家监督）缓解L1/L2，Latent-Y（湿实验验证）缓解L2，Robin（体外实验回路确认ripasudil与KL001）缓解L2，CRISPR-GPT（关键节点专家签署）亦为L2缓解路径。现有补救的两大共同缺陷是"未系统化"（逐系统各自定义、无通用协议）与"事后而非在环"（外部信号不进入主循环的纠正通道），且单维补救易被另两维的闭合结构重新吸收——加第二指标若验证仍在内部无效，加外部检查若不门控循环无效，加强基准若无外部批判通路亦无效。Zhang等人的实证发现（117篇智能体生成论文在纯稿件评审下达ICLR 2025加权均值水平，而在含产物的评审下分数骤降、实验严谨性为主要失效模式）与本文预测一致。作者亦审慎界定：本文不主张所有自动科研系统都存在坍塌，Coscientist、FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、ERA因云实验室/可执行评估等构成性外部约束而不属于该范式，Co-Scientist与Deep Research则属不同类别。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是：从工作流闭合推断科学闭合在结构上不成立。可信自动科研不应追求认识论上的自足，而应追求"非自主认识论控制下的自主执行"——保留自主执行能力，放弃认识论自足性，把循环从"闭合于自身"改为"经由世界闭合"。三项对应设计建议：(1) 目标信号设计上把多目标当作架构原语而非在决策时被聚合掉的对象，采用不可约目标的Pareto前沿并维护"目标账本"（记录待满足目标、各项证据、冲突权衡、冲突未决时的决策规则，如ML论文可分列预测性能/校准/鲁棒性/算力成本/可解释性/可复现性，生物医学可分列机制合理性/实验可行性/安全约束/临床相关性）；(2) 验证者设计上使外部验证既"架构上必需"又"在环内"，维护"验证者溯源记录"（谁/什么验证了哪个主张、与生产者的独立性关系、检查了什么证据、结果是否改变了后续搜索），同族LLM评审在未绑定外部约束时不得计为独立验证；(3) 输出通道设计上产出"声明包"而非仅论文形态产物，含原子主张、证据链、代码与数据溯源、失败案例、已知局限与敏感性、外部用户复现/质疑/扩展的路径，高利害领域还须包含"停止规则"（何时必须让位、请求外部评审或拒绝视其为已可被领域采纳）。最终元原则是：接受是一个过程而非一个分数。

title: UnityMAS-O: A General RL Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems decompose complex tasks into interacting roles, but most remain manually orchestrated by prompts, tools, and control rules, while agents are rarely optimized through a unified reinforcement learning interface. Existing RL post-training frameworks mainly target single-policy optimization and lack abstractions for user-defined multi-agent workflows, structured interaction, role-specific credit assignment, and configurable parameter sharing.
  We present UnityMAS-O, a general RL optimization framework for LLM-based multi-agent systems. UnityMAS-O treats the complete workflow as the optimization unit, rather than a single response or policy trajectory. It represents workflows through four first-class objects: logical agent roles, graph trajectories, user-defined rewards, and agent--model mappings. This decouples logical agents from physical model parameters, supporting full sharing, full separation, and partial sharing, with rewards assigned at role, turn, and trajectory levels.
  UnityMAS-O extends verl with a Ray-based star-topology runtime. A central controller executes workflows, invokes tools, records structured trajectories, and assembles rewards; model-local worker groups handle rollout, buffering, advantage computation, and distributed PPO-style updates. Users can define agents, workflows, model mappings, and rewards without rewriting the optimization infrastructure.
  We instantiate UnityMAS-O on retrieval-augmented QA, iterative agentic search, and reflective code generation. Across Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and held-out code tasks, multi-agent RL improves manually specified workflows after optimization, with especially large gains for smaller models and strict code all-passed metrics. These results show that UnityMAS-O can serve as a reusable substrate for converting diverse LLM-based multi-agent workflows into trainable multi-agent RL systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UnityMAS-O框架，通过RL优化LLM多智能体系统，将完整工作流作为优化单元而非单响应，支持逻辑角色与物理模型参数解耦，在多种任务上验证了多智能体RL优化人工指定工作流的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统依赖人工编排的提示词、工具和控制规则，缺乏统一RL优化接口；现有RL后训练框架主要针对单策略优化，缺少多智能体工作流抽象、角色级信用分配和可配置参数共享机制。
AI.method: 提出UnityMAS-O框架，将完整工作流作为优化单元，通过逻辑角色、图轨迹、用户定义奖励和智能体-模型映射四个一等对象表示工作流；扩展verl框架，采用Ray星型拓扑运行时架构。
AI.result: 在Natural Questions、HotpotQA和代码任务上，多智能体RL优化后性能提升，尤其是小模型和严格代码all-passed指标上增益显著。
AI.conclusion: UnityMAS-O可作为将多样化LLM多智能体工作流转化为可训练多智能体RL系统的可重用基础框架，在小模型和严格代码评估指标上效果尤为显著。

title: Lost in the Evidence? Reproducing Document Position and Context Size Effects in RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems rely on retrieved documents being concatenated into a model's input context, making both document ordering and context size critical yet controversial design choices. Prior work reports position-based effects such as lost in the middle and related long-context phenomena. However, empirical findings remain inconsistent and hard to reproduce across models, datasets, and evaluation protocols. In this paper, we present a systematic reproducibility study that revisits these claims and examines how they evolve with contemporary LLMs under a controlled evaluation framework. We first show that topic sampling is a major source of variance: small topic sets can mask or exaggerate ordering effects. Based on repeated subset sampling across multiple topic budgets, we provide a practical calibration procedure that identifies topic counts yielding stable trends at feasible cost. Using these fixed topic sets, we then reproduce and extend results on position sensitivity, re-evaluating lost in the middle and positional biases in modern LLMs. Then, we also study a more realistic RAG scenario in which relevance is mediated by a retriever rather than oracle access to ground-truth documents. In this setting, we re-examine a recent industry study and identify discrepancies to evaluation choices such as limited topic coverage and reliance on LLM-based judges. Finally, we conduct an analysis of how retrieval order and context size affect downstream LLM performance under imperfect retrieval. Our results demonstrate that both factors interact strongly with retrieval quality and model choice, and that conclusions drawn from idealised setups do not always transfer to real-world RAG pipelines. We release all code and configurations to support reproducibility and future work on robust RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究对RAG系统中的文档排序和上下文大小效应进行了系统性可复现性研究，发现主题采样是方差的主要来源，并证明理想化实验设置中的结论不一定能迁移到现实世界的RAG流程中。
AI.motivation: Prior work on position-based effects (e.g., "lost in the middle") in RAG systems shows inconsistent and hard-to-reproduce findings across models, datasets, and evaluation protocols.
AI.method: Controlled reproducibility study: (1) repeated subset sampling across multiple topic budgets for calibration; (2) fixed topic sets for reproducing position sensitivity results; (3) realistic RAG evaluation with retriever-mediated relevance vs oracle access; (4) analysis of retrieval order and context size effects under imperfect retrieval conditions.
AI.result: Topic sampling is a major source of variance; small topic sets can mask or exaggerate ordering effects. Conclusions from idealised setups do not always transfer to real-world RAG pipelines. Both retrieval order and context size interact strongly with retrieval quality and model choice.
AI.conclusion: Released code and configurations for reproducibility and future robust RAG evaluation work.

title: A Formal Semantics of C with OpenMP Parallelism
summary: OpenMP is a popular parallelization framework that lets users transform sequential code into parallel code with a few simple annotations. Unfortunately, it is also easy to inadvertently introduce errors by adding OpenMP pragmas into otherwise correct programs, including both logic errors and race conditions. We present a formal semantics for C code with OpenMP directives, building on the C semantics of the CompCert verified compiler and its extension to concurrency. Our semantics captures subtle interactions between OpenMP directives and variable state that have been obscured by previous OpenMP semantics, and provides a basis for detecting undesired behaviors introduced by incorrect annotations: in particular, any successful execution is guaranteed to be free of data races.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a formal semantics for C code with OpenMP directives, built on CompCert's verified compiler, to detect errors introduced by incorrect OpenMP pragmas and guarantee data race freedom.
AI.motivation: OpenMP pragmas can easily introduce logic errors and race conditions into otherwise correct programs, and existing OpenMP semantics have obscured subtle interactions between directives and variable state.
AI.method: Built on the C semantics of the CompCert verified compiler and its extension to concurrency to create a formal semantics capturing subtle interactions between OpenMP directives and variable state.
AI.result: A formal semantics that captures subtle interactions previously obscured, providing a foundation for detecting both logic errors and race conditions introduced by incorrect OpenMP annotations.
AI.conclusion: Provides a basis for detecting undesired behaviors introduced by incorrect annotations, guaranteeing successful executions are free of data races.

title: JobBench: Aligning Agent Work With Human Will
summary: Current benchmarks for occupational AI agents are scoped primarily by economic values, telling a replacement story. We introduce JobBench, which evaluates AI agents on the workflows that experts identify as high-priority for delegation, empowering humans based on their needs instead of replacing them with GDP value. JobBench covers 130 agentic tasks across 35 occupations. Each task is packaged as a workspace of heterogeneous reference files, requiring the agent to reason through the cluttered information streams of real professional work. Outputs are graded by a fact-anchored chain of rubrics, averaging 35.6 binary criteria per task. We evaluate 36 models; the strongest, Claude Opus~4.7 under Claude Code, reaches only 45.9 %. We hope JobBench shifts the community's target labour-market effect from replacement to enhancement: building agents that do what humans actually want delegated, not only what is most economically valuable.

AI.tldr: JobBench introduces a human-centered benchmark for occupational AI agents, evaluating 130 tasks across 35 occupations on what humans actually want delegated rather than economic value.
