Current state-of-the-art models achieve only 45.9% accuracy, highlighting the need to shift AI development from replacement to enhancement focus.
AI.motivation: Existing occupational AI benchmarks are narrowly scoped by economic values, framing AI as a human replacement rather than an enhancement tool. This replacement-centric framing misaligns with what humans actually want to delegate. The authors argue for a needs-based evaluation paradigm that empowers humans.
AI.method: JobBench evaluates AI agents on 130 agentic tasks across 35 occupations. Tasks are presented as realistic workspaces with heterogeneous reference files requiring agents to navigate cluttered professional information. Evaluation uses fact-anchored rubric chains averaging 35.6 binary criteria per task. 36 models were tested.
AI.result: The strongest model, Claude Opus 4.7 under Claude Code, achieves only 45.9% accuracy, indicating significant room for improvement in professional workflow automation.
AI.conclusion: JobBench provides a more human-centered evaluation framework for occupational AI agents. The benchmark demonstrates that current AI systems are still far from human-level performance in real professional workflows (45.9% accuracy). The authors advocate for shifting AI development priorities from replacement-focused economic metrics to enhancement-focused delegation preferences.

title: Memory Architectures for Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables; includes appendices with verbatim prompts, example session, and full ablation tables; prepared by the LLM Suite Engineering Team, JP Morgan Chase & Co
summary: Multi-turn Text-to-SQL is central to enterprise analytics yet remains predominantly evaluated in single-turn settings. We introduce EnterpriseMem-Bench, a multi-turn Text-to-SQL benchmark of 300 sessions and 1,400 turns built programmatically from three enterprise domains (BIRD financial, SEC EDGAR, Northwind), with deterministic ground truth and per-turn memory-critical annotation. We evaluate five frontier models -- GPT-5 mini, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.6 -- across five memory conditions enabling a three-way ablation isolating working-memory window size, episodic retrieval, and semantic augmentation as independent effects. All Claude models are evaluated with extended thinking enabled to maintain parity with GPT reasoning models. We introduce the Memory Benefit Score (MBS) as a per-turn diagnostic metric. Four findings emerge: (1) stateless multi-turn Text-to-SQL collapses to zero execution accuracy by Turn 3 across all five models, even under reasoning; (2) memory-architecture complexity does not monotonically improve accuracy -- working memory dominates, and additional components produce model- and dataset-dependent effects from +14 to -16 percentage points; (3) Claude Sonnet 4.6 underperforms Sonnet 4.5 by 17-33pp on SEC EDGAR across conditions, a generational regression persisting under reasoning; (4) under reasoning, Claude error distributions become mono-modal -- every non-correct turn is a wrong-result error. We release the benchmark, agent, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces EnterpriseMem-Bench, a multi-turn Text-to-SQL benchmark of 300 sessions and 1,400 turns for evaluating memory architecture effects on SQL generation. Through ablation of working-memory window, episodic retrieval, and semantic augmentation across 5 frontier models, the study finds that stateless approaches fail by Turn 3, working memory dominates performance, and additional memory components produce non-monotonic effects. Notably, Claude Sonnet 4.6 shows a significant regression from 4.5 on SEC EDGAR data.
AI.motivation: Multi-turn Text-to-SQL is critical for enterprise analytics but has been evaluated predominantly in single-turn settings, creating a significant gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment conditions. The lack of systematic study on how different memory architectures affect multi-turn SQL generation in enterprise contexts motivates this benchmark development.
AI.method: Programmatic benchmark construction from three enterprise domains (BIRD financial, SEC EDGAR, Northwind) generating 300 sessions and 1,400 turns with deterministic ground truth. Three-way ablation isolating working-memory window size, episodic retrieval, and semantic augmentation as independent effects. Evaluation of 5 frontier models (GPT-5 mini, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6, Opus 4.6) across 5 memory conditions with per-turn Memory Benefit Score (MBS) diagnostic.
AI.result: Stateless approaches collapse to zero execution accuracy by Turn 3 across all models. Working memory is the dominant memory component, and adding more complex components (episodic retrieval, semantic augmentation) produces non-monotonic, model- and dataset-dependent effects ranging from +14 to -16 percentage points. Claude Sonnet 4.6 shows a 17-33pp regression compared to Sonnet 4.5 on SEC EDGAR. Under reasoning, Claude models exhibit mono-modal error distributions with all errors being wrong-result errors.
AI.conclusion: The study conclusively demonstrates that stateless approaches are fundamentally inadequate for multi-turn Text-to-SQL by Turn 3, that working memory is the dominant component (not additive complexity), and reveals a concerning Claude Sonnet 4.6 regression. The findings argue for task-specific memory architecture rather than one-size-fits-all solutions, with practical implications for deploying enterprise analytics systems.

title: ARBITER: Reasoning Trajectory Basins and Majority Vote Failures in Test-Time Sampling
summary: When language models use test-time sampling, they generate multiple reasoning trajectories and select an answer by majority vote. We show that these trajectories are not independent: for a given question, they concentrate into a small number of clusters, or reasoning basins, each defined by a normalized final answer and the solutions that reach it. A majority vote therefore selects the most stable basin rather than the most accurate one, which creates wrong-majority failures where the correct answer is present but outvoted. We introduce ARBITER, a model-agnostic approach that models interactions between basins using only the base model's own sampled outputs, hidden states, and derived evidence. Most direct correction strategies fail; ARBITER instead uses conservative additive evidence on top of consensus. In its simplest parameter-free form, ARBITER-Δ adds same-model evidence to the majority prior, while ARBITER-Enc augments this with bounded residual signals from hidden states over complete solutions. On GSM8K with Qwen3-4B, consensus over K=24 samples achieves around the mid-94% range, while a same-pool top-2 oracle reaches around the mid-96% range. ARBITER recovers a subset of these cases using zero external information. Across three model families and three math benchmarks, it yields consistent gains with no net-negative cases; for example, on Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math, it improves accuracy from the mid-78% range to the mid-82% range, recovering about 22% of the available oracle headroom, indicating that this headroom can be partially recovered from the sample pool itself.

AI.tldr: ARBITER 指出测试时采样的多条推理轨迹并非独立，而是聚集成少数「推理盆地」（按归一化最终答案聚类）；多数投票本质上只是在选最稳定的盆地而非最正确的盆地，因而存在「错多数」失败（正确答案已在样本池中却被更大错误盆地压制）。作者提出模型无关的 ARBITER 后共识仲裁框架：保持共识为先验，仅当同模型证据累积到足以支持挑战者盆地时才做稀疏覆盖。其参数无关形式 ARBITER-Δ 用对数比形式把原始多数票先验与「framed-pool」「frame-guided」两类同模型证据相加（带无标签可靠性收缩），ARBITER-Enc 再叠加有界的隐状态残差。3 个模型族 × 3 个数学基准上 9/9 格子的计数级净变化非负、8 格准确率上升（如 Llama-3.1-8B 平均 +1.77pp，MATH-500 +3.00pp；总计 168 次覆盖、78 次纠错、35 次退化）。核心教训：结构不等于真相，后共识恢复必须保守、稀疏、可审计。
AI.motivation: 测试时采样（self-consistency / 多数投票）已是强基线，但其失败模式未被系统刻画：采样轨迹会因最终答案一致而聚成少数「答案盆地」，多数投票等价于「主导盆地选择器」，当主导盆地错误而正确挑战盆地已存在时即产生「错多数」失败（wrong-majority）。同池 top-k oracle 显示这部分可恢复空间不小（如 Qwen3-4B GSM8K：共识 94.54%，top-2 oracle 97.27%，top-3 97.88%）。但作者的大量实验表明，直接替换/全局纠错（自审、隐状态重排、轨迹连贯性打分、图路由 GNN、framing-first 替换、直接 panel/guided 替换）都会劣化强共识基线：模型内部信号更多反映「稳定性/承诺/风险」而非「正确性」。因此需要一个保守、可审计的后共识仲裁机制，同时不引入外部验证器、工具或金标。
AI.method:
问题设定：冻结模型 M、零外部信息，仅用自身采样输出、隐状态与派生证据；金标仅用于事后评估。定义候选解 s_i、隐状态轨迹 H_i、归一化答案 a_i、排名簇 C_r、答案盆地 B_r=(α_r, C_r, 轨迹集合)，主导盆地 B_1 与挑战盆地 B_r；定义 Oracle@k（诊断上界）、错多数指示 WM、净恢复 ΔAcc = 恢复率 − 退化率。

推理流水线（采样 → 聚类 → 描述 → 收集证据 → 加证据）：对每题采样 K=24 条普通解，按任务特定归一化的最终答案聚类，B_1 为共识先验；随后同一冻结模型生成三类辅助证据：①「frame」一句话盆地语义解释（目标量、实体、单位、运算模式）；②framed-pool solve（先陈述解释再求解，24 次）；③panel trial（并列展示两个盆地解释后重新求解，仅用于消融，含顺序交换与对称性因子 ρ_P,r）；④guided re-solve（给一个解释为假设并重新推导，约 4 次）。所有输出解析回已观测盆地；越界或无效输出不计入任一侧但降低该源可靠性。

核心规则 ARBITER-Δ（参数无关，仅 top-2 对）：Δ_2(q)=log((b_2+α)/(b_1+α)) + r_f(q)·log((f_2+α)/(f_1+α)) + r_g(q)·log((g_2+α)/(g_1+α))，其中 α=1 为固定 Laplace 伪计数，r_f=(f_1+f_2)/N_F^att、r_g=(g_1+g_2)/N_G^att 为无标签可靠性收缩（top-2 质量），仅当 Δ_2>0 时翻转选择，否则保留共识。附录 C 证明该式等价于对数线性源池化 log(w̃_2/w̃_1)，w̃_j=(b_j+α)(f_j+α)^{r_f}(g_j+α)^{r_g}；其贝叶斯动机是「对数比可加」，但刻意不随辅助试验数线性放大，以避免同源相关错误被重复计数。

ARBITER-Enc（可选残差，非主要主张）：置换不变轨迹聚合器 A_θ 汇聚盆地内隐状态轨迹输出有符号残差 e_θ,r 与可选权限头 γ_θ,r∈[0,1]，Δ^Enc_r = Δ_r + λ·γ·clip(e, −c, c)，保证残差保守、不能压过手工 Δ 规则；训练目标是用留出证据（如预测 panel/guided 的证据对数比 δ_o,r）的 Huber 损失，而非预测金标正确性，权限头只学证据可靠性。

评估：Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Phi-4 × GSM8K(1319)、MMLU-HS-Math(270)、MATH-500(500)；基线为同 run 族 raw consensus；指标含准确率与「覆盖/恢复/退化/净」分解，并报告证据预算（K=24 raw + 24 framed + 4 guided，panel 消融约 12）。
AI.result:
1) 共识与 oracle：raw consensus 在 9 格中 7 格优于 greedy、1 格持平、1 格低于（Qwen3-4B MATH-500：greedy 71.40% vs 共识 69.20%，但 oracle 仍更高）；top-2/top-3 oracle 显示可观可恢复空间。GSM8K 上 K=56 纯采样未优于 K=24（三模型分别 −0.15/0.00/−0.38pp），说明增益并非来自多采样。

2) 负向阶梯：广域自审（94.69%→93.10%）、top-up 合并投票（94.77%→94.24%）、原始轨迹复审（70.87% vs 76.96%）、答案备忘复审（63–66.5% vs 74.71%）、盆地原理裁决（净 −5，无护栏 −22）、原轨迹编码器做纠错（净 −46，362 个候选仅 5 个救回）、Cluster-GNN/router（各预算均净负）、framing-first 替换（风格/温度变体降到 94.31%/93.71%）、直接 panel/guided 替换（净 −170/−115）均失败；仅「答案可见的难切片二轮复审」为切片级正向（64.71%→70.59%）。

3) 主结果 ARBITER-Δ（固定 framed+guided、无调参）：9 格计数级净变化全部非负（8 正 1 中性），准确率 8 格上升。Llama-3.1-8B：GSM8K 91.81→92.65(+0.84, 35/20/9)、MMLU-HS-Math 78.52→80.00(+1.48, 17/9/5)、MATH-500 51.60→54.60(+3.00, 44/19/4)，均值 +1.77；Qwen3-4B：94.54→94.84(+0.30)、94.81→95.19(+0.37)、69.20→69.20(0)，均值 +0.23；Phi-4：96.13→96.44(+0.31)、92.59→93.70(+1.11)、73.00→73.20(+0.20)，均值 +0.54。全矩阵共 168 次覆盖、78 恢复、35 退化，净 +43。增益最大处正是共识头room 最大处。摘要另称 Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math 由约 78% 提升至约 82%、恢复约 22% oracle 头room，与表 2 中 80.00% 的数值略有出入。

4) 消融：panel+guided(mass+order) 在 Qwen GSM8K 达 95.00%（净 +6）；答案可见的 panel 面板在可见/隐藏两栏均更优（95.00% vs 94.84%）。

5) ARBITER-Enc：固定（无调参）残差额外增益 −0.1~+0.5pp，近零到微弱，主要作用是抑制退化翻转、识别噪声 framing；校准版（用带标签验证集）额外 +0.8~+1.5pp，但不再满足严格零外部信息设定。

6) 种子复现（Qwen3-4B GSM8K 源集诊断，三种子）：共识 94.52±0.27 → 95.02±0.12，增益 +0.51±0.16pp，净 +6.7±2.1。

7) 计算代价：非编码器 ARBITER-Δ 单个 GSM8K 单元约 8–12+ 小时（H100，vLLM 批推理）；隐状态编码器实验因教师强制抽取隐状态需数天。
AI.conclusion: 主要结论有三层：(a) 现象层面，测试时采样的轨迹在答案空间聚成少数「推理盆地」，多数投票是稳定性选择器而非准确性选择器，故存在正确解已在池中却被压制的「错多数」失败，且这部分头room 可在无外部信息下部分回收（示例：约 22% 量级 oracle 头room 可被回收）。(b) 方法层面，ARBITER 以「共识为先验、同模型证据加性叠加、稀疏高精度覆盖」为原则的参数无关仲裁器，Δ 规则在 3×3 矩阵上计数级净变化非负、8 格准确率提升，并给出 recovered/degraded 分解以保证可审计；隐状态编码器仅作有界残差与诊断工具（Basin Story Graph、轨迹 kNN 图）。(c) 更广的方法论教训：「结构不等于真相」——稳定性、连贯性、图结构识别的是承诺与风险而非正确性；广域替换策略常修复少于破坏；可靠的后共识恢复必须是保守的加性证据加显式纠错/退化核算。局限：额外证据开销（不作等算力宣称）、不同 run 族基线不可直接横比、同源证据可能重复计数（尚未建模依赖）、校准编码器破坏零外部信息设定、仅覆盖三个中等规模冻结指令模型与三个数学基准（前沿模型、非数学任务、难等价判定待做）、主策略多种子复现不足、结果依赖答案抽取与符号等价规则。

title: Grounding Text Embeddings in Stakeholder Associations
summary: Text embeddings are widely used to analyse large corpora of complex texts. However, it is unclear whether the embeddings capture the same semantic distances as the human experts using them. Ensuring alignment between embedding representations and human intentions is essential for valid analyses. We present the Stakeholder Grounding Exercise, a method for making expert associations explicit and grounding embedding model results in human understanding. In our primary case study on Danish policy issues, we find that neural text embeddings are substantially less reliable than human experts (19-26 pp gap), and that this misalignment propagates to downstream clustering performance (Spearman $ρ=0.9$ between exercise ranking and cluster quality). A secondary study on US Federal AI use cases replicates the gap (16pp) in English, using a digital protocol and a different community of experts -- demonstrating that the gap is not an artefact of a single instrument or domain. The Stakeholder Grounding Exercise offers a practical method for assessing whether embedding models capture the semantic distinctions that matter most to domain experts.

AI.tldr: Neural text embeddings are significantly less reliable than human experts (19-26pp gap) in capturing semantic distances relevant to domain experts, and this misalignment affects downstream analyses like clustering. The Stakeholder Grounding Exercise provides a practical method to assess embedding validity across different domains and expert communities.
AI.motivation: Text embeddings are widely used to analyze large corpora, but it is unclear whether they capture the same semantic distances as human experts. Ensuring alignment between embedding representations and human intentions is essential for valid analyses.
AI.method: The authors developed the Stakeholder Grounding Exercise to make expert associations explicit and ground embedding model results in human understanding. Two studies were conducted: a primary case study on Danish policy issues and a secondary study on US Federal AI use cases with a digital protocol and different expert community.
AI.result: Neural text embeddings were substantially less reliable than human experts (19-26 percentage point gap). This misalignment propagated to downstream clustering performance (Spearman ρ=0.9 between exercise ranking and cluster quality). The secondary US study replicated the gap (16pp) in English, confirming the gap is not an artefact of a single instrument or domain.
AI.conclusion: The Stakeholder Grounding Exercise is a practical method for assessing whether embedding models capture the semantic distinctions that matter to domain experts. It helps ensure validity in text embedding analyses.

title: Verus-SpecGym: An Agentic Environment for Evaluating Specification Autoformalization
summary: AI coding agents are increasingly used to write real-world software, but ensuring that their outputs are correct remains a fundamental challenge. Formal verification offers a promising path: an agent generates code together with a machine-checked proof, guaranteeing that the code satisfies a formal specification. However, there is no guarantee that the formal spec itself matches the user's intent. In this work, we study specification autoformalization: whether LLM agents can translate informal programming problems into faithful formal specifications. We introduce Verus-SpecBench, a benchmark of 581 spec-writing tasks derived from Codeforces problems targeting Verus, a verifier for Rust, and Verus-SpecGym, an agentic environment in which models interact with Verus, bash, & the filesystem to develop these specs. The central challenge is evaluation: expert-written reference specs are expensive to write, & LLM judges can miss subtle mistakes. We address this by (a) extending Verus's exec_spec mechanism so that generated specs can be executed as Rust code, & (b) testing them against official Codeforces tests & adversarial cases extracted from Codeforces "hacks", which are edge cases written by competitors to break incorrect solutions. On Verus-SpecBench, the strongest model, Gemini 3.1 Pro, solves 77.8% of tasks, other frontier models solve 51.1--57.8% & OSS models reach only 21.5--25.5%. Our analysis of failure modes shows that model-generated specs can omit important input assumptions, accept incorrect outputs, & reject valid ones. We also find that LLM-as-a-judge evaluation misses 26% of the failures our evaluator catches. Overall, our results suggest that spec autoformalization is within reach for frontier agents but remains brittle even on problems where they can already generate correct code. The code, data, & logs can be found at https://github.com/formal-verif-is-cool/verus-spec-gym

AI.tldr: 本文研究规范自动形式化问题，即LLM智能体能否将非形式化编程问题转化为忠实形式规范。提出Verus-SpecBench（581个任务）和Verus-SpecGym环境，通过exec_spec机制实现自动化评估。Gemini 3.1 Pro达77.8%准确率，开源模型仅21-25%。研究表明前沿模型的规范生成能力已可实用，但在边缘情况和评判机制上仍存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体虽能生成带形式化证明的代码，但形式化规范本身可能偏离用户意图。规范自动形式化(spec autoformalization)——将非形式化编程问题转化为忠实的形式化规范——缺乏系统性研究，主要瓶颈在于评估困难：专家编写参考规范成本高，LLM评判可能遗漏细微错误。
AI.method: (1) 构建Verus-SpecBench基准：581个源自Codeforces问题的规范编写任务，基于Rust验证器Verus；(2) 开发Verus-SpecGym智能体环境，支持模型与Verus、bash及文件系统交互；(3) 扩展Verus的exec_spec机制使生成的规范可作为Rust代码执行；(4) 利用官方Codeforces测试用例及"hacks"对抗性用例进行自动化评估，规避依赖专家参考规范和高成本LLM评判的问题。
AI.result: Gemini 3.1 Pro解决77.8%任务，其他前沿模型51.1-57.8%，开源模型仅21.5-25.5%。失败模式包括：遗漏关键输入假设、接受错误输出、拒绝正确输出。LLM评判机制会遗漏评估器捕获的26%失败案例。
AI.conclusion:
Spec autoformalization对于前沿模型已可实现（Gemini 3.1 Pro达77.8%），但对开源模型仍有较大差距（21.5-25.5%）。生成的规范存在遗漏输入假设、接受错误输出、拒绝正确输出等问题，且LLM评判机制会遗漏26%的失败案例，表明该任务在模型已能生成正确代码的问题上仍具脆弱性。

Code: https://github.com/formal-verif-is-cool/verus-spec-gym

title: QUACK: Questioning, Understanding, and Auditing Communicated Knowledge in Multimodal Social Deduction Agents
summary: Social deduction games have become a popular testbed for probing reasoning, deception, coordination, and belief modeling in Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, most environments are scored only by game outcomes such as win rates and largely remain to text-only interaction, making it difficult to tell whether an agent's language is actually grounded in what it perceived and did, or to identify the failure modes underlying its behavior. To address this gap, we introduce QUACK, an open-source environment and evaluation framework for auditing the grounding of agent language in multimodal social reasoning. QUACK evaluates agents at three levels: game outcomes, behavioral trajectories, and utterance-level consistency. Its core Statement Verification Pipeline reconstructs each agent's ground-truth trajectory from engine logs and checks every discussion claim against it, automatically flagging spatial hallucination, unsupported accusation, deception collapse, and language-action inconsistency. Evaluating three frontier VLMs in both homogeneous and cross-model adversarial settings, we find that even the strongest agent hallucinates 15.1% of its verifiable spatial claims and makes over half of its accusations without grounded evidence. We release the full engine, evaluation framework, toolkit, and logs at https://github.com/AAAAA-Academia-Attractions/QUACK.

AI.tldr: QUACK是一个用于评估多模态大型语言模型（VLM）智能体在社交推理游戏中语言与感知/行为一致性的开源框架。该框架通过重建智能体的真实轨迹并验证其陈述，发现即使最强的模型也会产生15.1%的空间幻觉，并使超过一半的指控缺乏证据支撑。
AI.motivation: 现有社交推理游戏测试平台（如狼人杀）仅以胜负结果评分，且多为纯文本交互，无法判断智能体的语言是否真正基于其感知和行为。这一缺陷阻碍了对模型幻觉、欺骗失败和语言-行为不一致等问题的深入诊断。
AI.method: 提出Statement Verification Pipeline核心机制，从游戏引擎日志中重建智能体的真实轨迹，并自动将每条讨论陈述与重建轨迹进行比对验证。评估在三个层级展开：游戏结果、行为轨迹、语句级一致性，并涵盖同构和跨模型对抗两种设置。
AI.result: 三大前沿VLM均表现不佳：最强智能体在可验证的空间陈述中产生15.1%的幻觉，超过50%的指控缺乏证据支撑。
AI.conclusion: QUACK揭示了当前VLM智能体在多模态社交推理中语言接地（grounding）的系统性缺陷，为未来多模态推理系统的可靠评估提供了标准化基准和开源工具链。

title: Rethinking Agentic RAG: Toward LLM-Driven Logical Retrieval Beyond Embeddings
summary: Recent advances in RAG have shifted toward an agentic paradigm, where LLMs interact with retrieval systems over multiple turns and iteratively refine queries based on intermediate results. At the same time, LLMs have demonstrated a strong ability to construct structured queries that precisely express their information needs. However, contemporary RAG systems remain heavily focused on engineering complex retrieval backends, including dense, hybrid, and graph-based retrieval architectures. In this study, we argue that agentic RAG should delegate greater control to the LLM to steer the retrieval process, while relying on a lightweight retrieval interface that provides fine-grained control and faithfully executes the LLM's structured intent. Guided by this principle, we propose an agentic RAG framework that enables LLMs to formulate retrieval intents using logical expressions while simplifying the retrieval backend to an inverted-index-based system. Extensive experiments show that our framework matches a strong agentic hybrid baseline, while substantially reducing construction and serving cost. Moreover, we show that anchoring the retrieval process in logical queries substantially reduces hallucinations in generated responses.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将控制权更多委托给LLM来主导检索过程，采用轻量级倒排索引后端替代复杂检索架构的Agentic RAG框架，实现成本降低和幻觉减少。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统过度关注检索后端工程（如稠密检索、混合检索、图检索等复杂架构），而忽视了让LLM主导检索过程的重要性。作者认为应该将更多控制权交给LLM，同时使用提供细粒度控制的轻量级检索接口。
AI.method: 提出AgentChain框架，让LLM通过逻辑表达式表达检索意图，后端采用轻量级的倒排索引系统。LLM能够多轮交互地迭代优化查询，根据中间结果调整检索策略。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在性能上与强大的Agentic混合检索基线相当，同时大幅降低了构建和服务成本。此外，基于逻辑查询锚定检索过程显著减少了生成响应中的幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将检索控制权交给LLM，同时简化后端架构，实现了性能与效率的良好平衡。这一研究为Agentic RAG系统设计提供了新思路，强调简洁的检索接口配合智能的查询控制可能比复杂的检索后端更为有效。

title: Reducing Internal State in Eigenvalue-Only Divide-and-Conquer Tridiagonal Eigensolvers
summary: Divide and Conquer (D&C) is a widely used algorithmic strategy for symmetric eigenvalue decomposition. Its natural parallelism makes D&C attractive on modern multicore CPUs and GPUs, but existing eigenvalue-only routines often default to QR-based methods because conventional D&C still materializes or replays large transformation matrices during the conquer phase. This paper proposes a boundary-row D&C algorithm for eigenvalue-only computation. The key observation is that the conquer phase only needs selected boundary rows/columns rather than the full accumulated eigenvector matrix. By propagating these boundary rows directly through the recursion, the proposed algorithm reduces the memory requirement from quadratic to linear space while also eliminating unnecessary matrix-vector work in the conventional lazy-replay formulation. We provide the algorithm, its time and space complexity analysis, correctness and stability arguments, optimized CPU and GPU implementations, and an evaluation against QR and D&C routines in standard numerical libraries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对对称特征值分解中的Divide and Conquer算法内存瓶颈问题，提出边界行D&C算法。通过观察到征服阶段仅需边界行/列而非完整特征向量矩阵，递归传播边界行，将空间复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n)，同时减少计算量。该方法兼具理论保证（正确性/稳定性证明）和实用价值（优化CPU/GPU实现），在性能和内存效率上优于现有QR和D&C方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的Divide and Conquer算法在对称特征值分解中存在一个问题：征服阶段需要实例化或重放大型变换矩阵（即完整的特征向量矩阵），导致内存占用高且计算冗余。虽然D&C天然具有并行性，在现代多核CPU和GPU上很有吸引力，但现有特征值专用例程仍倾向于使用QR方法。
AI.method: 提出边界行D&C（Boundary-row Divide and Conquer）算法。核心创新在于：征服阶段仅需矩阵边界行/列而非完整的特征向量矩阵，通过递归直接传播边界行，将内存复杂度从二次降至线性，同时消除传统延迟重放方式中的不必要矩阵-向量运算。提供了算法的正确性和稳定性证明，并实现了优化的CPU和GPU版本。
AI.result: 内存需求从二次降低到线性；消除了传统延迟重放中的不必要矩阵-向量运算；在标准数值库的QR和D&C例程上取得性能提升；GPU实现相比现有方法也有显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过理论分析和大量实验验证了该方法的有效性，在保持数值稳定性的同时，显著降低了计算和存储开销。

title: Managing Uncertainty in LLM-Generated Procedural Knowledge for Virtual Laboratory Planning
summary: Educational virtual laboratories can make experimental training more scala-ble, adaptive, and accessible, especially when students have limited access to physical laboratory facilities. However, authoring new simulated laboratory procedures remains costly: educators must describe new equipment, define how instruments and materials interact, and specify valid procedural flows that can be executed or assessed inside the virtual environment. Large lan-guage models can assist in this authoring process by generating detailed ex-perimental procedures, but their output should not be treated as directly exe-cutable plans. They may omit necessary actions, arrange steps in the wrong order, or produce instructions that are logically incorrect or incompatible with the laboratory equipment. This paper presents a prototype framework for managing uncertainty in LLM-generated procedural knowledge for virtu-al laboratory planning. The framework aims to reduce procedural uncertainty by using structured domain representations and uncertain LLM-generated state-transition samples to extract candidate procedural rules, transform them into explicit and inspectable constraints, and use them to repair uncertain procedural steps. Although the motivating domain refers to educational vir-tual laboratories, the underlying problem is more general: managing uncer-tain procedural knowledge for action planning in structured interactive envi-ronments. We illustrate the approach in a virtual laboratory domain involving laboratory instruments, containers, tools, and material-transfer actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个管理 LLM 生成虚拟实验室程序性知识不确定性的框架，通过结构化领域表示与状态转换样本提取候选规则，转化为显式约束以修复不确定步骤。
AI.motivation: 教育虚拟实验室可提升实验训练的可扩展性、适应性和可及性，但创作新的模拟实验程序成本高昂——教育者需描述设备、定义交互方式、指定执行流程。LLM 可辅助生成实验程序，但其输出不能直接作为执行计划，可能遗漏必要动作、步骤顺序错误或产生逻辑错误/设备不兼容的指令。
AI.method: 使用结构化领域表示和不确定的 LLM 生成状态转换样本，通过以下流程处理：(1) 提取候选程序规则；(2) 转换为显式可检验的约束；(3) 利用约束修复不确定的程序步骤。
AI.result: 提出一个管理 LLM 生成程序性知识不确定性的原型框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架虽源于教育虚拟实验室场景，但可泛化至结构化交互环境中的动作规划问题，为不确定性 procedural knowledge 管理提供了通用解决方案。

title: Annotator Positionality as Signal: Psychometric Weighting for Anti-Autistic Ableism Detection
comment: main paper: 8 pages; total: 18 pages; 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in decision-making tasks where they can amplify or suppress perspectives, raising concerns in high-stakes settings affecting autistic communities. While previous research has identified disability-related biases in LLMs, it remains unclear how they conceptualize ableism or detect it in text. We introduce a bias-aware evaluation framework targeting anti-autistic ableist language with a psychometrically-weighted, community-proximate ground truth anchored in annotator positionality. This framework constitutes a stricter standard than conventional majority-vote aggregation which significantly and consistently underweights autistic and autism-accepting perspectives. We find that LLMs frequently produce harmful outputs, mislabel community-reclaimed language as ableist, and express more negative attitudes toward autistic people when assessment instruments are masked. Our error analysis reveals that models rely on surface-level keyword matching rather than contextual factors such as speaker identity, and whether the language fosters in-group solidarity or inflicts out-group harm.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种考虑社区立场的反自闭症歧视语言评估框架，发现主流大语言模型在检测歧视性语言时存在严重问题：常产生有害输出、误标 reclaimed language 为歧视性语言，且依赖表层关键词匹配而非语境理解，导致无法区分社区内部 solidarity language 与 out-group harm 语言。
AI.motivation: While prior research has documented disability-related biases in LLMs, there is limited understanding of how these models conceptualize ableism or detect it in text. This gap is particularly concerning given LLMs' increasing deployment in decision-making contexts affecting autistic communities, where biased outputs can have significant real-world consequences.
AI.method: The authors developed a bias-aware evaluation framework specifically targeting anti-autistic ableist language detection. This framework employs psychometrically-weighted ground truth that accounts for annotator positionality, providing a more rigorous standard than conventional majority-vote aggregation approaches. They evaluated multiple LLMs on their ability to identify and respond to ableist language, with additional experiments involving masked assessment instruments to test model attitudes.
AI.result: LLMs frequently produce harmful outputs when processing ableist language. Models consistently mislabel community-reclaimed language as ableist and express significantly more negative attitudes toward autistic people when assessment instruments are masked. Error analysis reveals models rely on surface-level keyword matching rather than contextual factors such as speaker identity or whether language fosters in-group solidarity versus inflicts out-group harm.
AI.conclusion: LLMs inadequately understand and detect ableist language, frequently generating harmful outputs and misidentifying community-reclaimed terms. The root issue is reliance on superficial keyword matching rather than contextual understanding of speaker identity, solidarity dynamics, and harm differentiation. Future research should focus on developing context-aware detection systems that incorporate community-informed perspectives and address the limitation of majority-vote annotation methods.

title: InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion within that range. Guided by this analysis, we propose InfoQuant, a train-free method that employs Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation (PSOT) to shape activations into more quantization-friendly distributions. We further introduce adaptive outlier-token selection to improve the robustness of PSOT during optimization. Across multiple LLM families, InfoQuant consistently outperforms prior PTQ and end-to-end training baselines. Under W4A4KV4, it preserves 97% of floating-point accuracy on average and reduces the LLaMA-2 13B performance gap by 42% over the previous state of the art. Code is available at [https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant](https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant)

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论角度分析量化误差，指出量化友好的激活值应同时具有较小数值范围和足够分散性。基于此提出InfoQuant方法，通过峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）优化激活分布，配合自适应异常值令牌选择提升鲁棒性，在多个LLM上实现SOTA。
AI.motivation: 低比特激活量化是大语言模型高效部署的主要瓶颈，原因不仅是激活值包含异常值，更重要的是其分布与低比特均匀量化器不匹配。现有后训练量化方法抑制峰值、平衡通道或最小化重构误差，但未明确指定何种激活分布易于离散化，导致激活值表面看起来更平滑但量化误差仍然较大。
AI.method: 提出InfoQuant方法，采用峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）将激活值塑造成量化友好分布，并引入自适应异常值令牌选择以提高PSOT优化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族上，InfoQuant一致优于之前的后训练量化（PTQ）和端到端训练基线方法。在W4A4KV4配置下，平均保留97%浮点精度，将LLaMA-2 13B的性能差距比之前最优方法降低42%。
AI.conclusion: InfoQuant通过PSOT正交变换和自适应异常值令牌选择策略，将激活值塑造成量化友好的分布，在W4A4KV4配置下平均保留97%的浮点精度，并将LLaMA-2 13B的性能差距比之前最优方法降低42%。

title: Modeling Agentic Technical Debt and Stochastic Tax: A Standalone Framework for Measurement, Simulation, and Dashboarding
summary: Agentic AI systems combine probabilistic reasoning with delegated action through tools, context, memory, orchestration, and external workflow integration. This note develops a formal and managerially usable model that distinguishes Agentic Technical Debt from Stochastic Tax. Agentic Technical Debt is a stock of accumulated design and governance liability. Stochastic Tax is a recurring flow of operating burden that arises when stochastic agents are used in business workflows. The two constructs are related, but they are not the same: debt can amplify the tax, while the tax can remain positive even when debt is minimized. The note starts from a compact dashboard expression, expands it into a fuller structural model, defines all variables and parameters, shows how each cost category can be estimated from operational data, and illustrates the framework with an accounts-payable simulation and companion spreadsheet.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes a formal framework distinguishing "Agentic Technical Debt" (stock of accumulated design/governance liability) from "Stochastic Tax" (recurring flow of operating burden when using stochastic agents). These two constructs interact—debt amplifies tax, but tax persists even when debt is minimized. The model provides dashboard expression, structural formulation, variable definitions, estimation methods from operational data, and an accounts-payable simulation with companion spreadsheet for practical application.
AI.motivation: Agentic AI systems combining probabilistic reasoning with delegated action require clear governance and cost modeling. A formal and managerially usable model was needed to distinguish Agentic Technical Debt (accumulated design/governance liability) from Stochastic Tax (recurring operating burden from stochastic agents).
AI.method: Developed a formal model starting from a compact dashboard expression, expanded into a fuller structural model with defined variables and parameters; demonstrated cost estimation from operational data with accounts-payable simulation and spreadsheet illustration.
AI.result: Agentic Technical Debt and Stochastic Tax are related but distinct constructs: debt can amplify the tax, while the tax can remain positive even when debt is minimized.
AI.conclusion: The framework distinguishes two distinct cost constructs with practical applicability, supported by an accounts-payable simulation and companion spreadsheet for operational use.

title: Testing Agentic Workflows with Structural Coverage Criteria
summary: Multi-agent systems increasingly expose explicit workflow structure: agents, tools, tool-access rules, restrictions, and delegation paths. Existing evaluations rely largely on end-to-end task success, benchmark scores, final-response quality, or prompt-level checks, which provide limited evidence that this declared coordination structure has actually been exercised. This makes it difficult to assess test-suite adequacy or detect structural regressions in tool access, restrictions, and inter-agent delegation. We address this gap with a structural testing approach for multi-agent workflow specifications. The approach represents each workflow as a typed coordination graph, derives coverage obligations over reachable agents, allowed tool edges, restricted tool edges, and delegation edges, and uses coverage-driven generation with DSPy-based scenario realization to produce executable tests. The graph fixes what must be covered; DSPy realizes those obligations as natural-language scenarios whose witnesses are checked at runtime. We implement the approach for OpenAI Agents SDK-style workflows and evaluate it on ten SDK-derived benchmarks comprising 49 reachable agents, 47 tools, and 403 structural obligations. Generated scenarios witness 54/75 allowed-tool obligations and 36/48 delegation obligations within a bounded refinement budget. The adversarial restricted-tool criterion elicits 23/248 restricted-call violations, separating workflows whose restrictions hold under probing from workflows with concrete misrouting failures. These results show that structural coverage provides a useful adequacy layer for multi-agent workflow testing: it does not replace semantic or end-to-end evaluation, but reveals whether declared agents, tool-access rules, restrictions, and delegation paths have been exercised.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对多智能体工作流规格的结构测试方法，通过协调图覆盖率驱动与DSPy场景实现，验证工作流声明的结构（智能体、工具访问规则、限制、委托路径）是否被实际执行，为多智能体测试提供除语义和端到端评估之外的充分性评估层。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统评估主要依赖端到端任务成功率、基准分数或最终响应质量，缺乏对声明式协调结构（智能体、工具、访问规则、限制、委托路径）是否真正被执行的有效验证，难以评估测试套件充分性或检测结构性的工具访问、退避和智能体间委托回归。
AI.method: 将工作流表示为类型化协调图（typed coordination graph），从中导出覆盖义务（包括可达智能体、可允许工具边、受限工具边和委托边）；采用覆盖率驱动的生成方法，利用DSPy框架实现场景生成，将这些义务转化为自然语言场景，并通过运行时检查验证见证者（witnesses）。
AI.result: 在10个SDK衍生基准上测试（49个可达智能体、47个工具、403个结构义务），生成场景在有限优化预算内见证了54/75个可允许工具义务和36/48个委托义务；对抗性受限工具标准触发23/248个受限调用违规，成功区分了限制在探测下成立的系统与存在具体错误路由故障的系统。
AI.conclusion: 结构覆盖率（structural coverage）为多智能体工作流测试提供了一个有用的充分性评估层。它并不替代语义或端到端评估，但能揭示所声明的智能体、工具访问规则、限制和委托路径是否真正被执行。

title: Autonomic Federated-Market Orchestration for the Edge-Cloud Continuum
comment: 35 pages, 5 figures (combined main paper + electronic supplement, folded into one document for arXiv)
summary: The edge-cloud computing continuum demands self-management mechanisms that scale across autonomous administrative domains while honouring tenant- and operator-specified data sovereignty. We present Neural Pub/Sub, a federated-broker autonomic substrate whose self-organising behaviour emerges from market-based price signals rather than centralised control. Its MAPE-K control loop closes over per-broker health and load monitoring, marginal-cost clearing-price analysis, placement planning over a polymatroidal feasibility region, federated cross-domain dispatch, and shared peer subscription summaries with bounded-staleness price signals. The Plan step is anchored in a Walrasian convergence proposition: under gross-substitutes valuations on tree and series-parallel service-dependency DAGs, decentralised price-based allocation matches the welfare of a centralised oracle. We evaluate the substrate on a 4-VM, 4-domain, 48-worker federated edge-cloud testbed (single data centre, 50 ms emulated WAN) in a 1005-run campaign augmented by a fair-process-count sharded-oracle comparator. The federated market dominates a single-process oracle by 2-4% with 45 of 45 per-seed wins (sign-test p ~ 2.8e-14, Hodges-Lehmann median -39.6 ms); against a four-shard centralised orchestrator at equal process count the gap stays within +/-1.5% across all nine (pipeline, load) cells. Round-robin completion rate collapses 98.8% -> 22.4% -> 3.3% across arrival rates 5/10/15 pps while the market preserves completion; the advantage decomposes into three Walrasian properties (information completeness, admission control, price discovery). Federation withstands broker death and network partition (completion rate >= 98.7% across 75 cells), and sovereignty enforcement adds no measurable runtime overhead across 60 governance-grid runs. Heterogeneous-domain stressors and cross-site WAN deployment remain future work.

AI.tldr: Neural Pub/Sub 是一个面向边缘-云连续体的联邦代理（federated-broker）自治底座：每个管理域运行一个 broker，各自闭合 MAPE-K 控制环（监控健康与负载 → 边际成本清算价分析 → 多拟阵可行性域上的放置规划 → 联邦跨域派发 → 带界陈旧度的对等订阅摘要与价格信号作为 Knowledge），其自组织行为由市场式价格信号涌现而非中心协调。Plan 步骤锚定一条 Walrasian 收敛命题（树/串并联服务依赖 DAG 上，粗替代估值下分散价格分配达到中心化 oracle 的福利）。在 4-VM/4 域/48 worker 的 1005 次运行实验中：联邦市场相对单进程 oracle 平均时延低 2–4%（45/45 逐种子全胜，符号检验 p≈2.8×10⁻¹⁴，Hodges–Lehmann 中位数 −39.6 ms）；在等进程数的四分片中心化编排器对比下差距保持在 ±1.5% 以内；轮询调度在 λ=5/10/15 pps 下完成率崩塌 98.8%→22.4%→3.3%，而市场保持完成率并可优雅降级；broker 死亡与网络分区下完成率 ≥98.7%（75 个单元）；主权约束带来零可测运行时开销（60 次治理网格运行，偏差 1–3 ms）。
AI.motivation: 边缘-云连续体（仪器、边缘站点、区域云、中心 HPC）横跨彼此独立的管理域，复杂度与动态性使"自管理"成为关键路径能力：工作负载必须在无人在环、无单一协调者拥有全域可见性的条件下完成监控、分析、规划与派发。现有方案只覆盖问题碎片：Kubernetes/KubeEdge、Kueue/Volcano 等容器与批调度器限于单一控制平面、无联邦；Kafka/Flink/Ray 按主题分区路由而非按服务请求语义内容路由；Kubeflow/Argo/MLflow 在设计期固定 DAG 结构且限于单集群；Pegasus/Parsl/Swift/CometCloud 等科学工作流系统采用中心化单一规划器且无福利保证；经典拍卖/SFC/VNE 机制缺乏语义互联层与主权强制；LLM 多智能体框架在任务层组图，不涉及资源层放置。因此需要一个在跨厂商/跨司法辖区的自治域之间、以形式化福利保证驱动的自组织机制，同时把租户与运营方指定的数据主权（GDPR 传输、EU AI Act、NIS2）作为一等约束纳入自治决策。
AI.method: 系统模型：AI 流水线建模为服务依赖 DAG，容量约束族在树/两终端串并联结构下构成层状族，可行域为多拟阵（秩函数 f(S)=min over antichains of ΣC_v）；一般 DAG 由 integrator encapsulation 收缩为商图恢复多拟阵性；主权约束作为坐标上界与资源约束求交仍保持多拟阵。理论锚点（命题 3.1，自包含表述见补充材料 S2）：在层状约束 + 粗替代（GS）估值下，Walrasian 均衡存在、社会福利最大化，且可由多面体 clinching 升价拍卖多项式时间计算；原始流水线束估值是 Leontief（非 GS），仅在封装后得到单位需求的 GS 表示。架构：每域一个 broker，组成联邦覆盖层 F=(B,E_F)；broker 交换订阅摘要 σ_k={质心嵌入、簇半径、可用容量}与价格信号 PriceSignal，按语义距离阈值做跨域路由（每次发布比较代价 O(m·p̄)）；覆盖层异步，最终一致，陈旧度上界 B=δ_prop+WAN_max≈10.05 s（δ_prop=10 s 交换周期，k_miss=3 判故障，每 5 轮恢复探测）；派发为 POST-only HTTP RPC（at-most-once，τ_fed=5 s），本地派发为 at-least-once + 幂等阶段处理器，轮内预留账本 ℓ_add 单写者原子提交；因每个 worker 仅注册于一个 broker，跨 broker 预留冲突在构造上不可能。市场机制：worker 按拥塞定价提交 WorkerBid，broker 以 M/M/1 成本 cost_i=b_i/(1−ρ_i)（ρ_i≤0.99 上限）计算按阶段类型的边际成本清算价 π_k,t=d_t 便宜 worker 成本；跨域交易规则为远端 π_k',t+w_WAN < 本地 π_k,t 则远端放置（平局取本地）；总成本超流水线价值预算则拒收。实现含五项工程细化：速度缩放出价 b_i=b_0·s_i、M/M/1 动态拥塞定价、联邦价格交换、轮内负载预留账本、健康探测利用率同步。MAPE-K 映射：Monitor（δ_health=5 s 探测 + 心跳分区检测）、Analyse（M/M/1 清算价）、Plan（多拟阵域上算法 1）、Execute（联邦 HTTP 派发）、Knowledge（订阅摘要 + 对等价格，B 秒陈旧）。比较层级：单进程 oracle、全可见但无成本优化的中心化轮询、四 broker 市场、三个启发式（locality-only、latency-greedy、spillover），以及等进程数的四分片中心化编排器（指定协调者拉取对等状态、在合并拓扑上跑 find_placement）。测试床：5GTNF（Oulu）4 台 VM 各承载一个 O-RAN 域（DU/CU+near-RT RIC/non-RT RIC/SMO），每 VM 12 worker 共 48，4 broker，tc qdisc netem 模拟 50 ms 延迟 + 5 ms 抖动的跨站 WAN，站点内 <1 ms，URLLC 1 ms / eMBB 5 ms 切片 QoS；三个 8 阶段流水线模板（cqi-chain 树、anomaly-sp 串并联、ran-entangled 含钻石，γ>0）；Poisson 到达 λ∈{2,5,10} pps（消融扩展到 5/8/10/15/50），5 个种子，4 分钟预热 + 10 分钟测量；共 1005 次运行、7 个阶段、约 129 小时机时，含基础设施有效性验证、切片、worker 失效、压力、主市场网格与治理网格、联邦鲁棒性阶段。
AI.result: （1）去中心化与中心化的"反转"：四 broker 市场在全部 9 个（流水线, 负载）单元上平均端到端时延比单进程 oracle 低 2–4%，45/45 逐种子全胜（符号检验 p=2⁻⁴⁵≈2.8×10⁻¹⁴；HL 中位数 −39.6 ms，bootstrap 95% CI [−44.1, −35.3] ms），p50/p95/p99 方向一致；解释为单进程 oracle 在低至 2 pps 即成为状态/队列/派发决策的争用瓶颈。同等进程数的四分片 oracle 差距收敛到 ±1.5% 内（9 单元 5 胜/3 负/1 平），cqi-chain 市场全胜（−26 ms, 1.4%），anomaly-sp 分片略优（+5/+2 ms），ran-entangled 单元级平手；与单进程 oracle 相比仅在树结构上有优势，说明优势是流水线结构条件性的。10 pps cqi-chain 时单进程 oracle 完成率降至 99.4%，市场与分片 oracle 均保持 100%。（2）策略差异只在压力下显现：均匀负载下市场与三启发式在每单元收敛于 ±5 ms，locality-only 全单元具竞争力；饱和时轮询完成率 98.8%→22.4%→3.3%（时延 1.8 s→9.6 s），跨越标定膝点 λ≈13.8 pps（95% CI [12.5, 14.6]），市场在 λ≤10 保持 100%、λ=15 降至 83.3%、λ=50 仍有 25.4%（轮询为 0），且与四分片 oracle 在 sat-5/10/15 仅差 14 ms 与 0.5 个百分点；失效×负载交互中轮询在 8 pps 杀 12 worker 即崩至 33.5%，市场全程 100%；异构场景（边侧慢 2×、云侧快 1.5×）轮询 2508/1544/1251 ms 对市场 1290/851/702 ms，降幅约 46%。（3）优势可分解为三项与 GS 无关、在任何多拟阵域上的市场清算机制都成立的 Walrasian 属性：信息完备性、准入控制、价格发现。（4）联邦鲁棒性：broker 进程 kill、边缘-云网络分区、逐阶段 worker 死亡下 75 个单元完成率 ≥98.7%（联邦/静态 98.7%，其余 100%），时延在基线 1834 ms 的 25 ms 内；两个边缘站 36,098 与 36,092 事件上完成率 ≥99.9%。（5）主权强制零开销：60 次治理网格（4 场景×3 流水线×5 种子）均值与无约束基线差 1–3 ms（≤3 ms 内），因主权是可行性域上的坐标上界，清算自动绕开禁止分配。基础设施有效性：HTTP 与 Kafka 逐种子时延差 <1 ms；切片感知放置降中位时延 15%（1233 vs 1450 ms）并在均衡比较中把吞吐提升 5×；治理开销 0%；worker 失效下 HTTP 完成率 100%，Kafka 因消费者组再均衡损失 1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于：一个在多自治管理域间联邦、以市场价格信号实现自组织的自治分布式底座及其显式 MAPE-K 映射（含五项使经验包络成立的工程细化，但逐组件 leave-one-out 归因留待后续）；等进程数条件下"去中心化 vs 中心化"的经验反转（去中心化在树结构上占优、与理想中心化编排器相差在 ±5 ms 内，同时保留厂商机密性、无需单一协调器并具形式化 Walrasian 保证）；以及自管理策略何时才真正产生差异的结构性分解（饱和/异构/失效下的准入控制、信息完备性、价格发现）。保证的形式是"声明式运行包络"而非封闭形式证明：包络为陈旧度 B≈10.05 s、λ≤13.8 pps（λB≤139 由轮内账本吸收）、k_miss=3 故障切换阈值，安全不变量为无阶段被派发至 ρ_i≥0.99 的 worker、轮内超配不超过单流水线阶段数、主权约束不可被违反，活性依赖有界陈旧下的最终一致收敛；后续可做统计模型检验。局限与未来工作：实现的是边际成本清算而非完整多面体 clinching 拍卖，简化—最优定价差距计入所测效率差；处理时间为标定延迟而非真实 ML 推理，语义匹配层为冻结的预校准组件；测试床为单数据中心 4 VM、单条模拟 WAN，无带宽限制/丢包/重排/路径不对称/跨流量竞争，HPC 层未实测（架构上以批队列端点的 integrator 封装接入，但 10²–10³ s 排队方差需更粗的提交周期）；漏斗故障处理模式（wait/proceed/abort）未覆盖（鲁棒性单元均用树形 cqi-chain）；非模性间隙 γ 在封装前后的度量未做，故"封装恢复多拟阵"与"预留账本抑制超配"两种解释无法区分；异构域（不对称信任/容量/数据质量）下的多层级治理组合理论待检验；后续方向包括异构域实验、EISim 规模验证、面向对抗性多厂商场景的 broker 问责（承诺式定价、跨 broker 审计）、动态可信度自适应、语义通信传输层，以及跨真实 WAN（Oulu↔Tokyo，~150 ms RTT）部署验证。

title: Revisiting Bruck: Phase-Efficient All-to-All Communication in Reconfigurable Networks
summary:
All-to-All communication is a key performance bottleneck for distributed machine learning (ML) and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads, where dense traffic increasingly stresses scale-up interconnects. While these ML and HPC workloads have driven unprecedented infrastructure demand, optical reconfigurable networks (ORNs) offer a promising path forward. By adapting the physical topology to the active workload, they improve communication cost and bandwidth utilization. However, their benefit is critically contingent on whether the collective consists of structured phases that can be served by sparse and reusable topology states.
  In this paper, we revisit Bruck's All-to-All implementation and demonstrate the benefits of topology optimization in which both communication pattern and reconfiguration strategy are co-designed. We present ReTri, a bidirectional All-to-All schedule for ORNs. ReTri uses balanced ternary block propagation to complete All-to-All in $\lceil \log_3 n\rceil$ phases. The induced reconfiguration strategy from ReTri's pairwise bidirectional exchanges allow reconfiguration delays to be amortized across multiple phases. Preliminary simulations show that ReTri improves completion time by up to $10\times$ over static All-to-All, even for millisecond-scale reconfiguration delays, and improving reconfigurable Bruck by up to $2.1\times$.

AI.tldr: 本文针对光可重构网络(ORN)中 All-to-All 集合通信的效率瓶颈,提出名为 ReTri 的双向 All-to-All 调度算法。ReTri 借鉴 Trivance 的三进制通信模式,用平衡三进制块传播在 ⌈log₃n⌉ 个阶段内完成 All-to-All(相比 Bruck 的 ⌈log₂n⌉ 阶段减少约 33%),并由通信模式直接推导出一条"可复用的三进制子环"重配置策略,使重配置延迟可跨阶段摊销。仿真显示:相对静态 Pairwise All-to-All 最高加速 10×,相对可重构 Bruck(带镜像的 Bridge)最高加速 2.1×,且在毫秒级重配置延迟下仍保持优势。
AI.motivation: 分布式机器学习(尤其是 MoE)与 HPC 的 All-to-All 通信是端到端性能的主要瓶颈(MoE 训练中占比可达 55%),密集流量持续压迫 scale-up 互连。光可重构网络(ORN)可通过运行时调整物理拓扑来降低路径长度与拥塞,但存在根本权衡:每次重配置都需要全局同步并产生不可忽略的延迟 δ。已有方案的问题在于:(1) Pairwise All-to-All 需要 n−1 个阶段与线性次数的重配置,每次仅服务单个阶段,结构不可复用,固定重配置延迟无法摊销,除 δ≈0 外不可行;(2) 经典 Bruck 算法等分阶段算法在逻辑上按单向设计,无法同时利用双向光链路——理想多端口模型可达 ⌈log₃n⌉ 阶段,但在 2n 端口的 OCS 约束下,单向模式需要每节点 4 条入射链路,且环上流量单向推进导致拥塞与传播延迟上升。因此本文主张:通信模式与重配置策略必须围绕光交换机的端口约束进行协同设计,目标不只是带宽利用率,而是"以尽量少的阶段数 × 尽量少的重配置次数"传输尽可能多的流量,并让双向链路承载双向流量。
AI.method: 架构模型:scale-up 域内 n 个加速器,每节点 2 个光电收发器,OCS 提供 2n 个端口;保持全连通拓扑要求每节点度数≥2,故最小可行拓扑为若干环(2n 端口仅能建立 n 条双向匹配链路)。算法:ReTri 基于 Trivance(Juerss et al., 2026),在阶段 k 每个节点 r 与 r±3^k (mod n) 两个对称对等节点交换数据,共 s=⌈log₃n⌉ 个阶段。块传播:定义中心化偏移 Δ_{r,d}=ucr_n((d−r) mod n),其唯一的平衡三进制表示 Δ=Σ_k τ_k·3^k(τ_k∈{−1,0,+1})决定块在每个阶段的去向(+1 右传、−1 左传、0 保留);每阶段每节点向左右各发送 m/3 数据,附录 B 证明表示唯一且每阶段恰好 n/3 块分发。重配置策略:阶段 k 前若 x_k=1,则按 E_k={{i,(i+3^k) mod n}} 建立链路,等价于把节点划分为 3^k 个大小 n/3^k 的子环 S_i^(k)={u | u≡i (mod 3^k)};附录 A 证明这些子环在 2n 端口约束下是最小的,且包含所有未来阶段的对等节点,因此拓扑可跨阶段复用并保持连通。代价模型:扩展 Hockney α-β 模型 C = s·α_s + Σ_k(h_k·α_h + m_k·c_k·β) + R·δ,推导得静态代价 C^ReTri(m)=log₃n·α_s+(α_h+βm/3)(n−1)/2;给定 R 次重配置,最优分段长度应相差至多 1,对齐时 C^ReTri(R)=log₃n·α_s+(R+1)(α_h+βm/3)(3^{log₃n/(R+1)}−1)/2+R·δ,最优重配置次数 R*=argmin_R C^ReTri(R)(0≤R≤s−1),即在大 n、大消息、低带宽或高 per-hop 延迟时更倾向于每阶段重配置。评测:使用 Astra-Sim + ns-3 后端,链路带宽 400 Gbps、传播延迟 1 μs、每阶段延迟 1.7 μs,消息大小 1 KB–256 MB,重配置延迟 δ 从 1 μs 到 50 ms(附录扩展至 150 ms);对比基线为静态 Pairwise All-to-All 与可重构 Bruck(Bridge,作者另加镜像使其双向以保证公平)。由于三进制/二进制天然对齐差异,ReTri 用 n=81(n=243)对比 Bruck 的 n=64(n=256),对 Bruck 有利。
AI.result: 1) 相对静态 Pairwise All-to-All:在 δ=1 μs 时加速最高 10×;小消息在 δ≤10 μs 内重配置仍有收益,≤8 MB 消息可承受至 δ=1 ms,256 MB 消息在 δ=50 ms 时仍有收益。2) 相对可重构 Bruck(Bridge):稳定加速最高 2.1×(尽管 ReTri 网络规模大 26%);小消息阶段因阶段数与路径长度优势获得至少 1.6×,此时 R*=0,收益来自静态模式本身;大消息下加速 1.2×–2.1×。3) 阶段/重配置优势:Bruck 需要 log₂n/log₃n≈1.58 倍的阶段数,其 per-phase 与 per-hop 延迟高约 58%,达成同等拓扑优化还多承受 58% 的重配置延迟。4) 更大网络(附录 n=243 vs 256)中,δ=150 ms、256 MB 时 ReTri 仍比静态基线快 1.2×,而 Bruck 已不再优于静态执行。5) 结论性判断:重配置收益随消息规模与网络规模增大而扩大;ReTri 在"通信昂贵"区间(大消息、高延迟)最有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过在 ORN 物理约束下重新审视 Bruck 的对数阶段结构,提出 ReTri:一个双向、稀疏的 All-to-All 调度,在保留成对双向交换的同时诱导可复用的子环拓扑,以 ⌈log₃n⌉ 阶段完成通信,阶段数较 Bruck 的 ORN 可行实现减少 33%。核心洞见是"通信模式与光拓扑协同设计":由通信模式可确定性推导出最优重配置策略,减少阶段数即减少重配置次数,而稀疏重配置可跨阶段摊销固定延迟。实验证明该方案在现实重配置延迟下优于静态执行与可重构 Bruck,是面向未来 scale-up 域"可重构感知集合通信"设计空间的一个具体实例。作者同时指明研究议程:非 3 的幂规模网络(如 TPU 常见的 2 的幂,当前 ReTri 在 64 节点与 81 节点性能相同)、推广到 d=2q 端口的平衡基数 b=d+1 情形、把重配置与计算重叠、扩展到 AllReduce 等其他集合通信、子环复用时的路由与队头阻塞问题、重配置间的屏障/慢节点同步开销,以及基于真实 OCS 模型的硬件级仿真评估(目前仅为 ns-3 层面的初步仿真)。

title: Towards Just-in-Time Adaptive Feedback: Enhancing Student Learning via Knowledge-Grounded LLM
comment: 8 pages, Accepted to 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA 2026)
summary: Educational interventions are effective tools for enhancing student learning. While Large Language Models (LLMs) allow for generating adaptive feedback at scale, current studies lack clear methodologies for providing Just-in-Time (JiT) feedback in authentic instructional settings. In this paper, we present a framework that provides adaptive feedback by grounding LLMs with domain-specific expert knowledge. Our approach collects written reasoning logic (strategy essays) from students, analyzes potential error types based on the content of that reasoning, and delivers non-intrusive feedback designed to clarify missing or incorrect concepts. We deploy this framework in a large-scale university course (N > 1000), where it improved student performance by over 80% compared to previous semesters. Lastly, we validate the framework's pedagogical utility by analyzing the learning trajectories; we demonstrate how iterative conversations with LLM facilitate shifting one's misconception to correct understanding.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个将LLM与领域专家知识相结合的适应型反馈框架，通过分析学生策略文章中的错误类型提供非侵入性即时反馈。在超过1000人的大学课程中验证了该方法能使学生成绩提升80%以上，并展示了迭代对话如何帮助学生纠正错误认知。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏在真实教学环境中提供即时（JIT）反馈的明确方法论，尽管LLM能够在规模上生成适应型反馈。
AI.method: 提出一个将LLM与领域专家知识相结合的适应型反馈框架；收集学生的书面推理逻辑（策略文章），基于推理内容分析潜在错误类型，传递非侵入性反馈以澄清缺失或错误概念；在大型大学课程（N > 1000）中部署该框架。
AI.result: 相比前几个学期，学生成绩提升超过80%；通过学习轨迹分析验证了该框架的pedagogical utility；证明了与LLM的迭代对话能够促进学生从错误认知转向正确理解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效地将LLM能力与领域专家知识相结合，在大规模真实教学环境中实现了可量化的学生成绩提升，并验证了通过迭代对话引导学生从错误认知转向正确理解的 pedagogical utility。

title: GAC: Noise-Aware Adaptive Mixing for Hybrid SFT-RL Post-Training
summary: Hybrid post-training usually combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, but fixed mixing schedules cannot adapt when the relative noise of the two signals changes over time. We propose GAC, a noise-aware controller that derives an adaptive mixing weight from online estimates of gradient variance and disagreement between the two training signals. The method adds smoothing, prior guidance, and bounded updates while reusing existing training tensors. Experiments on math, code, science, and logic benchmarks show that GAC consistently improves hybrid post-training over strong fixed and rule-based baselines, with larger gains at larger model scales and less than 1% training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAC，一个用于混合后训练的自适应噪声感知控制器，通过在线估计梯度方差和信号分歧度动态调整SFT与RL的混合权重，在多种任务和模型规模上实现一致提升，计算开销极低。
AI.motivation: 混合后训练结合监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），但固定混合策略无法适应训练过程中两个信号相对噪声的动态变化，导致训练效率受限。
AI.method: GAC采用噪声感知控制器设计，基于梯度方差和两个训练信号之间的分歧程度，在线估计并推导自适应混合权重。具体实现包含平滑机制、先验引导和受限更新，并复用了现有训练张量，最大限度降低实现复杂度。
AI.result: 在数学、代码、科学和逻辑等多种基准测试中，GAC持续优于强固定基线和基于规则的基线，且在更大模型规模上收益更显著，训练开销不足1%。
AI.conclusion: GAC通过自适应调整混合权重，有效解决了混合后训练中固定调度无法适应噪声变化的根本问题。在多种任务和模型规模上展现出一致的改进效果，且计算开销极小（<1%），具有良好的实用价值。

title: FuzzPilot: Plateau-Triggered Recipe Validation for Structured Text Fuzzing
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Preliminary cJSON-only evaluation (N=5 main, N=3 ablation; descriptive statistics, no significance claims). Code and 25-run artifacts at https://github.com/Qiao-Zhiyi/fuzz_agent (tag paper01-arxiv-v1). Venue-version Stage-1 pilot on libxml2, sqlite3, openssl_x509 currently in flight; v2 will report those results
summary: FuzzPilot is a controller for AFL++ that moves expensive reasoning out of the mutation hot path. When coverage plateaus, it snapshots the corpus, prepares candidate mutation recipes, evaluates them in short isolated AFL++ micro-campaigns, and promotes only recipes with positive validation reward. Recipes are JSON data, not generated code: a native custom mutator consumes operator weights, byte ranges, corpus-selection rules, and dictionary tokens. Candidate recipes can come from local rules or from a language-model agent, with Ghidra-derived constants and decompiled context as target hints. This preprint reports a deliberately narrow cJSON evaluation. We compare vanilla AFL++ and the full FuzzPilot agent over five 14,400 s repetitions per arm. cJSON is saturated: baseline AFL++ reaches the exposed 269-edge ceiling at a median of about 2,500 s. The experiments therefore do not show that language-model proposals improve coverage or generalize beyond cJSON. Within this scope, FuzzPilot preserves throughput (median execs_per_sec about 1.06x baseline), shows a descriptively shorter median plateau (1,384 s versus 2,532 s), but the difference is not statistically significant at N=5 (Mann-Whitney p=0.42). The validation gate evaluated 20 model-proposed recipes and promoted none because all rewards were zero. The observed plateau reduction is more likely due to controller snapshot and restart machinery than to the model or recipe mutator. This version is best read as an auditable implementation report and baseline for ongoing non-saturated-target evaluation.

AI.tldr: FuzzPilot 是包裹在 AFL++ 外层的一个"平台期触发"控制器：当覆盖率停滞时，它把语料库做快照，把昂贵的推理（LLM 提议、Ghidra 静态分析）移出变异热路径，生成候选"变异配方"（JSON 数据而非生成代码），在短时独立微基准 campaign 中验证，仅当奖励为正时才提升到主循环。该预印本仅在 cJSON 上做窄范围评估：cJSON 在中位 2,524 s 即触及 269 边上限（饱和），因此无法证明 LLM 提议能提升覆盖率。结论是吞吐基本持平（中位 execs/s 约 1.06×）、平台期中位数描述性变短（1,384 s vs 2,532 s，Mann–Whitney p=0.42 不显著），验证门评估 20 个模型配方全部因 R=0 被拒、零提升，消融反而指向"控制器快照/重启机制"而非模型或配方变异器是主要驱动。作者自我定位为可审计的实现报告与后续非饱和目标评估的基线。
AI.motivation: 灰盒模糊测试的突变循环必须保持高速（小解析器上可达每秒数十万次执行），因此任何逐输入的 LLM 推理都会主导运行时间；已有 LLAMAFUZZ、FuzzCoder、Fuzz4All 等"在环内"方案要么接受这一代价，要么仅把模型放到并行辅助进程。G²FUZZ 确立了"把昂贵推理放在粗粒度时点、让产物可被原生复用"的设计契约，但它的中间表示是可执行 Python 生成器，只适用于二进制格式。针对结构化文本解析器（JSON/XML/SQL/ASN.1），语法级编辑用小型数据（操作码、偏移、字面量）表达比用代码更自然，且执行模型生成的代码带来网络/文件 I/O/死循环等运行时安全风险。由此本文提出三个开放问题：Q1 中间表示用代码还是数据；Q2 如何验证候选提议值得投入数小时主循环；Q3 无源码时静态上下文从何而来。
AI.method: 架构围绕单一不变式组织：任何 AFL++ 逐次变异路径上都不出现外部推理调用，仅在平台期检测器判定窗口停滞或微 campaign 完成需要裁决时调用模型。组件包括：(1) 平台期检测器，用滑动窗口 W=10 s、θ_e=50 execs、θ_p=1 path 判定停滞并冻结语料快照；(2) 黑板 JSON，汇聚快照、fuzzer_stats 与 Ghidra 静态上下文，作为 LLM 唯一视图；(3) 9 个角色特化的 agent（coordinator、plateau-diagnosis、scheduler、cmp-hint、dictionary、format、mutator、corpus、crash-triage）产出配方；(4) 配方存储，schema 校验的 JSON（≤2 KB），字段含 id、selector、priority/ttl、operator_weights、focus/protect_ranges、dictionary_tokens、expected_signal，序列化为 CompactRecipe 二进制缓存；(5) 7 个闭集字节级算子（BitFlip、OverwriteRange、InsertToken、Arith、Splice、DeleteBlock、DictionaryOverwrite）由原生自定义 mutator 按权重采样分派，无解释器、无嵌套控制流；(6) 微 campaign 门，每轮用 K_cand=4 个候选（default/dictionary/seed_focus/per_seed_recipe）在私有目录跑 N=20 s 隔离 AFL++，奖励 R=α·Δedges+γ·Δcrashes+δ_h·h−δ_m·m（α=1.0、γ=10、δ_h=1e-3、δ_m=5e-4，无 bitmap 时 β=0.5 替换 Δedges），仅 R>0 才提升，否则输出 winner_decided:no_significance 与 promotion_skipped:no_successful_micro_campaign；(7) Ghidra headless 静态通道，一次性提取 top-20 危险函数（危险分 = 10×{gets,system,popen}+5×{strcpy,strcat}+4×{sprintf}+3×{malloc,free,memcpy,memmove}+2×{printf}）、≤150 magic_tokens、≤100 cmp_constants、≤150 branch_constraints、top-5 函数反编译 C（各截 4 KB），同一份 static_context.json 同时供给 agent 黑板与微 campaign 的 -x 字典。实验：4 核 Xeon E5-2699 v4 / 8 GB / Ubuntu 24.04，AFL++ v4.21c，AFL_MAP_SIZE=65536，26 个手选 JSON 种子，每轮 14,400 s；主臂 baseline-afl 与 full-agent 各 N=5，消融 rule-only/no-mutator/no-static-analysis 各 N=3，公平性基线 baseline-afl-dict 与 baseline-afl-cmplog 各 N=3；模型为 deepseek-chat（T=0，API 花费 $0.002/4h campaign）。统计用双侧 Mann–Whitney U（exact, N≤8）、Vargha–Delaney A12、10,000 次百分位 bootstrap 中位数 CI；微基准用 SIGSTOP 隔离 AFL worker 串行运行。
AI.result: (1) 覆盖率：两种模式都收敛到 269 边上限（bitmap_cvg 23.21%），baseline 5/5 达到、full-agent 4/5 达到（r02 仅 266），无任何模式超过上限——cJSON 饱和。(2) 平台期：baseline 中位 last_find 11,911 s、平台期 2,532 s；full-agent 13,059 s、1,384 s，描述性 −45.3%（−1,148 s），但 Mann–Whitney U=8、p=0.42、A12=0.68，bootstrap 95% CI（[539,3,970] vs [238,3,226]）几乎完全重叠，不显著。(3) 端点自由指标：到 264/268 边各模式几乎相同（60/660 s vs 120/662 s），到 269 边 baseline 中位 2,524 s 反而早于 full-agent 的 6,702 s——"平台期更短"实为"更晚才触顶"。(4) 吞吐：full-agent/baseline 中位 execs/s 比 1.059×（13,816/13,049），通过 ≥0.85 门限；微基准 fp-active/fp-empty 中位比 1.016×、均值比 0.869×（Welch p=0.45），TOST ±5% 等价性 p=0.68 未建立；fp-empty/vanilla 中位 1.529× 通过 ≤5× 门限。(5) LLM 层：45 次调用中 43 次 schema 合法（95.6%），2 次非法且未触发回退；每轮仅触发 1 次平台期，共评估 5×4=20 个候选，全部 Δedges=Δpaths=Δcrashes=0，故 R=0、零提升，主循环全程运行默认 DictionaryAgent 配方 {FUZZ, MAGIC, TOKEN}——这验证了门的"无误报"一半，但未验证"能区分好坏"一半。(6) 消融（描述性，均不显著）：no-static-analysis 234 s < no-mutator 930 s (p=0.14, A12=0.87) < rule-only 1,165 s (p=0.39) < full-agent 1,384 s < baseline 2,532 s；若配方变异器是主因，移除它应变差而非变好，排序与该假设矛盾；no-static-analysis 呈双峰分布 [187, 234, 4,454]，中位不可靠。(7) cycles_done：baseline 中位 797 vs full-agent 140（约 5.7× 少），no-mutator 671 接近 baseline，rule-only 119，说明差异源于配方变异器导致每轮执行次数变多而非 LLM；但作者强调 cycles_done 是派生量，不能当作"进度"指标。(8) 公平性：AFL++ -x 字典臂中位平台期 2,256 s (p=0.79)、cmplog 臂 2,367 s (p=1.00)，均未缩小差距，但 cmplog 三次全部达到 270 边，比 FuzzPilot 的 269 多一条边——绝对覆盖轴上的负面结果。(9) 成本：DeepSeek API 全 5 轮共约 ¥0.07（≈$0.01），单次调用 $0.0002、单个 4 h campaign $0.002，远低于约 $1.60 的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 本版本只能读作"可审计的实现报告 + cJSON 概念验证"，而非性能提升的证据。核心结论有三：(1) 控制路径可以被工程化——把昂贵推理完全移出 AFL++ 逐次变异热路径，吞吐不降反微升（中位 1.06×），且全链路（黑板状态→提议→配方→奖励→提升判定）可从 append-only 审计日志逐条重放，便于验证零提升是 R=0 的真实证据而非控制器缺陷；(2) 在饱和目标上，模型提议层的价值完全未被证明：20 个候选全部零奖励、零提升，这既说明门是保守的（无误报），也说明其"可区分好坏"的核心能力仍未验证；消融的点估计排序（移除配方变异器反而缩短平台期）反而把归因指向控制器的平台期检测与语料重组/重启机制，但缺少 controller-only 消融臂使其只能停留在假设层面；(3) 存在明确的负面结果：cmplog 能多覆盖 1 条边，说明 FuzzPilot 并未改善绝对覆盖；两者作用轴不同（墙钟时间轴 vs 覆盖轴），可互补但当前 CLI 不支持组合。主要局限：单一饱和目标、统计功效不足（N=5/3，远低于 Klees 等建议的 N≥20）、调参与评测共用同一 26 文件种子语料（无 hold-out 划分，存在数据泄漏可能）、字节级而非 AST 级的算子词汇、无语法感知的修复算子、缺少 controller-only/ai-direct/random-recipe 消融与超参敏感性扫描。后续工作为最重要：非饱和目标（libxml2 ~30k 边、sqlite3 ~150k 边、openssl X.509 ~80k 边，60 s 冒烟已可达 2,776/6,922/3,635 边）的矩阵、N≥20/≥10 重复数与正式秩和检验、controller-only 消融、以及与 G²FUZZ 的正面对比。

title: Governed Evolution of Agent Runtimes through Executable Operational Cognition
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Reference implementation and associated source code available at: https://github.com/mgarralda/governed-runtime
summary:
Recent advances in agentic systems increasingly treat code as an executable operational substrate rather than as a disposable output artifact. Prior work such as \emph{Code as Agent Harness} frames validated agent-generated artifacts as runtime entities that can be created, executed, revised, persisted, and reused within long-running cognitive loops. However, the governance, lifecycle management, and operational evolution of such artifacts remain under-specified.
  This paper proposes a framework for governed runtime evolution in multi-agent systems through executable operational cognition. We formalize agent-generated artifacts as persistent runtime capabilities that progressively become part of the operational substrate rather than transient intermediate outputs. Building on this perspective, we introduce \emph{HarnessMutation} as a governed mechanism for lifecycle-aware runtime adaptation operating under explicit validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints.
  Rather than treating runtime adaptation as unrestricted self-modification, the proposed framework models evolution as a bounded and observable process over persistent operational memory. It further shows how these ideas can be operationalized over modern agent runtimes and governance-oriented orchestration systems, providing a conceptual foundation for adaptive infrastructures whose evolution remains explicit, auditable, and constrained.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the governance gap in agentic systems where code is treated as executable runtime substrate. It proposes a framework for governed runtime evolution, formalizing agent artifacts as persistent capabilities and introducing HarnessMutation as a lifecycle-aware adaptation mechanism with validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints.
AI.motivation: Prior work (Code as Agent Harness) treats agent-generated artifacts as runtime entities, but governance, lifecycle management, and operational evolution remain under-specified.
AI.method: Formalizes agent-generated artifacts as persistent runtime capabilities; introduces HarnessMutation as a governed mechanism operating under validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints; models evolution as bounded and observable process over persistent operational memory.
AI.result: Proposes a framework enabling runtime adaptation while maintaining explicitness, auditability, and constraints.
AI.conclusion: Provides a conceptual foundation for adaptive infrastructures whose evolution remains explicit, auditable, and constrained; operationalized through modern agent runtimes and governance-oriented orchestration systems.

title: FAB-Bench: A Framework for Adaptive RAG Benchmarking in Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become critical for knowledge-intensive applications, yet evaluating its performance in vertical domains remains difficult due to domain complexity, diverse context scales, and heavy reliance on expert assessments that are costly, inconsistent, and non-scalable. We introduce FAB-Bench, an end-to-end framework for adaptive benchmarking of RAG systems in semiconductor manufacturing. FAB-Bench defines six diagnostic metrics measuring factual accuracy, contextual utilization, completeness, retrieval relevance, technical depth, and reasoning consistency. The framework couples retriever diagnostics with generator-level reasoning analysis across context windows of 4K-32K tokens, quantifying how retrieval precision and generative fidelity co-evolve as contextual scope expands. From over 1,300 generated candidates, we curated a high-quality benchmark of 200 query-answer pairs spanning three synthesis strategies: needle-in-haystack, intra-document multi-topic, and cross-document multi-hop. Systematic evaluation across four LLMs and four RAG frameworks reveals three distinct context-scaling behaviors: logarithmic growth, early saturation, and cold-start dynamics, and identifies attention dilution as the primary mechanism behind performance degradation at extreme context lengths. Cross-framework validation on three additional production RAG systems confirms evaluation portability.

AI.tldr: FAB-Bench是一个针对半导体制造领域的RAG系统自适应基准测试框架，通过6项诊断指标在4K-32K上下文窗口上量化评估检索-生成协同性能，从1300+候选中筛选200个问答对，系统揭示了三种上下文缩放行为并确认注意力稀释是关键退化机制。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统在垂直领域（尤其是半导体制造）的评估面临三重挑战：领域复杂度高、上下文规模多样、过度依赖专家标注（成本高、不一致、不可扩展）。现有评估方法难以捕捉检索精度与生成保真度在不同上下文长度下的协同演化规律。
AI.method: 采用端到端评估框架，定义6项诊断指标（事实准确性、上下文利用率、完整性、检索相关性、技术深度、推理一致性），在4K-32K token上下文窗口范围内对检索器与生成器进行耦合分析；从1300+候选中筛选出200个高质量问答对，涵盖三种合成策略（大海捞针、文档内多主题、跨文档多跳）；对4种LLM和4种RAG框架进行系统性评估，并使用3个生产级RAG系统进行跨框架验证。
AI.result: 发现三种典型的上下文缩放行为：对数增长型、早期饱和型、冷启动型；确认注意力稀释是极端上下文长度下性能退化的主要机制；跨4个LLM和4个RAG框架的系统性评估验证了框架的有效性，三个生产级系统的跨框架验证证实了评估的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: FAB-Bench为半导体制造领域的RAG系统评估提供了可扩展、可复现的解决方案；跨框架验证证明了评估的可迁移性；识别出注意力稀释是长上下文场景下性能下降的主因，为RAG系统的优化提供了明确方向。

title: Nonlinear spectral clustering with C++ GraphBLAS
comment: Outstanding short paper award, IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC), 25 - 29 September 2023
summary: Nonlinear reformulations of the spectral clustering method have gained a lot of recent attention due to their increased numerical benefits and their solid mathematical background. However, the estimation of the multiple nonlinear eigenvectors is associated with an increased computational cost. We present an implementation of a direct multiway spectral clustering algorithm in the $p$-norm, for $p\in(1,2]$, using a novel C++ GraphBLAS API. The key operations are expressed in linear algebraic terms and are executed over the resulting sparse matrices and dense vectors, parameterized in the algebra pertinent to the computation. We demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of our shared-memory algorithm on several artificial test cases. Our numerical examples and comparative results against competitive methods indicate that the proposed implementation attains high quality clusters in terms of the balanced graph cut metric. The strong scaling capabilities of our algorithm are showcased on a range of datasets with up to $8$ million nodes and $48$ million edges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于p范数(p∈(1,2])的直接多路谱聚类算法的C++ GraphBLAS实现。该实现使用稀疏矩阵和稠密向量，通过共享内存并行方式处理大规模图数据。实验表明该算法在平衡图割指标上表现优异，能有效处理高达800万节点和4800万边的数据集。
AI.motivation: Nonlinear reformulations of spectral clustering offer increased numerical benefits and solid mathematical foundations, but the estimation of multiple nonlinear eigenvectors is computationally expensive. There is a need for efficient implementations that can handle large-scale problems.
AI.method: A direct multiway spectral clustering algorithm in p-norm (p∈(1,2]) implemented using a novel C++ GraphBLAS API. Key operations are expressed in linear algebraic terms and executed over sparse matrices and dense vectors, parameterized in the pertinent algebra. The algorithm is implemented in shared-memory parallel fashion.
AI.result: The implementation demonstrates effectiveness and accuracy on artificial test cases. Comparative results against competitive methods show the algorithm achieves high-quality clusters. Strong scaling is demonstrated on large datasets.
AI.conclusion: The proposed implementation achieves high-quality clusters in terms of balanced graph cut metric and demonstrates strong scaling capabilities on datasets with up to 8 million nodes and 48 million edges.

title: Automatic Layer Selection for Hallucination Detection
summary: Recent studies on hallucination detection have shown that hallucination-related signals are more strongly encoded in intermediate layers than in the final layer of large language models (LLMs). Although a growing body of work has sought to exploit this property for hallucination detection, how to automate the selection of high-performing layers remains underexplored, and principled methods for this purpose are still lacking. To address this gap, we first propose several hypotheses for why such signals emerge in intermediate layers and evaluate corresponding criteria for automatic layer selection across diverse LLM architectures, scales, and tasks, covering both question answering and summarization hallucination detection benchmarks. However, we find that none of these criteria consistently delivers satisfactory performance. We therefore propose a new selection criterion, First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension (FEPoID), which consistently identify optimal or near-optimal layers and outperforms both the aforementioned criteria and existing hallucination detection baselines. FEPoID is training-free and incurs negligible computational overhead. In addition, we study the generation behaviors of LLMs and introduce a simple yet effective truncation strategy, which further amplifies hallucination-related signals and substantially improves overall detection performance. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/DesoloYw/Automatic-Layer-Selection-for-Hallucination-Detection.git

AI.tldr: The paper addresses automatic layer selection for hallucination detection in LLMs by proposing FEPoID, a training-free criterion that identifies optimal intermediate layers by detecting the first effective peak of intrinsic dimension, achieving superior detection performance when combined with a novel truncation strategy.
AI.motivation: Hallucination-related signals are stronger in intermediate layers of LLMs, but automated layer selection remains an unresolved problem; existing principled methods lack consistent performance.
AI.method: Evaluated multiple criteria for automatic layer selection across diverse architectures, scales, and benchmarks; proposed FEPoID (First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension) as training-free criterion with negligible computational overhead.
AI.result: FEPoID outperforms prior criteria and baselines; truncation strategy amplifies hallucination signals and further improves detection.
AI.conclusion: FEPoID consistently identifies optimal or near-optimal layers, outperforming existing criteria and hallucination detection baselines; combined with truncation strategy, achieves substantially improved detection performance.

title: Slide Deck Q&A Quality Assurance App: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Pedagogical Question Generation
comment: 15 pages, 3 research questions, 1 figure, 1 table, 6 references, 2 appendices
summary:
Generating high-quality, pedagogically useful questions from lecture slide decks is difficult because important instructional content is distributed across both text and visual elements, and because useful questions must be scaffolded across the flow of a presentation rather than generated slide by slide in isolation. This paper describes Slide Deck Q\&A Quality Assurance (slidesqaqa), a Flask-based software system that extracts text and rendered images from PDF slides and processes them through a four-stage large language model pipeline comprising window planning, deck synthesis, slide annotation, and reconciliation. The system reasons jointly about slide modality and pedagogical role, allocates bounded question budgets, and revises draft annotations at the deck level to reduce redundancy and improve coverage. The final output is a structured JSON annotation containing deck-level goals, section structure, slide-level summaries, question sets, and evaluation scores. Initial experiments on two technical lecture decks indicate that the pipeline can filter non-instructional slides and produce high-fidelity, pedagogically coherent questions for visually complex content.
  The working system is at https://slidesqaqa-974767694043.us-west1.run.app
  The software repository is at https://github.com/blinding2submit/slidesqaqa

AI.tldr: 本文提出 slidesqaqa——一个基于 Flask 的开源软件系统，把 PDF 讲义幻灯片自动转换为教学级问答。其核心是一条四阶段大语言模型流水线：窗口规划（Window Planning）→ 整体合成（Deck Synthesis）→ 幻灯片标注（Slide Annotation）→ 全局调和（Reconciliation）。系统把幻灯片渲染成缩略图并拼接为"接触表"（contact sheet）送入多模态模型，结合文本抽取与受约束的标签词表进行推理，最终输出带学习目标、章节结构、逐页问题集与自评分数（Coverage/Fidelity/Scaffolding，1–5分）的层级化 JSON 标注。在 cs224n《Self-Attention and Transformers》与 cs288《Neural Constituency Parsing》两份技术讲义上的初步实验表明：该流水线能正确将标题页、议程页、过渡页等非教学页"零预算化"，对复杂图示类内容生成高保真、答案有可见证据锚定的问题，并保持整体问题脚手架的逻辑递进。
AI.motivation: 自动问题生成（AQG）传统上以纯文本为输入，用 NLP 把陈述句转为疑问句；但现代教学幻灯片本质上是多模态的，关键语义大量存在于图表、示意图、复杂版式与公式中，纯文本生成模型难以理解；同时，教学上有价值的提问必须跨页"搭建脚手架"（scaffolding），而逐页孤立生成无法体现讲义的叙事流与章节结构。此外，底层模型的上下文窗口限制，使得整份讲义一次性处理不可行；而已有系统多采用大块分块或割裂的单页处理，依赖脆弱的 OCR，丢失叙事连贯性与依赖版式的语义。作者因此主张需要一条布局感知（layout-aware）、跨页建模、分阶段精修的流水线，以同时缓解上下文长度限制、模态失焦与冗余覆盖失衡三个问题。研究以三个研究问题组织：RQ1 多阶段重叠窗口流水线相对朴素逐页生成在教学脚手架上的改进幅度；RQ2 显式建模幻灯片模态与角色对问题保真度（groundedness）与覆盖度的影响；RQ3 静态启发式 + 动态调和阶段能否在无需人工干预下平衡不同类型幻灯片的问题预算。
AI.method: 系统为单服务器 Python Flask 应用，含三个紧耦合组件：预处理器（基于 PyMuPDF/fitz 抽取原生文本并将每页渲染为高分辨率 PNG）、LLM 流水线引擎（经 Google GenAI SDK 调用 Gemini，多模态推理与强类型 JSON 约束）、前端 UI（原生 HTML/JS，兼作实时日志查看器与结果可视化）。数据流：用户上传 PDF 或给出 URL → 文本与图像抽取 → 窗口规划（把幻灯片按滑动窗口切分并拼接为多页接触表图像，由 LLM 推断每页标题、局部摘要、modality_type、role_in_deck、是否出题及原因、0–5 的问题预算与问题类型配比）→ 整体合成（合并重叠窗口分析，保守消解冲突，推断 deck 主题、目标受众、学习目标、连续章节边界；并施加静态启发式：对精确重复页与标题页零预算化）→ 幻灯片标注（对合资格页，结合局部证据与全局 deck 上下文生成问题，须严格等于给定预算、仅依赖幻灯片本身可答、答案有界且有证据锚定；MCQ 恰 4 选项，非 MCQ 选项为空）→ 调和阶段（在全 deck 视角检测跨页冗余、预算失衡、学习目标覆盖不均、章节内脚手架薄弱，输出 keep/reduce/expand/zero_out/rewrite 动作与新预算，必要时重跑标注）→ 最终 JSON 编译并流式返回客户端。核心数据结构用 Pydantic 严格类型化（SlidePlan、SlideAnnotationModel、ReconciliationModel）；所有提示词仅允许使用封闭标签词表（modality_type 7 类、role_in_deck 13 类、question_type 8 类、action 5 类），并要求"仅返回 JSON"。附录 A 给出完整输出 JSON Schema（deck_metadata、deck_analysis、reconciliation、slides 及每页 questions/evaluation 字段），附录 B 给出四阶段系统提示词原文。实验采用 cs224n-2024-lecture08-transformers 与 cs288-sp23-neural-parsing 两份讲义，覆盖标题/议程等结构页与 LSTM 双向路由、mean-pooling 聚合、span 分类等机制密集的复杂图示页。
AI.result: 多阶段流水线可靠地过滤了结构性与过渡性幻灯片，把生成注意力集中于核心教学材料：在 Self-Attention 讲义中，调和阶段正确地对管理性与过渡页执行零预算，在降低问题总量的同时保持了叙事连贯。数量上，两个讲义的 Fidelity 普遍为 5，Coverage 为 4–5，Scaffolding 为 3–5，说明生成项既是可靠的基础性核查又形成逻辑递进的序列。定性上，系统能正确解读复杂多模态图示：mean-pooling 一页生成了"Sentence encoding 如何计算"的问题并给出"取所有隐状态逐元素最大或平均"的正确答案（Fidelity 5 / Coverage 5）；Neural Constituency Parsing 一页则针对 LSTM 单元示意图生成了关于双向路由的问题，并以"盒子之间向左向右的水平箭头"作为可见证据（Fidelity 5）。这些结果表明窗口规划与调和阶段具有实质价值，且对结构性与冗余页削减预算的能力正是朴素 AQG 工具所缺失的。
AI.conclusion: slidesqaqa 证明了一条结构化的四阶段多模态问题生成路线是可行的：把幻灯片切块为视觉接触表以保留过渡上下文，并以类型校验的 LLM 生成显著提升结构分析与教学性产出的质量，且通过在 deck 层面重写草稿标注来降低冗余、改善覆盖。作者同时明确列出局限：多遍架构导致大讲义推理延迟与 API 成本高昂；依赖专有模型 Gemini 带来复现性与长期稳定性风险；评测规模小（仅两个技术讲义），自评分数由系统自身给出，缺乏与人工编写问题集的对照与外部指标验证。未来工作包括与人工问题集的全面对照评测、延迟优化、以及为窗口规划阶段探索微调的小模型。作者声明无外部资助、无利益冲突，写作过程中使用了 Gemini Pro 3.1、Google Jules 与 ChatGPT 5.4 辅助代码与文稿并自行审校。

title: Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations via forward-pass clipping, and (ii)catastrophic forgetting, where an aggressive learning rate overwrites pretrained commonsense knowledge independently of quantization. Neither is detectable from training loss alone. We address amax saturation with a conservative max-algorithm DTS strategy over a 64-step history window, and mitigate forgetting via a 500-step BF16 warmup followed by QAT at lr=10^{-5}. Both fixes are necessary and sufficient: our final configuration achieves 0.43% MMLU drop, 0.58% HellaSwag drop, and 0.22% ARC-Challenge drop versus a matched BF16 baseline, with a training loss APE of only 0.11% over 10,000 steps.

AI.tldr: 针对HiF8 W8A8量化感知训练中两类隐性失效模式（amax饱和与灾难性遗忘）进行系统诊断，提出保守DTS策略与BF16预热相结合的解决方案，实现精度损失控制在0.5%以内。
AI.motivation: 低比特浮点格式量化感知训练（HiF8 W8A8 QAT）在高效部署LLM时存在隐性失效模式，这些问题无法被标准训练指标检测到。
AI.method: 通过8组对照实验，系统分离两类失效模式；采用保守DTS策略（64步历史窗口）和BF16 500步预热结合QAT（lr=10^{-5}）的复合方案。
AI.result: 成功将MMLU、HellaSwag和ARC-Challenge的精度下降分别控制在0.43%、0.58%和0.22%，训练损失APE为0.11%。
AI.conclusion: 结合两种策略（64步保守DTS和500步BF16预热），最终配置将MMLU下降控制在0.43%，HellaSwag下降0.58%，ARC-Challenge下降0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%，验证了方法的有效性。

title: TrajAudit: Automated Failure Diagnosis for Agentic Coding Systems
summary:
Agentic systems have been widely studied to automate software engineering jobs such as bug fixing. As these systems increasingly tackle complex tasks, understanding where and why they fail becomes essential for iterative refinement and operational reliability. Existing automated failure diagnosis approaches leverage task execution trajectories, yet their effectiveness degrades substantially as trajectory length and complexity increase. For repository-level coding tasks specifically, trajectories are laden with noise, such as redundant program structure and verbose code context. Moreover, these trajectories are very long, while long-context reasoning remains a known weakness of LLMs.
  To address these two challenges, we propose TrajAudit, the first failure diagnosis framework for repository-level coding trajectories. TrajAudit employs an investigator agent supported by two modules: one filters failure-irrelevant information through pattern matching and keyword detection, and the other generates a preliminary diagnosis from test failure reports as prior knowledge, helping the agent handle noisy long contexts. The investigator agent can further invoke tools to retrieve filtered content on demand, ensuring that critical information is preserved while noise is minimized. We also introduce RootSE, a benchmark of 93 real-world agentic failure instances sourced from software maintenance tasks, representing the most complex trajectory diagnosis benchmark to date. Experiments on RootSE show that TrajAudit outperforms all existing baselines by over 24.4 percentage points in localization accuracy, while reducing token consumption by at least 18%, demonstrating its practical effectiveness. We hope this work draws community attention to failure management in agentic software engineering and provides a foundational resource for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrajAudit，首个用于仓库级编码轨迹的失败诊断框架。该框架通过信息过滤和先验知识注入解决长轨迹噪声问题，实验表明其在准确率和效率上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化失败诊断方法在轨迹长度和复杂度增加时效果显著下降。仓库级编码任务轨迹充满噪声（冗余程序结构、冗长代码上下文），且轨迹非常长，而长上下文推理正是LLM的已知弱点。
AI.method: TrajAudit框架包含一个调查员智能体(investigator agent)，配备两个核心模块：(1)通过模式匹配和关键词检测过滤失败无关信息；(2)从测试失败报告中生成初步诊断作为先验知识。调查员智能体还可按需调用工具检索过滤后的内容，保留关键信息同时最小化噪声。
AI.result: 在RootSE基准测试上，TrajAudit在定位准确率上超过所有基线方法24.4个百分点以上，同时将token消耗降低至少18%。
AI.conclusion: TrajAudit demonstrates practical effectiveness for failure diagnosis in agentic software engineering, outperforming baselines while reducing token consumption. The work draws community attention to failure management in agentic SE and provides RootSE as a foundational resource for future research.

title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables, working in progress
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on reusable skills to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill creation approaches treat skills as isolated and static artifacts, limiting their reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement. We propose MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that lets agents continuously improve their task-solving capability by creating, reusing, and refining skills under a unified lifecycle (creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement). Our framework enables agents to create skills on demand, store and reuse them across tasks, organize and select them efficiently, and evaluate them through unit tests and runtime feedback for continuous refinement. We further introduce skill-level memory that accumulates experience for each skill across tasks, enabling more effective reuse and adaptation over time. Experiments on SkillsBench provide initial evidence that lifecycle-managed skills can improve task success, efficiency, reuse, and cross-agent transfer, highlighting the importance of treating skills as long-lived, experience-aware, and testable assets.

AI.tldr: MUSE-Autoskill 提出"统一技能生命周期"（创建—记忆—管理—评估—精化）的免训练智能体框架：内置 skill_create 工具把技能生成嵌入 ReAct 运行时循环以消除"创建—使用脱节"，每个技能配 .memory.md 技能级记忆跨任务累积经验，单元测试+沙箱/运行时反馈驱动评估与自动精化，并用会话 DAG 上的两级自适应上下文压缩支持长程任务。在统一 GPT-5.5 骨干下对比 Hermes / Codex / Claude Code，SkillsBench 75 任务×5 次共 375 次运行中取得最高无技能 46.95%、人类技能 59.67%、自建技能 53.42%；覆盖子集上自建技能 85.24% 超过人类技能 81.17%；生成技能迁移至 Hermes 达 51.90%，高于 Hermes 使用人类技能（48.02%）；SkillLearnBench 100 实例上 72.0%/48.0% 均领先。
AI.motivation: 现有自动技能合成方法（Voyager、AutoSkill、EvoSkill、SkillGen、Skill1、SkillOS、Anthropic Agent Skills 等）仅覆盖生命周期的部分环节，存在四类工程缺口：(i) 创建—使用错配——技能在缺乏智能体运行时上下文的情况下离线生成；(ii) 缺少结构化的"逐技能记忆"，无法跨任务沉淀单个技能的自由形式经验；(iii) 技能静态且未经验证，缺少单元测试驱动的评估与精化；(iv) 上下文处理粗糙，长程任务中扁平对话历史被截断或溢出。作者主张技能不应是一次性生成产物，而应是"长期存续、持续演化、可测试"的能力资产，并在统一生命周期框架内管理。
AI.method: 框架层面：MUSE-Autoskill 遵循 Planning–Action–Observation 的 ReAct 循环（沿用 ReAct 结构），核心组件包括：(1) 内置 skill_create 技能，按"生成 SKILL.md 接口→规划内部结构→生成文件"的流水线在运行时按需造技能，create→evaluate→register 闭环，注册前在沙箱跑 tests/，失败则用 update_skill 打补丁重试；(2) 三级记忆：技能级 .memory.md（逐技能经验、失败模式、格式怪癖）、短期记忆（任务内上下文，自适应压缩）、长期记忆（跨会话持久笔记，不压缩）；(3) 技能管理：基于 SKILL.md 元数据（name/description/inputs/outputs）建立目录，采用 Anthropic Agent Skills 的渐进披露模式（仅目录注入系统提示，正文经 read_skill 按需加载，100 技能目录约 5–10K token），并支持精化、合并、剪枝；(4) 评估子系统：代码型技能用单元测试，文本型或无测试技能用沙箱执行、源轨迹检查与运行时反馈作弱信号；(5) 上下文管理：以会话节点 DAG 表示对话，节点含可变 parent_id 与不可变 history_prev/history_next 两套指针，Level-1 单节点重写（阈值 15K token）、Level-2 中段合并为合成摘要节点（总阈值 180K），首尾各 5 轮始终保留原文，原始历史不修改以支持跨会话恢复与回放；(6) 技能包遵循 Anthropic Agent Skills 目录规范（SKILL.md + scripts/ + tests/ + resources/ + references/），纯文本、可版本化。实验层面：四个智能体（Hermes、Codex、Claude Code、MUSE）共享同一 GPT-5.5 部署 gpt-5.5-2026-04-24；基准为 SkillsBench 75 任务公共集（375 次运行，Docker 隔离 + 自动验证器）与 SkillLearnBench 20 任务/100 实例；自建技能采用两阶段协议（Phase 1 无技能求解并蒸馏，Phase 2 注回重评 5 次），未覆盖任务按 0 计入全任务分母；另做跨智能体技能迁移、记忆系统开关消融、稳定性与成本分析、FDABench 补充评测。
