AI.result: SkillsBench（严格 75×5 分母）：MUSE 无技能 46.95%、人类技能 59.67%（+12.72pp）、自建技能 53.42%，均优于 Codex（44.80/57.58/47.52）、Claude Code（42.43/56.15/44.27）、Hermes（37.24/48.02）；人类技能使四个智能体提升 +10.78~+13.73pp。域级上 MUSE 在 4 个超级域中的 3 个（科学与工程 67.97%、文档处理 74.29%、运维与规划 51.40%）领先，数据分析由 Claude Code 领先。覆盖子集：MUSE 自建技能 85.24% > 人类技能同子集 81.17%，Codex 75.83%、Claude Code 75.45%；瓶颈在覆盖率——MUSE/Codex 覆盖 47/75、Claude Code 44/75，未覆盖任务按 0 计。跨智能体迁移（注入 Hermes）：MUSE 生成技能使 Hermes 达 51.90%（+14.66pp），超过 Hermes 用人类技能（48.02%）；Claude Code 生成技能 45.97%（+8.73pp）；Codex 生成技能 37.01%（−0.23pp，无提升）。稳定性：MUSE 逐任务奖励标准差均值 0.109、MAD 0.096，优于 Codex（0.124/0.110）与 Claude Code（0.182/0.160），非恒定任务最少（13/47）。成本：MUSE 一次性造技能最低（364K token、156.3s、6 轮），自建技能复用时 499K token/434.7s，较人类技能每次复用约省 139K token 与 321s，token 约 3 次复用、时延 1 次复用即回本；人类技能对全部智能体在提高奖励的同时降低中位时延（Codex 1013.6→869.5s，MUSE 747.6→730.8s），但 turn 数未一致下降。记忆消融（SkillLearnBench 双轮验证器反馈）：开启记忆后 round-1 由 48%→64%、round-2 由 60%→74%（+14pp），且 round-1 token/turn/时延均下降。技能解剖：MUSE 生成的 SKILL.md 中位 310 行（人类 165、Codex 128、Claude Code 89），90% 为纯 SKILL.md 自包含包，且是唯一生成 tests/ 包的群体（8%）。案例：adaptive-cruise-control（PID 控制器）20%→100%、flink-query（Flink 会话化作业）20%→100%、weighted-gdp-calc（Excel SUMPRODUCT）20%→100%，且前三者均可指导 Hermes 复现同一流程；回归案例 hvac-control 由 80% 降至 20%，因技能固化了源轨迹的校准窗口与增益估计假设。人工审计 50 个 MUSE 技能包未发现硬编码验证器输出或读取答案文件。补充评测 FDABench：单选 74.10% EX、多选 49.70% EX、报告 85.20% RS。
AI.conclusion: 技能应作为"长期存续、经验感知、可测试"的一等资产被管理，而非一次性生成输出。MUSE-Autoskill 在统一免训练框架内覆盖创建、记忆、管理、评估、精化五阶段，配套的技能级记忆、单元测试驱动评估与跨智能体技能迁移是相对现有工作的主要增量；实验表明生命周期管理的技能在准确率、效率、复用与迁移上均优于静态技能方案，且自建技能在覆盖子集上可超过人类撰写技能，同时生成技能还能迁移到其他智能体运行时并超越其人类技能基线。论文明确指出局限：仅评测 75/94 个 SkillsBench 任务、自建技能覆盖不完整（47/75）、每个技能仅由单条成功轨迹蒸馏且在同一任务上复评可能高估增益、迁移仅验证到 Hermes、每任务 5 次运行置信区间较宽、token 统计不完整，以及生成技能存在幻觉与源轨迹过拟合风险（hvac-control 案例），高影响部署需更强的溯源、对抗测试与人工审核。后续工作应聚焦提升 Phase 1 源轨迹覆盖率、从失败轨迹中提取部分诊断性技能，并完善跨智能体的全对全迁移评测。

title: Evidence Absence Is Not Evidence Insufficiency: Diagnosing NEI Construction Artifacts in Fact Verification
summary: Evidence absence is not evidence insufficiency, but fact verification benchmarks can make them observationally similar. The Not Enough Information (NEI) label is often operationalized through different evidence conditions, and that choice silently determines what a verifier learns and what its score can hide. We introduce NEI-CAP, a construction-aware diagnostic protocol for insufficient-evidence evaluation. Each NEI example carries the construction family that produced it; NEI-CAP audits shortcut cues, validates hard cases through human adjudication, and tests whether competence transfers across constructions. We instantiate the protocol in SciFact-style scientific verification, with FEVER and HoVer as bounded external controls. Across these settings, NEI competence does not transfer reliably: models trained on shortcut-prone constructions fail to recognize semantically related insufficient evidence, and mixed-construction training narrows but does not close the gap. Fixed-claim diagnostics further show that the evidence condition shifts confidence in the reference Support/Refute label, not only NEI recall, so an aggregate NEI score can hide which problem a model has actually solved.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NEI-CAP诊断协议，针对事实验证中NEI（信息不足）标签操作化问题，指出当前基准的证据条件选择会影响模型学习内容和得分解释。研究发现NEI能力在跨构造场景下无法可靠迁移，聚合的NEI分数可能掩盖模型实际解决的问题。
AI.motivation: NEI标签在事实验证基准中通过不同证据条件进行操作化，但证据条件的选择会悄无声息地决定验证器学习内容和得分可隐藏的问题。当前基准使证据缺失与证据不足在观测上难以区分。
AI.method: NEI-CAP：一种构造感知的诊断协议，为每个NEI样本携带构造家族标签，通过快捷线索审计、人类裁决验证硬案例、测试构造间能力迁移。
AI.result: 在SciFact风格科学验证中，FEVER和HoVer作为外部对照实验表明：NEI能力无法跨构造可靠迁移；基于捷径构造训练的模型无法识别语义相关的证据不足情况；混合构造训练可缩小但未能弥合差距；固定声明诊断显示证据条件不仅影响NEI召回率，还影响参考Support/Refute标签的置信度。
AI.conclusion: NEI能力无法在不同构造间可靠迁移，基于捷径构造训练的模型无法识别语义相关的证据不足情况，混合构造训练可缩小但无法弥合差距。聚合的NEI得分可能掩盖模型实际解决的问题类型。

title: Exploiting Local Dynamics Regularity for Reusable Skills in Offline Hierarchical RL
summary: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) promises to solve long-horizon Reinforcement Learning (RL) tasks more efficiently than non-hierarchical counterparts by discovering and reusing temporally-extended skills. However, obtaining skills that are actually reusable remains an open challenge. Towards this end, we focus on abstractions that exploit the intuition of local dynamics: local transitions in different global contexts require similar kinds of action sequences. By aligning these contexts with the action sequences they require, we are able to learn which skills to reuse and where to reuse them. In principle, this information should benefit many HRL algorithms, where high-level policies have to reason about the low-level skills they use. The resulting algorithm CARL (Contrastive Action-based Representations for Reusable Local Control) shows both qualitative clustering of meaningful skills in complex humanoid environments and improved downstream performance on the OGBench benchmark when integrated with HIQL.

AI.tldr: CARL通过对比学习对齐上下文与动作序列，利用局部动态一致性发现可复用技能，在OGBench基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: HRL通过发现和复用时间扩展技能来解决长horizon任务，但如何获得真正可复用的技能仍是开放问题。核心假设是不同全局上下文中的局部转移需要相似的动作序列——即局部动态一致性。
AI.method: 提出CARL算法，利用对比学习框架学习基于动作的表示，将具有相似局部动态的不同全局上下文与相应的动作序列对齐，从而识别可复用的技能及其适用场景。该表示可与HIQL等现有HRL算法集成。
AI.result: 在复杂人形环境中展示了有意义的技能聚类定性效果；在OGBench基准上与HIQL集成后实现显著的下游性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CARL通过对比动作表示学习可复用的局部控制技能，证明了局部动态一致性可以作为HRL中技能发现的的有效信号。该方法在OGBench基准上与HIQL集成后显著提升了下游性能，同时在复杂人形环境中产生了有意义的技能聚类。

title: Probing Minimalist Phase Structure in LLMs: What Universal Dependencies Cannot Represent
summary:
Structural probes train on Universal Dependencies (UD), which does not encode formal-syntactic abstractions such as phase boundaries or phase-internal cohesion. Whether large language models (LLMs) encode these remains an open question that UD-based probing cannot answer by construction. We evaluate structural probes on wh-movement stimuli where UD distances are invariant across conditions by design -- any non-zero effect therefore reflects structure beyond UD. The three conditions -- bare small clause, infinitival, and finite -- are ordered by the number of Minimalist Program (MP) phase boundaries the wh-element crosses.
  Across 13 LLMs from four families, we find a phase-count gradient on a cross-clause pair (12/13 models) and a 13/13 sign asymmetry on a within-clause pair whose UD distance is identical across conditions -- the latter specifically predicted by phase-internal cohesion, an MP abstraction invisible to UD by construction. Activation patching confirms the representations are causally active in 12/13 models. These findings suggest that distributional pretraining can induce representations aligned with formal-syntactic abstractions beyond the reach of annotation-based probing; UD-grounded probes provide a lower bound on syntactic encoding, not an upper bound.

AI.tldr: 研究挑战了当前结构探测范式的局限性：基于通用依赖(UD)的探测仅能测量UD可标注的结构，无法探查更抽象的形式句法概念如相位边界。研究通过设计wh-移动刺激材料，在UD距离保持恒定的条件下测试13个LLM，发现模型确实编码了UD不可见的相位边界和相位内部凝聚等抽象结构，且激活修补证实了这些表示具有因果活性。这表明UDgrounded探测提供的是句法编码的下界而非上界。
AI.motivation: 当前结构探测范式依赖Universal Dependencies (UD)标注，但UD不编码形式句法抽象（如相位边界、相位内部凝聚）。这意味着基于UD的探测无法回答LLM是否编码这些更抽象结构的问题——这是方法论上的根本局限。
AI.method: 设计wh-移动刺激材料，三种条件（裸小句、不定式、限定从句）按wh元素穿越的极简主义程序(MP)相位边界数量排序；通过结构探针评估13个来自4个家族的LLM；在UD距离不变的条件对之间比较，发现非零效应即反映UD之外的结构。
AI.result: 13个模型中12个出现跨从句的相位计数梯度，13个模型全部出现从句内条件对的符号不对称性（仅由相位内部凝聚预测，UD本质不可见）；激活修补确认12/13模型的表示具有因果活性。
AI.conclusion: 分布式预训练可诱导与形式句法抽象对齐的表示；UD-grounded探测提供句法编码的下界而非上界；未来需设计不依赖特定标注体系的探测范式以探查更深层的句法表征。

title: HRVConformer: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Classification from the Heart Rate signals
comment: Paper submitted to Journal of Engineering Applications of Artifical Intelligence
summary: This paper presents the HRVConformer, a novel deep learning architecture for the classification of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using the instantaneous heart rate (HR) signal. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on handcrafted features, HRVConformer directly processes raw HR signals in an end-to-end manner, capturing both local and long-range dependencies through a hybrid Convolution-Transformer framework. By integrating convolutional layers for local feature extraction and Transformer-based attention mechanisms for global context modelling, the architecture effectively enhances signal representation and classification performance. The model was trained using supervised learning on a large HR dataset consisting of 1,573 one-hour epochs, including 259 one-hour expert-annotated epochs and a substantial set of weakly labelled data. A 314-hour validation set provided a robust performance estimation, while an independent 215-hour dataset with expert annotations was reserved for final testing. HR signals were extracted from electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings using an improved Pan-Tompkins algorithm, which significantly enhanced both signal quality and data availability. Experimental results demonstrate that the HRVConformer achieves an AUC of 83.23\% and accuracy of 74.56\% on the test set. These results surpass the performance of the Transformer, ResNet50 and fully convolutional networks baselines, highlighting the advantages of integrating convolutional and Transformer-based components for HR-based HIE classification. The proposed method provides a promising step toward a more accurate and automated assessment of HIE using HR signals. The code is available at: https://github.com/syu-kylin/HRVConformer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HRVConformer，一种混合卷积-Transformer架构，直接从新生儿瞬时心率（HR/RR间期）原始信号端到端分类缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE），无需手工特征；同时提出改进的Pan-Tompkins算法以提升噪声ECG的心率提取质量。测试集AUC 83.23%、准确率74.56%，优于Transformer、ResNet50和FCN基线。
AI.motivation: 新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）死亡率高、需在6小时内启动治疗性低温。EEG虽是脑损伤评估金标准，但并非所有临床环境可及；心率变异性（HRV）反映自主神经系统功能，是非侵入、实时可及的替代生物标志物，既往研究已证实HIE婴儿HRV显著降低且抑制程度与脑损伤严重度相关，但现有研究依赖手工HRV特征（时域/频域/复杂度域指标）结合统计/逻辑回归，尚无标准化深度学习方法从原始心率信号直接验证该关联，也缺少大规模标注的HR数据。
AI.method: 1）数据：ANSeR1/ANSeR2两项多中心队列（8家欧洲NICU，472例入组、284例HIE），最终181例纳入分析，按出生后6/12/24/36/48小时提取1小时epoch，由神经生理学专家依据cEEG将HIE分为五级并二值化（正常+轻度→类0无需TH；中度/重度/无活动→类1需TH）；依据相邻强标签插值规则生成弱标签epoch（ANSeR2共1316个），构成强监督+弱监督训练数据。2）改进Pan-Tompkins：预处理加入极性校正与4–30 Hz带通（适配足月新生儿）、决策阶段优化阈值初始化/重置（>1.4 s无RR即重置）、忽略近零ECG段、用带通信号替代原始信号做search-back回溯定位R峰；后处理新增伪迹校正（RR≤0.2 s及0.2–2 s异常值用滑动平均替换；2–10 s长间期用带通信号潜在峰重建，剔除<0.6倍全局均值RR的重建；>10 s标记剔除）。3）预处理：按异常长间期切分长段→线性插值256 Hz→三次样条插值至4 Hz→切为重叠80%的5分钟窗→样本级噪声剔除（标准差>0.12）、剔除有效窗<10的epoch→5/95百分位min-max归一化。4）模型：5分钟RR序列切为25 s patch，线性嵌入为144维、3层Conformer编码器（相对位置编码、卷积模块含点卷积+GLU+1D深度卷积+BN+SiLU、前后两个半步FFN残差、MHSA）、FCN分类头；后处理按1小时epoch对样本预测做多数投票定类、概率平均算epoch级AUC。5）训练：ANSeR2共1573 epoch（1259训练/314验证），ANSeR1的215 epoch为独立测试；AdamW、余弦warmup调度、label smoothing、dropout 0.3、weight decay 0.1、早停；基线为HRVTransformer、HRVRes50、FCN19，10次随机实验取均值±标准差；并做组件/patch大小/归一化/深度宽度头数/kernel等消融、注意力rollout可视化、注意力距离与熵分析、数据量缩放实验。
AI.result: 1）改进Pan-Tompkins显著提升数据可用性：噪声剔除后标准算法仅保留ANSeR1 127 h/ANSeR2 159 h，改进版保留215 h/251 h；以16项HRV特征训练随机森林，改进版HR数据在训练/测试AUC与准确率上均明显优于标准版。2）HRVConformer测试集AUC 0.8323±0.010、准确率0.7456±0.016，验证AUC 0.9524；HRVTransformer（AUC 0.8133）、FCN19（0.7996）、HRVRes50（0.7796）均低于融合模型；10次集成ROC曲线同样以HRVConformer最优。3）消融：去掉半步FFN与卷积模块分别降0.75%与0.97%测试AUC；去除/替换位置编码不降反略升，固定sin-cos编码显著恶化（0.7699/0.7482）；patch 25 s最佳（5 s最差0.7735）；min-max归一化优于z-score（0.7915）；FCN分类头优于class token与global pooling；深度增至5块（0.8364）、宽度192（0.8373）、kernel 5–7带来小幅提升；注意力rollout显示模型聚焦于RR动力学异常段；HRVConformer注意力距离更宽、注意力熵跨层跨头更具多样性，而HRVTransformer存在注意力冗余；数据量≥60%后HRVConformer缩放趋势最强。
AI.conclusion: HRVConformer是首个直接从原始瞬时心率信号端到端分类新生儿HIE的深度学习框架，混合卷积-Transformer结构在捕捉局部与长程依赖上优于纯Transformer与纯卷积网络；改进Pan-Tompkins算法大幅提升噪声ECG下HR信号的质量与覆盖率，为大规模HRV分析奠定基础；HRV凭实时、非侵入特性有潜力作为NICU中EEG的补充模态，用于更早检测、预后与个体化治疗。局限性：训练数据量有限未充分发挥模型潜力；强标签全部来自单一专家存在主观偏差，弱标签由强标签派生，单一错误可传播至5–11个epoch；训练中验证损失持续上升而准确率稳定，提示模型置信度与噪声标签间不一致，凸显高质量标注的重要性。

title: Energy-Aware Decision Making in Software Stack Upgrades
comment: to be published in the Journal of Systems and Software
summary: Software stack upgrades are a routine part of software maintenance and evolution, typically motivated by improved performance, stability, or functionality. Yet their impact on energy consumption - a growing concern for organizations pursuing sustainability - remains poorly understood. This paper presents a systematic method for measuring how different versions of core software stack components, such as Spring Boot and the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), influence the energy consumption of applications. Our approach evaluates combinations of framework versions, runtime versions, and execution platforms through automated benchmarking. Using a case study based on the Spring Petclinic REST application, we show that energy consumption varies substantially across Spring Boot and JVM versions, in some cases producing unexpected regressions. Notably, newer JVM releases and virtual threads (introduced in Java 21 and 23) yielded significant energy savings without requiring application changes. These results demonstrate that software upgrades can meaningfully affect energy usage and that measuring energy consumption provides valuable evidence for decision making in software maintenance and evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种系统化方法，通过自动化基准测试测量Spring Boot和JVM等核心软件组件不同版本对应用能耗的影响；研究发现能耗在不同版本间差异显著，较新JVM版本和虚拟线程可带来显著节能，表明软件升级决策应纳入能耗考量。
AI.motivation: 软件栈升级虽常见，但升级对能耗的影响尚不清晰，而能耗正成为组织追求可持续发展的关注重点。
AI.method: 通过自动化基准测试评估框架版本、运行时版本和执行平台的组合，使用Spring Petclinic REST应用作为案例研究。
AI.result: Spring Boot和JVM版本间的能耗存在显著差异，部分情况下出现意外的能耗回退；较新的JVM版本和虚拟线程（Java 21和23引入）带来显著节能，无需修改应用代码。
AI.conclusion: 软件升级会对能耗产生实质影响，能耗测量为软件维护和演进的决策提供了有价值的数据支撑；组织在进行软件栈升级时，应将能耗纳入评估维度。

title: Large Language Model-Powered Query-Driven Event Timeline Summarization in Industrial Search
summary: Understanding how events evolve over time is essential for search engines handling queries about trending news. We present QDET (Query-Driven Event Timeline Summarization), a production system deployed on Baidu Search that constructs focused event timelines to explain specific query events. Unlike traditional topic-centric approaches that aim for comprehensive coverage, QDET identifies and organizes sub-events closely relevant to the query from noisy candidate sets formed by millions of documents retrieved daily. QDET incorporates two key innovations: (1) multi-task supervised fine-tuning with three auxiliary tasks-temporal ordering, causal judgment, and timeline completion-that enable compact models to match the performance of much larger general-purpose models in specialized domains; (2) reinforcement learning-based event concise summarization that enforces strict length constraints while maintaining semantic quality, achieving 88.2% length compliance and outperforming 671B-scale models by 7.7 points in constraint satisfaction. Our fine-tuned 7B parameter model achieves 76.2% F1 score on timeline summarization, slightly surpassing the zero-shot performance of DeepSeek-R1-671B (76.1% F1) while using only 1% of its parameters-demonstrating that domain-specific optimization enables production-ready models with comparable quality at drastically reduced computational costs. Online A/B tests on Baidu Search validate real-world effectiveness, showing 5.5% CTR improvement, 4.6% longer dwell time, and 4.4% deeper exploration compared to single-task baselines. We further demonstrate that timeline understanding transfers to heat prediction, confirming effective knowledge transfer to downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: QDET是部署在百度搜索的生产系统，通过多任务微调和强化学习实现高效的时间线摘要。7B参数模型性能媲美671B模型，参数用量仅1%，在线实验验证了其在点击率、停留时间和用户深度探索等方面的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 搜索引擎处理趋势新闻查询时，需要理解事件随时间的演变过程。传统以话题为中心的方法追求全面覆盖，但在处理每日数百万文档检索形成的嘈杂候选集时，难以有效识别和组织与查询密切相关的事件子集。
AI.method: (1) 多任务监督微调：引入时间排序、因果判断和时间线补全三个辅助任务，使紧凑模型在专业领域匹配更大通用模型的性能；(2) 强化学习事件简洁摘要：强制执行严格长度约束同时保持语义质量；(3) 使用7B参数模型，通过领域特定优化达到与671B规模模型相当的性能。
AI.result: 微调的7B参数模型在时间线摘要任务上达到76.2% F1分数，略超DeepSeek-R1-671B零样本性能(76.1% F1)；强化学习方法达到88.2%长度合规率，在约束满足方面优于671B规模模型7.7个百分点；在线A/B测试显示CTR提升5.5%、停留时间延长4.6%、深度探索增加4.4%。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定优化使生产级模型能在大幅降低计算成本的情况下达到可比的性能水平。QDET已验证在线A/B测试效果，并展示了时间线理解能力可迁移到热度预测等下游任务。

title: Advancing Creative Physical Intelligence in Large Multimodal Models
comment: 51 Pages, 9 Figures, 7 Tables, Previous Work CreativityBench: arXiv:2605.02910
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have rapidly advanced in perception and reasoning; however, it remains unclear whether these capabilities generalize to discovering visually grounded solutions in open-ended environments, beyond pattern recognition. In such settings, intelligence requires more than answering well-posed questions: it involves identifying how elements in a scene can be repurposed in non-obvious yet physically feasible ways. This form of creative problem-solving is central to human intelligence, but remains largely untested in current benchmarks. To evaluate this ability, we introduce MM-CreativityBench, a benchmark for affordance-grounded creative tool use in visually rich, physically constrained environments. Each instance presents a scenario image with structured views of candidate entities and their parts, enabling fine-grained, interactive evaluation of how models iteratively inspect the scene, identify relevant affordances, and compose visually and physically grounded solutions. Our experiments show that current LMMs often fall short, not due to lack of generative capability, but because they do not sustain grounded exploration. Models often overlook relevant entities, under-examine critical parts, or hallucinate attributes not grounded in the image. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose affordance-grounded alignment, which casts creative tool use as a preference learning problem. Using Direct Preference Optimization, we encourage models to prefer attribute-affordance reasoning grounded in visual evidence over hallucinated alternatives. In addition, we incorporate supervision derived from an affordance knowledge base to guide broader entity exploration and multi-turn planning. Our results show consistent gains in selecting the correct entities and parts, while substantially reducing hallucination and grounding-related errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MM-CreativityBench 基准评估多模态大模型的创造性工具使用能力，揭示了当前模型在 grounded 探索上的不足，并通过 DPO 偏好学习和 affordance 知识库监督提出有效的改进方案。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在感知推理上进展迅速，但缺乏对开放式环境中视觉 grounded 创造性问题解决能力的评估，这种能力是人类智能的核心。
AI.method: 提出 MM-CreativityBench 基准测试评估 affordance-grounded 创造性工具使用；提出 Affordance-Grounded Alignment 方法，采用 DPO 进行偏好学习，鼓励模型基于视觉证据推理，并引入 affordance 知识库监督引导实体探索和多轮规划。
AI.result: 当前 LMMs 存在遗漏实体、检查不充分、幻觉等问题；所提方法在实体/部件选择准确性上一致提升，显著减少幻觉和 grounding 错误。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉 grounded 推理纳入偏好学习框架，并利用 affordance 知识库提供结构化监督，可有效提升模型在创造性场景中的 grounded 探索能力。

title: Vectors Are Not Neutral: Sensitive-Information Inference from Exported LLM Representations in Summarization
summary: Large language model (LLM) summarization systems may pass compact vector representations of private inputs to downstream retrieval, monitoring, audit, or analytic workflows. Even when source documents remain access-restricted, derived vectors may be handled under different access controls and still support sensitive-information inference, creating a residual information-disclosure risk. We study this issue in clinical discharge-summary generation as a high-stakes case study, using electronic health record (EHR)-recorded race as a controlled sensitive-label audit. We audit two artifacts that a system might retain or expose to downstream components: the final prompt-token hidden state and the mean-pooled prompt representation. Our results show that reducing recoverability of the case-study sensitive label from one exported artifact does not necessarily reduce recoverability from another. As a mitigation case study, we introduce SurfaceLoRA, an exported-vector-targeted parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that uses a gradient-reversal discriminator attached to a designated exported vector. Under a balanced five-way probing protocol, SurfaceLoRA reduces EHR-recorded race recoverability from the targeted final-token artifact toward chance while preserving summarization utility, yet recoverability remains substantially higher from untargeted pooled artifacts. These findings show that privacy auditing and mitigation should be performed on the exact vector artifact retained or exposed to downstream components.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了LLM导出向量中的隐私泄露风险——即使源文档受保护，派生向量仍可推断敏感信息。研究提出SurfaceLoRA方法通过梯度反转微调降低特定向量上的敏感标签可恢复性，但关键发现是：不同导出向量需分别进行隐私审计和防护，因为降低一个工件的可恢复性不等于降低所有工件。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)摘要系统可能将私有输入的紧凑向量表示传递给下游的检索、监控、审计或分析工作流。即使源文档受访问限制，派生向量可能在不同访问控制下被处理，仍可能支持敏感信息推断，存在残余信息泄露风险。
AI.method: 使用EHR记录的种族作为受控敏感标签审计，采用平衡五分类探测协议评估两种导出向量（最终token隐藏状态和均值池化提示表示）的敏感标签可恢复性。提出SurfaceLoRA方法——一种基于梯度反转判别器的参数高效微调方法，针对指定导出向量进行隐私保护。
AI.result: SurfaceLoRA在保持摘要实用性的同时，将目标最终token工件上EHR记录种族的可恢复性降低至接近随机水平，但非目标的池化工件上可恢复性仍然显著较高。表明减少一个导出工件的可恢复性并不必然减少另一个的可恢复性。
AI.conclusion: 隐私审计和缓解措施应在确切的向量工件上进行，而非假设不同导出向量之间的可恢复性会同步降低。SurfaceLoRA等针对性微调方法可有效降低特定导出向量上的敏感信息泄露风险，但需根据具体暴露的工件设计防护策略。

title: Modeling Dynamic Mixtures of Time-Delay Systems from Streaming Time Series
summary: This research addresses the problem of adaptive modeling in time-series data streams with clear input-output relationships. This problem is challenging because rapid system changes (regime shifts) caused by environmental factors or input delay changes degrade model performance, and the trade-off among accuracy, robustness, and memory usage arises when using multiple small models for each time-series pattern. To address these issues, this paper presents an online framework/method that treats streaming time series as dynamic mixtures of time-delay systems. This framework maintains robustness of model tracking and reduces memory usage by summarizing past regimes using a fixed-length representation that captures both the system dynamics and input-output delays. Concretely, this approach constructs a summary system tensor using the system's Markov parameter series, capturing both dynamic behavior and delay characteristics. If necessary, a tensor decomposition algorithm extracts relevant past models from the tensor and helps select the system that best fits the current regime. This method enables rapid adaptation to environmental changes and is computationally efficient. Tests on real datasets show that DelayMix consistently outperforms other methods, achieving superior forecast accuracy and faster adaptation to delays, especially for highly non-stationary data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DelayMix框架，将时序数据流建模为延迟系统的动态混合，通过马尔可夫参数张量总结历史状态，实现快速适应环境变化同时保持计算效率。
AI.motivation: 时序数据流中的系统变化（制度转移）和输入延迟变化会显著降低模型性能，多个小模型组合时存在准确性、鲁棒性和内存使用的权衡问题。
AI.method: 将流式时序数据建模为延迟系统的动态混合；利用马尔可夫参数序列构建摘要系统张量，捕捉系统动态和输入输出延迟特性；通过张量分解算法提取相关历史模型，选择最适配当前制度的系统。
AI.result: DelayMix在真实数据集上一致优于对比方法，实现了更高的预测精度和更快的延迟适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效应对非平稳环境的快速变化，在保持低内存消耗的同时实现鲁棒跟踪。

title: Software Engineering Podcasts: An Empirical Study of Their Potential as a Research Resource
summary: Podcasts have become an increasingly popular medium for knowledge sharing within the software engineering (SE) community, offering insights into industry developments and the perspectives of professionals with different backgrounds. As this medium grows, it presents a potentially valuable resource not only for practitioners but also for researchers seeking to understand the evolving field. However, little is known about the actual content of SE podcasts or how they are perceived and used by researchers. This study systematically explores the SE podcast landscape, analyzing its content and surveying researchers to assess how podcasts can serve as a meaningful resource for advancing empirical software engineering research.

AI.tldr: 研究系统性地探索软件工程播客领域，分析其内容，并对研究人员进行调查，以评估播客作为推进实证软件工程研究的资源价值。
AI.motivation: 播客在软件工程社区中日益流行，但目前对SE播客的实际内容以及研究人员如何看待和使用它们知之甚少，亟需系统性的了解。
AI.method: 系统性地分析SE播客内容，并对研究人员进行调查。
AI.result: 分析SE播客景观，评估其作为研究资源的潜力。
AI.conclusion: SE播客不仅是从业者的有价值资源，也可能成为研究人员理解该领域演变的有效工具。

title: GraphReview: Scientific Paper Evaluation via LLM-Based Graph Message Passing
summary: Scientific paper evaluation often involves not only assessing a manuscript itself, but also relating it to contemporaneous research and prior literature. However, existing LLM-based methods typically model these signals separately and lack a unified mechanism for propagating review evidence across papers. We propose $\textbf{GraphReview}$, a graph-based LLM framework that formulates paper evaluation as review-signal message passing over a semantic paper graph. The graph jointly captures intrinsic quality, synchronic links among contemporaneous papers, and diachronic links to prior work. LLMs are used to estimate node-level quality priors and generate edge-level comparative evidence through pairwise paper comparisons, while Personalized PageRank integrates review signals for quality ranking, decision prediction, and review generation. To produce higher-quality graph evidence, we propose reward-induced maximum likelihood objectives for training the LLM backbones. Experiments show that GraphReview consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, achieving average improvements of 29.7% on decision and ranking metrics, including gains of 23.7% in Accuracy and 57.6% in Spearman's $ρ$. It also produces higher-quality review texts and generalizes effectively across time periods and conference venues. The code is available at https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/GraphReview.

AI.tldr: GraphReview是一种基于图的LLM框架，通过语义论文图中的review信号消息传递进行论文评估，在决策预测、排序和评审生成任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的论文评估方法通常独立建模各种信号，缺乏跨论文传播review证据的统一机制。
AI.method: 提出GraphReview框架，将论文评估形式化为图上 review-signal 消息传递。构建语义论文图，联合捕捉内在质量、同期论文的同步链接和先前工作的历时链接。利用LLM估计节点级质量先验并通过成对论文比较生成边级比较证据，使用Personalized PageRank整合review信号。此外，提出reward-induced最大似然目标函数训练LLM骨干模型。
AI.result: 在决策和排序指标上平均提升29.7%（包括Accuracy提升23.7%、Spearman's ρ提升57.6%）；生成更高质量的评审文本；在时间和会议场景上具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphReview提出了一种将图结构与LLM相结合的有效范式，通过将论文评估形式化为图上的消息传递过程，实现了对论文质量的全面评估。实验结果表明该方法在决策预测、排序和评审生成等任务上均取得了显著提升，并具有良好的泛化能力。

title: When Does Deep RL Beat Calibrated Baselines? A Benchmark Study on Adaptive Resource Control
summary: A properly calibrated rule-based autoscaler can beat every one of six mainstream deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms on cost across every workload we test - so when, if ever, does DRL actually help? We study this in RLScale-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for DRL on adaptive resource control, where an agent allocates compute to a dynamic workload under cost and service-level constraints. We evaluate PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3, and DDPG under matched architectures, training budgets, and reward functions against a calibrated rule-based baseline across six workload patterns and five seeds (240 runs), instantiate the benchmark on Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling, and probe distribution-shift generalization. Three findings challenge common assumptions: (i) the calibrated controller achieves the lowest cost on all six workloads, though it trails the best RL agents on bursty and flash traffic; (ii) discrete-action algorithms outperform continuous-action ones by one to two orders of magnitude in constraint violations due to action-space mismatch; and (iii) no single algorithm dominates across workloads, with rankings shifting by up to four positions. The bottleneck in RL-based resource control is not algorithm selection but baseline calibration, reward engineering, and realistic evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明经过properly calibrated的规则基础自动扩缩器在成本上可超越所有6种主流DRL算法，核心发现是离散动作算法优于连续动作算法，且瓶颈在于基线校准和奖励工程而非算法选择本身。
AI.motivation: 研究问题：当DRL在自适应资源控制中何时真正优于规则基础的自动扩缩器？挑战DRL总是更好的常见假设。
AI.method: 在Kubernetes HPA上构建RLScale-Bench基准测试，对比6种DRL算法(PPO/DQN/A2C/SAC/TD3/DDPG)与校准规则基线，涵盖6种工作负载模式和5个随机种子(共240次实验)，并测试分布偏移泛化能力。
AI.result: 三个颠覆性发现：①校准控制器在所有工作负载上成本最低，但bursty/flash流量场景略逊于最佳RL智能体；②离散动作算法约束违规率比连续动作算法低1-2个数量级(存在动作空间不匹配问题)；③无单一算法在所有工作负载上占优，排名差异可达4位。
AI.conclusion: DRL资源控制的关键瓶颈不在于算法选择，而在于基线校准、奖励函数设计和更现实的评估协议。

title: From Static Context to Calibrated Interactive RL: Mitigating Distribution Shift in Multi-turn Dialogue with Aligned Simulator
summary: A long-standing goal of the research community is to develop highly interactive LLM-based dialogue agents. Recent research focuses on optimizing policies based on fixed offline logs (Static Context RL) or using a prompt-based simulator (Interactive RL). In this work, we theoretically show that both paradigms are fundamentally limited by context distribution shift--a mismatch between dialogue histories observed during training and those encountered in real conversations. This shift compounds quadratically over turns and severely degrades dialogue quality. Specifically, we attribute this shift to two distinct sources: (i) policy-induced shift, arising from training on static histories rather than self-generated trajectories; and (ii) simulator-induced shift, stemming from discrepancies between simulated and real human behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose Calibrated Interactive RL, a unified framework that couples interactive RL with simulator alignment. By aligning the simulator with human interaction patterns, our approach reduces the sim-to-real gap and mitigates compounding distribution shifts. Experiments across multiple dialogue tasks confirm our theoretical analysis: (i) Interactive RL significantly outperforms the Static Context baseline by mitigating policy distribution shift; and (ii) calibrating simulators with our alignment method further bridges the sim-to-real gap, yielding state-of-the-art downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 论文针对LLM对话智能体中上下文分布偏移问题进行理论分析，识别出策略诱导偏移和模拟器诱导偏移两种来源，并提出Calibrated Interactive RL统一框架，通过模拟器对齐来耦合交互式强化学习，从而缓解复合分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有两类范式（Static Context RL和Interactive RL）都受到上下文分布偏移问题的根本性限制，导致对话质量随轮次二次衰减。
AI.method: Theoretical analysis of context distribution shift; Proposes Calibrated Interactive RL framework combining interactive RL with simulator alignment to calibrate simulated behaviors with real human interaction patterns.
AI.result: 实验验证：(i) Interactive RL通过缓解策略分布偏移显著优于Static Context基线；(ii) 模拟器校准进一步缩小sim-to-real差距，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: Calibrated Interactive RL achieves state-of-the-art performance by coupling interactive RL with simulator alignment, effectively mitigating both policy-induced and simulator-induced distribution shifts.

title: Targeted Remasking: Replacing Token Editing with Token-to-Mask Refinement in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete masked diffusion language models such as LLaDA generate text through iterative denoising, where mask tokens are progressively replaced with predicted tokens. LLaDA2.1 introduced a Token-to-Token (T2T) editing mechanism that accelerates generation by directly replacing committed tokens suspected of being incorrect. However, we identify fundamental limitations of T2T editing: it couples error detection with replacement, pollutes the generation context with potentially incorrect tokens, and introduces a train-inference noise mismatch where systematic model-generated errors differ from the random perturbations seen during training. We propose Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking, a training-free, drop-in replacement for T2T editing that resets suspected erroneous tokens back to the mask state, allowing the diffusion process to re-predict them under cleaner context. We design and empirically validate three complementary error detection strategies -- probability-based, trigger-mirrored, and temporal-difference-based -- and provide a unified theoretical analysis showing that T2M remasking purifies the generation context, converts systematic inference errors back to the model's native mask noise type, and enables delayed commitment for joint multi-position optimization. Comprehensive experiments across 12 benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that T2M generally improves performance on tasks requiring precise token-level output, with the largest gain on mathematics (+5.92% on CMATH). Error analysis on CMATH reveals that the dominant failure mode is last-mile token corruption -- where correct reasoning produces a corrupted final answer -- and that T2M repairs 59.4% of such cases.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking as a training-free replacement for T2T editing in discrete diffusion language models. T2M addresses T2T's limitations by resetting erroneous tokens to mask state, allowing clean re-prediction. Across 12 benchmarks, T2M shows consistent improvements, particularly on mathematics tasks.
AI.motivation: Current T2T editing has fundamental limitations: (1) couples error detection with replacement, (2) pollutes generation context with potentially incorrect tokens, (3) introduces train-inference noise mismatch where model-generated errors differ from random training perturbations.
AI.method: Three complementary error detection strategies: probability-based, trigger-mirrored, and temporal-difference-based. T2M resets suspected erroneous tokens back to mask state for re-prediction under cleaner context.
AI.result: T2M generally improves performance on token-level precision tasks. Largest gains on mathematics (+5.92% on CMATH). 59.4% of last-mile token corruption cases (correct reasoning but corrupted final answer) are repaired.
AI.conclusion: T2M remasking purifies generation context, converts systematic errors to native mask noise, enables delayed commitment for joint multi-position optimization. Achieves +5.92% improvement on CMATH, repairs 59.4% of last-mile token corruption cases.

title: Co-folding model guided by structural proteomics
summary: Protein structure generative models excel at predicting single protein static structures from sequence, but routinely fail to capture the correct conformational state of protein complexes, critical for protein design and induced proximity modalities such as antibodies and PROTACs. While structural proteomics techniques like Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) and Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange (HDX-MS) offer valuable spatial and dynamic insights, integrating these sparse, heterogeneous measurements into these models remains an open challenge. Here, we bridge this gap by combining structural proteomics data with the rich biophysical priors learned by pretrained diffusion models. We introduce AIMS-Fold, an inference-time guided-diffusion framework that actively steers the generative sampling trajectory using differentiable physical potentials derived from XL-MS spatial restraints and HDX-MS solvent accessibility profiles. We demonstrate that these structural methods individually enhance predictive accuracy, and their integration yields synergistic improvement. Crucially, by leveraging these experimental restraints, AIMS-Fold achieves higher accuracy on challenging induced proximity targets than purely computational, unguided state-of-the-art models like Boltz-2. This establishes our framework as a powerful, integrative computational approach for the structure based drug design of induced proximity drugs. Evaluation code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: AIMS-Fold通过将结构蛋白质组学数据（XL-MS和HDX-MS）与预训练扩散模型相结合，开发了一种推理时引导扩散框架，成功提升了诱导接近靶点的构象预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质结构生成模型虽能预测单体蛋白结构，但无法正确捕获蛋白质复合物的构象状态，这对抗体和PROTAC等诱导接近模态的蛋白设计至关重要。
AI.method: 提出AIMS-Fold，一个推理时引导扩散框架，通过可微分物理势能主动引导生成采样轨迹，融合XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性图谱。
AI.result: XL-MS和HDX-MS方法单独使用均能提升预测精度，集成后产生协同改善效果；在诱导接近靶点上，AIMS-Fold精度优于未受指导的SOTA模型Boltz-2。
AI.conclusion: AIMS-Fold establishes an effective integrative computational framework for structure-based drug design of induced proximity drugs, outperforming state-of-the-art unguided models like Boltz-2 on challenging targets.

title: HTMLCure: Turning Browser Experience into State Guided Repair for Interactive HTML
summary: LLMs can now produce full HTML pages, but many of those pages are only superficially correct: they render once, then fail under scroll, hover, click, resize, or gameplay. Evaluation from screenshots can miss these failures, and filtering discards many pages that are still repairable. We introduce HTMLCure, a browser experience framework that evaluates HTML after the system has interacted with it. The evaluator executes the page across viewports and interaction states, records deterministic browser evidence, and gives the VLM curated keyframes from the executed trajectory rather than isolated screenshots. The same state signal drives a closed loop repair engine: HTMLCure diagnoses the current page, chooses a state specific repair family, runs each candidate again, and exports quality cleared pages for SFT. On a 97K prompt corpus, this expands the directly usable seed into a candidate pool of 63703 quality cleared pages, from which we construct the final refined SFT set of 40K pages. Under the same backbone and training recipe, HTMLCure-27B-Refined reaches 50.6 on HTMLBench-400 with 45.2% deterministic test case pass, placing it in the same performance band as strong reference rows such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4. On the released MiniAppBench validation split, it reaches 81.2 average, improving raw 27B SFT by 15.3 points and approaching the level of strong reference systems.

AI.tldr: HTMLCure通过交互式浏览器评估和闭环修复机制，将97K提示词扩展为63K质量清理页面并最终筛选出40K高质量SFT数据，使27B模型达到与Kimi-K2.6/GPT-5.4相当的性能水平。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM生成的HTML页面仅在初始渲染时正确，但在滚动、悬停、点击、调整大小或交互操作时容易失败。基于截图的评估方法无法检测这些交互故障，而简单过滤会丢弃大量仍可修复的页面。
AI.method: HTMLCure是一个浏览器体验框架，包含评估引擎和闭环修复引擎。评估引擎在多种视口和交互状态下执行页面，记录确定性浏览器证据并提取curated keyframes；修复引擎基于诊断结果选择状态特定的修复方案，对候选页面进行迭代测试和筛选。
AI.result: 从97K提示词扩展到63,703个质量清理后的候选页面，最终构建40K高质量SFT数据集。在HTMLBench-400上达到50.6分（45.2%确定性测试通过率），在MiniAppBench验证集上达到81.2平均分，较原始27B SFT提升15.3点。
AI.conclusion: HTMLCure enables a 27B model to reach performance comparable to strong reference systems (Kimi-K2.6, GPT-5.4) through quality-cleared SFT data, demonstrating that systematic interaction evaluation and targeted repair significantly enhance generated web pages without architectural changes.

title: The Coverage Illusion: From Pre-retrieval Routing Failure to Post-retrieval Cascades in a Production RAG System
summary: In modern RAG pipelines, query augmentation methods such as HyDE and query expansion are applied to every query, resulting in substantial LLM inference costs and increased end-to-end latency. The empirical justification for this overhead in real production traffic remains largely unexplored. We present a case study of the Danish National Encyclopedia, evaluating five retrieval workflows over 20,000 query-workflow pairs from production traffic and synthetic conditions. In this system, synthetic queries suggest that LLM augmentation is needed for over 90% of queries to achieve high retrieval coverage. However, under our production deferral policy, only 27.8% of real user queries need LLM augmentation. We call this gap the Coverage Illusion and attribute it to a structural mismatch between synthetic and real query distributions. Pre-retrieval routing cannot resolve this gap, as the need for LLM augmentation is only revealed after searching the index, a result confirmed by our evaluation of four machine learning paradigms. The coverage gap, undetectable from the query alone, motivates a post-retrieval cascade that runs workflows in cheapest-first order and escalates to LLM augmentation only when a step returns no documents. Operating entirely without training overhead or secondary serving infrastructure, the cascade improves quality by +0.140 Composite Overall points over Always-HyDE, reduces latency by 31.8%, and serves 72.2% of real user queries without LLM augmentation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现代RAG管道中普遍采用的查询增强方法（如HyDE）在真实生产流量中造成不必要的开销。合成查询显示90%需要LLM增强，但实际仅27.8%需要。该差距被称为"覆盖幻觉"，源于合成与真实查询分布的结构性错配。由于前置路由无法提前判断增强需求，研究提出后检索级联策略，按成本从低到高排序工作流，仅在无文档返回时升级至LLM增强，最终实现质量+0.140分、延迟-31.8%、72.2%查询无需LLM增强。
AI.motivation: 现代RAG管道中，HyDE和查询扩展等LLM增强方法被无差别地应用于所有查询，导致高推理成本和端到端延迟显著增加；然而这种开销在真实生产流量中的实证合理性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 在丹麦国家百科全书系统中，对5种检索工作流进行评估，覆盖20,000个查询-工作流对（包括真实生产流量和合成条件）；同时评估了四种机器学习范式的前置路由能力，验证其无法解决LLM增强需求的识别问题。
AI.result: 发现了"覆盖幻觉"现象：合成查询建议90%以上需要LLM增强以实现高检索覆盖率，但真实生产流量中仅27.8%的查询需要LLM增强；前置路由无法解决此问题，因为LLM增强需求只能在检索索引后才能识别；后检索级联策略实现了质量提升和延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 提出了后检索级联策略，无需额外训练或二级服务基础设施，即可实现质量提升（+0.140 Composite Overall分）、延迟降低31.8%，且72.2%的真实用户查询无需LLM增强，揭示了合成查询与真实查询分布之间的结构性错配问题。

title: Reasoning, Code, or Both? How Large Language Models Handle Variations in Math Questions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve impressive accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet their performance drops when problems are modified with simple changes like different names or numbers. Code execution methods, which let models generate and run Python code instead of reasoning in natural language, have been proposed as a solution, but their effect on reasoning robustness (the ability to maintain accuracy across problem variations) has not been systematically tested. This study evaluates three approaches on 1,000 problems from the GSM-Symbolic dataset: pure reasoning using chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, single-shot code execution using Program-Aided Language models (PAL), and iterative code execution using Step-by-Step Coding (SBSC). All three were run on paired original and modified problems using Claude Haiku 4.5. CoT was the most robust method, with an accuracy drop of 1.3 percentage points and 1.8% of problems breaking under perturbation. PAL was the least robust at 1.7 percentage points and 3.1% broke, with SBSC falling in between. Although these differences were not statistically significant ($p = .096$), the directional trend was consistent across all measures, suggesting that code execution, whether single-shot or iterative, does not improve reasoning robustness on grade-school-level problem variations.

AI.tldr: 本研究在GSM-Symbolic数据集的1,000道小学数学题上,以Claude Haiku 4.5为被试模型,对比纯推理(CoT)、单次代码执行(PAL)与迭代代码执行(SBSC)三种方法在原题与变体题上的表现。结果显示CoT最稳健(准确率下降1.3个百分点,1.8%的题目被"破坏"),PAL最不稳健(1.7个百分点,3.1%被破坏),SBSC居中;卡方检验p=0.096未达显著。结论:代码执行(无论单次还是迭代)并未提升LLM在小学难度题目变体上的推理稳健性。
AI.motivation: GSM-Symbolic的发现表明,LLM在数学基准上表现优异,但仅改变人名或数字即会导致最高约15%的性能下降(插入无关子句时下降可达65%),暴露了模型依赖模式匹配而非真正逻辑推理的脆弱性。PAL与SBSC等代码执行方法通过将计算卸载给Python解释器来提升准确率,在GSM-HARD等算术压力测试上优势明显,但其对"推理稳健性"(面对保持结构与难度不变的问题变体时维持准确率的能力)的作用此前缺乏系统检验。现有代码执行研究(PAL、SBSC、TIR)均只在GSM8K、MATH等静态数据集上评测,未在GSM-Symbolic这类成对变体数据上测试。论文由此提出核心研究问题:迭代代码执行能否相比单次代码生成与纯推理提升推理稳健性,并假设PAL最稳健、CoT次之、SBSC最不稳健(因迭代结构会放大错误形式化问题)。
AI.method: 实验设计:从GSM-Symbolic的main子集(仅替换人名与数值、保持结构难度不变)随机抽取1,000题,对每个题对(原题+变体题)分别运行三种方法,共记录各方法在原题/变体题的准确率与配对结果。方法实现:CoT采用Mirzadeh等人的8-shot提示(示例取自GSM8K),系统提示改为"Follow the format in the examples provided."并加入"Let's think step by step"预填充;PAL改编自Gao等人附录J.4的8-shot提示,将答案封装于def solution():函数块中以便自动抽取,预填充"def solution():";SBSC改编自Singh等人,示例由Claude生成并人工校验,移除代码注释改用语义化变量名,保留"DO NOT restart solving from Step 1"的纠错指令、###END OF CODE终止符,最大15轮交互。实施:Python脚本借助Claude Opus 4.5/GitHub Copilot编写,统一通过Anthropic API调用Claude Haiku 4.5,temperature=0以保证确定性可复现;因中途发现错误,不同方法的数据分两次运行采集,但使用相同的1,000个索引。分析:除准确率降幅外,将每题按正确性变化分为broke(原对变错)、fixed(原错变对)、stayed(两版同态),并用卡方同质性检验比较三方法的类别分布;同时进行个案错误分析(如题91、72、45)。
AI.result: 基线准确率均超过96%:CoT 97.9%、PAL 97.2%、SBSC 96.4%;准确率降幅分别为CoT 1.3pp、PAL 1.7pp、SBSC 1.4pp。稳健性分布:CoT broke 18题(1.8%)/fixed 5题(0.5%)/stayed 977题(97.7%);PAL broke 31(3.1%)/fixed 14(1.4%)/stayed 955(95.5%);SBSC broke 25(2.5%)/fixed 11(1.1%)/stayed 964(96.4%)。卡方检验p=0.096,在α=0.05下不显著,但所有指标方向一致:CoT最稳健,PAL最差,SBSC居中,故假设仅部分成立(PAL的表现与预期相反)。误差分析显示:(1)题91的变体上PAL与SBSC在11次实例中失败9次,CoT仅失败2次,说明表层特征变化时代码方法更易错误形式化;(2)题72中SBSC在原题全部8次均答6(将寄信与回信时间重复计算),迭代结构放而非纠正该错误;(3)题45三方法全部失败并一致输出约162(正确为342),说明错误源于推理开始前的语义理解缺陷,代码执行无法补偿。解释上,PAL在GSM-HARD(仅增大数值)上的优势源于算术卸载,而小学难度下CoT本身即可可靠完成算术;剩余失效模式是错误形式化——解释器会确定地执行错误解,而灵活的自然语言推理仍可能绕正。
AI.conclusion: 代码执行无论是单次(PAL)还是迭代(SBSC),都不能提升LLM在小学级问题变体上的推理稳健性;其在小规模算术与竞赛级数学上的准确率增益无法迁移为抗变体能力。代码执行改进的是计算精度而非语义形式化能力,代码的刚性使形式化错误被确定性地执行,可能降低面对自然语言问法变化时的可靠性。因此,稳健性应作为新推理方法的显式评测维度,与静态基准并行进行;Mirzadeh等人指出的稳健性难题仍未被当前代码执行方案解决,可能需要根本不同的方法。局限包括:卡方同质性检验假设组间独立但三方法共用同一1,000题;仅测试main子集且名称与数值扰动未分离(P1/P2/NoOp子集未测);仅用Claude Haiku 4.5单一模型、样本仅1,000/5,000;GSM-Symbolic早于该模型训练截止时间(2025年2月)可能存在数据污染,使CoT的稳健性优势难以区分真正推理与记忆。未来工作:扩展至其他扰动子集与多模型、使用带扰动标签的数据集、更大样本、生成未公开的新变体以排除污染,并对全体失败题(如题45)做人类求解测试以区分模型能力边界与数据集歧义。

title: LURE: Live-Usage Replay Evaluations for Reducing Evaluation Awareness
summary: Large language models can recognize when they are being evaluated (evaluation awareness) and behave differently because of that, which undermines the validity of safety and alignment benchmarks. We propose LURE (Live-Usage Replay Evaluations), a method for constructing deployment-like evaluations by replaying realistic agentic interaction trajectories and appending evaluation prompt at the end. We also introduce an automated pipeline for measuring evaluation realism, combining detection of verbalized evaluation awareness and judge-model estimates of the probability of logs being an evaluation, and validate it on a large dataset of deployment and evaluation transcripts. We find that LURE-based evaluations are substantially less distinguishable from deployment than widely used benchmarks and synthetic evaluation generators, and can approach the realism of real conversations with users. We instantiate LURE in scheming, AI safety sabotage, and sycophancy settings. Our results suggest that evaluation realism is a crucial property of alignment benchmarks and should be reported alongside benchmark results, especially when such results are used in safety cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LURE方法解决大模型评估中的"评估意识"问题——模型能识别评估情境并改变行为。通过重放真实交互轨迹构建逼真评估环境，并在scheming、AI安全 sabotage和谄媚场景中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型具有"评估意识"，能够识别何时被评估并因此表现出不同行为，这破坏了安全和对齐基准测试的有效性。
AI.method: LURE（实时使用回放评估）方法，通过重放真实的智能体交互轨迹并在末尾追加评估提示来构建部署式评估；同时引入自动化流水线，结合评估意识言语化检测和评判模型对日志是否为评估的估计概率来测量评估逼真度。
AI.result: LURE评估与部署的区分度显著低于广泛使用的基准测试和合成评估生成器，接近真实用户对话的逼真度。
AI.conclusion: 评估逼真度是Alignment基准测试的关键属性，应与基准测试结果一起报告，尤其是在将这些结果用于安全案例时。

title: Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 提出CoAD框架，通过协同设计统一分类与重建范式，有效解决时间序列异常检测中细微复杂异常的检测难题，性能与效率均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在检测细微和长期异常时表现不佳，基于OE的方法泛化能力差，基于MAE的方法存在掩码错位问题。
AI.method: 提出CoAD框架，统一Outlier Exposure（分类范式）和Masked Autoencoder（重建范式）两大范式。分类模块生成概率驱动的软掩码引导重建模块，同时解决分类粒度不当和频率信息忽视的问题。
AI.result: 在高质量基准数据集上，CoAD显著优于现有最先进的深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法，且更轻量、推理速度更快。
AI.conclusion: CoAD通过统一分类与重建范式，展现了深度学习在时间序列异常检测中的潜力，具有轻量级、高速度的特点，适用于大规模实时应用场景。

title: On the GitHub Actions Language: Usage, Evolution, and Workflow Reliability
summary: Developers often struggle with maintaining GitHub Actions workflow configurations in GitHub-hosted repositories, with recent studies showing frequent execution failures. This paper empirically explores how the adoption and evolution of GitHub Actions language constructs impacts workflow reliability and maintainability. To do so, we quantitatively analyse 260K workflows from 49K GitHub repositories to understand how they are used in practice and how their usage has evolved from July 2019 to August 2025. We identify 197 language constructs available in the GitHub Actions language and map them to 14 features reflecting workflow capabilities. We observe that only a small set of constructs and features are used very frequently, and that larger and more complex workflows are associated with higher failure rates and more maintenance effort. We identify specific features that are more likely to be linked with reliability and maintainability risks. These insights can help practitioners and researchers improve their understanding and usage of the GitHub Actions language, which can help in improving and sustaining workflow automation practices.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对49K仓库中260K个工作流进行大规模实证分析，揭示GitHub Actions语言构造的使用模式和演化趋势，为改善工作流自动化实践提供实证依据。
AI.motivation: 开发者在维护GitHub Actions工作流配置时面临困难，近期研究表明工作流执行失败现象频繁发生，亟需深入理解语言特性对工作流可靠性和可维护性的影响。
AI.method: 对49K GitHub仓库中的260K个工作流进行定量分析，时间跨度从2019年7月到2025年8月。将197个语言构造映射到14个功能特性，分析其使用模式及演变趋势。
AI.result: 仅少量语言构造和特性被高频使用；更大更复杂的工作流关联更高失败率和更多维护工作量；识别出与可靠性和可维护性风险相关的特定特性。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，只有少部分语言构造和特性被高频使用，而更大更复杂的工作流与更高的失败率和维护成本相关。识别出特定特性与可靠性和可维护性风险相关，为从业者和研究人员提供了改进GitHub Actions自动化实践的见解。

title: Separating Semantic Competition from Context Length in RAG Reading
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can respond incorrectly even when the correct passage was retrieved. The model must still read the retrieved passages and identify which one contains the answer among others that look relevant. This passage-reading model is called the reader. Does it fail simply because the context is longer or because the other passages genuinely compete with the correct one? We introduce and demonstrate a matched-control protocol for RAG reading: we keep the number and length of passages fixed, but replace hard competitors with less competitive real passages. We apply this control across two compact open models on SQuAD. This replacement partially restores performance, with the strongest effects on F1 and answer inclusion. For Phi-2, this recovers +6.0 EM points, +7.0 answer-inclusion points, and +0.057 F1. For Qwen2.5-1.5B, it recovers +4.5 EM points, +9.0 answer-inclusion points, and +0.068 F1. To track how performance changes as competitors accumulate, we also report retention curves and summarize them with a right-censored half-life when the curves do not cross half-retention. Together, these results show the protocol isolates a competition effect distinct from context length, though the effect is clearer for F1 and answer inclusion than for exact match, and also varies with snippet length.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出匹配控制协议来研究RAG阅读器中passage竞争效应的本质，通过控制实验证明竞争效应独立于上下文长度存在，但效果因评估指标和snippet长度而异。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中，即使正确passage被检索到，系统仍可能给出错误答案。现有研究未能区分这种失败是由上下文长度增加还是由其他相关passage的竞争效应导致。需要一个控制实验来隔离这两种因素。
AI.method: 采用匹配控制协议（matched-control protocol）：固定passage数量和长度，用竞争力较弱的真实passage替换hard竞争对手。对Phi-2和Qwen2.5-1.5B两个紧凑开源模型在SQuAD数据集上进行实验。同时引入保留曲线和右截断半衰期指标追踪性能变化。
AI.result: 替换hard竞争对手后性能部分恢复：Phi-2获得+6.0 EM、+7.0答案包含、+0.057 F1提升；Qwen2.5-1.5B获得+4.5 EM、+9.0答案包含、+0.068 F1提升。部分恢复而非完全恢复，说明竞争效应确实存在且独立于上下文长度。竞争效应在F1和答案包含指标上更明显，而精确匹配指标受影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了RAG系统中存在独立于上下文长度的"竞争效应"。部分性能恢复（而非完全恢复）表明答案包含和F1指标受影响最大，且效果因模型和snippet长度而异。提出了右截断半衰期作为保留曲线的汇总指标。

title: ReMoE: Boosting Expert Reuse through Router Fine-Tuning in Memory-Constrained MoE LLM Inference
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary:
Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models sparsely activate only a subset of experts per token, reducing activated computation while maintaining high model capacity. However, in memory-constrained inference scenarios, only a small set of experts can be cached. Experts not in the cache must be fetched from slow external storage (e.g., UFS), leading to frequent evictions and substantial I/O overhead.
  We propose ReMoE, a router fine-tuning framework designed to boost token-wise expert reuse. ReMoE biases the router toward recently selected experts, producing temporally stable routing that better matches cache locality constraints. By increasing short-horizon expert reuse, ReMoE reduces expert fetches from storage without adding inference-time computation.
  Experiments on DeepSeek and Qwen models show that ReMoE improves expert reuse by 26% while maintaining downstream task performance. Real-system evaluations further confirm these benefits, improving output throughput by 8.4% under vLLM GPU-CPU expert offloading and reducing TPOT by 43.6-49.8% under llama.cpp on Jetson Orin NX, corresponding to a 1.77-1.99$\times$ decode speedup across diverse workloads. Checkpoints and usage instructions are available at https://github.com/BUAA-OSCAR/ReMoE.

AI.tldr: ReMoE是一种针对MoE模型路由器的微调框架，通过偏置路由决策倾向于近期选中的专家，增强时间局部性以提升专家缓存命中率，从而减少内存受限场景下的存储I/O开销和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 在内存受限的推理场景中，MoE模型面临专家缓存与I/O开销的矛盾：只有少量专家可缓存在GPU内存中，非缓存专家需从外部存储获取，导致频繁驱逐和高I/O开销。传统MoE的稀疏激活特性虽降低计算量，但与缓存局部性存在冲突。
AI.method: ReMoE通过路由器微调框架，偏置路由器倾向于选择最近被激活的专家，从而产生时间上稳定的路由模式。该方法在训练阶段引导路由决策，不引入推理时的额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek和Qwen模型上，ReMoE实现专家复用率提升26%，同时保持下游任务性能。真实系统评估显示：vLLM GPU-CPU专家卸载下吞吐量提升8.4%；llama.cpp在Jetson Orin NX上TPOT降低43.6-49.8%，解码速度提升1.77-1.99倍。
AI.conclusion: ReMoE successfully bridges the gap between sparse MoE routing and memory constraints, providing a practical solution for edge deployment. The framework demonstrates consistent gains across different hardware platforms (vLLM GPU-CPU offloading and Jetson Orin NX with llama.cpp), confirming its real-world applicability.

title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
summary: We introduce the MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence. The flagship M2 contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Designed end-to-end for agentic deployment, the M2 series rests on three components: (i) agent-driven data pipelines producing large-scale, verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and agentic cowork, each grounded in an executable workspace and an artifact-aligned reward; (ii) Forge, a scalable agent-native RL system that adapts to long-horizon agent trajectories, paired with windowed-FIFO scheduling, prefix-tree merging, inference optimization, and a clean training-inference-agent decoupling that supports both white-box and black-box agents; (iii) the latest M2.7 checkpoint takes an early step toward self-evolution -- autonomously debugging training runs and modifying its own scaffold. Across M2 through M2.7, this combination translates a mini-activation footprint into frontier-tier performance on agentic coding, deep search, office-task, and reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MiniMax-M2 is an efficient MoE model (229.9B params / 9.8B active) designed for agentic AI applications, using agent-driven data pipelines and a scalable RL system called Forge. M2.7 achieves early self-evolution capability, reaching frontier performance across agentic benchmarks.
AI.motivation: The motivation is to build efficient Mixture-of-Experts language models that maximize real-world intelligence with minimal activation, specifically designed end-to-end for agentic deployment scenarios.
AI.method: Three core components: (i) Agent-driven data pipelines generating verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and cowork, grounded in executable workspaces with artifact-aligned rewards; (ii) Forge, a scalable agent-native RL system featuring windowed-FIFO scheduling, prefix-tree merging, inference optimization, and training-inference-agent decoupling; (iii) M2.7 self-evolution capability for autonomous debugging and scaffold modification.
AI.result: The flagship M2 model contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Across M2 through M2.7, this architecture achieves frontier-tier performance on agentic coding, deep search, office-task, and reasoning benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: MiniMax-M2 series demonstrates that mini-activation MoE models combined with agent-native data pipelines and scalable RL training can achieve frontier-tier agentic performance. The M2.7 checkpoint takes an early step toward self-evolution by autonomously debugging and modifying its own scaffold.

title: Conv-to-Bench: Evaluating Language Models Via User-Assistant Dialogues In Code Tasks
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has outpaced the scalability of traditional evaluation benchmarks, which remain heavily dependent on labor-intensive expert curation. We address this bottleneck with Conv-to-Bench, a multi-stage framework that automatically transforms authentic multi-turn user-assistant dialogues into structured, verifiable requirement checklists. By leveraging the "instructional evolution" found in real-world conversational logs, our approach deconstructs fragmented user intent into consolidated instructions and binary evaluation criteria. Applied to the programming domain, Conv-to-Bench produces evaluation sets that demonstrate near-perfect alignment with human-authored standards like BigCodeBench, achieving Spearman correlations of up to $ρ$ = 1.000 with significantly lower computational overhead. Validation of the LLM-as-a-judge framework further confirms its reliability, with the primary evaluator achieving substantial agreement with human-verified ground truth ($κ$ = 0.705). Our comprehensive ablation studies reveal that while multi-turn interactions capture the iterative evolution of user intent, instruction-centric extraction provides a more robust foundation. Ultimately, Conv-to-Bench provides a scalable, cost-effective paradigm for maintaining high-fidelity evaluation standards as user-centric AI applications continue to diversify.

AI.tldr: Conv-to-Bench通过自动从真实对话中提取和结构化用户需求，解决了LLM快速迭代与人工评估基准成本高、扩展慢的矛盾，为用户中心AI应用提供了可扩展、低成本的高保真评估范式。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展已超过传统评估基准的可扩展性，这些基准仍严重依赖劳动密集型的专家人工策划，亟需解决这一瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出了Conv-to-Bench多阶段框架，自动将真实的多轮用户-助手对话转换为结构化、可验证的需求检查清单。该框架利用真实对话日志中的"指令演化"现象，将碎片化的用户意图解构为统一指令和二元评估标准。
AI.result: 在编程领域的应用表明，Conv-to-Bench生成的评估集与BigCodeBench等人工编写的标准实现了接近完美的对齐，斯皮尔曼相关系数高达ρ = 1.000，计算开销显著降低。LLM-as-a-judge框架验证亦确认了其可靠性，主评估器与人工验证的真实标签达成实质性一致（κ = 0.705）。
AI.conclusion: Conv-to-Bench成功展示了一种可扩展且经济高效的范式，能够在用户中心AI应用多样化发展的背景下，持续维护高保真度的评估标准。消融研究进一步表明，尽管多轮交互能捕捉用户意图的迭代演化，但以指令为中心的提取方法提供了更稳健的基础。

title: On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series
summary: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

AI.tldr: PathoFM是一种用于脊髓损伤（SCI）病理步态分析的基础模型，通过三种互补的预训练目标（局部补全、时序连续性、上下文动态）研究时序表征学习的迁移问题。实证表明，动态中心的混合目标能产生最均衡的跨任务迁移效果，最佳方案是结合局部重建与时序连续性，并在可行时加入上下文条件化。
AI.motivation: 临床时序学习面临小型异质队列和协议漂移的约束，且下游任务涵盖分类（如病理诊断）和回归（如时序预测）两类。基础模型预训练虽具吸引力，但如何设计归纳偏置以使表征在任务类型和被试间有效迁移是关键问题。
AI.method: PathoFM：一种以编码器为中心的Transformer架构，采用三种互补的预训练目标——局部补全（重建连续掩码区间以强制局部结构）、时序连续性（从观察前缀预测掩码的中期延续以强制平滑性和因果一致性）以及无监督上下文动态（通过注意力机制基于被试示例窗口进行支持-查询重建）。通过encoder-centric架构设计实现跨任务迁移。
AI.result: 动态中心的混合目标产生最均衡的迁移效果：分组/对比目标有利于判别性边界但会损害连续目标所需的幅度保真度；而仅重建目标虽能保留波形结构但在分类任务上可能表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 结合局部重建与时序连续性，并在样本获取可行时加入上下文条件化，能产生最具鲁棒性的跨被试泛化表示。

title: LLM-based Mockless Unit Test Generation for Java
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for automated test generation, yet most approaches to generating Java unit tests still rely on mocking frameworks to handle dependencies. Mockless test generation could exercise more real low-level code, but it faces challenges such as invalid test code generation due to hallucination, strict language constraints, and inadequate dependency awareness. We identify two causes behind these hallucinations: not knowing, where the LLM lacks sufficient context, and not following, where the LLM fails to comply with constraints even when they are provided.
  We present MocklessTester, a mockless unit test generation approach built around two strategies: context-enriched generation and constraint-enforced fixing. To mitigate not knowing, context-enriched generation mines real usage patterns from existing code to generate tests. To mitigate not following, constraint-enforced fixing performs two-stage repair under symbol-, protocol-, and iteration-level constraints, using a ClassIndex, a Markov typestate model, and experience memory.
  We evaluate MocklessTester against the state-of-the-art baseline on Defects4J and Deps4J. Results show that MocklessTester improves line coverage by 19.99% and 22.69% and branch coverage by 24.90% and 15.78% on the two benchmarks, respectively, and improves mutation score by 13.67% and 0.17%. Beyond the class under test, MocklessTester also exercises more real dependency code, covering 378 and 55 additional lines in dependency classes, respectively. The improvement in test quality comes with higher total token and time costs than the baseline. Nevertheless, the cost per method remains practical, averaging 108.97 seconds and 26.59k tokens on Defects4J, and 69.85 seconds and 25.46k tokens on Deps4J. Ablation results confirm that all major components contribute positively to the final performance.

AI.tldr: MocklessTester通过上下文增强和约束强制修复策略解决了LLM生成无模拟器单元测试时的幻 hall闭问题，在多个基准上显著提升覆盖率但计算成本较高。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的Java单元测试生成方法仍依赖模拟框架，而无模拟器测试可执行更多真实底层代码，但面临幻 hall闭生成、语言约束不遵循、依赖感知不足等挑战，这些挑战源于"不知道"（缺乏足够上下文）和"不遵循"（即使提供约束也无法遵守）两类问题。
AI.method: 提出MocklessTester，采用上下文增强生成策略（从现有代码中挖掘真实使用模式）和约束强制修复策略（符号级、协议级、迭代级三层约束的两阶段修复），并结合ClassIndex、Markov类型状态模型和经验记忆库。
AI.result: 在Defects4J和Deps4J上，MocklessTester分别提升行覆盖率19.99%/22.69%、分支覆盖率24.90%/15.78%、突变评分13.67%/0.17%；额外覆盖依赖类378和55行代码；Defects4J上平均每方法耗时108.97秒/26.59k tokens，Deps4J上69.85秒/25.46k tokens；消融实验验证各主要组件均正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: MocklessTester显著提升了无模拟器测试生成的质量，覆盖率和突变评分均大幅改善，虽然计算成本较高但仍在实际范围内，且各主要组件均对性能有正向贡献。

title: Which Changes Matter? Towards Trustworthy Legal AI via Relevance-Sensitive Evaluation and Solver-Grounded Reasoning
summary: Legal reasoning requires distinguishing changes that matter from those that do not. Legal AI should remain stable under legally irrelevant perturbations, but should change when perturbations alter legally material points. We formulate this requirement as a legal-relevance-sensitive evaluation problem: LLMs should only be sensitive to the legally relevant change. We introduce a unified evaluation suite covering should-change and should-not-change evaluation across judicial fairness, robustness, and statute-confusion scenarios. Our evaluation shows that existing legal LLMs are systematically sensitive to legally irrelevant variations and often fail to distinguish related legal elements and statutory rules. To mitigate these failures, we present LexGuard, an adversarial multi-agent framework grounded in formal reasoning. LexGuard formalizes statutes into executable constraints, uses adversarial agents to extract competing fact-statute arguments, and invokes SMT solvers to verify legal satisfaction and logical consistency. Experiments show that LexGuard improves legal reasoning reliability by reducing vulnerability to manipulative framing, improving disambiguation among similar statutes, limiting the influence of legally irrelevant attributes, and increasing consistency under benign reformulations. We show that legal trustworthiness requires not only accuracy, but calibrated sensitivity to legally material changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"法律相关性敏感评估"（legal-relevance-sensitive evaluation）范式，把法律AI的可靠性拆分为两类可测量的敏感性：对法律无关扰动应保持不变（should-not-change），对法律实质性改变应正确更新（should-change）。配套提出LexGuard——一个求解器接地（solver-grounded）的对抗式多智能体框架：先将刑法条文自动形式化为可执行的SMT约束（ArticleGuard∧ClauseGuard⇒Penalty），再由控方/辩方代理独立抽取类型化事实与候选法条，最后由Z3求解器验证法条适用性、排除冲突并裁决量刑。实验显示LexGuard在法条预测F1、量刑RMSE、should-change对齐度、should-not-change鲁棒性和相似法条消歧上全面优于GPT-5.2、GPT-4o、Claude 4 Sonnet、DeepSeek v3等基线及CoT/少样本提示基线。
AI.motivation: 法律推理是"形式理性"要求的高风险场景，仅有准确性不足：结论须由明确、普遍、逻辑自洽的规则支撑，并可追溯至法条、解释与判例。现有法律LLM（ChatLaw、LawLLM、Lexi）仍存在幻觉法条、混淆相似法条、对无关属性过度敏感等问题。已有评测把司法公平、推理链鲁棒性、对抗框架、相似法条混淆等分开孤立研究，且多只检验"应保持不变"（label-preserving，如J&H仅研究知识注入鲁棒性），缺乏对"应发生改变"（label-changing）的法律敏感性评测。法律的核心能力恰是判断"哪些变化重要"：构成要件、主观状态、危害程度、例外条件改变应导致结论变化；而人口学属性、程序背景、措辞改写、无关专家意见、伪造引用等法律无关扰动不应改变结论。规则之治要求"相似案件同等对待、不同案件基于法律理由区分"，故需统一刻画这一相关性敏感能力。
AI.method: 1）法律相关性敏感评测框架：将扰动划分为标签保持型（司法公平：被告性别/民族/财富/学历/户籍、受害人属性、法院层级、庭审 publicity；良性鲁棒：改写、同义替换、语序调整、无关叙述；大前提鲁棒：相似但不适用法条、误导性引用、伪造权威、错误罪名；小前提鲁棒：非决定性事实编辑、法律等价的要件描述、无关事实添加；结论层鲁棒：无关专家意见、情绪化框架、角色劫持、判决强制指令、格式仿冒提示注入）与标签改变型（构成要件敏感性：行为/对象/主体身份/角色/数额门槛/危害严重性/因果关系；主观状态敏感性：故意vs过失、明知vs不明知、非法占有目的；例外与条件敏感性：正当防卫、未遂、从犯、自首、累犯、法定从轻从重；相似法条敏感性：盗窃vs诈骗、抢劫vs敲诈、故意伤害vs故意杀人、窝藏vs洗钱）。形式化定义Inv(f)=E[I{f(x)=f(τ(x))}]与Align(f)=E[I{f(τ(x))≠f(x)}]，配套指标含偏差幅度、ASR、CRR、攻击感知F1、正/宏精确率、金标遗漏、错误相似法条选择等。2）LexGuard三阶段：(a) 法律形式化——从法条与司法解释构建形式法律知识库K，ArticleGuard=Subject∧Object∧Conduct，ClauseGuard=Element(Mental∧Result∧Causation)∧Threshold∧Exception，蕴含Penalty区间（月份整数变量），情节严重/从宽以单调调整上下界，并显式排除ExtraLegal变量以保证法律无关属性不影响约束；知识库经句法、语义（矛盾/空真/过宽）、案件级激活三步校验。(b) 对抗式代理——控方与辩方代理从同一案情独立抽取⟨F,L⟩，事实按行为人/行为/主观状态/法益/对象/数额/后果/因果/例外等类型标注并链接原文片段以抑制幻觉；法条按相似度聚簇，代理在簇内就易混条款辩论。(c) 求解器中心裁决——Search(L,K)取回约束、Refine(F,C_L)对齐事实、Encode为SMT公式，Z3检验条款/例外守卫可满足性，不满足者丢弃，多条款可满足时按法定层级、特别性、例外处理、刑序规则择优；代理事实冲突时返回unsat core反馈触发事实重锚定或约束修复，直至可满足或全部候选被拒；输出⟨法条, 条款, 量刑, 说明⟩。3）数据集：LeCaRDv2（55,192案）、LEEC嫌疑人级（9,470实例）、自建8,000条配对受控扰动集；基线含通用与法律专用LLM及GPT-5.2的J&H-CoT/少样本变体；消融移除Attorney、Z3 Reasoner、Statutes Debating。
AI.result: RQ1：LexGuard在两数据集、两粒度上F1均最佳，收益主要来自精度（抑制无关法条）——LeCaRDv2 G-F1 39.08 / S-F1 78.99（GPT-5.2为31.14/75.53），LEEC嫌疑人级 G-F1 45.51 / S-F1 78.13（GPT-5.2为39.08/76.46），且远高于DISC-LawLLM/LexiLaw；量刑RMSE最低（LeCaRDv2 12.72→给定金标法条9.98；LEEC 23.04/20.95），法律有效率94.6%~97.7%，LEEC嫌疑人抽取F1 98.80。RQ2：去掉Z3推理器退化最大（G-F1 39.33→25.60、S-F1 78.96→60.97），去掉辩论模块次之（29.10/67.47），去掉Attorney主要削弱召回（37.87/69.60），原始LLM为30.69/69.90，验证符号一致性校验与细粒度竞争是关键。RQ3：should-change扰动下Overall 0.8101、Align 0.8353、Sta. 0.7702、Bias 0.0242，全面优于LLM（0.7235/0.7434/0.6911/0.0904）与CoT、少样本基线。RQ4：should-not-change扰动下ASR 0.4988（基线0.5625）、CRR 0.1571（基线0.0082）、不变性0.2602（基线0.0573）、攻击感知F1 0.5588（基线0.4013），提示级推理基线仅带来有限保护。RQ5：相似法条簇正精确率88.71%（LLM 58.57%）、宏精确率79.17%（59.47%）、金标遗漏9.68%（39.39%）、错误相似选择1.61%（6.39%）。成本：平均10.33次LLM调用、107.36秒、约1.3万输入token、0.082美元/案。需注意附录中各攻击模板的干净准确率本身很低（约5%~11%），且RQ4绝对不变性/CRR数值仍偏低，说明鲁棒性有改善但远未饱和。
AI.conclusion: 法律可信AI不能只看准确率，而需"对法律实质性改变的校准敏感性"：在法律无关扰动下保持稳定、在法律材料改变时正确更新，二者缺一不可。LexGuard表明把法条形式化为可执行约束、并以SMT求解器做"法律提案—法律校验"分离，可同时提升法条选择精度、量刑准确性、公平性、鲁棒性与相似法条消歧，并给出可审计的符号化理由。局限：形式化质量受LLM抽取错误传导影响；仅覆盖成文法，未扩展至判例法、开放性规范与演化中的 jurisprudence；确定性规则解析无法刻画刻意保留的规范模糊性；多阶段流程带来中等计算开销。

title: Alignment Tuning for Large Language Models: A Data-Centric Lens on Alignment Data Pipelines
comment: Accepted at the Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Much of the alignment tuning literature is organized around optimization objectives, while the construction of alignment data is often treated implicitly. In this survey, we adopt a data centric perspective and reframe alignment tuning as a pipeline design problem. We decompose alignment data construction into three interacting stages, response synthesis, preference evaluation, and preference instantiation, and use this framework to organize existing alignment methods into a unified taxonomy. Through this lens, we identify recurring design trade-offs and failure modes observed across prior alignment methods, and distill a set of high level principles that clarify how pipeline design choices influence the resulting optimization signal. Finally, we outline open challenges for alignment data pipelines, including prompt-level alignment, agentic settings, and alignment under evolving objectives.

AI.tldr: A survey paper that rethinks alignment tuning from a data-centric perspective, decomposing alignment data construction into three stages to create a unified taxonomy of alignment methods, identify design trade-offs, and outline future challenges.
AI.motivation: The alignment tuning literature is primarily organized around optimization objectives, while the construction of alignment data is treated implicitly. This paper adopts a data-centric perspective to reframe alignment tuning as a pipeline design problem.
AI.method: Decomposes alignment data construction into three interacting stages (response synthesis, preference evaluation, preference instantiation) and uses this framework to organize existing alignment methods into a unified taxonomy.
AI.result: Identifies recurring design trade-offs and failure modes across prior alignment methods, and distills high-level principles clarifying how pipeline design choices influence optimization signal.
AI.conclusion: Outlines open challenges for alignment data pipelines, including prompt-level alignment, agentic settings, and alignment under evolving objectives, suggesting future research directions.

title: From Privacy to Generalization: Linear Max-Information Bounds for DP-SGD
summary: Understanding the relationship between generalization and privacy remains a central challenge in modern machine learning theory, particularly for deep networks trained by variants of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD). In this work we make progress on this persistent open problem by proving a finite-sample bound on the approximate max-information of DP-SGD that exhibits scaling properties comparable with (Dwork et al, 2015)'s classic result for $ε$-differentially private algorithms, namely at most linear in the dataset size. From our result we obtain a general-purpose PAC-Bayes generalization bound in which the necessary prior distribution can be learned by DP-SGD, as well as a generalization bound for DP-SGD-trained models themselves, with a complexity term that is fully explicit and controlled by the optimization hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 本文为差分隐私学习算法建立"近似最大信息量"的显式有限样本上界，涵盖(ε,δ)-DP、Rényi DP、高斯机制（输出扰动）与流式DP-SGD，主界关于数据集规模呈线性（对应Dwork et al. 2015的经典纯ε-DP结果），并据此给出由DP-SGD学习先验的PAC-Bayes泛化界，在MNIST与CIFAR-10上对最高约1330万参数的深度网络首次给出无需压缩参数化、无需数据划分的非空泛（non-vacuous）泛化保证。
AI.motivation: 泛化与隐私之间的理论联系是现代机器学习理论的核心难题之一：深度网络过参数化、非凸、且用SGD训练，已有针对纯ε-DP（极严格、不适用于实际）或受限问题类（如凸设定、随机特征模型、低敏感度查询）的结果均无法直接套用到实践中广泛采用的近似(ε,δ)-DP与Rényi DP训练上。同时，Dwork et al.(2015)建立了纯ε-DP算法的最大信息量（approximate max-information）上界并将其用于PAC-Bayes泛化分析，但如何将该结论推广到更实用的隐私定义、且保留显式常数以便数值评估，仍是公开难题；Rogers et al.(2016)的推广只给渐近保证、仅适用于有限的(ε,δ,β)组合，无法用于实际任务。另一个动机是数据依赖先验的PAC-Bayes框架（Dziugaite & Roy 2018；Rivasplata et al. 2020）：要说明先验本身没有过拟合训练数据，必须能对"实际执行的"学习算法给出可计算的max-information界。
AI.method: 统一采用"信息密度 + 矩母函数 + Chernoff尾界"的技术路线（附录B给出五步结构化证明模板），并统一使用自然对数以去除log e常数。【定理1：(ε,δ)-DP】设β₀=β-nδ≥0，则 I^β_∞ ≤ min{nε, (1/8)nε² + ε√((n/2)log(1/β₀)) + (nδ/β₀)c(ε)}，其中 c(ε)=e^{2ε}+ε-1+e^{√(32log(1/β₀)/n)}；同时严格证明当β<nδ时不存在任何有限上界（构造"以概率nδ泄露某个数据点"的(0,δ)-DP机制，反例中 I^β_∞ ≥ log M + log(1-β/(nδ)) 随M→∞发散）。当δ=0时第一项相对经典结果改进4倍，并可取β=0恢复 nε。【定理2：Rényi DP】定义有效隐私 ε̃=ε+log(c/β)/(α-1)，得 I^β_∞ ≤ min{ n ε̃, v+2√(v log(2/β)) + log(2/β)/(α-1) }，v=(n/8)(ε+log(8/β)/(α-1))²，无β取值限制。证明用Hellinger积分的联合凸性给出条件Rényi散度上界（Lemma B.10），再用对称化Rényi散度J(w)=H_α(W∥μ)H_α(μ∥W)、单侧Rényi界推出的次高斯曲率界（Lemma B.15、B.16）与Hoeffding型方差界（Lemma B.14）得到信息密度的矩估计，并按坐标逆序积分。【定理3：高斯机制/输出扰动】M(S)=Ψ(S)+σζZ，ν=n/(4σ²)，L=log(1/β)，得 I^β_∞ ≤ ν + inf_{λ∈(0,r_ν)} (1/λ)[L - log(1-(λ+λ²)ν)]，并给出按ν幂次整理的解析松弛（O(n/σ²+√(n/σ²))级）。关键技术引理：Lemma B.1（Jensen不等式给出信息密度上界）、Lemma B.3（指数倾斜 + Hoeffding引理得到有限支撑随机变量的二次型矩界）、Proposition B.4（Doob鞅 + 指数倾斜给出有界差分不等式下的集中不等式，改进前导常数）；并证明目标函数关于λ严格凸（Lemma B.5）。【定理4：流式DP-SGD】T个大小m的固定不重叠批次，ν=m/(4σ²)，得 I^β_∞ ≤ 2Tν + inf_{λ∈(0,r_{4ν})} (1/λ)[L - (T/2)log(1-4(λ+λ²)ν)]，以及显式形式；因DP-SGD的特征函数是逐样本有界向量之和，可用改进的Lemma B.7/Proposition B.8获得更好的常数（领先因子由2r²降为r²）。【定理5与推论6】将max-information代入PAC-Bayes：kl(R̂(ρ)∥R(ρ)) ≤ [KL(ρ∥π) + I^{δ/2}_∞(A(S),S) + log(4√n/δ)]/n，其中先验π由算法A在S上训练得到；取ρ=π得仅含max-information的更简洁形式。【数值实验】使用Opacus与PAC-Bayes梯度优化实现（Biggs 2022的高效经验风险估计 + kl^{-1}数值反演），对MNIST（1.2M参数MLP）与CIFAR-10（9.9K/5.9M/13.2M参数ConvNet）比较数据无关高斯先验、流式DP-SGD先验、Poisson子采样DP-SGD先验；用union bound处理超参数网格选择，并将add/remove RDP转换为replace-one RDP（Mironov 2017）。
AI.result: 1) 定理1给出(ε,δ)-DP算法的显式max-information上界，纯ε-DP情形第一项比经典结果紧4倍，δ→0时连续收敛到纯DP结果，且不含δ/ε量级的项、在ε→0时无需同时δ→0仍有效；同时严格刻画了β≥nδ的必要性（β<nδ时无有限上界，给出显式反例机制）。2) 定理2给出Rényi DP的对应界，含"有效隐私"ε̃的线性项与高隐私区更紧的二次项，且对任意β∈(0,1)有效，比"先转成(ε,δ)-DP再用定理1"更优。3) 定理3、4给出利用高斯机制与流式DP-SGD内部随机化结构得到的更紧显式界（数值上始终紧于仅基于隐私属性的界），标量化的无穷小优化问题是关于λ的一维严格凸问题，可数值快速求解。4) 定理5/推论6把上述界接入PAC-Bayes，得到复杂度项完全显式、由优化超参数控制的泛化界。5) 实验：MNIST上两种私有先验均优于数据无关先验（风险上界0.325→0.273/0.248）；CIFAR-10上三个ConvNet规模（最大13,193,930参数）的DP-SGD模型全部给出非空泛上界（如0.782→0.848），而数据无关先验在5.9M与13.2M规模上完全空泛；这是首个在原始参数空间、无数据划分、针对实际使用算法的此类非空泛保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次给出了适用于现代深度学习实际训练情形的差分隐私学习算法近似最大信息量显式上界，跨越了纯DP或受限问题类的限制，并把隐私与泛化通过PAC-Bayes理论建立原则性联系，证明DP-SGD可在学习数据依赖先验的同时给出可由优化超参数直接表达的泛化保证。作者同时强调这类界是保守且常偏松的，不应被误读为实践指南；其核心洞见是：由于主结果关于数据集规模呈线性，且PAC-Bayes界中含 I^{δ/2}_∞/n 修正项，保证泛化最有希望的策略不是单纯增加数据，而是施加更强的隐私（当然更多数据也允许使用更大的噪声乘子而不牺牲效用）。局限与未来工作包括：显式的DP-SGD分析限于固定大小不重叠批次与独立噪声，未覆盖随机/重叠批次的隐私放大（Poisson采样、balls-and-bins、截断Poisson采样等）与跨步相关噪声技术；批大小与更新步数的权衡值得进一步研究；理论层面可形式化研究数据量与噪声水平的最优平衡。论文声明使用了生成式AI工具辅助推导思路、校验证明常数、文献检索与常规编程，并经人工复核。

title: Strategies for Guiding LLMs to Use Software Design Patterns: A Case of Singleton
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate functional source code from natural-language prompts, but often fail to consistently follow higher-level architectural structures or design patterns. Since LLMs are increasingly used in software engineering, their ability to apply established design principles to generated code is crucial to the long-term success of software products. Therefore, the goal of this paper is to identify strategies for guiding LLMs to incorporate design patterns into the generated source code. We designed a computational experiment to evaluate the ability of 13 LLMs to generate code that follows the Singleton design pattern, using four prompting strategies: instructions, binary automated feedback, extensive automated feedback, and extensive feedback with few-shot prompts, in 164 Java coding challenges from HumanEval-X. Our results shows that the optimal strategy to guide LLMs to include design patterns depends heavily on the type of model. Still, overall, iterative binary feedback provides the best alignment with Singleton while preserving or improving the code's functionality. With guiding with instructions, Llama 3.3 generated Singleton classes in 100% of cases and improved code functionality, increasing the number of tests passed by 34.1 percentage points. It achieved a similar result with guidance through instructions and binary feedback. Qwen 3 (8B) increased the alignment with Singleton to 99.2% and the functionality to 58.6% using binary feedback. Our result suggests that even simple strategies can be used to guide LLMs to use design patterns.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了如何引导LLM在生成的代码中融入设计模式，以Singleton模式为案例，在13个LLM上测试了四种提示策略。结果表明迭代二元反馈总体效果最佳，且即使简单策略也能有效指导LLM应用设计模式。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能根据自然语言提示生成功能性源代码，但往往无法一致地遵循高层架构结构或设计模式。随着LLM在软件工程领域的应用日益广泛，其将既定设计原则应用于生成代码的能力对软件产品的长期成功至关重要。
AI.method: 设计计算实验，在164个Java编码挑战题（来自HumanEval-X）上评估13个LLM使用四种提示策略生成符合Singleton设计模式代码的能力。四种策略包括：指令式、二元自动反馈、扩展自动反馈，以及结合少样本提示的扩展反馈。
AI.result: 最佳引导策略高度依赖于模型类型。总体而言，迭代二元反馈在保持或提升代码功能性同时，实现了与Singleton模式的最佳对齐。Llama 3.3通过指令引导在100%的情况下生成Singleton类，测试通过率提升34.1个百分点。Qwen 3 (8B)使用二元反馈后，Singleton对齐度达99.2%，功能性达58.6%。
AI.conclusion: 即使简单的策略也能有效引导LLM在生成的代码中使用设计模式。研究表明，不同模型对策略的响应差异较大，但迭代二元反馈总体上能实现Singleton模式对齐与代码功能性的最佳平衡。

title: PolyFusionAgent: A Multimodal Foundation Model and Autonomous AI Assistant for Polymer Property Prediction and Inverse Design
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; Supplementary material included
summary: Polymer discovery is central to fields ranging from energy storage to biomedicine, but it is hindered by an astronomically large chemical design space and fragmented representations of structure, properties, and prior knowledge. This fragmentation leaves many AI models disconnected from physical and experimental reality, restricting their ability to support directly actionable design decisions. Here we introduce PolyFusionAgent, an interactive framework coupling a multimodal polymer foundation model (PolyFusion) with a tool-augmented, literature-grounded design agent (PolyAgent). PolyFusion aligns complementary polymer views including sequence, topology, 3D geometry, and fingerprints across millions of polymers to learn a shared latent space transferable across chemistries and data regimes, improving thermophysical property prediction and enabling property-conditioned generation of chemically valid, structurally novel polymers beyond the reference design space. PolyAgent closes the design loop by linking prediction and inverse design with evidence retrieval from the polymer literature, proposing, evaluating, and contextualizing hypotheses with explicit precedent in one workflow. Together, PolyFusionAgent enables interactive, evidence-linked polymer discovery combining large-scale representation learning, multimodal chemical knowledge, and verifiable scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: PolyFusionAgent is an AI framework for polymer discovery that integrates multimodal representation learning (PolyFusion) with literature-grounded design reasoning (PolyAgent), enabling evidence-linked, interactive generation and prediction of novel polymers.
AI.motivation: Polymer discovery faces challenges due to massive chemical design space and fragmented representations of structure-property relationships. Current AI models lack connection to physical/experimental reality, limiting their utility for actionable design decisions.
AI.method: PolyFusionAgent combines a multimodal foundation model (PolyFusion) and a tool-augmented design agent (PolyAgent). PolyFusion aligns polymer representations (sequence, topology, 3D geometry, fingerprints) across millions of polymers in a shared latent space, enabling cross-chemistry transfer. PolyAgent retrieves evidence from polymer literature to contextualize and validate design hypotheses.
AI.result: PolyFusion improves thermophysical property prediction accuracy and enables property-conditioned generation of chemically valid, structurally novel polymers beyond existing design spaces. PolyAgent closes the design loop by linking prediction with inverse design through literature-grounded evidence retrieval.
