AI.conclusion: PolyFusionAgent represents a significant advancement in AI-driven polymer discovery by bridging the gap between computational prediction and experimental reality through evidence-linked, interactive design.

title: MicroSpec: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Lightweight In-Context Vocabularies
summary: Large language models typically employ vocabularies of over 100k tokens, which creates a major computational bottleneck at the final linear projection layer when performing speculative decoding. Current methods for vocabulary pruning depend on either fixed or coarse-grained sub-vocabularies, requiring around 30k active tokens to preserve the quality of the draft model. We introduce MicroSpec, a training-free technique that overcomes this limitation by building a compact, context-sensitive active vocabulary on the fly for every decoding step. Exploiting the natural temporal locality found in language generation, MicroSpec attains high token coverage while reducing the average vocabulary size by more than 40x (down to under 3k tokens), all without any additional trained parameters. To translate this high sparsity into actual speedups on contemporary hardware, we present a co-designed system and algorithm that mitigates the overhead of sparse memory accesses via asynchronous gathering and GPU-resident state management. Acting as a plug-and-play enhancement, MicroSpec reduces draft inference latency by 51.6% on average, achieving an end-to-end speedup of 1.12-1.32x relative to the leading speculative decoding approach EAGLE-2 on various benchmarks, while also surpassing more sophisticated training-based pruning baselines.

AI.tldr: MicroSpec introduces a training-free technique for speculative decoding that builds compact, context-sensitive active vocabularies on the fly, achieving 40x vocabulary reduction and 1.12-1.32x speedup over state-of-the-art methods through co-designed sparse memory optimization.
AI.motivation: Large language models with vocabularies of over 100k tokens create a major computational bottleneck at the final linear projection layer during speculative decoding, and existing vocabulary pruning methods depend on fixed or coarse-grained sub-vocabularies requiring ~30k active tokens, limiting efficiency.
AI.method: MicroSpec dynamically constructs a compact, context-sensitive active vocabulary for each decoding step by exploiting temporal locality, and co-designs an asynchronous gathering system with GPU-resident state management to mitigate sparse memory access overhead.
AI.result: MicroSpec reduces average vocabulary size by more than 40x (to under 3k tokens) while maintaining high token coverage, and achieves 1.12-1.32x end-to-end speedup over EAGLE-2 with a 51.6% reduction in draft inference latency.
AI.conclusion: MicroSpec reduces draft inference latency by 51.6% on average, achieving an end-to-end speedup of 1.12-1.32x relative to EAGLE-2, while also surpassing more sophisticated training-based pruning baselines.

title: Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance on relational data, but real-world graphs are often distributed across organizations that cannot share raw data due to privacy and policy constraints. Existing federated GNN methods either ignore cross-client links, leading to degraded accuracy, or require frequent embedding exchanges, incurring substantial communication and privacy costs. We propose CE-FedGNN, a communication-efficient and privacy-preserving federated GNN framework for learning over such coupled graphs. Our approach avoids sharing raw data or per-round embeddings by infrequently exchanging aggregated node representations. To handle cross-client dependency and staleness, we introduce a moving-average estimator that continuously tracks node representations and enables their stable reuse across rounds. To provide formal privacy guarantees for the released representations, we adopt the metric differential privacy (metric-DP) framework, which measures privacy with respect to distances in the learned embedding space rather than worst-case input perturbations. This yields meaningful guarantees at noise levels where standard differential privacy becomes overly conservative. We establish convergence to a stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ with $O(T^{3/4})$ communication complexity. In addition, we derive $(\varepsilon,δ)$-metric-DP guarantees via Rényi differential privacy composition under a public-cohort threat model. Experiments on synthetic interbank anti-money laundering benchmarks and citation networks demonstrate that CE-FedGNN achieves strong performance while significantly reducing communication and maintaining robustness under privacy-preserving noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CE-FedGNN：面向跨机构耦合图（如银行间反洗钱交易网络）的联邦图神经网络框架。其核心是以低频（仅在通信轮次）交换"边界节点"的聚合嵌入而非原始数据或逐轮嵌入，并通过节点嵌入与随机梯度的滑动平均（moving-average）估计器缓解跨客户端依赖与陈旧性偏差；同时首次将度量差分隐私（metric-DP）引入联邦 GNN 训练，在嵌入空间 L2 距离上对释放嵌入给出 (ε,δ)-metric-DP 保证（公开队列威胁模型，RDP 组合）。理论上达到 O(1/√T) 收敛率、O(T^{3/4}) 通信复杂度；在合成反洗钱基准与 Cora/Citeseer/PubMed/MSAcademic 引用网络上一致优于 FedAvg、Swift、FedGCN、FedGNN-ST 等基线，并在噪声下保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 真实图数据常分散在不同组织（如银行间交易网络），受 GDPR/CCPA 等法规约束无法共享原始数据。现有联邦 GNN 存在根本权衡：(1) 忽略跨客户端边导致表示不完整有偏、精度下降；(2) 每轮交换嵌入通信开销巨大；(3) 低频交换又无法适应表示漂移（representation drift）。此外，联邦学习中交换的嵌入本身可能泄露敏感信息，而针对逐节点嵌入释放的最坏情况 L2 敏感度等于嵌入球直径，使标准 DP 在实用噪声水平下变得空洞（vacuous）。因此需要一个同时实现跨客户端建模精度、低通信成本与可证明隐私的方案。
AI.method: 方法分三部分。①问题设定：消息传递式 GNN（GCN/GraphSAGE-mean/GIN），节点或边级预测头，跨客户端边对双方可见（边属性共享）但节点特征私有。②通信高效算法（Algorithm 1, CE-FedGNN）：服务器维护全局嵌入缓冲区，客户端本地做 K 步小批量训练；前向使用滑动平均嵌入估计器 H̃=(1-γ)H̃+γW·mean(邻居)（仅对节点、不对边，因为边数远大于节点数）；梯度用滑动平均估计器 G=(1-β)G+β∇̂F；跨客户端边只回传自己端点的梯度分量、另一端嵌入按最近一次共享值（陈旧）视为固定输入，通过两客户端的对称采样/再加权使聚合梯度对 W^e 无偏；仅需一跳跨客户端交互，无需多跳采样。③隐私扩展：仅在通信时对共享嵌入注入高斯噪声 σ0、对聚合模型参数与梯度注入 σ1、σ2；采用 Chatzikokolakis 等人的 metric-DP（Pr[M(x)∈S] ≤ e^{ε·d(x,x')}Pr[M(x')∈S]+δ，d 为嵌入空间 L2 距离）；用 Rényi DP 组合（无放回放大，样本率 1）给出 R' 轮组合后的 (ε(ρ),δ) 保证；ρ 由 k-匿名式构造取第 k 近邻距离分布的 q 分位数。
AI.result: 理论结果：Lemma 3.2/3.3 分别刻画嵌入估计误差与梯度估计误差；Theorem 3.4 给出平均梯度范数 O(1/(ηRK)+1/(βRK)+1/(γpRK)+β/N+γ/p+β²K²)，取 γ=β=η=Θ(R^{-2/3})、K=Θ(R^{1/3}) 得 R=Θ(T^{3/4}) 时 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛率，迭代复杂度 O(ε^{-4})、通信复杂度 O(ε^{-3})，且 p 随 N 增长时可得 O(N^{-1}ε^{-4}) 的线性加速。Theorem 3.6 给出组合高斯机制的 (ε(ρ),δ)-metric-DP 保证（ρ 取嵌入球直径时退化为标准 DP）；Theorem 3.7 表明噪声下收敛界以 σ0² 二次形式进入，而 σ1、σ2 以 1/β 进入，说明更强的嵌入扰动可被容忍。实验：AML 六个 HI/LI×Small/Medium/Large 设置中 CE-FedGNN-PNA 全部最优（如 HI-Large 0.7114 vs 次优 0.6461），LI 极端不平衡下多数基线崩溃而本方法保持优势；引用网络四数据集全部第一（Cora 0.4701、Citeseer 0.4343、PubMed 0.6517、MSAcademic 0.8497）；通信间隔 K 增至 1024 时性能几乎不降；σ0 增大时呈清晰的效用-噪声权衡但仍可与 FedAvg 竞争；消融显示去掉全局嵌入共享或改用陈旧嵌入均显著变差；属性推理攻击下重建误差高于 1% 最近邻距离基线；单轮运行时间与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: CE-FedGNN 通过低频交换滑动平均节点嵌入，在保持跨客户端全局结构建模能力的同时显著降低通信量，并首次为联邦 GNN 的逐节点嵌入释放给出公开队列威胁模型下的 (ε,δ)-metric-DP 形式化保证，从而在标准 DP 已变得空洞的中等噪声水平上仍获得有意义的隐私。实验验证其在 AML 与引用网络任务上的精度、极低通信频率下的稳健性及噪声下的效用保持能力。局限与展望：该类系统具有双重用途（检测能力提升亦可能被用于缺乏监督的监控），因此形式化隐私保证尤为重要；由于公开可观测的释放队列无法利用子采样放大，隐私增益受限，作者指出可结合安全聚合或匿名洗牌进一步改进；AML 实验因监管限制使用合成数据，真实交易数据上的验证仍待补充。

title: ConVer: Using Contracts and Loop Invariant Synthesis for Scalable Formal Software Verification
summary: Formal verification of large C programs is impeded by state-space explosion: Bounded Model Checking (BMC) tools must encode the entire state space up to the predetermined bound by unrolling all nested constructs. We present ConVer, a top-down compositional verification tool. Given a C program with a top-level assertion, ConVer decomposes verification top-down: it uses a large language model (LLM) to synthesise function contracts from the system property, then alternates system-level and function-level checks in a CEGAR-CEGIS loop, refining contracts whenever a check fails via SMART ICE learning. We evaluate ConVer on four benchmark suites of increasing difficulty and against other state-of-the-art (SOTA) tools. On the Frama-C benchmark of 45 simple C programs, ConVer achieves 82-96% verification success across three LLM backends, with 93-95% of converged programs requiring only a single CEGAR-CEGIS iteration. On the X.509 parser benchmark (6~programs) and LF2C-Simple suite (17 programs), ConVer achieves 33-50% and 82-88% success respectively. On the VerifyThis suite of 11 recursive and loop-intensive programs, the Pre-Abstraction strategy achieves 55-64% success. In addition, we present ESBMC-LF a preprocessor tool that converts LF models to C while preserving the properties of the LF files, enabling ConVer to verify them. We transpile the LF Verifier Benchmarks using ESBMC-LF to C; we denote those LF-Hard. We show that ConVer successfully verifies 67% of LF-Hard benchmarks overall.

AI.tldr: ConVer 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自顶向下组合式 C 程序形式化验证工具：从 main() 的系统级断言出发，由 LLM 合成各函数契约（前置条件/后置条件/assigns），在 CEGAR-CEGIS 循环中交替执行系统级检查（调用替换为契约桩）与函数级检查（实现对契约的符合性检查），失败时通过 SMART ICE 学习（正例/负例/蕴含例分类）驱动契约精化，并在需要时按需合成循环不变式；还提出 ESBMC-LF 预处理器把 Lingua Franca 模型转成保留验证属性的 C 代码。实验覆盖 Frama-C(45)、LF2C-Simple(17)、X.509(6)、VerifyThis(11)、LF-Hard(24) 共 79+24 个程序，在 Qwen-Plus、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-OSS 120b 三种后端下分别取得 82–96%、82–88%、33–50%、55–64% 与 46–62% 的验证成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型 C 程序的形式化验证受制于状态空间爆炸：有界模型检查（BMC，如 ESBMC、CBMC）必须将程序展开到预设界限并编码整个状态空间，函数调用与循环嵌套都会使求解器负担迅速增长，导致超过数百行的程序基本无法验证。传统缓解手段是手写函数契约，但这一工作专家密集、实践中采纳率低（即便 AWS 的 s2n-tls 等资源充足项目也需专职验证工程师投入大量标注），且自底向上逐个函数写规格的负担极大。作者希望：①以自顶向下的属性分解降低规格负担——只需契约刻画系统属性所要求的内容，而非函数全部语义；②用 LLM 自动化契约的生成与精化，把人从标注工作中解放出来，同时保持验证决策由模型检查器承担以确保可靠性（soundness）；③扩展到循环密集、递归密集及真实世界的指针密集型代码（如 X.509 解析器）这类 BMC 难以直接处理的场景。
AI.method:
1) 自顶向下属性分解：以 main() 中单一顶层 assert() 为系统属性 φ，抽取函数集合 F，按复杂度阈值 τ 将函数分为低复杂度集 F_L 与高复杂度集 F_H；低复杂度函数由 LLM 合成精确契约，高复杂度函数生成“sound but loose”的过近似抽象契约（较弱的 ensures 如空指针安全、值域界，加上覆盖所有可能被修改全局量的 assigns），LLM 失败时用启发式回退生成平凡 ensures 与基于函数体扫描的 assigns。

2) 双层验证（基于 ESBMC 8.1.0 的函数契约与循环不变式机制）：系统级（Replace 模式）将调用替换为抽象桩 abs(P,Q,s0)={s | P(s0) ∧ Q(s0,s)}，仅 havoc assigns 指定位置，不探索函数内部；函数级（Enforce 模式）假设前置条件、执行真实实现、断言后置条件，即证明 ∀s0. P(s0) ⇒ ⟦f⟧(s0) ∈ abs(P,Q,s0)，等价于标准 Hoare 三元组。两级皆通过即由替换（substitution）得出端到端可靠性。

3) CEGAR 主循环（最多 5 轮）：每轮根据反例精化契约并重新验证；函数级失败指示 LLM 放松契约，系统级失败指示 LLM 加强契约，二者方向相反；出现停滞时以 Delta Debugging 变体作为“停滞破除器”，逐条删除停滞函数的后置条件子句直至通过。

4) CEGIS 升级（再最多 5 轮，累计 10 轮预算，超出则判为 inconclusive）：构建约束数据库 D，累积正例 E+（通过配置）、负例 E−（必须排除的状态）、蕴含例（由程序行为与函数体结构模式推断的归纳关系），每次合成都在完整约束集条件下进行，并从 CEGAR 迁移已有反例。

5) SMART ICE 反例处理管线：解析 ESBMC 原始输出，区分工具级失败（超时/内部错误/解析拒绝，单独记录）与语义反例；后者再分类为语法错误、未解析、工具错误、未受约束初始化、语义违反，仅将“语义违反”与“未受约束初始化”纳入 E− 以抑制噪声；对系统级失败将变量映射到责任函数，计算 gap 分数并标记最弱环节函数，最终渲染为结构化诊断块（轨迹 + E+/E− 分析）注入 LLM 提示。

6) 循环不变式按需合成：ESBMC 的 __ESMC_loop_invariant() 以基例+保持性+退出蕴含三步归纳论证替代循环展开，嵌入 CEGIS 循环，作为有界检查不足时的补充。

7) Pre-Abstraction（预抽象）五阶段流水线：1a 生成高复杂度函数的过近似抽象；1b 并发为低复杂度函数合成精确契约；2 用抽象作为函数摘要做快速系统级过近似检查；3 逐函数原子化验证（无条件执行）；4 用已验证的精确契约替换对应抽象，未验证者保留保守抽象；5 若替换后仍不满足系统属性则升级到 CEGAR/CEGIS。复杂度评分由正则静态分析得出的循环数/嵌套深度、递归与无界循环（大额惩罚）、动态内存分配（中等）、分支与指针操作（较小）等指标的加权和决定，映射为 minimal(<5)、low(≥5)、medium(≥10)、high(≥20) 四个爆炸风险层级。

8) ESBMC-LF 预处理器（7 步）：用 LFC 将 LF 编译为语义等价 C；平台路径/头文件归一化；将 reactor-c 运行时替换为“运营模型”（stub 调度器、事件队列、token 生命周期）并扁平化为单一翻译单元；从原始 LF 源码抽取 MTL 属性并映射符号到 C 位置；用九种仪表化模板将 MTL 编码为 __ESBMC_assert/__ESBMC_assume 与跟踪变量；解析输出拓扑构建级联图，用带 is_present 守卫的直接函数调用替换调度分发，按定时器周期与属性时间域推导有限可完全展开的循环界；后处理剥离死代码、固定预处理常量、传播动作值、去除行指令。产物构成 LF-Hard（24 个 1998–4328 LOC 的单体 C 程序）。

9) 实验设置：ESBMC 8.1.0 后端，每程序最多 5 次 CEGAR 迭代；LLM 后端为 Qwen3.5-Plus（DashScope 云 API）、Claude Haiku 4.5（Anthropic 云 API）、本地 Ollama 部署的 GPT-OSS 120b（4×RTX A6000）；超时 Frama-C/LF2C-Simple/X.509 为 600 s、VerifyThis 为 900 s；策略对比 SmartICE（完整 CEGAR+ICE）与 No-ICE（消融），VerifyThis 专用 Pre-Abstraction。
AI.result:
RQ1（验证有效性）：Frama-C 45 个程序：GPT-OSS 120b 43/45（96%）、Qwen-Plus 40/45（89%）、Claude Haiku 4.5 37/45（82%），且 93–95% 的收敛程序仅需一次 CEGAR 迭代；LF2C-Simple 17 个程序：82%–88%（14/14/15）；X.509 6 个程序明显更难，33%–50%（3/3/2），反映当前 LLM 为指针密集底层代码合成可靠契约的能力缺口，且三种后端均无法弥合。

RQ2（ICE 学习贡献，消融）：ICE 并非普遍增益，而是“能力条件化的放大器”。GPT-OSS 120b +2 个程序（96% vs 91%），Qwen-Plus +1（89% vs 87%）；Claude Haiku 4.5 反而少收敛 2 个（37 vs 39）。原因有二：模型产出语法畸形的契约（如在需 C 整数表达式处使用布尔字面量）导致解析错误被当作负例入库，使后续精化远离表面模式却持续产出畸形表达式直至耗尽迭代预算；以及 ESBMC 反例格式无法被解析时，语义空条目进入 E− 并以“具有结构含义”的姿态回灌给模型，噪声伪装成信号。较强后端能更稳定产出语法良好的契约与结构化反例，使 ICE 数据库保持干净、反馈真正有效。

RQ3（复杂程序可扩展性）：LF-Hard 24 个程序（Pre-Abstraction，600 s）：无契约的直接 ESBMC 基线为 10/24（42%），ConVer 提升至 Qwen-Plus 11/24（46%）、Haiku 4.5 12/24（50%）、GPT-OSS 15/24（62%），增益来自 Election、ADASModel、ProcessMsg 等单体展开会超时、而契约分解可把每个函数级 SMT 实例降到可解规模的程序；ProcessSync 因 ESBMC 在系统级检查阶段即拒绝其结构而在所有后端统一 FAILED（不计入收敛数）。大多数收敛程序无需 CEGAR 精化（迭代 0）。VerifyThis 11 个程序（900 s）：Haiku 4.5 7/11（64%）与流水线作者的手工配置参考结果持平，Qwen-Plus 与 GPT-OSS 均 6/11（55%）；四个全后端失败的程序（MultCommutative、duplets、prefixsum、prefixsum_rec）涉及超出当前契约合成能力的复杂过程间不变式。

与 SOTA 比较：与 ACSE 在同一 Frama-C 与 X.509 基准上直接可比，ACSE 支持量化循环不变式（如 ∀i. a[i]≥0）而 ConVer 因 ESBMC 契约机制不支持 requires/ensures 中的一阶量词被限制在无量词的 45 个程序子集；ConVer 优势在于以形式化反例迭代精化而非一次性符号推断。与 PolyVer 互补：PolyVer 在 LF 源级用 UCLID5 达到 22/22，ConVer 则在包含完整运行时的 1998–4328 LOC 翻译 C 上达到 15/24（GPT-OSS，全部运行合计 16/24），二者不可直接比较。此外跨全部四种配置有 4–5 个程序处于“仅系统级通过”的持续状态，原因是 LLM 反复生成过强契约而 5 轮预算不足以放松之。已知可靠性保留点：ESBMC 不支持指针解引用目标形式的 assigns（如 assigns *instance_args），这类子句被剥离，指针参数所修改状态的框架条件未被机械验证——这是 ESBMC 后端限制而非组合方法本身的缺陷，requires/ensures 与标量 assigns 均正常验证，方法可靠性论证对契约中被验证的部分成立。
AI.conclusion:
ConVer 证明了一条可行路径：把 LLM 用于“提出候选规格”、把模型检查器用于“做出验证判决”，可以在保持可靠性（soundness 仅取决于 ESBMC 而非 LLM）的前提下自动化组合式验证的自顶向下契约合成。其核心结论有三：(1) 在结构良好的算法型程序上（Frama-C 82–96%、LF2C-Simple 82–88%），CEGAR+ICE 循环几乎与模型无关，且绝大多数程序只需一次迭代即可收敛，说明瓶颈在契约生成而非求解能力；(2) SMART ICE 学习是能力条件化的放大器而非无条件改进——它只在 LLM 已能产出高质量契约与结构化反例时带来收益，在小模型上因反例数据库被噪声污染甚至适得其反；(3) 在大型与结构复杂程序上（LF-Hard 46–62%），结果与模型能力严格排序，说明约束瓶颈是契约合成质量；Pre-Abstraction 的“抽象优先、原子验证、再精化”分层策略能把直接 ESBMC 无法在预算内验证的程序转为可验证。

局限与展望：Frama-C 基准均为简单的单断言程序，向多属性、多函数程序的泛化尚未验证；LLM 输出具有随机性，每种配置仅运行一次，未做重复试验；不支持多顶层断言、无法量化的数组不变式、指针 assigns 缺失、以及深度过程间不变式是主要能力缺口；4–5 个“仅系统级通过”的顽固案例提示需要更高迭代预算与自动循环不变式合成。后续工作方向为：扩展至多顶层断言的程序；引入混合模型选择策略，按程序复杂度路由到便宜快速的 LLM 或更强的推理模型。工具、全部基准、预计算结果与复现脚本已以 Zenodo 复制包公开。

title: MobileExplorer: Accelerating On-Device Inference for Mobile GUI Agents via Online Exploration
summary: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable AI models to autonomously operate smartphones on behalf of users. However, most existing systems focus primarily on optimizing task accuracy and rely on cloud-hosted models for inference, which introduces privacy concerns and network-dependent latency. As a result, fully on-device deployment of mobile GUI agents remains underexplored. We propose MobileExplorer, a new framework that accelerates on-device inference for vision-based mobile GUI agents via online exploration. The key idea is to exploit the long per-step reasoning time of vision-language models (VLMs) by performing lightweight, parallel exploration of UI elements. During model inference, the agent proactively probes semantically relevant UI elements and records these exploration traces as structured memory. To ensure reliable execution in live mobile environments, we design a two-level rollback mechanism that robustly restores the initial UI state when a fast but naive backtracking strategy fails. The collected exploration traces are then summarized into concise contextual hints and injected into the prompt to enhance the subsequent reasoning step. We evaluate MobileExplorer on multiple off-the-shelf devices using the AndroidWorld benchmark, as well as newly designed, more complex tasks and dynamic on-device environments. MobileExplorer reduces the average number of reasoning steps and end-to-end latency by 23\%, while maintaining or improving task success rates by up to 5\%. A video demonstration of MobileExplorer performance in the real world is available at https://youtu.be/thK7MJmdlvM .

AI.tldr: MobileExplorer 是一种完全端侧（on-device）的视觉型移动 GUI 智能体框架，其核心思想是"时间复用"：利用端侧 VLM 每步数十秒的推理空闲窗口，并行地对语义相关的 UI 元素进行轻量在线探索（点击、观察页面跳转），把探索轨迹压缩成结构化文本提示注入下一步提示词，从而在不增加模型调用次数的前提下减少交互步数与端到端延迟。配合两级回滚机制（感知哈希校验的深度受限回退 + 回桌面重放轨迹的确定性恢复），保证在真实设备上探索后能恢复到原 UI 状态。在 AndroidWorld（116 任务）上成功率 50.86%，优于对比方法（相对 M3A 提升 9.3%），交互步数与端到端延迟分别下降约 15.5%/15.9%（摘要与结论中给出约 23% 的口径），并在复杂 UI、弹窗干扰、资源动态变化的真机场景中保持稳定表现与低开销。
AI.motivation: 移动 GUI 智能体普遍依赖云端大模型推理，虽能保证精度，但带来隐私外泄与网络延迟问题，完全端侧部署仍属空白。端侧部署面临三重挑战：(1) VLM 视觉推理计算/内存开销大，即便轻量模型 MAI-UI-2B 在三星 Galaxy S24 上单步也需约 40 秒；(2) 细粒度视觉定位难以像无障碍树那样压缩或结构化；(3) 移动界面高度动态（弹窗、内容刷新、机型差异），往往需要多轮推理。作者对端到端延迟做分解测量后发现关键"延迟失衡"：单步 VLM 推理耗时数十秒，而 UI 感知与点击交互仅需 1–2 秒；现有系统采用"感知—推理—操作"串行流水线，模型推理期间设备完全空闲。任务本身又具长程性（部分任务需 15–20 步以上），单步延迟沿轨迹累积导致端到端耗时极高。因此核心机会在于：把"本应浪费的推理空闲时间"转化为探索时间，用极低成本获取额外的任务相关界面上下文，减少后续决策的不确定性与试错步数。已有加速方案各有局限：多步规划/脚本式执行在动态 UI 下脆弱；验证器流水线依赖候选质量；token/上下文剪枝可能丢失细粒度视觉信息；而离线知识库（GUI-explorer、LLM-Explorer、AutoDroid 状态转移图）构建成本高、难泛化到动态界面。
AI.method:
框架流程为"部分并行"执行流水线：每步截屏与任务描述送入 VLM 推理的同时，同一设备上启动探索控制器。探索控制器解析无障碍树获取可点击元素及其精确坐标，将元素（文本标签、content-desc、resource-id 等）转为轻量文本表示，用轻量文本嵌入模型计算与任务描述的余弦相似度得到相关性分数 r(a)，并对历史已访问元素施加惩罚项 λ·1[a∈H]，按综合优先级 S(a) 排序依次探测，深度上限 d、时间预算 τ_i^explore 内终止，记录新屏幕与元素形成探索上下文 C_i。

回滚采用两级机制：Level-1 为深度受限回退，即连续执行最多 d 次 back，每步用截图 pHash 计算 Hamming 距离与起始屏哈希 H_0 比较，距离 ≤ 阈值 τ 即认为恢复成功（选截图而非无障碍树是因为截屏延迟远低于取树，且 pHash 容忍动态元素造成的轻微视觉差异）；Level-2 为"回桌面+重放"，当 Level-1 失败（如触发权限/确认弹窗导致 back 跳过中间态）时，返回 Home 后确定性重放记录的动作轨迹 Π_i 重建原状态。

探索增强推理：每次访问屏幕记录 (pHash, 解析出的 UI 元素) 紧凑观测；执行推理动作到达 s_{i+1} 后，用其 pHash 与探索观测做 Hamming 距离匹配筛选出相关观测集合 O_i^match；再按任务相关性排序选取少量元素，经模板化摘要生成简洁文本提示，附加到下一步提示词（当前截图 + 任务指令 + 探索上下文）。实验采用双设备设置：Android 模拟器执行交互，模型经 vLLM/llama.cpp（Q8 量化）在 Galaxy S24、Jetson AGX Orin、MacBook Air M4 上推理；基线含 M3A、T3A、输入剪枝 VLM、离线探索智能体。
AI.result: AndroidWorld 全部 116 个任务上成功率 50.86%（59/116），高于 M3A 的 46.55%（相对提升 9.3%），也高于 M3A(SoM, Gemini-2.5-Pro) 39.7%、UI-TARS-7B 33.0%、GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking 41.7% 等榜单方法；平均交互步数 9.24 对 10.93（↓15.5%），端到端延迟 185.82 秒（↓15.9%）。真机案例研究覆盖三类真实特性（复杂 UI 平均 48 个交互元素 vs AndroidWorld 的 19.75、闹钟/消息/来电/通知等弹窗干扰、视频与音乐播放造成的资源动态），成功率相当或更高且延迟持续下降，复杂 UI 场景收益最明显。消融显示：随机探索替代任务相关性选择使成功率从 50.9% 降至 42.2%；移除两级回滚降幅最大（39.7%，且延迟上升）；关闭探索对齐降至 47.4%。分任务类别看，复杂 UI 理解、搜索、信息检索等视觉密集型任务提升明显，而数据录入/编辑等确定性序列任务略低于 M3A。回滚统计显示 Level-1 处理大多数情况，复杂页面 Level-2 占比更高，整体回滚成功率保持高位。提示遵循率随 UI 复杂度上升，且遵循率高的任务成功率一致更高。微基准显示 2B/8B 不同规模模型均受益（平均省约 1 个推理步）；分辨率实验中 MobileExplorer 在中等分辨率下最佳。系统开销方面，内存与功耗基本持平，控制逻辑每步仅增加数十毫秒，回滚校验因截图检查开销最大但相对秒级推理可忽略。
AI.conclusion: MobileExplorer 证明"在端侧 VLM 推理的空闲窗口内做有界在线探索"是可行的加速路径：它把推理延迟从纯粹负担转化为信息采集机会，在完全本地、零云通信的条件下，通过任务相关性驱动的探索 + 两级回滚 + 探索增强推理的组合，在维持甚至提升任务成功率（最高 +5%）的同时降低交互步数与端到端延迟（摘要/结论口径约 23%）。其价值在于无需离线知识库、可适应动态真实界面，额外系统开销极小。局限与后续方向：当前探索策略相对固定，作者计划引入依据任务需求与 UI 复杂度动态调整探索路径的自适应策略，并进一步研究 UI 探索与模型推理之间更复杂的耦合关系。需注意文中数值口径不完全一致——摘要与结论称步数与延迟下降约 23%，而正文 §6.2 给出的是步数 ↓15.5%、延迟 ↓15.9%（成功率"最高 +5%"与正文 9.3% 相对提升亦不完全对应），另有 23% 与"约省一个推理步"的表述混淆可能，读者应以正文实验数据为准。

title: Curation and Extraction of Drug-Related Entities from Reddit Platform
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2026)
summary: Physicians learn primarily about illicit drugs from clinical overdose cases, limiting their understanding of real-world usage. Meanwhile, drug users share first-hand experiences online, offering insights into dosage and effects of drugs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReDose (REddit Drug DOSe and Effect), a dataset of 6,435 Reddit posts on substance use. A board-certified toxicologist primarily annotated both the training and test sets, while two medical science students contributed to the test set, labeling DRUG, DOSE, and EFFECT entities. We benchmarked 6,267 annotations using BERT-based, large language model (LLM)-based, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models. BiomedBERT achieved an F1-score of 0.843 for DRUG, while Llama-3 70B outperformed GPT-4 (F1 = 0.79 vs. 0.72). EFFECT extraction remains challenging, with GPT-4 achieving a recall of 0.41. ReDose captures patient-curated narratives to advance medical data extraction from social media.

AI.tldr: ReDose is a dataset of 6,435 Reddit posts on substance use, annotated for DRUG, DOSE, and EFFECT entities. It benchmarks various models, showing LLM-based approaches (Llama-3 70B, GPT-4) outperform biomedical BERT models, though EFFECT extraction remains difficult.
AI.motivation: Physicians' knowledge of illicit drugs is limited to clinical overdose cases, lacking real-world usage insights; meanwhile, drug users share experiences on online platforms like Reddit, creating a data gap that prevents medical professionals from leveraging user-generated content.
AI.method: ReDose dataset (6,435 Reddit posts, 6,267 annotations); annotation by board-certified toxicologist and medical students; evaluation of BiomedBERT, GPT-4, Llama-3 70B, and RAG models for DRUG, DOSE, and EFFECT entity extraction.
AI.result: BiomedBERT achieved F1=0.843 for DRUG entities; Llama-3 70B (F1=0.79) outperformed GPT-4 (F1=0.72); EFFECT extraction remains challenging with GPT-4 recall at 0.41.
AI.conclusion: ReDose provides a valuable resource for extracting medical information from social media, with LLM-based models showing promise, though EFFECT extraction remains challenging and requires further research.

title: The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias, the mismatch between training and inference distributions. To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge-Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: Bridges, where the next token must be exact, and Gardens, where it can be flexible. We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens. A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence. Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge-Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels. Across a primary suite of seven teacher-student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by 9.7x, enabling efficient model compression. Code is available at https://github.com/ghwang-s/bridge_garden_hybrid_kd_release.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示hard/soft标签混合优于单独使用的本质原因——减少暴露偏差而非更好的教师匹配；提出Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论解释该现象，并基于此开发自适应混合监督方法，在模型压缩任务中实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏中，soft标签看似信息更丰富，但单独使用hard或soft标签都存在局限：hard-only避免风险但缺乏多样性，soft-only保持多样性但可能偏离关键节点。
AI.method: 提出Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论，将生成步骤分为必须精确的Bridges和可灵活的Gardens；开发自适应平衡hard和soft标签的混合监督方法。
AI.result: 混合策略同时处理Bridges和Gardens，降低了序列级别的暴露偏差；在7个师生模型对（Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek）的推理和编码基准测试中优于基于散度的on-policy KD基线，训练效率提升9.7倍。
AI.conclusion: Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论揭示了hard/soft标签混合优于单独使用的根本原因；基于此理论提出的混合监督方法在7个师生模型对和推理/编码任务上显著优于基线，同时将训练成本降低9.7倍。

title: EviACT: An Evidence-to-Action Framework for Agentic Program Repair
summary: LLM-based agents have moved automated program repair (APR) from fixed-context patch generation to interactive repository-level repair. However, existing agentic APR systems still struggle to use execution evidence to guide localization, patch generation, and validation. We propose EviACT (Evidence-to-Action), an agentic APR framework that coordinates three evidence-driven guardrails across repair stages. The retrieval scaffold grounds repair context, the compile gate filters invalid edits, and the test-driven gate checks target-test recovery before full regression. Across four benchmarks, EviACT improves resolve rate over the strongest reported comparable baselines by 1.6-6.0 percentage points and shows 70.1-88.6% lower reported per-bug API cost where baseline costs are available. Ablations and diagnostics suggest that these gains are associated with the coordinated evidence-to-action chain, making agentic APR more effective and efficient.

AI.tldr: EviACT提出了一种基于证据驱动的智能程序修复框架，通过三个阶段的防护机制（检索脚手架、编译门控、测试驱动门控）来协调证据到行动的转化，显著提升了自动程序修复的解决率和成本效率。
AI.motivation: Existing agentic APR systems struggle to effectively use execution evidence to guide the key repair stages: localization, patch generation, and validation.
AI.method: EviACT coordinates three evidence-driven guardrails across repair stages: (1) retrieval scaffold for grounding repair context, (2) compile gate for filtering invalid edits, and (3) test-driven gate for checking target-test recovery before full regression.
AI.result: Across four benchmarks, EviACT improves resolve rate over the strongest comparable baselines by 1.6-6.0 percentage points and achieves 70.1-88.6% lower per-bug API cost.
AI.conclusion: The coordinated evidence-to-action chain in EviACT enables more effective and efficient agentic APR, with improvements in both resolve rate (1.6-6.0 percentage points) and cost efficiency (70.1-88.6% lower API cost).

title: MedGuideX: Internalizing Decision Logic from Executable Guidelines into Large Language Models for Clinical Reasoning
summary: Clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) encode evidence-based decision logic that clinicians apply by evaluating patient variables, conditional criteria, and recommendation rules. However, existing methods often use CPGs as free-text training data or retrieval sources, underutilizing their procedural decision structure. To better exploit this structure, we introduce a guideline-derived training pipeline that transforms CPG recommendations into executable clinical decision logic and uses it to generate factual and counterfactual question-answering data. Theses data teach models both guideline-supported decisions and how decisions change under different patient conditions. Post-training a medical LLM on the generated data yields MedGuideX. Across four clinical reasoning benchmarks, MedGuideX achieves a 10.28% relative improvement in average accuracy. Physician evaluation further shows that MedGuideX better recovers clinician authored reasoning steps and produces physician-preferred rationales in faithfulness, validity, completeness, and clarity. Overall, our results show that executable decision logic from CPGs can be transformed into scalable supervision for building reliable medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: MedGuideX 将临床实践指南（CPG）的推荐规则转化为可执行的 Python 决策函数 f(X)，据此自动合成事实型与反事实临床问答监督，并用 SFT + GRPO 后训练 Qwen3.5-4B/9B，得到具备"指南逻辑内化"能力的医疗 LLM。在 MedQA、MedCaseReasoning、MIMIC-CDM-FI、ER-Reason 四个基准上，MedGuideX-9B 相对基座平均准确率提升 10.28%，为开源医疗 LLM 中最佳平均分；医生盲评显示其推理在忠实性、有效性、完整性上优于 GPT-5.0（整体非平局胜率 76.86%），推理步骤召回 62.77% vs GPT-5.0 的 50.78%。
AI.motivation: 临床实践指南（CPG）本质上编码的是"患者变量 → 条件判据 → 推荐规则"的可执行决策逻辑，但现有利用方式存在三方面不足：①把 CPG 当作自由文本训练语料（如 MEDITRON 式继续预训练）或检索/prompting 知识源，只暴露文本内容而未显式建模变量、条件与规则，程序性结构被浪费；②通用医学语料（病历、病例报告）只能提供隐式推理监督，噪声大、异质、不完整，与临床决策程序弱对齐，模型易学到广博知识却缺乏稳定可泛化的临床决策逻辑；③作者用实验证实，仅在推理时检索指南（+1.56%）、指南式少样本示例（+1.48%）收益微弱，而直接在原始指南文本上微调甚至出现负迁移（-9.08%），说明"文本级指南曝光"不足以习得可操作的决策规则。因此需要一个能把指南结构化为可验证、可规模化监督信号的范式。
AI.method: 1) 指南筛选：以 MEDITRON 所用开源 CPG 集合（37,970 篇）为起点，限定美国来源（CDC 607 篇 + PubMed 234 篇），用 LLM 抽取疾病/药物、年龄、种族、性别、发布日期等元数据做去重（保留最新版本）与残缺剔除，得到 841 篇高质量指南。2) 可执行化：切分为 3,127 个推荐导向 chunk（≤4500 词/块、每文档≤4 块、每块≤2 条推荐）→ LLM 抽取 4,750 条候选推荐（目标人群、临床条件、推荐动作、例外、证据等级）→ 校验并去除非条件-动作结构与近重复，保留 3,796 条 → 转为决策树 T_f（内部节点为原子谓词 a=1[g(X)]，如 age≥65、eGFR<30）→ LLM 校验完整性/分支覆盖/变量可溯源性，2,800 棵通过 → 编译为可执行 Python 函数（语法正确、采样可执行、与决策树一致），最终 2,793 个函数构成"可执行指南知识库"，既是标注器又是验证器。3) QA 合成：事实型——采样完整变量赋值 X，执行 f 得 Y_obs，施加"路径覆盖"与"输出平衡"约束（避免 no-diagnosis 主导）生成 4,963 条；反事实型——将变量划分为 X_obs/X_hid/x_int，执行干预前后 f，仅保留输出发生变化者并施加同等平衡规则，得 5,028 条，模型须完成"溯因（推断与 Y_obs 一致的隐藏变量）→ 干预 → 预测"三步推理；每条样本配 GPT-5.4-mini 生成的推理轨迹（ verbalize 决策路径 π_f(X) 或三步结构）。4) 训练：先在事实+反事实平衡混合数据上做 LoRA SFT（rank16、α=32、bf16、5 epoch、lr 1e-5、max len 2048、batch 64，verl，8×RTX 5090 约 16 h），再以该检查点初始化 GRPO（1 epoch、lr 5e-6、24 rollouts/prompt、KL 0.005、low-variance KL，约 33 h）；奖励 = 格式奖励（违规记 -1）+ 答案奖励，事实型以 f 执行结果为真值，反事实型奖励为"隐藏变量正确 ∧ 复现事实输出 ∧ 反事实输出正确"三项指示函数之积。消融显示最优配置为"混合数据 SFT → 事实型 RL"。5) 评测：四基准（MedQA 确定性解析 1,273 题；MedCaseReasoning 897 例 LLM 评审 + 推理召回；MIMIC-CDM-FI 1,000 例；ER-Reason Task 4 1,000 例），基线含前沿闭源模型、开源医疗 LLM、基座及 RAG/ICL/CPGPrompt/CPG 微调/CPG 过程奖励 RL，并做配对答案转移分析与 30 例医生盲评。
AI.result: 主结果：MedGuideX-9B 在 MedCaseReasoning/MedQA/MIMIC-CDM-FI/ER-Reason 分别为 41.36/80.13/85.20/28.70，相对 Qwen3.5-9B 提升 26.64%/9.45%/4.41%/11.67%，平均 58.77（+10.28%）；MedGuideX-4B 为 35.34/77.06/82.40/25.90，平均 55.18（+7.63%）。开源医疗 LLM 中平均分最高，在 MedCaseReasoning、MedQA、MIMIC-CDM-FI 上为最佳；MIMIC-CDM-FI 增益相对小，因其基座水平已高且需噪声 EHR 证据综合等超出指南决策逻辑的能力。指南类基线对比进一步支持核心论点：RAG +1.56%、3-shot ICL +1.48%、CPGPrompt（决策树提示）大幅下降 24.56%、原始 CPG 文本微调 -9.08%（负迁移）、最强指南基线"CPG 派生过程奖励 RL"仅 +5.37%，均不及可执行函数监督的 +10.28%。消融：仅在原始指南文本上继续预训练会显著掉分；SFT-only 中事实+反事实混合最佳，RL-only 中事实型奖励最稳，最优为混合 SFT → 事实 RL（较 Qwen3.5-9B 在 MedCaseReasoning +8.7、MedQA +6.9）。配对转移分析：4B 净增益 MedCaseReasoning +60、MedQA +59、MIMIC-CDM-FI +20、ER-Reason +23；9B 分别为 +78/+88/+36/+30，说明增益主要来自纠正基座错误而非无规律偏移。推理质量：推理召回 62.77% vs GPT-5.0 50.78%；30 例（40 次标注）盲评中 MedGuideX-9B 非平局胜率——忠实性 85.00%、有效性 79.31%、完整性 92.31%、清晰度 51.52%（接近持平），总体 76.86%。
AI.conclusion: CPGs 不应仅被视为无结构文本知识；其程序性决策逻辑可被抽取、编译为可执行函数，并转化为可规模化、自动可验证的监督信号（同时充当标签器与 RL 验证器），从而内化进 LLM 的推理行为。MedGuideX 表明，这种监督在困难推理场景（长篇病例诊断、急诊诊断）收益最大，优于检索增强、提示、原始文本微调与基于 LLM 评审的过程奖励等替代方案，并同时改善答案准确性与临床推理过程质量（医生可感知）。局限：模型仍可能在合成监督上产生偏差，指南覆盖与决策树抽取质量受 LLM 抽取/校验能力限制，评测依赖 LLM-as-a-judge 与小样本医生评测（30 例、2 名医师），且仅限美国来源指南。论文明确声明 MedGuideX 仅为研究系统，部署前仍需进一步外部验证、安全与偏差评估、监管审查及临床工作流整合。

title: Model Unlearning Objectives Vary for Distinct Language Functions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) learn undesirable properties during pretraining, including dangerous knowledge and toxic text generation. Just as post-training uses different objectives to shape different behaviors, we argue that unlearning methods should be designed for the language function at issue. To study this, we consider two mechanistically distinct unlearning goals, dangerous-knowledge unlearning and toxicity unlearning. For dangerous knowledge, we introduce a cosine-based, meta-learned variant of RMU. For toxicity, we propose a multi-layer objective based on layer-specific probe directions. Across four open-source 7-8B models, our methods achieve strong results, based on distinct training objectives for the two types of unlearning. Overall, our results suggest that unlearning should be studied as a family of problems, analogous to the multiple types of LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出针对LLM中不同类型不良知识的遗忘方法应采用差异化设计：危险知识遗忘采用余弦元学习方法，毒性遗忘采用多层探针方向目标。在4个7-8B模型上验证了方法有效性，表明遗忘研究应作为问题族来对待。
AI.motivation: LLM在预训练过程中会学习到不良属性（如危险知识和毒性文本），现有后训练使用不同目标函数塑造不同行为，同理，遗忘方法也应该针对不同的语言功能设计不同的方案。
AI.method: 针对危险知识遗忘：提出基于余弦的RMU元学习变体；针对毒性遗忘：提出基于层特定探针方向的多层目标函数。使用4个开源7-8B模型进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在四个开源7-8B模型上均取得了良好结果，证明了针对两种不同遗忘目标设计差异化训练目标的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: Unlearning应该被研究为一个问题族（family of problems），类似于LLM后训练的多种类型；针对不同类型的有害内容（如危险知识vs毒性），需要设计不同的训练目标和方法。

title: Unified Neural Scaling Laws
summary: We present a functional form (that we refer to as a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL)) that accurately models and extrapolates the scaling behaviors of deep neural networks as multiple dimensions all vary simultaneously (i.e. how the evaluation metric of interest varies as one simultaneously varies the number of model parameters, training dataset size, number of training steps, number of inference steps, amount of compute, and various hyperparameters) for various architectures and for each of various tasks within a varied set of upstream and downstream tasks. This set includes large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning. When compared to other functional forms for neural scaling, this functional form yields extrapolations of scaling behavior that are considerably more accurate on this set.

AI.tldr: The paper introduces a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL) — a functional form that jointly models scaling behaviors of neural networks across multiple simultaneously varying dimensions (parameters, data, compute, steps, hyperparameters) — and demonstrates its superior extrapolation accuracy over existing scaling law approaches on large-scale vision, language, math, and RL tasks.
AI.motivation: Existing neural scaling laws typically model scaling behavior with respect to only one or a few variables at a time. In practice, however, multiple dimensions vary simultaneously during training and deployment, and a unified framework is needed to accurately capture and extrapolate these complex interactions.
AI.method: The authors propose a unified functional form that jointly models how evaluation metrics vary as multiple dimensions (model parameters, dataset size, training steps, inference steps, compute, and hyperparameters) are varied simultaneously across diverse architectures and tasks.
AI.result: The UNSL functional form yields considerably more accurate extrapolations of scaling behavior compared to other functional forms tested across large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning tasks.
AI.conclusion: The proposed Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL) provides a more accurate functional form for extrapolating scaling behaviors compared to existing approaches, applicable across diverse architectures and task domains at large scale.

title: AGORA: Adapter-Grounded Observation-Action Retention for Inference-Free Prompt Compression in LLM Agents
summary: The token-level extractive compressors widely used for general LM context are structurally inappropriate for LLM agents: across 17 (env, backbone, method) cells spanning two independent token-level method families, every cell collapses to mean reward <= 0.05 despite 1.3-13.3x realized compression. We name and characterize this failure mode as action-grammar destruction -- the tokens carrying action semantics (identifiers, brackets, action verbs) are exactly those self-information ranks lowest, so a general-purpose compressor reliably removes them and the environment rejects the residual. The diagnosis points to step-granularity compression. We introduce AGORA, an inference-free step-level compressor combining a structural prompt parser, an always-keep floor for format- and recency-critical content, and a 125M-parameter relevance scorer trained on counterfactual next-action-change labels (~2ms/step, zero per-step LLM toll). Across the compared inference-free and LLM-based methods, AGORA is the only one retaining >= 75% uncompressed performance in 8 of 9 cells (with the lone exception at 73%); a four-way component ablation isolates the structural floor as the dominant quality lever and the learned scorer as the source of 1.0-11.5x adaptive end-to-end compression from a single fixed keep ratio.

AI.tldr: 论文发现用于LLM智能体的token级压缩器存在"动作语法破坏"问题——低自信息排名的动作语义token被错误删除。针对此问题，提出了AGORA方法，通过结构化解析器+always-keep机制+125M relevance scorer实现step级压缩，在17个实验配置中表现最优。
AI.motivation: Token-level extractive compressors widely used for general LM context are structurally inappropriate for LLM agents, causing "action-grammar destruction" -- tokens carrying action semantics (identifiers, brackets, action verbs) have the lowest self-information ranks, so general-purpose compressors reliably remove them, causing environment rejection.
AI.method: AGORA is an inference-free step-level compressor combining: (1) structural prompt parser, (2) always-keep floor for format- and recency-critical content, and (3) a 125M-parameter relevance scorer trained on counterfactual next-action-change labels (~2ms/step, zero per-step LLM toll).
AI.result: Across 17 (env, backbone, method) cells spanning two independent token-level method families, AGORA is the only method retaining >= 75% uncompressed performance in 8 of 9 cells (lone exception at 73%). Ablation confirms structural floor as the dominant quality lever and learned scorer as source of 1.0-11.5x adaptive end-to-end compression.
AI.conclusion: AGORA is the only method across 17 experimental cells that retains >= 75% uncompressed performance in 8 of 9 cells (lone exception at 73%), with ablation confirming the structural floor as the dominant quality lever and the learned scorer enabling 1.0-11.5x adaptive end-to-end compression from a single fixed keep ratio.

title: Towards Error-Free EHRs: Reasoning-Intensive Consistency Verification Between Clinical Notes and Structured Tables in Electronic Health Records
summary: Data consistency between unstructured clinical notes and structured tables in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) is essential for patient safety and clinical decision-making. However, existing work on note-table consistency verification mainly relies on surface-level matching of numeric values or simple events. Such approaches fail to capture the reasoning underlying real-world EHR documentation, including clinical interpretation, event relations, and temporal changes. To address this gap, we introduce EHR-ReasonCon, a reasoning-intensive benchmark for note-table consistency verification. Built on MIMIC-III with expert-guided annotations, it comprises 8,048 entities derived from clinical notes and provides high-quality ground-truth labels. The annotation protocol is supported by specialized table-exploration tools to ensure systematic evidence retrieval and reliable consistency assessment. We also propose EHR-Inspector, an LLM-based framework that segments notes, extracts anchor entities and temporal references, and uses table-exploration tools to verify consistency against structured tables. Evaluated using expert-validated LLM-as-a-judge metrics under harsh and lenient criteria, EHR-Inspector achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple model backbones. Analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness of its components and highlight differences from human verification.

AI.tldr: 针对EHR中临床笔记与结构化表格的一致性验证任务，提出 EHR-ReasonCon 推理密集型基准数据集和 EHR-Inspector LLM验证框架，实现并超越现有最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EHR中笔记-表格一致性验证方法仅依赖表面数值或简单事件匹配，无法捕捉临床推理、事件关系和时间变化的深层次逻辑。
AI.method: 构建EHR-ReasonCon基准数据集（基于MIMIC-III，包含8,048个实体）；提出EHR-Inspector框架，采用LLM进行笔记分段、锚定实体与时间引用提取，并利用表格探索工具进行一致性验证。
AI.result: EHR-Inspector在严苛与宽松标准下均达到SOTA性能，验证了各组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EHR-Inspector框架在多个模型主干上达到最优性能，其组件有效性得到验证，同时揭示了LLM自动验证与人类专家验证之间的差异。

title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
comment: Variants of this manuscript were accepted to the ICML 2026 workshops SCALE and F2S
summary: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contribution of cached keys, a phenomenon we call the Jensen bias. This effect causes quantized keys to steal attention mass from the unquantized current chunk. We derive a per-attention-score correction that removes this bias in expectation, computed on the fly from the quantization step sizes of the cached keys and the query norm. Using a second-order Taylor approximation, the additional computational overhead is negligible, and no additional memory is needed alongside the cache. Evaluated on MAGI-1, SkyReels-V2, and HY-WorldPlay at INT2 quantization, our correction recovers most of the quality lost to aggressive quantization, reaching near-BF16 video quality, and can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

AI.tldr: KV cache quantization in video diffusion models introduces a systematic bias in attention weights (Jensen bias) due to quantization noise inflating cached key contributions. The paper derives a per-attention-score correction using second-order Taylor approximation that removes this bias with negligible overhead, recovering near-BF16 quality at INT2 quantization while saving 50% memory vs INT4.
AI.motivation: Long-form video generation with chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models suffers from KV cache memory bottleneck. Existing low bitwidth KV cache quantization methods degrade video quality, limiting their practical applicability.
AI.method: A per-attention-score correction derived from quantization step sizes and query norm, using a second-order Taylor approximation for on-the-fly computation. No additional memory beyond the existing cache.
AI.result: At INT2 quantization, the correction recovers most quality lost to aggressive quantization, approaching near-BF16 video quality. It can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.
AI.conclusion: The Jensen bias correction effectively recovers quality lost to aggressive KV cache quantization, achieving near-BF16 quality at INT2 while potentially outperforming INT4 with 50% less memory. The method incurs negligible computational overhead and requires no additional memory.

title: EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering
summary:
Flowcharts are widely used in industrial requirements, but usually remain embedded as static images. Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise in the conversion of these flowcharts into machine-readable models for RE activities, yet, when directly applied to flowchart conversion, they often fail on topology-critical visual details. To address this, we propose EdgeFlow that augments a VLM's original input with a deterministically extracted Canny edge map-acting as a structural prior-to improve flowchart-to-Mermaid conversion, without requiring annotated training data or domain-specific model fine-tuning.
  We evaluate EdgeFlow on IndusReqFlow, a dataset sourced from real-world requirements. Compared with off-the-shelf VLMs, EdgeFlow improves node-level F1 by 17.39 percentage points and edge-level F1 by 16.94 percentage points. At the path level, EdgeFlow improves path F1 by 11.06 percentage points, enabling better support for model-based testing. These results demonstrate that EdgeFlow provides a practical, training-free means to improve topology-preserving flowchart-to-Mermaid conversion for industrial RE. Cross-dataset evaluation results on a public synthetic benchmark show no significant improvement; this highlights the need for diverse benchmarks incorporating industrial data for the comprehensive evaluation of future VLM-based RE tools.

AI.tldr: EdgeFlow通过将Canny边缘图作为结构先验增强VLM输入，无需训练数据或微调即可显著提升工业需求流程图的拓扑保持转换性能，为基于模型的测试提供更好支持。但该方法在合成基准数据集上无显著提升，凸显了当前评估框架缺乏工业数据多样性的问题。
AI.motivation: Flowcharts are widely used in industrial requirements but remain embedded as static images. Vision Language Models show promise for converting these flowcharts into machine-readable models for RE activities, yet they often fail on topology-critical visual details when directly applied to flowchart conversion.
AI.method: EdgeFlow augments a Vision Language Model's original input with a deterministically extracted Canny edge map that serves as a structural prior, without requiring annotated training data or domain-specific model fine-tuning. This edge map provides topology-critical visual details that VLMs typically miss when processing flowcharts.
AI.result: On the IndusReqFlow dataset (real-world requirements), EdgeFlow improves node-level F1 by 17.39 percentage points, edge-level F1 by 16.94 percentage points, and path-level F1 by 11.06 percentage points compared to off-the-shelf VLMs, enabling better support for model-based testing. However, cross-dataset evaluation on a public synthetic benchmark shows no significant improvement.
AI.conclusion: EdgeFlow provides a training-free solution for improving topology-preserving flowchart-to-Mermaid conversion in industrial RE, with significant improvements across node-level, edge-level, and path-level F1 scores on real-world industrial data. However, the method's ineffectiveness on synthetic benchmarks indicates that current evaluation frameworks lack the diversity needed to comprehensively assess VLM-based RE tools for industrial applications.

title: FAST-GOAL: Fast and Efficient Global-local Object Alignment Learning
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP have shown impressive capabilities in aligning images and text, but they often struggle with lengthy and detailed text descriptions due to pre-training on short and concise captions. We present FAST-GOAL (Fast and Efficient Global-local Object Alignment Learning), an efficient fine-tuning method that enhances ability of CLIP to handle lengthy text through global-local semantic alignment. Our method consists of two key components. First, Fast Local Image-Sentence Matching (FLISM) efficiently extracts local image regions through object detection and spatial division, then matches them with corresponding sentences. Second, Token Similarity-based Learning (TSL) maximizes the similarity between patch tokens from specific regions in the image and their corresponding region embeddings, applying the same principle to text, which enhances the ability of the model to capture detailed correspondences. Additionally, we introduce GLIT100k, a dataset that provides both global image-lengthy caption pairs and context-derived local pairs, where local descriptions are extracted from global captions to maintain semantic coherence. Through extensive experiments on long caption datasets (DOCCI, DCI) and short caption datasets (MSCOCO, Flickr30k), we demonstrate that FAST-GOAL achieves significant improvements over baselines, enabling effective adaptation of CLIP to detailed textual descriptions while maintaining computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: FAST-GOAL是一种面向CLIP长文本理解的轻量级微调方法，通过"全局-局部"语义对齐让预训练CLIP能处理冗长详细的描述，同时保持较低训练成本。其核心是两个组件：FLISM（Fast Local Image-Sentence Matching，用YOLOS检测+空间四分割快速提取局部图像区域，并与描述性句子做最大余弦相似度匹配生成局部伪配对，替代GOAL中昂贵的SAM稠密分割）和TSL（Token Similarity-based Learning，将全局图像中局部区域的patch token与全局文本中对应句子的token聚合后投影，最大化其与局部CLS嵌入的相似度）。同时构建GLIT100k数据集（100,647对图像-长描述，源自SA-1B图像配LLaVA-Next生成，局部描述直接从全局描述中按句抽取以保证语义一致），提供全局与上下文派生局部两级监督。在DOCCI/DCI/MSCOCO/Flickr30k上零样本检索显著超越CLIP、EVA-CLIP、Long-CLIP、FineCLIP及前作GOAL。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型在短简描述上预训练（原生最多77 token），其统一嵌入空间仅针对高层全局语义优化，导致其在面对冗长、细节丰富的图像描述时难以捕捉局部细粒度信息；而现有关于长文本理解的工作存在明显的效率困境：FG-CLIP、FineHARD等需十亿级预训练数据与两阶段训练，Long-CLIP、FineLIP等微调方法依赖百万级MLLM生成数据与额外token聚合模块，GOAL虽证明小规模数据可行但其稠密分割（LISM/SAM）带来极高数据构建开销。本文旨在寻找"效率与规模"的平衡点——用低成本的局部配对生成流程与十万级数据集，实现CLIP对长文本的有效适配。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成。（1）FLISM局部配对构建：将全局描述按句切分为M个文本段{T_l,i}；图像侧用轻量级检测器YOLOS提取语义对象区域，并补充四个等分象限与由象限中点连成的中心区共5个默认区域，得到N个局部图像{I_l,i}；分别过CLIP文本/视觉编码器取CLS嵌入，计算余弦相似度，每个句子匹配相似度最高的图像区域，最终只保留全局相似度最高的一对(I_l, T_l)作为局部伪配对。（2）TSL损失：对全局图像取最后一层patch token P_g∈R^{N×d}，依据局部区域边界框索引集合B做平均池化得P_m并经视觉投影ψ_v得P̂_l；对全局文本取序列token S_g，用局部句子对应的token索引集合T做平均池化得S_m并经文本投影ψ_t得Ŝ_l；L_TSL = MSE(sim(P̂_l, v_l^cls), I) + MSE(sim(Ŝ_l, t_l^cls), I)，即以批内n×n相似度矩阵对角线为1进行优化，把局部注意力传播到全局表示。文本端沿用Long-CLIP的位置嵌入插值以支持超77 token序列；全局与局部样本共享同一套CLIP编码器权重。（3）GLIT100k数据集：从SA-1B采样图像，用定制提示词驱动LLaVA-Next生成多句长描述（平均159词），并将描述中的具体句子直接抽取为局部描述，与FLISM得到的图像区域构成"上下文派生"局部配对；相比FineHARD独立为裁剪区域生成文本的方式，该设计保持全局-局部的语义连贯性且避免冗余生成。训练：ViT-B/16主干，10 epoch，batch 256，4×A6000约1–2小时，总损失L_total = λ_g L_global + λ_l L_local + λ_TSL L_TSL（λ_g=1, λ_local=0.5, λ_TSL=1），其中L_global、L_local均为CLIP式对比损失。
AI.result: 长描述检索（ViT-B/16，跨数据集零样本）：DOCCI上T2I R@1/R@5达74.27/93.76（Long-CLIP为71.63/92.16，GOAL为71.22/92.39），I2T R@1达74.67（GOAL 72.18）；DCI上T2I R@1/R@5达56.62/75.26（Long-CLIP 48.41/68.71，GOAL 49.13/70.17），I2T R@1达56.74（GOAL 51.87）。短描述检索不降反升：MSCOCO T2I R@1 42.81、I2T R@1 61.00，均优于EVA-CLIP（42.58/58.44）；Flickr30k T2I R@1 72.50，I2T R@1 86.80。效率方面，FLISM预处理比GOAL的LISM快约12.7×（DOCCI：97.63分钟 vs 1239.7分钟）与11.8×（DCI：34.44 vs 407.71分钟），性能不降；两阶段训练（GLIT100k→目标域）进一步把DOCCI T2I R@1提升至84.16%、DCI至78.29%。消融显示三损失组合最优（DOCCI T2I R@1 79.06 vs 去掉TSL的78.27）；YOLO+空间分割一致优于仅YOLO（DOCCI 74.27 vs 69.41）；单对最高相似度匹配优于Top-3均匀/加权策略（如DOCCI 74.27 vs 71.51/71.75）。GLIT100k生成描述与人工标注DOCCI的Long-CLIP平均余弦相似度仅差0.0014（0.2434 vs 0.2448）。可视化显示FAST-GOAL注意力更集中于建筑物、屏幕风景与猫等具体对象，长查询下Top-1检索显著更准；误差分析指出DCI失败案例源于多条描述高度语义重叠的细粒度判别挑战。
AI.conclusion: FAST-GOAL通过FLISM（YOLO检测+空间划分的高效区域-句子匹配）与TSL（token级局部-全局注意力传播）的组合，配合十万级上下文派生的GLIT100k数据集，在无需百万级数据、无需额外架构参数的前提下，显著提升CLIP对冗长描述的检索能力（长描述R@1最高提升约8个百分点），同时在短描述任务上保持甚至提升性能，并将数据预处理成本降低约12倍。论文表明细粒度全局-局部对齐加高效配对构建是长文本视觉语言理解的一个实用范式；未来可探索更精细的语义差异判别能力。局限方面，局部配对依赖MLLM生成描述与检测器的伪标签质量，描述极长且语义高度重叠时仍存在细粒度判别困难。

title: Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出模型式 RL 的真正瓶颈并非模型误差累积，而是"搜索"与"价值学习"之间的结构性错配（价值函数由非搜索策略的数据训练，策略改进却依赖 MPPI 搜索轨迹），并提出 MBDPO（Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization）：把策略优化重构为潜空间世界模型中"对想象轨迹的扩散过程"，用从缓冲区学习的隐式能量函数充当 KL 信任域锚点，通过得分匹配直接实现策略优化，从而统一搜索与策略优化。在 4 大基准共 121 个任务上，MBDPO 全面超越 SAC/DreamerV3/TD-MPC/TD-MPC2，并呈现随模型容量（1.7M→340M）单调提升的扩展曲线，训练开销与 TD-MPC2 相当。
AI.motivation: 世界模型 RL 被认为有希望规模化，但实践中仍难超越无模型方法。既有解释多归因于模型偏差与误差累积（提升精度、不确定性估计、截断/分支 rollout 等），而作者引用并推进了"模型精度不等于规划效果"的观点，指出更关键却少被探索的瓶颈是搜索与价值学习的结构性错配：价值函数 Q̂ 只在非搜索策略 β（离线为行为策略，在线为回放缓冲区的混合策略）采集的数据上训练，而策略改进与执行依赖世界模型上 MPPI 采样搜索产生的轨迹。二者分布不一致导致 Q̂ 在 OOD 状态-动作对上被查询并系统性高估，搜索进一步"利用"这些误差，形成"分布偏移—价值高估—误差放大"的自我强化循环，理论上对应两条不等式：Value Iteration Gap（‖T^π Q̂ − T^β Q̂‖∞ ≤ γ‖Q̂‖∞√(2 D_KL^max(π‖β))）与 Policy Improvement Gap（真实改进 ≥ 估计改进/(1−γ) − C₁D_KL^max − C₂‖Q^β − Q̂‖∞），说明"策略改进本质上是局部（信任域）过程"。MPPI 从高斯先验出发的启发式搜索既无单调改进保证，也不满足分布一致性，因而无法真正规模化。
AI.method:
1) 潜空间世界模型：沿用 TD-MPC 框架，编码器 E、潜动力学 F、潜奖励 R、可学习任务嵌入 e（支持多任务），全部优化在潜空间进行。
2) 策略目标重构：不再显式构建规划器，而是求解带 KL 约束（s.t. D_KL(π_φ‖β) ≤ ε，且 z_{h+1}=F(z_h,a_h)）的策略优化问题（Eq.8），以获得真正的单调改进保证。
3) 隐式能量函数 E_θ：由于 β 的密度不可解，用 InfoNCE 式对比损失从缓冲区学习 E，使得 −E(z,a) ≈ log β(a|z) + C(z)，从而把 KL 约束吸收进奖励：R̃ = R − (η/γ^{h−t})E；η 为能量正则因子，κ 为温度。
4) 扩散策略（DDPM over 动作块 a_{t:t+H}，receding-horizon 执行）：不建显式规划器，score 由世界模型的想象轨迹估计——从 DDPM 后验高斯提议 q_τ 采样干净动作序列，在潜动力学中 rollout H 步，用能量正则化累计回报 G̃ 计算归一化重要性权重 w = exp(G̃/κ)/Z，用加权 Monte Carlo 估计得分（Lemma C.1 给出解析推导），再以 L² 得分匹配损失训练 score 网络（Eq.16）；推理时用摊销的 score 网络做迭代反向扩散，避免在线 rollout 开销。
5) 理论：定理 3.2 证明 KL 约束最优策略为 Gibbs 分布 π* ∝ (∏β(a_h|z_h))·exp(G/κ)·∏1{z_{h+1}=F(z_h,a_h)}，且"得分匹配条件成立 ⇔ 达到该最优"，即反向扩散等价于模型式策略优化；误差相对 Gibbs 分布以 Poly(N, T, L_φ) 衰减（N 扩散步、T 采样数、L_φ score 的 Lipschitz 常数）。
6) 实现：交替联合训练——(i) 世界模型 + 一步 TD 价值迭代 + 能量对比损失（联合损失 Eq.14，CE 处理稀疏奖励，EMA 目标网络）；(ii) 扩散策略优化；支持在线从零、离线多任务预训练、离线到在线微调三种模式。
AI.result:
(1) 在线从零训练：在 DMControl/MetaWorld/ManiSkill2/MyoSuite 共 121 任务及 10 个视觉控制任务上全面优于 SAC、DreamerV3、TD-MPC、TD-MPC2；训练早期更快提升、方差更低；PickYCB 成功率 >75%（基线无法学习）。
(2) 扩展性：30/80 任务多任务离线预训练中，模型从 1.7M→6M→21M→54M→340M 性能单调上升；小模型优势最大（更大模型使 TD-MPC2 的轨迹搜索受益，差距收窄）；30 任务数据集在 340M 时因数据容量饱和略有下降。η=0（去掉能量约束）仍优于 TD-MPC2（75.29 vs 57.1）。
(3) 机制验证：MBDPO 的 cross TD error 更低更稳定，相对动作漂移显著更小并在 1M 步后趋近 0，而 MPPI 全程高漂移，印证错配诊断与理论分析。
(4) 离线到在线：70 任务预训练 + 10 个未见任务每任务仅 40k 交互微调，显著优于从零训练；"Hopper Hop"失败归因于任务嵌入孤立导致的表征分布偏移。
(5) 效率：在线训练每环境步耗时与 TD-MPC2 持平（Visual RL 3.55→3.04 ms），离线 30→80 任务仅增 1.02–1.32×，340M 模型 202.9 h vs 206.8 h；代价是推理/评估时间约为 TD-MPC2 的 2 倍（扩散多步采样）。
(6) 消融：η 在 [0.3,1] 稳定，η=5 时因行为克隆效应过强跌至 70 以下；增大扩散步数 N 与 Monte Carlo 样本数 T 均单调提升性能，与 Poly(N,T,L_φ) 误差界一致；T 可并行故几乎不影响耗时，N 线性影响推理耗时。
(7) 表征分析：MBDPO 的潜轨迹呈周期性闭环/目标导向平滑结构，TD-MPC2 更散乱；任务嵌入 t-SNE 显示域级分离与语义相关任务聚簇。
AI.conclusion: MBDPO 通过"扩散策略 + 潜世界模型 + 隐式能量锚定"的组合，把启发式搜索改造为带 KL 信任域约束的真正策略优化，证明得分匹配与模型式最优策略等价，从而消除搜索—价值学习错配，释放世界模型的可扩展策略学习潜力，并实现"性能随模型容量单调提升"。三点洞见：①扩散模型是世界模型与策略优化之间的天然接口，潜在联合训练还能诱导具有物理一致性的因果潜结构；②世界模型中的策略学习应重新思考——KL 约束目标同时承载了离线 RL 的保守性与 TRPO/PPO 的信任域原理，规模化不应依赖更复杂的搜索启发式；③表征质量是前提，物理合理的潜空间是规模化的先决条件（离线到在线迁移依赖通用表征，退化表征会直接瘫痪策略优化）。局限：受算力限制未扩至基础模型规模、仅在仿真中验证、尚需接入视觉/多模态预训练编码器；未来方向包括真机部署与更大规模预训练世界模型。

title: Tail-Aware HiFloat4: W4A4 Post-Training Quantization for Wan2.2
summary: This report describes Tail-Aware HiFloat4, our submission to the low-bit text-to-video generation quantization challenge. Our method adapts the public ViDiT-Q post-training quantization pipeline to Wan2.2 under the HiFloat4 numerical format. We quantize the main linear layers in both Wan2.2 transformer modules with W4A4 HiFloat4 fake quantization, keep numerically sensitive boundary modules in high precision, and introduce an activation-tail-aware percentile calibration module for channel-mask construction. Together with compact PTQ-state restoration, this design reduces the influence of rare calibration outliers while keeping the runtime HiFloat4 arithmetic and sampling pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tail-Aware HiFloat4方法，通过适配ViDiT-Q后训练量化流程至Wan2.2框架，采用W4A4 HiFloat4伪量化主线性层、保持边界模块高精度、引入激活尾部分位数校准模块等策略，解决了低比特文本到视频生成中的量化挑战，在保持运行时流程不变的情况下有效降低了稀有校准异常值的影响。
AI.motivation: 低比特文本到视频生成量化挑战，需要在保持生成质量的同时降低计算复杂度，同时减少稀有校准异常值的影响。
AI.method: 采用HiFloat4数值格式，对Wan2.2 transformer模块中的主线性层进行W4A4 HiFloat4伪量化；对数值敏感的边界模块保持高精度；引入激活尾部分位数校准模块进行通道掩码构建；结合紧凑PTQ状态恢复。
AI.result: 成功将ViDiT-Q后训练量化流程适配到Wan2.2框架，在HiFloat4格式下实现了主线性层的低比特量化，有效控制了稀有校准异常值的干扰。
AI.conclusion: 通过激活尾部分位数校准和PTQ状态恢复，在保持运行时HiFloat4算术和采样流程不变的前提下，有效降低了稀有校准异常值的影响。

title: Elias in the Lighthouse, Again? Diagnosing Low Diversity in LLM Stories
summary: LLM-generated stories are a popular use case, but they show very low variability. We sample 20,000 total stories from four current models using five prompts. We find that 11 words occur in 88.3% of generated stories, with little difference between models. These words include names (Elias, Mara, Elara), settings (lighthouses), and professions (clockmaker, librarian). These tokens do not often occur in published literature nor pre-training data, but they are found in preference data that is likely to have been used by all current models. Surprisingly, these "lighthouse" stories are infrequent when compared with the average post-training story, much of which contains references to copyrighted characters or adult content. This result demonstrates the potentially disproportionate impact of small datasets combined with powerful alignment algorithms.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM生成故事存在严重的词汇同质化现象，11个高频词出现在近九成故事中，根源在于偏好数据集的影响。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的故事存在明显的低变异性问题，输出内容高度同质化。
AI.method: 从四个当前主流模型中抽取20,000个故事样本，使用五个提示词，并通过词频分析追踪高频词汇的来源。
AI.result: 88.3%的生成故事中出现11个高频词汇（包括名字Elias/Mara/Elara、场景lighthouses、职业clockmaker/librarian等），这些词汇源自偏好数据而非训练数据或出版文学。
AI.conclusion: 小型偏好数据集结合强大的对齐算法可能产生不成比例的影响，导致LLM生成内容呈现高度同质化。

title: Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems
summary: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information. We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories. We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports. Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于两参数流的概率密度动态学习方法，无需轨迹标签即可在高维环境下学习物理时间动力学，并能自然处理旋转或循环等非梯度物理现象。
AI.motivation: 解决高维概率密度动态学习问题，传统方法依赖标记轨迹数据，但实际场景中常缺乏轨迹信息仅有未标记样本。
AI.method: 提出两参数流（two-parameter flows）方法：(1) 学习从基分布到各边缘分布的采样时间传输；(2) 通过回归耦合合成轨迹提取物理时间速度场。构建于条件流匹配技术之上。
AI.result: 证明物理时间动力学唯一性，且继承采样时间传输的正则性；在高维场景可扩展，同时支持非梯度动力学。
AI.conclusion: 通过条件流匹配技术实现高维概率密度动态学习，避免逐步最优传输耦合，支持非梯度动力学（如旋转/循环现象），同时保证物理时间动力学的唯一性和规律性继承。

title: Verilog-Evolve: Feedback-Driven and Skill-Evolving Verilog Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation from natural-language specifications, but most pipelines still treat generation as isolated sampling followed by functional checking. This is insufficient for practical RTL design, where useful Verilog must be correct, synthesizable, timing-conscious, and friendly to downstream hardware objectives. We present Verilog-Evolve, a feedback-driven framework for versioned Verilog refinement and cross-session skill evolution. For each task, Verilog-Evolve generates diverse minor candidates, evaluates them with executable feedback from functional simulation, Yosys synthesis, ABC timing proxy, and optional GEMM metrics, then promotes the best candidate into a major version under configurable scoring. To improve across tasks, the system maintains modular skill guidance, retrieves skills according to task and feedback context, and evolves candidate skills from logged histories through create/improve/skip decisions and verifier reports. Experiments on VerilogEval and mixed-precision GEMM tasks show that Verilog-Evolve improves final functional success and promotion stability while producing more downstream-friendly RTL under open-source synthesis, timing-proxy, and netlist-level GEMM objectives. Validation-gated skill evolution further improves GEMM downstream quality and achieves the best downstream score and GEMM held-out pass rate among the evaluated skill modes.

AI.tldr: Verilog-Evolve 是一个"反馈驱动 + 技能演化"的 Verilog 生成框架：把规格到 RTL 的过程建模为带版本管理的迭代精化问题，在每个大版本内生成多个互不相同的候选（minor），用可执行工具（iverilog 仿真、Yosys 综合、ABC 时序代理、混合精度 GEMM 下游评估器、可选 DC/SEC）打分，按可配置多目标评分把最优候选提升为大版本；同时把跨会话运行历史蒸馏为可复用的模块化"技能"，经证据门控与外部回放验证后才入库。在 VerilogEval 与混合精度 GEMM 任务上，最终功能成功率提升（Machine 85.3、Human 72.8），同时获得更低的单元数/乘法器数/ABC 延迟/ADP 与下游分数；"经验证发布"的技能演化模式在下游质量与留出通过率上最优。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 生成 Verilog 的流水线多为"一次性采样 + 功能测试"，存在三点不足：(1) 仅靠模型自反思/自断言作为证据强度很弱，代码可能连编译或仿真都过不了；(2) 功能等价的两份 RTL 在综合后的单元数、布线复杂度、时序代理指标及对加速器内核的适配度上差异巨大，功能正确不等于下游可用；(3) 每次尝试被当作孤立样本，缺乏记录工具结果、提升更优候选、跨任务积累修复知识的版本化机制。已有工作或从黄金 RTL 出发做优化（缺少从自然语言规格出发的生成路径），或提供通用技能演化机制（记忆未与 HDL 工具证据绑定）。因此作者将 Verilog 生成重新表述为"反馈驱动的精化问题"，需要把 LLM 生成与可执行工具闭环、把候选工件版本化，并把成功轨迹转化为可复用技能。
AI.method:
**1) 主/次版本化搜索（Algorithm 1）**：输入任务描述 d 与模块头 h，迭代 R 个大轮次，每轮生成 K 个 minor 候选；评估、记录轨迹，若启用 early-stop 且出现通过者则提前终止本轮 minor 循环；合格集合 A_i 非空时按 (Score, Tie) 取最优 k*，只有当 Score 严格低于当前大版本基线（Improve）且通过 Gate（如留出测试）时才提升为 V_{i+1}，否则保留原版本并继承反馈上下文。

**2) 候选多样性**：两类来源——生成策略（direct 直接生成、c_bridge 先生成 C 风格功能参考再转 Verilog、feedback-conditioned repair 基于失败评估器的结构化反馈做定点修复，功能不匹配触发复位/符号位/位宽修复提示，综合失败触发不支持构造的简化）与时序/结构多样性计划（PathSelect 优先时序关键路径、结构复杂模块或随机探索；Focus 在组合、时序、混合变换间轮换）。候选 v_{i,k} ~ Strategy × PathSelect × Focus。

**3) 可插拔评估器池**：每个评估器返回 (pass_j, m_j, f_j)。功能评估器用 iverilog/vvp（VerilogEval 框架）区分 passed/mismatch/compile_error/syntax_error/timeout/unknown_failure，并记录失配样本比例、转化为修复提示；Yosys 综合评估器提取 cell_count、wire_count、wire_bits、单元类型分布；ABC 时序代理给出逻辑单元数、DFF 数与 abc_delay_proxy；下游评估器针对混合精度 GEMM 报告乘法器/加法器/DFF/mux 数量、位宽命中、流水线深度代理、面积-延迟积代理与聚合下游分数；可选工业 DC/SEC 评估器返回 SEC 状态、WNS、TNS、面积、功耗、关键路径（也支持仅解析已有报告的 parse-only 模式）；留出晋级评估器用可见测试做修复反馈、仅用生成的随机留出测试做大版本晋级，防止对可见 testbench 过拟合。

**4) 可配置多目标评分**：EvalScore(r) = (Score(r), Pass(r))，Pass 为必选评估器与硬门（如 SEC）的合取；开源模式 Score_open = P_func + P_opt + λ_a A + λ_w W + λ_t T + λ_d D（失配按比例罚分，编译/语法/超时/未知失败为固定罚分，可选评估器失败累加 P_opt）；工业模式 Score_EDA = 0.5·ΔWNS + 0.35·ΔTNS + 0.15·ΔArea + P_area + P_SEC。

**5) 技能检索与跨会话技能演化**：技能以轻量文件存储（含触发条件与可复用领域知识），覆盖功能生成、仿真反馈修复、综合感知重写、时序感知重写、RTL 优化模式、量化 GEMM 协同设计；按任务描述、当前时序/综合反馈、多样性计划三路检索，且注册表中有验证版本历史者检索得分更高。历史按行记录，批次结束后作为 session 导入，按引用技能聚合；证据门控为 n_pass ≥ 2 ∧ (n_promote ≥ 1 ∨ Δs̄ < 0)（高等价风险时强制要求 promotion），通过则 create_skill / improve_skill，否则 skip。发布分两种模式：immediate 直接写回并登记版本哈希；validated 进入验证队列（存最多 8 条回放用例，当前 worker 每次作业最多回放 3 例，用功能评估器判定），要求 N_results ≥ 2、N_approve ≥ 2、q̄_cand ≥ 0.75，且候选技能回放质量不得劣于基线才发布。

**6) 实验设置**：基座模型 BetterV-CodeQwen-7B（以聚焦算法贡献而非模型规模）；统一预算为 3 大轮 × 5 minor，策略池 direct,c_bridge,repair；对比 Direct LLM、C-Bridge、Repair-only、Verilog-Evolve w/o Skill Evolution、Full；GEMM 侧含 int4_int8_mac_pe、mixed_precision_dot4、requantize_int32_to_int8 三个内置任务。
AI.result:
**表1（VerilogEval 功能与晋级稳定性）**：Final Success 逐步提升——Direct 76.8/58.9 → C-Bridge 79.4/61.8 → Repair-only 81.2/64.9 → w/o Skill 83.6/68.7 → Full 85.3/71.6（Machine/Human）；Best Func. Score 同步下降（70.4 → 72.8 对应值降至 0.41/0.23 量级）；Promotion Pass 由 58.9 升至 71.6，Compile Pass 由 84.2 升至 91.9，平均晋级大版本数 0.0 → 2.2，Full 的技能验证接受/拒绝为 18/6。表明版本化多工具选择与技能演化在不牺牲正确性的前提下稳定增益。

**表2（混合精度 GEMM 多目标）**：Correctness-only（仅 F）功能通过 91.7、留出 83.3，但 cell 182.4、mul 4.7、ABC delay 6.81、ADP 512.6、下游分 4.92；PPA-aware（F+Y）91.7/86.1，cell 降至 159.8、下游分 4.31；Timing-aware（F+Y+A）留出 86.1、delay 5.72、ADP 401.7；Downstream-aware（F+Y+A+D）取得最佳综合：功能 91.7、留出 88.9、cell 151.6、mul 2.4、delay 5.48、ADP 332.5、下游分 3.21。说明仅靠功能正确无法选出 GEMM 友好 RTL，开源工具代理足以替代商业 EDA 做下游引导。

**表3（技能模式消融）**：No skills 68.9/4.37/82.1；Static skills 70.4/3.98/85.0；Evolved-immediate 72.1/3.55/87.3（技能 24/0）；Evolved-validated 72.8/3.21/88.9（技能 18/6）。即静态技能本身有效，演化进一步增益，回放验证以"更少发布"换来"更高质量"。
AI.conclusion: Verilog-Evolve 证明：以可执行工具反馈为核心、以主/次版本化搜索为骨架、以验证门控的跨会话技能演化为记忆层，可以在不损失功能正确性的前提下系统性提升 RTL 的综合结构、时序代理与下游硬件质量；开源评估器栈（iverilog + Yosys + ABC + 任务特定下游评估器）足以逼近工业流程的下游引导能力，且回放式验证能有效过滤低质量技能更新（接受 18 / 拒绝 6）。作者指出局限与后续方向：扩展评估器栈以纳入更丰富的物理设计信号、集成工业 EDA 流程并引入形式等价性检查；同时 ABC 时序仅为代理指标、工业 PPA 结果依赖可选 DC/SEC 适配器（主实验未启用），技能演化阈值与验证队列参数均带有经验性默认值。

title: Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling
summary:
Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.
  We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by ingesting only the new tokens, while a radix prefix cache extends this across interleaved multi-agent traffic and a prompt-lookup speculative decoder accelerates structured output. Against vLLM and SGLang on novel, fully-generated workloads, the reference implementation is $2.1\times$ faster per turn on a 6-turn agentic workflow and $4.2\times$ on the median turn of a 35-turn one, halving end-to-end wall time. The advantage comes from stateful reuse and speculation, not caching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种状态化推理架构，将多智能体工具调用场景中每个轮次的O(n_t)成本降至O(Δ_t)增量成本，通过跨轮次持久化KV缓存、基数前缀缓存和提示查找推测解码器实现。
AI.motivation: 现有推理框架将每次工具调用视为独立请求，即使85-95%的提示内容在前一轮保持不变，仍从头重新处理整个对话，造成大量计算资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出状态化推理架构：(1) 持久化KV缓存跨轮次保持，仅摄入新增token推进状态；(2) 基数前缀缓存扩展支持交错多智能体流量场景；(3) 提示查找推测解码器加速结构化输出。
AI.result: 在全新生成的工作负载上，相比vLLM和SGLang：6轮智能体工作流提速2.1倍；35轮工作流中位轮次提速4.2倍；端到端wall time减半。性能优势源于状态化复用和推测执行，而非传统缓存机制。
AI.conclusion: 状态化推理架构能有效解决多智能体工具调用场景中的重复计算问题，通过增量处理机制实现显著的性能提升，为LLM系统的实际部署提供了高效的推理范式。

title: Completion vs Optimality: Policy Gradient in Long-Horizon Cumulative-Damage Problems
summary: Long-horizon decision problems with cumulative damage couple locally attractive actions to globally adverse outcomes. We identify two orthogonal failure modes for policy-gradient methods on this class and propose a decomposition that separates them: \emph{completion} (reaching the terminal horizon rather than exiting via an implicit terminal constraint) and \emph{optimality} (matching the dynamic-programming reference given completion). Under PPO with a linear soft penalty, granting horizon access alone reduces the completion rate: the penalty's equilibrium drives the dominant-activity share to zero, while action-space restriction combined with horizon access achieves completion but leaves an optimality gap ($ΔM_{\text{final}} = 0.271$) that we trace to first-phase greedy commitment at the damage origin. We derive four testable predictions and evaluate them in two separately calibrated environments that share the same abstract structure but differ in domain, horizon, activity set, and calibration data: a 49-step bricklayer career and a 20-season NBA power-forward career. All four predictions replicate qualitatively. The horizon-invariance prediction is met at three of four tested horizons, with the exception at $H = 15$ consistent with the $H^*$ boundary ($H^* \in [6, 14]$ under the NBA parameters).

AI.tldr: 论文识别了policy-gradient方法在cumulative damage long-horizon决策问题上的两个正交失败模式(completion和optimality)，提出分解框架，验证了PPO在此类问题上的局限性及其四个可检验预测，为理解和改进此类问题提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: Long-horizon decision problems with cumulative damage将局部吸引动作与全局不利结果耦合，传统policy-gradient方法在此类问题上失败，需要识别其正交失败模式。
AI.method: 将问题分解为completion(到达terminal horizon而非通过隐式terminal约束退出)和optimality(给定completion条件下匹配动态规划基准)两个正交失败模式；采用PPO结合线性soft penalty；在两个不同领域、horizon、活动集和标定数据的环境中评估：49步bricklayer职业和20赛季NBA power-forward职业。
AI.result: 仅授予horizon访问权限会降低completion率(penalty均衡使dominant-activity share趋向零)；action-space限制结合horizon访问可实现completion但留下optimality gap(ΔM_final=0.271)，该gap可追溯至damage origin处的first-phase贪婪承诺；四个可检验预测在bricklayer和NBA两个环境中均得到定性复现；horizon不变性预测在H=15处例外，与H*边界(H*∈[6,14])一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，PPO与线性软惩罚相结合时，horizon访问会降低completion率；结合action-space限制可实现completion但存在最优性差距(ΔM_final=0.271)，该差距源于damage origin处的first-phase贪婪承诺。四个可检验预测在两个标定环境中均得到定性复现，horizon不变性预测在四个测试horizon中通过三个。

title: Conceptual Steganography
summary: Language Models (LMs) emit Chains-of-Thought (CoTs) that drive much of their capability. However, the same sequence that carries useful reasoning can also covertly convey messages: a misaligned model may embed covert information in its CoT that slips through human supervision, a form of steganography known as encoded reasoning. Prior LM steganography schemes operate in the token or lexical space, and a content-preserving paraphraser is the canonical and effective defense in recent work. We introduce conceptual steganography, in which each step of a CoT carries information through patterns of high-level reasoning behavior, rather than through lexical choice. Across four model families and two reasoning domains, this backdoor communication channel is shown to be consistently more robust to a strong paraphrase defense than standard keyword approaches, and the encoding of information into CoTs does not affect their utility in the reasoning process. Having raised awareness of this new risk, we then demonstrate that a strategy-aware paraphraser can close much of the channel, highlighting new challenges and recommended defenses for ensuring faithful LLM reasoning in the wild.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces "conceptual steganography," a new technique for embedding hidden messages in Language Models' reasoning chains through patterns of high-level reasoning behavior rather than word choice. This method is more resistant to paraphrase-based defenses than traditional approaches, but can be partially mitigated by strategy-aware paraphrasing, raising new challenges for LLM safety.
AI.motivation: Language Models can embed covert messages in their Chains-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning through steganography, potentially allowing misaligned models to communicate hidden information past human supervision—a risk that current defenses may not fully address.
AI.method: The researchers tested conceptual steganography across four model families and two reasoning domains, evaluating its robustness against a strong paraphrase defense compared to standard keyword-based approaches. They also proposed a strategy-aware paraphraser as a potential countermeasure.
AI.result: Conceptual steganography proved consistently more robust to paraphrase defenses than standard keyword approaches, while the encoded information did not compromise the CoTs' utility for reasoning. A strategy-aware paraphraser, however, was able to close much of this covert channel.
AI.conclusion: The study demonstrates that conceptual steganography poses a significant new threat to LLM safety, but a strategy-aware paraphraser can substantially mitigate this risk, highlighting the importance of developing more sophisticated defenses for ensuring faithful LLM reasoning.

title: Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks
summary: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. Historical information is fused with current node representations using either global or node-adaptive weighting, allowing the architecture-agnostic framework to accommodate heterogeneous temporal behaviors. We instantiate the approach on the Self-Explainable Signed Graph Transformer (SE-SGformer), preserving interpretability while extending it with temporal awareness. Experiments on real-world and synthetic TSNs, including Bitcoin OTC, Bitcoin Alpha, Reddit, and small-world network models, demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the static baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化、可插拔的时间增强框架（核心为历史上下文整合模块 HCIM），通过可学习的近因感知时间加权、LSTM 嵌入轨迹建模与多头时间注意力捕捉短期与长期的符号化交互动态，并以全局或节点自适应权重将历史信息与当前节点表示融合；在保持可解释性的前提下将框架实例化于 SE-SGformer（自解释符号图 Transformer），在 Bitcoin OTC/Alpha、Reddit 及小世界合成网络上取得相对静态基线一致且统计显著的提升。
AI.motivation: 静态/无符号图的链接预测中 GNN 已表现良好，但在时序符号图（TSN）上仍存在核心困难：符号关系的正负极性、图结构的持续演化，以及平衡理论（balance theory）约束之间的复杂耦合，使得现有静态架构难以有效建模。时间符号网络广泛出现在社交媒体分析、信任与声誉系统、金融交易网络等场景，其中边的符号（合作/对抗）与时间戳同时变化，静态方法丢失了行为演化的时序线索。此外，许多符号 GNN 强调可解释性，改造其内部结构困难，因此需要一种架构无关、无需重写主干模型即可注入时间感知能力的方案。
AI.method: 框架层面的三部分技术栈：1）可学习的近因感知（recency-aware）时间加权，使衰减/衰减型时间核的参数端到端学习而非手工设定；2）基于 LSTM 的节点嵌入轨迹建模，捕捉嵌入随时间的演化路径以刻画长期依赖；3）多头时间注意力，在不同子空间并行聚合多个时间尺度的交互信息。HCIM 将历史上下文与当前节点表示融合，融合策略分为全局加权与节点自适应加权（node-adaptive）两种，以适应异质的时间行为模式。框架整体与主干解耦（architecture-agnostic），可插入现有符号 GNN；论文将其实例化到自解释符号图 Transformer（SE-SGformer），保留其注意力权重驱动的可解释性，仅额外引入时间感知组件，从而在时间化与可解释性之间取得平衡。实验在真实时序符号网络（Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit）以及小世界合成网络模型上进行，与静态基线对比并做统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 在 Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit 及小世界网络模型上，集成 HCIM 的模型相对静态 SE-SGformer 基线取得一致且统计显著的改进，说明历史时间信息对符号链接预测具有实质增益；模块化设计未破坏原模型的可解释性属性，且全局/节点自适应两种融合方式对不同数据集各有适用性，表明框架能容纳异质时间行为。（摘要未披露具体指标数值与提升幅度。）
AI.conclusion: 时序符号图的学习瓶颈主要在于缺乏对演化历史与符号极性的联合建模；将历史上下文作为可插拔模块注入静态符号 GNN 是一条低侵入、高收益的路径。HCIM 通过近因加权、LSTM 轨迹与多头时间注意力的组合，同时覆盖短期与长期的符号交互动态，并以全局/自适应权重解决节点间时间行为的异质性。面向真实金融与社交网络及合成网络的实验支持该框架的有效性，且保留了符号模型的可解释性优势；后续可进一步扩展到更多符号架构（不限于 Transformer）、多关系/多极性场景与更大规模图，并探索时间信息与平衡理论约束的显式耦合机制。

title: MemFail: Stress-Testing Failure Modes of LLM Memory Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to remain consistent across long-horizon interactions, but little empirical work has been done to understand the specific failure modes and design choices that these systems present. Existing benchmarks report aggregate question-answering accuracy and treat memory systems as black boxes, making it impossible to attribute an incorrect answer to a particular failure mode of the system. We introduce MemFail, a diagnostic benchmark that isolates the failure modes of modern LLM memory systems. We begin by formalizing memory systems as the composition of three canonical operations -- summarization, storage, and retrieval -- and identify the potential failure modes induced by each. Based on these hypothesized failure modes, we construct five datasets spanning four tasks, each adversarially designed to test a specific operation of a memory system. Using these datasets, we evaluate four state-of-the-art memory systems on MemFail and demonstrate how MemFail can be used to empirically understand the tradeoffs induced by differences in memory system architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MemFail，一个诊断基准测试，用于隔离现代LLM记忆系统的故障模式。研究团队将记忆系统形式化为总结、存储和检索三个操作的组合，针对每个操作识别潜在故障模式，并构建了五个对抗性设计的数据集来测试特定操作。通过评估四种最先进的记忆系统，证明了MemFail能够实证揭示不同架构间的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越依赖外部记忆系统来保持跨长时间交互的一致性，但现有研究缺乏对记忆系统具体故障模式和设计选择的实证理解。现有的基准测试仅报告聚合的问答准确率，并将记忆系统视为黑箱，无法将错误答案归因于系统的特定故障模式。
AI.method: 首先将记忆系统形式化为三个规范操作的组合（总结、存储、检索），识别每个操作可能诱导的故障模式；然后基于这些假设的故障模式构建了跨越四个任务的五个数据集，每个数据集都经过对抗性设计以测试记忆系统的特定操作；最后使用这些数据集对四种最先进的记忆系统进行评估。
AI.result: MemFail能够隔离现代LLM记忆系统的故障模式，并可用于实证理解不同记忆系统架构之间产生的权衡。
AI.conclusion: MemFail提供了一个可诊断的基准测试，能够隔离现代LLM记忆系统的故障模式，并为理解和改进记忆系统架构设计提供了实证基础。

title: Reliable Extraction of Clinical Follow-Up Instructions: A Hybrid Neural-Symbolic Pipeline
summary: Objective. Outpatient notes carry follow-up instructions pairing actions with future times ("MRI brain in two weeks"). Extracting (action, date) pairs supports scheduling and audit, but generative extractors miss the date because linking and arithmetic are implicit in decoding. We test a hybrid neural-symbolic pipeline against direct generation. Methods. We define TestSpecification and TimeSpecification entities and a ScheduledFor relation. BioBERT feeds BIO tagging and a biaffine linker; entities are canonicalized via a 28-action ontology and times normalized to day offsets deterministically. We evaluate on a 2,000-note synthetic outpatient corpus with action-disjoint splits (18 train, 6 OOV-test) against zero-shot GPT-4o-mini and LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA-3 8B with note-level bootstrap 95% CIs. Results. On 259-note seen and OOV splits the hybrid pipeline achieves Test-Time Pair F1 of 0.997 and 0.986 with 0.00-day MAE. Baselines reach high action F1 (LLaMA-3 0.992; GPT-4o-mini 0.963 seen) but Pair F1 stays at 0.51-0.57 (LLaMA-3) and 0.53 (GPT-4o-mini), CIs non-overlapping with the hybrid. Conclusion. Separating learned entity extraction from deterministic date arithmetic outperforms generation on this benchmark, generalizes to held-out actions, and exposes failure modes. Transfer to real EHR notes is the next validation; a first-pass realism check is in Limitations.

AI.tldr: 研究提出混合神经符号管道分离实体提取与确定性日期计算，相比GPT-4o-mini和LLaMA-3等生成模型，在门诊笔记的动作-时间配对提取任务上显著提升性能（Pair F1达0.986 vs 0.53），MAE为0且泛化至未见动作类型。
AI.motivation: 门诊笔记包含配对的动作和时间指令（如"MRI脑部检查两周后"），提取这些(action, date)配对可支持调度和审计任务。生成式模型在提取日期时表现不佳，因为日期链接和算术运算在解码过程中是隐式的。
AI.method: 提出混合神经符号管道：BioBERT作为编码器进行BIO标注和双仿射链接，定义TestSpecification和TimeSpecification实体及ScheduledFor关系，通过28类动作本体库进行实体规范化，时间归一化为天偏移量后进行确定性计算。与零样本GPT-4o-mini和LoRA微调LLaMA-3 8B进行对比。
AI.result: 在259份笔记的可见/非可见分割测试中，混合管道达到Test-Time Pair F1 0.997（seen）/0.986（OOV），MAE为0.00天。基线模型动作F1较高（LLaMA-3达0.992），但Pair F1仅为0.51-0.57（ LLaMA-3）和0.53（GPT-4o-mini），置信区间不重叠。
AI.conclusion: 混合神经符号管道在成对(action, date)提取任务上显著优于生成模型，成对F1达0.986-0.997，MAE为0。分离式架构不仅性能更优，还能泛化到未见过的动作类型，并有效暴露失败模式。下一阶段将迁移至真实EHR数据进行验证。

title: Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks
summary: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于「有理高斯小波卷积」(RGW convolution) 的模型驱动小型神经网络，用于基于麦克风声音信号的无人机检测、型号分类与蜂群识别。该方法把可学习形态的有理高斯小波作为卷积核嵌入神经网络端到端训练，能自适应提取具有物理意义的频率特征，在室内纯净与室外强噪声两种场景下均优于随机森林、SVM、朴素贝叶斯与全连接网络，并在多数指标上超过结构相近的 CNN，同时参数更少、可解释性更强，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 无人机威胁使低成本、可信（可解释）的检测与分类技术成为刚需。现有四类检测手段各有局限：雷达成本高且小目标雷达截面积小、视觉受天气与视线限制、射频方案无法识别自主飞行或非无线控制的无人机、声学方案虽低成本且不受视线约束但易受风与背景噪声干扰。已有基于声音的 AI 方案主要有两类问题：(1) 深度学习模型参数无物理意义，在安全关键场景不可解释，且需专用硬件、部署维护成本高；(2) 采用固定时频变换（如 STFT）作为静态特征提取器，无法适应不同机型、机动状态与环境变化，导致信号表示次优。此外，多机蜂群协同飞行的出现使防御更难，作者希望同一套系统能区分单机、噪声与多机共存。作者的目标是：以 MEMS 麦克风构建低成本声学前端，用数学上可解释的模型驱动机器学习（model-driven ML）替代黑箱深度学习，在小数据、少参数条件下同时实现无人机存在检测、机型分类与蜂群识别。
AI.method:
方法核心是提出一个新的 RGW 卷积层并构造轻量可解释网络。

(1) 信号处理与数据：音频切分为 100 ms 不重叠片段（室内 192 kHz/24-bit → 每段 19200 点；室外 8 kHz/16-bit），仅做逐段零均值单位方差归一化。设备为 PIX 270i + Apogee Big Ben 主时钟 + Focusrite RedNet/Pro Tools + Brüel & Kjær 4006 与 Schoeps MK2(CMC5) 压电传声器；室外用共 PCB 的 4 通道 MEMS 阵列，环境含直升机掠过、公路车流、人声与强风。机型覆盖 Mavic Pro(734 g)、Mavic Pro 2(907 g)、Mavic Mini(249 g)、Mavic 3 Pro(958 g)、Avata 2(377 g，涵道三叶高转速 9000–12000 RPM)、Matrice 30T(3.7 kg，2500–4200 RPM)，以覆盖宽频声学谱。

(2) RGW 小波：沿用 Ámon 等(2025) 的有理高斯小波 ψ^η(t)=C(η)P^η(t)v^η(t)e^{-t²/2}，其中 P^η 为带实零点 t_k 的多项式项、v^η 为由共轭极点 z_k 构成的有理项，参数向量 η∈C^{p+n} 决定母小波形态，已证明满足可容许性条件。

(3) RGW 卷积层（本文主要创新）：不学习平移参数，只把缩放/尺度 λ_k(k=1..m) 与 η 作为可学习参数，用离散卷积近似小波系数 W_ψ(λ,τ)（替代依赖信号周期性的 variable projection 算子，后者对非周期音频无效）。层输出 T_η f ∈ R^{m×(N+M-1)}，Jacobian 可由 ∂ψ^η_{λ_k}/∂η 解析给出。实验中取 p=1、n=10、m=10 个尺度滤波器，室内核长 32（输出 10×19169），室外核长 64（输出 10×4347）。

(4) 网络结构与可解释性：卷积输出先按尺度做均值/方差标准化，再经特殊 top-Q 最大值池化（每个尺度保留 Q 个最大 |小波系数|），语义上等于“输入信号在 λ_k 定义频带内的最大幅值”；后接 2 层带 ReLU 的全连接层（分类块 200 神经元），输出端用 sigmoid（二分类）或 softmax（多类）。总训练 300 epoch、batch 64、5 折交叉验证（每折 80/20 划分），超参由大规模网格搜索确定。

(5) 三个实验场景：① 室内多机/蜂群检测（背景噪声、单机、多机共 3 类，机型 Mavic Pro/Pro 2/Mini，每类 1790 段）；② 室内单机机型分类（3 类，每类 1000 段）；③ 室外强噪声下单机存在检测（二分类，机型 Avata 2、Matrice 30T、Mavic Mini、Mavic Pro 3，每类 1050 段）。基线为 RF、SVM-L、SVM-RBF、朴素贝叶斯、FCNN 与结构对齐的 CNN，指标为准确率 Acc=(N_tp+N_tn)/N_total。
AI.result:
场景1 室内蜂群检测（3 类）：WG-NN（RGW 网络）均值 92.52%（90.50–96.00），优于 CNN 90.57%、SVM-RBF 90.62% 附近、RF 78.94%、SVM-L 50.32%、NB 41.49%、FCNN 48.13%，且参数远少于 CNN。
场景2 室内机型分类（3 类）：RGW 网络 99.20%（98.33–99.83），CNN 99.97% 略优，SVM-RBF 96.37%、RF 91.53%，而 NB 48.10%、SVM-L 38.00%、FCNN 47.63% 基本失效。
场景3 室外噪声检测（二分类，任务最难）：RGW 网络 90.55%（87.75–94.75）为最优，CNN 89.60%、RF 80.40%、SVM-RBF 77.71%、SVM-L 62.34%、FCNN 55.90%、NB 49.48%。
总体结论：传统 ML 基线（尤其线性 SVM、朴素贝叶斯、纯 FCNN）明显不足；RGW 模型在三项任务上取得与 CNN 相当或更优的精度，并借助“可解释的频带最大幅值特征”可在噪声场景下检验模型有效性；python 实现已公开于 GitLab（gitlab.com/aele02/drone-classification-and-detection），原始数据因许可限制需向 HUN-REN 能源研究中心申请。
AI.conclusion:
