AI.result: Key findings: (1) Transfer is governed more by whether tokenization preserves reusable cross-lingual substructure than by tokenizer balance or raw lexical similarity; (2) Smaller vocabularies often improve masked transfer by keeping words decomposable into shared fragments, while larger vocabularies can turn forms into language-specific atoms; (3) Transfer emerges as a staged process where grammatical and type-level competence precede masked lexical generalization.
AI.conclusion: Tokenization acts as a "bridge" mechanism where bridge strength strongly correlates with masked reachability, explaining how cross-lingual transfer operates in neural language models.

title: Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features
comment: Main Paper: 9 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change. Together, these results suggest that stability is more critical in continual learning when changes are gradual, and that multi-timescale consolidation of predictive representations is an effective approach.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates deep RL agents in environments with gradual continual drift (as opposed to abrupt changes). Through experiments in modified Miniworld and MuJoCo environments, the authors demonstrate that stability-focused synaptic consolidation methods outperform plasticity-focused approaches like parameter resetting. They further show that consolidating Successor Features across multiple timescales is particularly effective, suggesting that stability and predictive representations are key for continual learning in realistic non-stationary settings.
AI.motivation: Real-world environments evolve gradually through continual drift, but prior RL research focuses on abrupt task changes. This distinction is critical for the stability-plasticity dilemma, as abrupt changes may demand different mechanisms than naturalistic gradual changes. The paper aims to investigate appropriate learning strategies for realistic non-stationary settings.
AI.method: Modified 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments with naturalistic continual non-stationarity; compared synaptic consolidation (stability-focused) vs. parameter resetting (plasticity-focused); applied consolidation to Successor Features across multiple timescales.
AI.result: Stability-favoring methods (synaptic consolidation) outperform plasticity-focused approaches (parameter resetting); consolidating Successor Features yields superior performance compared to consolidating Q-values; multi-timescale stabilization of SFs captures complementary aspects of gradual environmental change.
AI.conclusion: Multi-timescale consolidation of Successor Features is an effective approach for continual learning; prioritizing stability over plasticity is crucial when environmental changes are gradual rather than abrupt.

title: Multi-Stakeholder LLM Alignment: Decomposing Estimation from Aggregation
summary: Multi-stakeholder tasks require one output to satisfy users with conflicting preferences. Holistic LLM judges conflate utility estimation and utility aggregation, yielding unstable implicit weights. We show empirically and theoretically that this aggregation-specific \emph{weighting noise} can create large score shifts when stakeholder satisfaction is dispersed; in our experiments, these weight-induced shifts also increase with stakeholder count. We propose \textsc{DecompR}: counterfactual-calibrated weights are fixed from query structure before candidate scoring, while per-role utilities are estimated independently, removing candidate-dependent weight drift and reducing estimation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多利益方任务中LLM评判器的权重噪声问题提出DecompR方法，通过因果解耦权重校准与效用估算，实现更稳定公平的多方偏好聚合评分。
AI.motivation: 现有整体式LLM评判器将效用估算与效用聚合混为一谈，导致权重噪声。当利益方满意度分散时，这种噪声会产生大幅分数偏移，且随利益方数量增加而加剧。
AI.method: 将LLM判断分解为两个独立阶段：1）从查询结构中提取反事实校准的固定权重；2）对每个角色独立估算效用值，从而消除候选依赖性权重漂移并降低估算噪声。
AI.result: 实验验证了该权重诱导偏移在大分散度场景下确实存在，且随利益方数量增长而增加。
AI.conclusion: DecompR通过将权重校准与候选评分解耦，解决了多利益方场景下的权重噪声问题，实现了更稳定的多方偏好聚合评估。

title: The Need for an External Observer Formalizing the Sufficiency Gap: A Mathematical Extension of Mixture Identifiability and Contextual Grounding in Sequence Models
summary: We construct a binary mixed-regime process with one deterministic textual regime and one random regime governed by an unobserved latent state. Even an ideal infinite-capacity sequence predictor that exactly recovers the text-only marginal law can become overconfident when the observed prefix is compatible with the wrong latent regime. The resulting entropy difference is not an ordinary optimization error; it is a sufficiency gap caused by marginalization over an unobserved state. We then formalize retrieval, tool use, and external grounding through an auxiliary binary signal with fidelity $γ\in [1/2,1]$. The resulting Bayesian update yields a contextual dominance threshold: a corrective signal reverses the posterior odds induced by the textual history exactly when its fidelity exceeds the text-only posterior weight assigned to the misleading regime. This threshold reduces, but does not generally eliminate, the sufficiency gap; complete closure requires perfect revelation of the relevant latent state or an equivalent verification mechanism. The analysis clarifies why temperature scaling cannot restore missing context, why grounding mechanisms must be both informative and learnably usable by the model, and why autonomous sequence models require structurally decoupled observers or verifiers in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在隐状态未观测情况下序列预测器的置信度问题，揭示了充足性缺口源于边缘化而非优化误差，并通过贝叶斯分析证明外部信号的纠正效果受限于文本后验权重分配的阈值。
AI.motivation: 问题背景：即使理想的无穷容量序列预测器能精确恢复仅文本边缘律，当观测前缀与错误隐机制兼容时，仍会产生过度自信问题。这引发了对"充足性缺口"本质的追问。
AI.method: 构建一个二元混合机制过程：一个确定性文本机制和一个由未观测隐状态驱动的随机机制。形式化检索、工具使用和外部接地，通过保真度 γ∈[1/2,1] 的辅助二元信号进行贝叶斯更新。
AI.result: 引入辅助信号后推导出情境主导阈值：纠正信号在保真度超过文本后验权重时恰好逆转由误导性机制引起的赔率。但该阈值只能减少，不能完全消除充足性缺口；完全闭合需要完美揭示相关隐状态或等效验证机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了充足性缺口的本质——源于对未观测隐状态的边缘化，而非优化误差。温度 scaling 无法弥补缺失的上下文；接地机制必须既具有信息性又可被模型学习使用；在高风险领域，自主序列模型需要结构上解耦的观察者或验证器。

title: Online Learning on Hidden-Convex Losses via Algorithmic Equivalence: Optimal Regret, Geometric Barrier, and Bandit Feedback
summary: We study adversarial online learning with hidden-convex losses, i.e., nonconvex losses that become convex after a nonlinear reparameterization. Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) proved that, under geometric and smoothness assumptions, online gradient descent (OGD) on such nonconvex losses approximately simulates online mirror descent (OMD) on the underlying convex losses with a suitable regularizer, yielding $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret. They left open whether the optimal $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret from online convex optimization can be recovered in this hidden-convex setting. We answer this question affirmatively. More specifically, via a sharper discrete-time algorithmic equivalence argument, we prove that OGD achieves $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under the same assumptions, matching the optimal worst-case rate for adversarial online convex optimization. We also address another open question of Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) by clarifying the geometry required for this algorithmic equivalence. We replace the diagonal-Jacobian sufficient condition with a necessary-and-sufficient Hessian compatibility condition, thereby expanding the class of admissible reparameterizations. We complement our tight regret bound with a lower bound showing that the Hessian compatibility assumption is essential for OGD; when it fails, we construct a smooth reparameterization and an adversarial sequence of hidden-convex losses for which OGD suffers $Ω(T)$ regret. Finally, we extend our analysis to one-point bandit feedback and prove a $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret bound for bandit OGD with spherical smoothing, matching its classical rate on convex losses.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了隐藏凸损失下在线学习的最优遗憾恢复问题。通过改进离散时间算法等价性论证，证明了在线梯度下降法在相同假设下可达到 O(√T) 的最优对抗遗憾界。同时将充分条件从对角Jacobian条件收紧为必要且充分的Hessian相容性条件，并证明了该条件的必要性。进一步扩展至单点bandit反馈场景，提出球面平滑策略并给出 O(T^(3/4)) 遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有研究(Ghai et al., 2022)仅证明隐藏凸损失下 OGD 可达 O(T^(2/3)) 遗憾界，但无法确定能否恢复 OCO 中的最优 Θ(√T) 遗憾率；同时其几何条件(对角Jacobian)是否必要且充分尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过更精确的离散时间算法等价性论证，证明 OGD 在隐藏凸损失上可实现 O(√T) 遗憾界；建立 Hessian 相容性作为必要充分条件；构造反例验证条件必要性；扩展至单点 bandit 反馈场景并采用球面平滑技术。
AI.result: 理论上证明了 OGD 在隐藏凸设置下可达 O(√T) 最优遗憾界；确立了 Hessian 相容性作为算法等价的充要条件；当该条件失败时，OGD 遗憾可退化至 Ω(T)；Bandit OGD 在球面平滑下可达 O(T^(3/4)) 期望遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 通过Hessian相容性条件替代原有对角Jacobian条件，扩大了可容许重参数化类别。Bandit设置下提出球面平滑的 bandit OGD，达到 O(T^(3/4)) 期望遗憾界。

title: PRISM: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Peer Reviewers
summary: The rapid growth in submissions to machine learning venues has strained the scientific peer-review system and intensified interest in LLM-based automated peer reviewers. However, how good these systems are actually, especially compared to human reviewers at catching scientific gaps, remains poorly understood. In this work, we introduce PRISM (Peer Review Intelligence via Structured Multi-dimensional assessment), a benchmarking framework that evaluates review quality across four dimensions: Depth of Analysis, Novelty Assessment,Flaw Identification & Major Issues Prioritization, and Multi-dimensional Constructiveness. Unlike most existing evaluations based on surface-level metrics like ROUGE and BLEU, or unconstrained LLM-as-a-judge prompting that conflates fluency with rigor, PRISM grounds each dimension in argument mining, retrieval-augmented verification, and consensus-based scoring. We apply PRISM to benchmark five leading automated reviewer systems and human reviewers on a stratified corpus of reviews from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. The results reveal that LLMs can match or beat human reviewers on individual dimensions: comparable depth of analysis, stronger novelty verification, and highly accurate critique prioritization. However, no single system consistently matches the balanced performance of the human baseline across all dimensions at once. Each exhibits a distinct specialization profile with characteristic blind spots -- failure modes that aggregate metrics miss entirely. The implication is that LLM reviewers are best understood as targeted supplements to human review, effective within specific dimensions, but unreliable as standalone replacements. Our demo and key results can be found at https://khanhthanhdev.github.io/prism-page/.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个面向"LLM 自动审稿人"的多维度评测基准，将同行评审质量拆为四个维度（分析深度、新颖性评估、缺陷识别与主次排序、多维建设性），每维用可验证的专用流水线打分（论证挖掘、检索增强核验、共识加权评分、语义规则匹配），在 ICLR 2026/ICML 2025/NeurIPS 2025 的 600 篇论文上对比 5 个自动化审稿系统与人类评审。核心结论：LLM 在单一维度上可匹敌甚至超越人类（深度相当、SEA 新颖性核验更强、Reviewer2 缺陷召回最高、DeepReview 建设性最佳），但无一系统能全维度均衡；更致命的是 LLM 评审对"录用/拒稿"缺乏区分度（评估不变性），故只适合作为人机协同中的定向补充，而非自主替代者。
AI.motivation: 机器学习顶会投稿量激增（NeurIPS 从 2024 年 15,671 篇增至 2025 年 21,575 篇，ICML 同比 +44.9% 与 +25.4%），审稿系统严重超载，已有 17–21% 的评审涉及 LLM 辅助（部分会议全面禁止、有的要求强制披露），而人类评审质量也在恶化（NeurIPS 一致性实验显示约 23% 的录用决定仅因审稿人分配而改变）。核心问题是：LLM 审稿人究竟能否像人类一样发现论文的科学缺口？现有评测方法存在明显缺陷：ROUGE/BLEU 只看表层词面重叠，LLM-as-a-judge 的整体打分把"语言流畅度"与"科学严谨性"混为一谈；ReviewEval 虽定义 6 个维度但依赖端到端 rubric 打分且仅覆盖 16 篇论文、3 个系统；DeepReview-Bench 规模虽大但局限于 ICLR 单一场次；均无法验证"单条论断是否有据可依"、"新颖性断言能否被检索到的先前工作证实"。因此需要一个可追溯、可核验、跨维度的评测框架来刻画 LLM 审稿人的能力画像与失效模式。
AI.method: 框架设计：形式化 E(R_LLM, R_human, P) → 多维分数集合 S，每个维度用独立的"证据抽取 + 解析式计分"流水线（LLM 只做受限的证据标注，最终分数由公式解析计算），配合 Data Segmentation 单元解析论文与评审结构。(1) 深度分析 DoA：将 Summary/Strengths/Weaknesses 切成论证话语单元 ADU，标注 Claim/Premise 角色与四类主题（新颖性、方法、实验、清晰度），对 Premise 评 grounding 0/1/2（泛化/内部引用/外部文献），以 Premise Ratio 与归一化 Grounding 的调和平均计分（|P|=0 则为 0）。(2) 新颖性评估：三阶段——受限 LLM 抽取论文核心任务/贡献锚点/关键术语与评审中的逐字新颖性断言（含 stance、置信度、引用正则回退）→ 用 Semantic Scholar 确定性构造查询、去重（标题摘要相似度 ≥0.96）、按投稿年份时间过滤、MMR 选 K=30 候选池 → LLM 裁判对每个（断言, 候选）对照论文摘要+引言与候选标题+摘要给出 [−2,+2] 五级证据支持度；采用相关性加权 top-3 聚合（而非 max 池化）得到 NS/SR/SSR。(3) 缺陷识别与主次排序：先原子化并归并多评审（含人类与 LLM）的 Micro-flaw 至七类宏主题，再由独立"元审稿人"对论文核验有效性并按本体标注 Critical/Minor（是否需要新实验/证明修订 vs 纯文字修订），合并为共识真值集；按严重度分层召回 + 受 NDCG 启发的 nCPS（严重度权重 2/1，按出现位置 log2 折损，除以理想分 iCPS）。(4) 多维建设性：把评审拆成原子评论 ARC（含 5–25 词锚定引文与类型），在 D1 可执行性、D2 具体性、D3 论证性、D4 解决方案、D5 语气五个 0/1/2 维度打分，取评论级均值 CLC 与评审级 MCS，另派生 Actionability Ratio、Solution Density、Constructiveness Density。实验设置：每会场年 200 篇、按决定类别（Oral/Spotlight/Poster/Reject）与主题分层并保持原始分数分布，共 600 篇、生成 3,000 条 LLM 评审；对比 5 个系统（SEA-E、CycleReviewer、DeepReview 为微调范式，Reviewer2、TreeReview 为提示范式，后者统一骨干以隔离框架效应）；裁判引擎 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite（temperature 0）；统计用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 + Holm-Bonferroni 校正（按模型-维度族），接受/拒稿对比用 Mann-Whitney U 检验，维度独立性用 Pearson 相关；并邀请 15 位资深研究者对 25 篇论文的预抽取片段重标，计算 Cohen's κ/κw 与 ±1 一致率做人类验证。
AI.result: 1) 深度分析：人类 0.493 为最高，CycleReviewer 0.483、DeepReview 0.481 统计上与之无差异（ns），Reviewer2/SEA/TreeReview 显著更低；差异主要来自 Premise Ratio（人类 0.557、CycleReviewer 0.614、DeepReview 0.588）而非 Grounding（0.432–0.481 相当）。TreeReview 把 26.3% 前提预算投向 Clarity（人类 9.5%），JSD 最高 0.205；Reviewer2 聚焦最贴近人类（JSD 0.055）但前提比仅 0.376，暴露"冗长无据"幻觉。2) 新颖性：SEA 最高 0.854（显著超越人类 0.802），但其 83% 断言判为"novel"，人类为 62%，反映趋同作者；DeepReview 最怀疑（41% novel/21% not novel/35% unclear）。跨评审一致规律是"novel"断言证据支撑远强于"not novel/unclear"（否定新颖性需定位到具体先验工作，门槛更高），说明这是检索核验任务本身的属性。3) 缺陷识别：Reviewer2 召回最高（Critical 0.644、Minor 0.470，远超人类 0.311/0.253）且幻觉率仅约 3.6%，CycleReviewer 幻觉率约 16.2%；所有系统的幻觉严格限于 Minor，Critical 缺陷零幻觉。nCPS 所有系统与人类均约 0.97，说明"先主后次"已是普遍基线行为而非区分性能力。4) 建设性：DeepReview 最高 0.636（三会场均显著优于人类 0.556），D1=1.422、D4=0.781、语气最佳 D5=1.730；人类 Specificity 高（1.732）但 Solution 极低（D4=0.427、Solution Density≈0.102），呈"诊断者"而非"指导者"特征；Reviewer2 高分由 D3=0.969 的冗长辩护造成而 D4 仅 0.249（"解释为何错却不给修法"）；CycleReviewer Specificity/AR 高但 D3≈0.326、SD≈0.05（清单式浅层评审）。5) 接受/拒稿敏感性（最关键）：人类评审与决定显著相关（Novelty Δ=+0.051*、Prioritization Δ=+0.006***、Critical Δ=−0.049***、Minor Δ=−0.018**，Critical 差距约为 Minor 的 2.7–3 倍），而 5 个 LLM 系统几乎全部 ns，仅 DeepReview 的 Prioritization 显著（Δ=+0.011***），呈"评估不变性"。6) 维度独立性：6 指标两两 Pearson |r|max=0.193，15 对中 7 对不显著，共享方差 <4%，近正交。7) 人类验证：与 Gemini 的一致性在客观任务较好（Aspect Identification κ=0.688、Flaw Validity F1=0.880），主观任务一般（Novelty κ=0.332、D5 κ=0.122），但序数任务 ±1 一致率 75.7%–100%。8) 裁判鲁棒性：换用 Mimo v2.5 Pro 后各指标绝对值有偏移但相对排序与全部定性结论不变。9) 案例：TreeReview 陷入"表层陷阱"源于其启发式（无论论文是否需要都产出泛化可复现性套话）；Reviewer2 与人类缺陷集合近零重叠（9+9+2），LLM 强在逐公式级核查、人类强在论断—证据校准与领域规范感知；Reviewer2 会捏造"论文未报告计算开销"而论文实际有报告，属孤立评估未交叉核验所致。
AI.conclusion: LLM 审稿人是"专精型工具"而非通用替代品：每个系统在某一维度上突出、在他处存在结构化盲区，聚合指标完全掩盖这些失效模式。作者给出部署建议——采用定向集成：Reviewer2 负责缺陷穷举扫描（最高诊断召回）、DeepReview 负责建设性反馈起草（最高可执行性与方案密度）、SEA 负责新颖性文献核验（最高证据支撑率），作为人机协同流水线中的"专科副驾驶"而非自主审稿人。最强论据不是任何单项分数，而是 LLM 评审对论文真实科学质量的"评估不变性"——它无法区分将被录用与将被拒稿的论文，因此单项维度的高分不等于专家级判断力，须对此结论保持必要的保守解释。局限与未来工作：主裁判依赖单一模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite，仅做 Mimo 子集初步验证），需跨模型家族的多裁判研究与不确定度量化；语料仅限 ML/AI 三个会场年（600 篇），跨领域（临床医学、社科、纯数学）需重新校准；原子化切分可能丢失上下文，事实核查受检索 API 覆盖度限制；未来应扩展到作者满意度与跨年度纵向追踪，以验证 PRISM 指标捕捉的是真实评审质量而非表层流畅度。

title: Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series
summary: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了时序因果发现中将非线性模型学习到的因果关系简化为标量边分数的做法，指出这会造成严重信息瓶颈。作者提出函数值因果影响（function-valued causal influence）概念，并用个体条件期望（ICE）框架从训练好的模型中直接估计因果响应函数。实验表明，具有相同标量分数的边可能呈现截然不同的函数行为，且该方法能揭示标量方法系统性地遗漏的特定情境因果结构。
AI.motivation: Scalar causal edge scores (common in nonlinear ML-based causal discovery) obscure the true object learned—state-dependent functions whose effects vary across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. These scalar scores conflate between-state variation with within-state residual noise, causing loss of important structural information.
AI.method: The authors use Neural Additive Vector Autoregression (NAVAR) as a representative architecture and introduce a framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) for estimating causal response functions from trained models.
AI.result: Controlled experiments show that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors (monotonic, thresholded, saturating, sign-changing effects). Applied to democratic development data, function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.
AI.conclusion: The paper demonstrates through synthetic and real-world experiments that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structures that scalar score methods systematically miss.

title: TADDLE: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews
summary: LLM-generated peer reviews are increasingly common at major venues, yet their deficiencies are hard to detect because they are uniformly fluent and well-structured. Existing work either classifies authorship without judging quality, or scores quality with features designed for human-written reviews; no prior system detects deficiencies in LLM-generated reviews at the level of individual defect types. To bridge the gap, we introduce TADDLE, a Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews, together with the first expert-annotated benchmark for this task. Our benchmark comprises 1,800 reviews on 50 ICLR 2025 papers, multi-label-annotated by 18 domain experts against a taxonomy of six defect categories (plus a non-deficient label). TADDLE decomposes detection into four specialized analysis tools -- Verify, Correct, Complete, and Transform -- orchestrated by an agent; an integrator synthesizes their outputs into binary and multi-label classifications via two-stage semi-supervised learning. Extensive experiments show that TADDLE performs strongly on both binary detection and the multi-label classification task. We release the benchmark and code at https://github.com/AquariusAQ/TADDLE.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces TADDLE, the first system designed to detect specific deficiency types in LLM-generated peer reviews. It includes a benchmark of 1,800 expert-annotated reviews on 50 ICLR 2025 papers, using a six-category defect taxonomy. The system uses a multi-tool agent architecture with semi-supervised learning to achieve strong detection performance.
AI.motivation: LLM-generated peer reviews are becoming increasingly prevalent at major venues, but their deficiencies are difficult to detect because they appear uniformly fluent and well-structured. Existing approaches either classify authorship without assessing quality, or evaluate quality using features designed for human-written reviews, creating a critical gap in the ability to identify specific defect types in LLM-generated reviews.
AI.method: TADDLE employs a tool-augmented agent architecture with four specialized analysis tools (Verify, Correct, Complete, and Transform) orchestrated by an agent. An integrator synthesizes tool outputs into classifications via two-stage semi-supervised learning. The system was evaluated on a benchmark of 1,800 reviews across 50 ICLR 2025 papers, annotated by 18 domain experts using a taxonomy of six defect categories.
AI.result: TADDLE demonstrates strong performance on both binary detection (identifying whether a review is deficient) and multi-label classification (identifying specific deficiency types) tasks.
AI.conclusion: TADDLE represents the first system capable of detecting specific deficiency types in LLM-generated peer reviews at the individual defect level. The system demonstrates strong performance on both binary and multi-label classification tasks, with the released benchmark enabling further research in this important emerging area.

title: Rethinking the Multilingual Reasoning Gap with Layer Swap
summary: Recent reasoning Large Language Models produce a chain-of-thought (CoT) predominantly in English, even when prompted in non-English languages. Prior work suggests that forcing the CoT to remain in the input language (\emph{native reasoning}) substantially degrades performance relative to allowing the model to reason in English before answering in the input language (\emph{English-pivoted reasoning}). However, most studies of this native reasoning gap rely on inference-time interventions or limited native-language training data. We revisit this comparison at a larger scale and under comparable supervision. We construct long multilingual reasoning datasets across six languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese and Swahili); fine-tune specialists in both native and English-pivoted regimes on top of \texttt{Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base}, and evaluate across mathematics, science, general knowledge, and code. In this setting, the average native reasoning gap shrinks to 1.9--3.5\% across the five non-English languages, considerably smaller than previously reported. Weight-space analysis of the native specialists reveals aligned fine-tuning updates in the middle layers and divergence in the outer layers. This points to a largely language-agnostic reasoning core surrounded by language-specific layers. Exploiting this structure, we introduce a Layer Swap: transferring the English specialist's stronger reasoning mid-layers into each native specialist, closing most of the native reasoning gap across the five non-English languages while preserving CoT in the target language. We release all models and datasets.

AI.tldr: 本研究在更大规模和可比监督条件下重新评估了多语言大模型的本地推理差距，发现该差距（1.9-3.5%）比先前报告小得多。通过权重分析发现推理核心是语言无关的（位于中间层），而外层是语言特定的。基于此发现，提出Layer Swap技术，通过迁移英语专家的强推理中间层到本地专家，有效缩小了本地推理差距，同时保留了目标语言输出的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为强迫CoT保持在输入语言（本地推理）相比允许先用英语推理再翻译回输入语言（英语转向推理）会显著降低性能，但这些研究多依赖推理时干预或有限的本地语言训练数据，需要在更大规模和可比监督条件下重新审视这一差距。
AI.method: 构建跨6种语言的长推理数据集；在Qwen3-8B-Base基础上分别进行本地推理和英语转向推理模式的微调；在数学、科学、常识和代码领域进行评估；对本地专家模型进行权重空间分析；提出Layer Swap方法——将英语专家较强的中间层迁移到各本地专家模型中。
AI.result: 在可比监督设置下，本地推理差距缩小至1.9-3.5%，远低于先前研究；权重空间分析发现本地专家模型在中间层有对齐的微调更新，在外层存在分歧，显示出语言无关的推理核心被语言特定层包围的结构；Layer Swap可关闭大部分本地推理差距。
AI.conclusion: Layer Swap技术通过迁移英语专家模型的中间层到本地语言专家模型，成功缩小了大部分本地推理差距，同时保持了目标语言的CoT输出。研究发布了所有模型和数据集。

title: From Norms to Indicators (N2I-RAG): An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Legal Indicator Computation
summary: Computing legal indicators from normative texts is a key task in legal monitoring and policy evaluation, but presents significant challenges due to the complexity, scale, and interpretive nature of legal language, as well as the variability in available document quality. Existing natural language processing techniques and generative models can assist in legal analysis, but often suffer from high risk of hallucinations and lack the interpretability and evidence grounding required for reliable indicator computation. This paper presents N2I-RAG (From Norms to Indicators), an agentic retrieval-augmented generation framework designed to automate the computation of legal indicators in a transparent and traceable way. We integrate adaptive retrieval, llm-based agents, and validation mechanisms in a modular pipeline, where each component performs a defined role in filtering, retrieving, and assessing evidence, and in producing binary legal outcomes linked to identifiable legal provisions. The framework emphasizes traceability by requiring explicit explanations of intermediate decisions and final indicator assignments. We evaluate N2I-RAG using an in-house constructed French marine environmental law corpus that includes both scanned and digital sources. Comparative experiments with multiple language model families demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms baseline systems, and generalizes well when tested on 2 different bans. The results indicate that agentic retrieval-augmented generation can bridge open-text legal language and standardized indicator computation, offering a foundation for transparent and scalable legal observatories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 N2I-RAG（From Norms to Indicators）——一个面向法律指标自动计算的多智能体检索增强生成（agentic RAG）框架。它把"从规范文本到标准化二元法律指标"的计算任务转化为结构化信息抽取问题，通过多智能体流水线（查询消歧、元数据检索、上下文检索与评分、生成、groundedness 真实性校验、答案相关性校验、二元判定）实现可解释、可溯源的 0/1 决策。在自建的法语海洋环境法语料库（5 个集合、10,596 条法条，覆盖 15 个非洲法语国家与法国，含扫描件与电子件）上，以"塑料袋禁令"和"底拖网禁令"为案例、用 11 项专家设计的指标问题构成 0/1 评估网格进行评测。与纯向量检索基线及去掉幻觉控制模块的消融配置相比，完整流水线在准确率、精确率、召回率、特异度上全面提升（Mistral-Nemo 12B 平衡准确率 0.981/0.876，F1 最高 0.943），且在 Qwen3:8B、Llama3.2:3B 上同样有效，说明增益来自结构化编排而非单一模型能力。错误分析显示残余错误主要源于法条数据缺口与过渡性条款的过度解读，而非模型技术缺陷。
AI.motivation: 法律指标（legal indicators）是将法律义务、实施情况与合规表现转化为可比较、可量化的标准化度量，是法律监测与政策评估的核心工具，尤其在海洋环境法这类国际治理需求强烈的领域。然而现有构建方式高度依赖专家问卷与人工文献解读（Prieur et al. 2021；Billant 2022），既难以规模化，也存在主观性、一致性与透明度的瓶颈。已有 NLP 方法（命名实体识别、文档分类、检索）依赖有限标注语料与领域规则，泛化性差且是"黑箱"；LLM 虽具备零样本/少样本推理能力，但受冻结参数知识限制、领域泛化弱、且存在严重幻觉风险，输出缺乏事实锚定，无法满足"每个结论都必须由可核验证据支撑"的法律要求。标准 RAG 虽有接地能力，但采用固定的"检索—生成"线性流程，无法动态改写查询、评估中间结果可靠性，难以说明"为何/如何"选择与评估法条。因此需要一种兼具适应性、可解释性与证据可追溯性的自动化法律指标计算方法。
AI.method: （1）文档处理层：采用基于视觉—语言模型（VLM，视觉编码器+语言解码器）的混合 OCR 策略，对低质量扫描件中的印章、签名、排版噪声进行纠错、补全缺失文本；随后按"法条"切分文档，并附加司法管辖区、发布日期、修订日期、机构来源、文本类型（法律/法规/指令）等标准化元数据。（2）检索层：以多语言、多粒度嵌入模型 BGE-M3 编码，在 ChromaDB 上建立 HNSW 索引，采用余弦相似度（d = 1 − Σ(A_i×B_i)/(ΣA_i²·ΣB_i²)）做近似最近邻检索，top_results=10。（3）多智能体流水线（8 个专门智能体）：Metadata Retriever（元数据→JSON）、Query Disambiguator（歧义查询改写，保持原意并具体化）、Context Retriever（向量检索候选法条）、Context Grader（按语义相关性与具体性两维评分并给出解释）、Generator Agent（严格基于已筛选上下文生成带来源的回答）、Groundedness Grader（逐条声明是否被引用文本直接支撑，未支撑者标记为不可靠）、Answer Relevance Grader（回答与原始查询一致性）、Binary QA Agent（依据"完全肯定/完全否定"与"全问题覆盖"两条规则输出 0/1，JSON 返回分数+解释）。（4）可解释性设计：区分 explainability（各阶段显式解释）与 interpretability（输出与指标定义对齐并可直接链接到具体法条）。（5）实现与实验：LangChain/LangGraph 编排，Ollama 本地运行 Llama3.2:3B、Qwen3:8b、Mistral-Nemo:12b；确定性任务温度 0，改写类任务温度 0.9；语料来自 FAOLEX，覆盖法语为行政语言的非洲国家，另引入 3 个额外禁令（沿海建筑、捕鲸、碳氢化合物排放）作为检索干扰项。（6）评测：11 个由法律/生态/经济专家共同设计的标准化问题构成 0/1 评估网格（涵盖禁令的成文法依据、全国范围、永久性、活动细节、无例外、例外受限、罚金、监禁、执法机构、限期管控程序、地点特定管控程序）；指标包括准确率、灵敏度(召回)、特异度、精确率、F1、平衡准确率、FPR、FNR；消融配置为完整流水线、纯向量检索基线、去除相关性/groundedness/一致性校验模块的版本。（7）法律错误分析：区分"数据缺口（配套法令未入库导致假阴性）"与"过渡性条款误读（把渐进实施期当作禁令的时间限制）"两类。
AI.result: 完整流水线在所有 LLM 变体上均优于基线，Mistral-Nemo:12B 表现最佳：平衡准确率 0.933、F1 0.943（无框架时仅 0.768），特异度从 0.612 提升至 0.919；Llama 与 Qwen 接入 N2I-RAG 后 F1 分别提升至 0.77 与 0.784，仍略低于 Mistral，说明增益源于结构化编排而非特定模型，且更强模型更能利用多智能体交互。消融（Mistral-Nemo）显示：塑料袋禁令平衡准确率 Baseline 0.768 → Without-Hall 0.842 → Full 0.981（F1 0.809/0.855/0.980，精确率与特异度均达 1.000，召回 0.962）；底拖网禁令 0.567 → 0.778 → 0.876（F1 0.553/0.753/0.865）。特异度是受影响最大的指标，表明幻觉控制模块对抑制法律假阳性尤为关键。残余错误主要源于法律数据本身（配套法令缺失于 FAOLEX、渐进实施期被误读为时间限制），而非模型技术缺陷；框架在缺乏依据时倾向"不产出错误信息"，但会因来源不完整而漏判现行禁令。
AI.conclusion: N2I-RAG 通过将自适应检索、LLM 智能体与验证机制整合为模块化多级流水线，弥合了开放式法律语言与标准化指标评估网格之间的鸿沟，在可解释性、证据溯源与自动化方面优于传统 NLP、纯 LLM 与标准 RAG；每个智能体均输出显式解释，结论可直接绑定到可识别的法律条款，为"法律观测台"（legal observatory）提供透明、可扩展的持续法律监测基础。作者指出框架对模型架构不敏感、可跨模型迁移，残余挑战主要来自法律语义的微妙性（过渡期、文档缺口、隐含例外）而非技术短板，故需跨学科方法（如同时纳入法令、实施细则等补充文本）加以改进。后续工作方向为扩展到多语种、多司法管辖区，集成更丰富的数据库与实时数据源，以支持更具适应性与包容性的法律指标计算。

title: KARMA: Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation
summary: Human communication depends on implicit social signals where effectiveness is shaped by tone, context, and conversational norms rather than semantic content alone. We introduce KARMA (Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation), a framework for LLM learning of context-sensitive conversational behavior from large-scale social interaction data. KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on context, and uses this signal to fine-tune language models via reinforcement learning to improve performance on pragmatics-mediated tasks. Critically, we find that the highest performing reward model does not lead to better downstream model alignment: a reward model relying exclusively on conversational context was a worse predictor of Reddit karma but yielded substantially better downstream performance. We evaluate the effects of KARMA applied to a downstream model with and without direct exposure to the social media data. The resulting models show improved pragmatics-mediated behaviors with largely mitigated undesirable side effects. Factuality is consistently diminished by KARMA across all conditions, including when the downstream model has no direct exposure to Reddit data, suggesting that this tension is embedded in the reward signal itself rather than introduced by noisy training data.

AI.tldr: KARMA框架通过Reddit社交数据训练奖励模型，用强化学习微调LLM以提升语用能力。关键发现：预测karma更好的奖励模型反而导致更差的下游表现；仅使用对话上下文的奖励模型效果更优。所有条件下KARMA都会降低事实性，且这一权衡似乎根植于奖励信号本身而非训练数据噪声。
AI.motivation: Human communication relies heavily on implicit social signals (tone, context, conversational norms) rather than semantic content alone. Training LLMs to handle context-sensitive conversational behavior requires learning from large-scale social interaction data, which presents challenges in capturing pragmatics while maintaining other desirable properties.
AI.method: KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on conversational context, then fine-tunes LLMs via reinforcement learning. The framework was evaluated with and without direct exposure to social media data to isolate the effects of the reward signal itself.
AI.result: A context-only reward model (worse at predicting Reddit karma) actually yielded substantially better downstream performance than a karma-predictive model. KARMA improves pragmatics-mediated behaviors with mitigated side effects, but factuality consistently diminishes across all conditions—including when the downstream model has no direct Reddit data exposure.
AI.conclusion: KARMA improves pragmatics-mediated conversational behaviors while largely mitigating side effects; however, the factuality-pragmatics trade-off appears inherent to the reward signal itself, as factuality diminishes even without direct Reddit exposure. The counterintuitive finding that better karma prediction leads to worse downstream performance suggests that context-only reward models may be more suitable for practical deployment.

title: Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference
summary: Amortized inference promises fast test-time Bayesian inference, but existing methods are inherently tied to fixed models. Extending amortization to unseen models typically requires retraining or costly test-time finetuning. In this paper, we ask: is it possible to build a single inference network capable of generalizing across varying priors, likelihoods, and dimensionality? We introduce Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), a family of encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification and its observations to the parameters of a variational posterior. Experimentally, a single trained AFIN achieves posterior accuracy comparable to NUTS and several variational inference methods, while requiring 2 to 4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute. Code is available at https://github.com/joohwanko/AFINs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs)：一个把模型表示为"带类型的先验/似然因子列表"的 encode–merge–decode 推断网络，通过参数共享的 Deep-Sets 式 MLP 与无位置编码注意力，其权重形状与隐变量维度 D 和观测数 N 无关。单个训练好的 AFIN 在一次前向传播（~10 ms）内给出高斯后验近似，精度经自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）修正后可比 NUTS 与逐任务变分推断，但测试时计算量低 2–4 个数量级；还可通过小规模适配器扩展到新的似然类型（如 Poisson），并在合成与 UCI 任务上优于 NPE-PFN/TabPFN 基础模型基线。
AI.motivation: 神经后验估计（NPE）等摊销推断方法虽能实现快速测试时贝叶斯推断，但本质上绑定于固定的先验、似然与模拟器；一旦更换先验/似然族、参数取值或数据规模，就需要重新训练或昂贵的测试时微调。已有工作只放宽了其中一个维度（如观测数 N、模型参数 θ、或用概率程序文本表示模型），且往往仍需逐任务拟合才能达到 NUTS 级精度。作者提出的核心问题是：能否训练单一推断网络，同时泛化到变化的先验族、似然族、隐变量维度 D 与观测数量 N，甚至在测试时直接接受未见过的因子类型组合？其动机还来自共轭推断的启示：指数族中"编码每个因子→自然参数相加→解码后验"这一模板可以泛化到非共轭情形，只要把三步都变成可学习的、且参数量不随维度变化的模块。
AI.method:
模型接口：m=(D, N, t_{0:N}, θ_{0:N})，每个观测对应一个似然因子，类型标签 t_n 与数值参数 θ_n 分开，观测在给定 z 时条件独立，先验为因子 0。
架构：Encoder 用类型专属 adapter（把该类型的 θ_n、y_n、协变量经 symlog 与两层坐标级 MLP 编码成节点/对描述子）后接共享的 4 层 node-pair 网络，输出统一的节点特征 E^node∈R^{D×C} 与对特征 E^pair∈R^{D×D×C}（C=40，pair 数组每步对称化）；Merge 用 M=4 个无位置编码的 Transformer 块，让各因子的 node/pair 作为 token 互相注意（注意力分数对坐标与坐标对取平均，node/pair 分数用可学习 λ 混合，8 头×5 维），再沿因子轴求和得 Ȳ；Decoder 由三个坐标级 MLP 输出 μ、精度对角 r_i 与非对角 Ω_ij，通过"对角 = Σ|Ω_ik| + softplus(r_i)+1e-4"保证精度矩阵严格对角占优、正定，用 Cholesky 做密度与采样。
维度无关性：所有映射为参数绑定（parameter-tied）MLP，等价于 Deep Sets 层（局部项 + 全局均值池化），node/pair 摘要取 row/col/diag/全局均值等置换等变线性映射的子集，因此权重形状与 D、N 无关且对坐标置换等变。
训练：在线生成任务（先抽模型再抽 z 与 y），目标为 max E_{p(m,z,y)}[log q(z; f_w(y,m))]（等价最小化前向 KL，偏向覆盖后验质量），AdamW 10 万步、余弦衰减、4 个微批次梯度累积、EMA 权重，单张 H100 不到 24 小时，共 4,550,011 个可训练参数（adapter 55,376 / 共享编码器 728,384 / merge 块 3,643,208 / 解码器 123,043）。训练分布：D∈{1..16}、N∈{1..256} 按偏置采样，4 种先验（对角/全协方差高斯、Student-t、Laplace），5 种似然（含协变量的高斯、含协变量的 Student-t、Bernoulli-logit、Binomial-logit），同一任务可混合多种似然。
推断：一次前向得到 (μ, Λ)；可选 SNIS 以 q_φ 为提议分布做无额外优化的后验修正。计算量 O(KD²(CH+H²)+K²D²C)，D 方向 O(D³)（Cholesky），内存对 D 二次、对 N 线性。
AI.result: 合成基准：直接 AFIN 输出的 SW²=0.0412、M1=0.0533、M2=0.1047，经 SNIS 修正后与 NUTS（两种实现）及更长 FRVI 拟合的误差相当，而前向耗时约 10 ms（D≤16、N≤64），D=64 时 67 ms/1.1 GB、N=1024 时 71 ms/1.3 GB，测试时算力比 NUTS/VI 低 2–4 个数量级。SNIS 诊断显示 AFIN 提议 ESS/样本在数据丰富设置达 0.954、权重退化小，但在数据稀缺与异质似然设置 ESS 降至 0.25–0.47。UCI 12 个任务上 SW²/M1/M2 相对时间曲线同样优于 VI 与 NUTS。校准：训练范围内 90% 边际区间覆盖 0.875（平均绝对偏差 2.6 个百分点），共轭任务上直接预测覆盖 0.92；外推时明显退化（N=384–1024 时 0.57，D=24–64 时 0.74）。消融：node+pair+注意力最优，node-only 注意力次之（0.0490），去掉注意力的"求和"变体大幅变差（0.132/0.143）；merge 消融中 learned attention 优于 uniform mixing 再优于 self-only；训练时排除的先验–似然组合在测试时误差升高（M1 0.052→0.072），表明组合泛化不完美但仍有迁移。扩展：新增 Poisson 似然仅训练 adapter（4.9 GPU-h）即可用，SW² 0.059→0.030，与已有似然混合时 90% 区域质量仍约 0.90；对比 NPE-PFN（TabPFN v2，1k/10k 上下文）在全部 144 个任务上 AFIN 的 M1/M2/SW² 均更低，且 SNIS 后 ESS 更高（0.81 vs 0.60）。
AI.conclusion: AFIN 证明：把模型表示为"带类型的因子列表"并用 encode–merge–decode 的参数共享网络处理，可让单一摊销推断网络同时覆盖先验族、似然族、参数取值、隐变量维度与观测数量，权重形状与 D、N 无关，并保留置换等变性；其共轭式"编码—求和—解码"组织是对指数族自然参数相加的可学习推广，通过注意力实现因子间信息交换以逼近非共轭依赖。局限与未来方向：(1) 作用域限于单一全局隐向量、条件独立观测、已知因子参数，需扩展到层次模型与局部隐变量；(2) 解码器为高斯，限制可表达后验，可换为混合/流式解码器以保持 SNIS 所需密度；(3) 成本对 D 与 N 均为二次，D 的外推精度最先退化，需在更大规模上训练。需注意论文中 Table 1 的 NUTS 级精度对比并非受控比较，E.9 的 NPE-PFN 对比也使用了各自的评估预算与计时口径。

title: Developing a Totally Unimodular Linear Program for Optimal Conformance Checking: When and Why It Complements A*
comment: Author-accepted manuscript accepted for publication in Expert Systems with Applications. Code and experiment scripts are available at: https://github.com/Izack-Cohen/unimodular-conformance-checking. Version corresponding to the accepted paper: v1.0.0
summary:
Alignment-based conformance checking is the state-of-the-art approach for comparing observed process executions with normative process models. The standard exact solution relies on an A*-based heuristic search, which can exhibit exponential runtime in the presence of long traces or substantial deviations.
  This paper introduces a reformulation of alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program (LP) defined on the reachability graph of the synchronous product. By exploiting the underlying network-flow structure, the proposed formulation guarantees the existence of an integral optimal extreme-point solution through LP relaxation, thereby avoiding the combinatorial overhead associated with integer variables and branch-and-bound search.
  We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation on more than 2.1 million conformance checking instances derived from real-world and synthetic benchmark datasets. The results show that A* and the LP approach exhibit complementary performance characteristics: the former performs best on short, well-conforming traces, while the LP formulation provides substantial speedups for longer traces with deviations, precisely where conformance checking is most informative. Based on these findings, we derive simple algorithm-selection guidelines that combine both approaches, achieving average runtime savings of 38.6% with 96% selection accuracy compared to always using A*.

AI.tldr: This paper reformulates alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program, exploiting network-flow properties to guarantee polynomial-time solutions without integer programming. A hybrid approach combining both methods achieves 38.6% runtime savings.
AI.motivation: The standard A*-based heuristic search for alignment-based conformance checking suffers from exponential runtime when dealing with long traces or substantial deviations, limiting its practicality for large-scale process mining applications.
AI.method: The paper reformulates alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program (LP) on the reachability graph of the synchronous product. This exploits the network-flow structure to guarantee integral optimal extreme-point solutions through LP relaxation, eliminating the need for integer variables and branch-and-bound search.
AI.result: Extensive empirical evaluation on over 2.1 million instances shows A* and LP have complementary performance: A* excels on short, well-conforming traces, while LP provides substantial speedups for longer traces with deviations.
AI.conclusion: The proposed LP-based approach demonstrates substantial speedups for longer traces with deviations, and when combined with A* through simple algorithm-selection guidelines, achieves 38.6% average runtime savings with 96% selection accuracy.

title: From Snippets to Semantics: Rethinking Evidence Granularity for Multilingual Fact Verification
summary: Multilingual fact verification requires evidence that is both relevant and sufficiently complete for reliable factuality prediction. However, existing systems often rely on search snippets, sentence-level evidence, or locally segmented passages, which can miss decisive context and produce fragmented evidence. To overcome these limitations, we propose SEEK, a Semantic Evidence Extraction with an adaptive chunKing framework that constructs coherent evidence chunks from full fact-checking articles by identifying semantic topic transitions and preserving local verification context. The constructed chunks are encoded using a multilingual encoder and then multilingual LLMs are finetuned using LoRA adapter for veracity prediction. Experiments on X-FACT and RU22Fact show that SEEK improves macro-f1 by up to 10% over semantic chunking, 19% over sentence chunking, and 20% over search-snippet baselines. Evidence completeness and significance analyses further show that SEEK preserves richer verification context and enables more reliable multilingual fact-checking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEEK框架，通过语义主题转换识别和自适应分块策略从完整事实核查文章中构建连贯证据块，结合多语言编码器和LoRA微调的大语言模型进行真实性预测，在多语言事实核查任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有系统依赖搜索片段、句子级证据或局部分割段落，容易遗漏关键上下文并产生碎片化证据，无法满足可靠事实性预测所需的完整证据需求。
AI.method: 该方法首先通过识别语义主题转换来构建连贯的证据块，同时保留本地验证上下文；然后使用多语言编码器对证据块进行编码；最后通过LoRA适配器对多语言大语言模型进行微调以预测真实性。
AI.result: SEEK在X-FACT和RU22Fact数据集上的宏观F1值相比语义分块提升10%，相比句子分块提升19%，相比搜索片段基线提升20%。证据完整性和显著性分析表明该方法保留了更丰富的验证上下文。
AI.conclusion: SEEK框架通过语义分块策略显著提升了多语言事实核查的性能，在X-FACT和RU22Fact数据集上均展现出优于基线方法的表现，证明了构建连贯证据块对提升事实核查可靠性的有效性。

title: FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis
summary: Task-based fMRI provides a direct readout of task-evoked neural dynamics, but it is expensive and difficult to acquire at scale, motivating rest-to-task synthesis from widely available resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI). We propose FM-fMRI, an event-conditioned flow-matching model that learns a continuous-time conditional vector field to generate task ROI time series from a subject's rsfMRI and the task event information. The formulation enables fast ODE-based sampling and flexible conditioning over heterogeneous event schedules. Rather than optimizing for pointwise reconstruction, we evaluated generated signals using complementary criteria that probe temporal and spectral structure, subject and group-level connectome consistency, and distributional alignment. On the public Human Connectome Project and internal BioPoint autism cohort, FM-fMRI achieves the strongest spectral and connectivity agreement and improved distribution-level matching over conditional diffusion, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and variational autoencoders (VAEs) baselines. Furthermore, we augment the BioPoint cohort by synthesizing task-fMRI ROI time series with our method, improving downstream autism classification and demonstrating practical utility in data-limited clinical settings. The code will be available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FM-fMRI，一个基于事件条件流匹配的任务态fMRI生成模型，可从静息态fMRI合成任务态ROI时间序列，在HCP和BioPoint自闭症数据集上表现优于扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线方法，并成功应用于自闭症分类任务。
AI.motivation: 任务态fMRI能直接反映神经动力学，但获取成本高、难度大；而静息态fMRI数据丰富易得，因此需要研究从静息态到任务态的跨模态合成方法，以降低大规模应用的门槛。
AI.method: 提出FM-fMRI方法，采用事件条件流匹配（flow-matching）模型学习从静息态fMRI到任务态ROI时间序列的条件向量场，支持连续时间生成和基于ODE的快速采样，可灵活处理异质性事件计划。
AI.result: FM-fMRI在Human Connectome Project和BioPoint自闭症队列上实现了最强的频谱和连接一致性，分布匹配性能优于条件扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线。
AI.conclusion: FM-fMRI可有效合成任务态fMRI时间序列，在数据受限的临床场景中具有实用价值；通过增强BioPoint队列数据，成功提升了自闭症分类的下游任务性能。

title: Quality Without Usefulness: LLM-Generated XAI Narratives as Trust Heuristics Rather Than Decision Aids
summary: Prior work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform Explainable AI (XAI) outputs into Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) that score highly on quality metrics such as plausibility, coherence, and comprehensibility. But does explanation quality translate to practical usefulness? We investigate this question in a time-series energy forecasting domain through five controlled experiments (2,730 judgments across 60 test instances), each operationalising a distinct facet of usefulness studied in the XAI literature. Holding NLE quality constant at the high levels established by a prior factorial study, we find that NLEs do not improve task accuracy on any of the five tasks, while inflating self-reported confidence. A placebic control shows that this confidence boost is driven by text presence rather than content. In an out-of-distribution detection task, NLEs reduce the LLM judge's ability to flag unreliable predictions, providing false reassurance that masks model failure. We characterise these findings as the Quality-Usefulness Gap and argue that evaluation of the XAI-to-NLE pipeline must extend beyond text-quality metrics to downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: Large Language Models can transform XAI outputs into high-quality natural language explanations, but this quality does not translate to practical usefulness. In energy forecasting tasks, such explanations fail to improve accuracy while inflating user confidence through mere text presence, and reduce the ability to detect unreliable predictions—highlighting a "Quality-Usefulness Gap" that demands evaluation beyond text-quality metrics.
AI.motivation: Prior work demonstrated that LLMs can produce Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) scoring highly on quality metrics (plausibility, coherence, comprehensibility). However, it remains unclear whether these high-quality NLEs translate to practical usefulness in real-world tasks.
AI.method: Five controlled experiments (2,730 judgments across 60 test instances) in a time-series energy forecasting domain, each operationalizing a distinct facet of usefulness. A placebo control was used to isolate the effect of text presence versus content.
AI.result: NLEs do not improve task accuracy across any of the five tasks while inflating self-reported confidence. This confidence boost is driven by text presence rather than content. In out-of-distribution detection, NLEs reduce the LLM judge's ability to flag unreliable predictions, providing false reassurance that masks model failure.
AI.conclusion: The study introduces and characterizes the "Quality-Usefulness Gap" and argues that XAI-to-NLE pipeline evaluation must extend beyond text-quality metrics to downstream task performance.

title: Aperiodic and Low-Frequency Spectral Bias in Reconstruction based EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models, pre-trained on large-scale unlabelled EEG data, have emerged as a promising direction towards learning generalizable EEG representations. Despite showing positive results in data-rich regimes, they often fail to outperform significantly smaller supervised models in low-resource settings compared to fully supervised models. We provide a mechanistic account of this shortcoming, attributing it to a fundamental mismatch between reconstruction-based pretext tasks and the idiosyncratic spectral structure of EEG signals, which decompose into distinct high-power aperiodic and low-power oscillatory components. Using controlled, synthetically-generated EEG inputs, we demonstrate that EEG foundation model embeddings are biased to capture the aperiodic components of the EEG signal while under-representing oscillatory components, particularly at higher frequencies. Additionally, linear probe evaluations on real-world BCI datasets further reveal that embeddings encode subject identity more strongly than task-relevant information, thereby reinforcing the low-frequency and aperiodic component bias in foundation model embeddings trained primarily on reconstruction based objectives. Together, these findings elucidate a failure mode in reconstruction based EEG foundation models and motivate future work to incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure as a path toward more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了重建目标预训练任务与EEG信号特殊频谱结构之间的根本不匹配：基于重建的EEG基础模型倾向于过度表征高频 aperiodic 成分而忽视 oscillatory 成分，且编码了过多的受试者身份信息而非任务相关特征。
AI.motivation: 尽管EEG基础模型在大数据场景下表现良好，但在低资源环境下往往无法优于完全监督模型。
AI.method: 通过受控的合成生成的EEG输入进行实验，并结合真实世界BCI数据集上的线性探针评估。
AI.result: EEG基础模型嵌入主要捕获EEG信号的周期性成分，而对振荡成分（尤其是高频）的表征不足；嵌入编码了更多受试者身份信息而非任务相关信息。
AI.conclusion: Future work should incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure to develop more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

title: LELA: An End-to-end LLM-based Entity Linking Framework with Zero-shot Domain Adaptation
summary: Entity linking is a key component of many downstream NLP systems, yet existing approaches are often tied to the specific target knowledge bases and domains, limiting their real world application. In this paper, we extend LELA, a modular and domain-agnostic LLM-based entity disambiguation method, into a practical Python library that integrates zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) -thereby providing a complete end-toend pipeline for entity-linking in real-world usage. We provide experimental results validating LELA's performance and robustness across diverse entity linking settings. In our demo, users can play with the system on their own input texts.

AI.tldr: 本文将LELA实体消歧方法扩展为Python库，集成零样本NER，提供端到端实体链接管道。
AI.motivation: 现有实体链接方法通常绑定于特定知识库和领域，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 将模块化领域无关的LLM实体消歧方法LELA扩展为Python库，集成零样本命名实体识别，实现端到端实体链接流程。
AI.result: 实验验证了LELA在不同实体链接场景下的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LELA扩展为Python库，提供端到端实体链接管道，可在用户自定义输入文本上运行演示。

title: EmoDistill: Offline Emotion Skill Distillation for Language Model Agents in Adversarial Negotiation
summary: Post-trained LLMs are often optimized to align responses with human preferences, making them safe, polite, and conversationally appropriate. In adversarial negotiation, however, this alignment can become a vulnerability: emotionally framed language may steer agents toward the counterparty's interests. Using GoEmotions-based affective prompting, we show that emotion substantially shifts negotiation outcomes, suggesting that emotion is a strategic action channel rather than a surface style. Thus, we introduce \textbf{EmoDistill}, an offline framework for distilling emotional negotiation skills into language model agents. EmoDistill decomposes emotional strategy into emotion selection and emotion expression: an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) selector learns \emph{which} emotion to express, while a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)-based policy learns \emph{how} to express it through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Judge Policy Optimization (JPO). Across four emotion-sensitive, high-stakes negotiation domains, SLM policies trained under the EmoDistill framework achieve the highest utility, outperforming vanilla SLM/LLM baselines and IQL-only emotion selection. Ablations show that emotion conditioning is essential, and transfer studies demonstrate generalization across domains, unseen counterparties, and trained-vs-trained tournaments. Overall, EmoDistill learns skills from offline agent-to-agent interactions, avoiding costly online negotiation during training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EmoDistill框架，通过离线方式将情绪谈判技能提炼到语言模型智能体中。该框架结合隐式Q学习进行情绪选择，以及LoRA微调与判断策略优化进行情绪表达，在多个高风险谈判场景中超越基线方法，并展现出良好的跨领域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 后训练LLM的对齐优化在对抗性谈判中可能成为弱点——情绪化语言会引导智能体偏离自身利益。论文认为情绪是一个战略性行动渠道，而非表面风格，因此需要专门将情绪谈判技能提炼到语言模型智能体中。
AI.method: EmoDistill将情绪策略分解为情绪选择和情绪表达两部分：隐式Q学习（IQL）选择器学习"何时"表达情绪，而基于低秩适应（LoRA）的策略通过监督微调（SFT）和判断策略优化（JPO）学习"如何"表达情绪。
AI.result: 在四个情绪敏感的高风险谈判领域中，基于EmoDistill框架训练的小型语言模型（SLM）策略获得最高效用，优于vanilla SLM/LLM基线和仅使用IQL的情绪选择方法。消融实验表明情绪条件化是关键，迁移研究表明该方法能够泛化到未见领域、未见对手以及训练-训练锦标赛场景。
AI.conclusion: EmoDistill能够从离线智能体间交互中学习技能，避免了训练过程中的高昂在线谈判成本，且展现出跨领域、跨对手及训练-训练锦标赛的泛化能力。

title: DDGAD: Trajectory Dynamics for Diffusion-Based Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify nodes or substructures whose behavior or attributes deviate significantly from the overall pattern in graph-structured data, with critical applications in financial risk control, social network analysis, and cybersecurity. However, existing GCN-based methods suffer from the fundamental problem of contamination propagation, where anomalous nodes pollute the representations of their neighbors through message passing, leading to degraded detection performance. In this paper, we propose DDGAD, a novel diffusion-based graph anomaly detection framework that leverages trajectory dynamics to distinguish normal and anomalous nodes. Our key insight is that normal nodes exhibit consistent and stable representation trajectories under the coupled effects of diffusion regularization and reliability-aware neighborhood consensus, while anomalous nodes exhibit unstable and conflicting dynamics due to the directional disagreement between the global manifold prior and locally contaminated message passing. To mitigate contamination propagation, we introduce a distributed reliability-aware consensus refinement mechanism and define three complementary anomaly signals: neighbor inconsistency, reliability weight, and dynamical conflict energy. We further provide a preliminary theoretical analysis on normal node stability under the coupled dynamics. These signals collectively characterize anomalous behaviors from the perspectives of local inconsistency, consensus reliability, and dynamical instability. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDGAD框架，利用轨迹动力学区分正常和异常节点，通过可靠性感知共识机制抑制GCN中的污染传播问题，在五个真实数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GCN的图异常检测方法存在污染传播的根本问题——异常节点通过消息传递污染其邻居的表示，导致检测性能下降。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹动力学的扩散图异常检测框架（DDGAD）。引入分布式可靠性感知共识精炼机制缓解污染传播，定义三种互补的异常信号：邻域不一致性、可靠性权重和动力学冲突能量，并提供正常节点稳定性的初步理论分析。
AI.result: 在五个真实数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DDGAD框架通过分布式可靠性感知共识精炼机制有效抑制了污染传播，在五个真实数据集上验证了有效性。正常节点在扩散正则化和可靠性感知邻域共识的耦合作用下表现出稳定一致的表示轨迹，而异常节点则因全局流形先验与局部污染消息传递之间的方向分歧而呈现不稳定冲突的动力学行为。

title: Generating Robust Portfolios of Optimization Models using Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 LM4Plan Workshop
summary: Mathematical optimization is a powerful tool for structured decision-making across domains such as resource allocation and planning. Formulating optimization models faithful to reality, though, remains a significant bottleneck as it typically demands both domain expertise and optimization knowledge that are often scarce. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) promise to bridge this gap, enabling the generation of candidate optimization models from natural language descriptions. However, there is no guarantee that any single LLM-generated model is reliable, and existing approaches that output only one model are therefore risky. In this work, we propose a novel algorithm that generates a portfolio of optimization models, designed to be robust to the limitations of LLMs. Our method exploits the observation that a single LLM can play two distinct roles $\unicode{x2014}$ as a stochastic generator and as a reasoning evaluator $\unicode{x2014}$ and proposes a unified framework that leverages both capabilities in a complementary manner. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, as long as either the generator or the evaluator is well-aligned with human preferences, the portfolio is guaranteed to contain high-quality candidates, enabling a principled human-in-the-loop process in which a decision-maker can review multiple candidates before committing to one. We further validate our approach empirically, demonstrating strong performance across a range of optimization modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个免训练、轻量的“优化模型组合（portfolio）”生成算法：让同一个 LLM 同时扮演随机生成器（generator）与推理评估器（evaluator/judge），先由生成器多次采样产生候选优化模型，再用评估器排序，取排序最靠前且累计生成概率≥1−α 的前 k*(α) 个候选构成组合。理论上只要生成器或评估器之一与人类偏好对齐，组合就保证包含高质量候选（评估器对齐→覆盖率=1；生成器对齐且 α<1/2→覆盖率>(1−2α)/k*(α)>0）。在合成仿真与 NL4LP 真实任务的 25 个优化问题上验证：该组合在最坏情况（人选中最差模型）下显著优于随机采样组合，且基于推理能力的评估器优于仅用生成概率排序的评估器。
AI.motivation: 数学优化建模（把自然语言任务描述形式化为目标函数与约束）同时需要领域知识和优化知识，人力成本高，是实际落地的瓶颈。已有工作借助 LLM 从自然语言自动生成优化模型（端到端建模或仅生成目标函数），但普遍存在两个问题：一是需额外训练/微调、计算开销大；二是只输出单个模型且对其质量没有任何保证，而 LLM 生成的模型可能不可靠，直接使用风险高。作者因此希望：既降低门槛（免训练），又给出质量层面的鲁棒性保证，并支持 human-in-the-loop——让决策者在多个高质量候选中审阅后再选定其一。
AI.method:
1）形式化：设 d 为自然语言问题描述，生成器 g 在候选模型空间 O（O=O_v ∪ ⊥，⊥ 表示无效输出）上诱导概率分布 p；评估器 e 诱导排序策略 π_e(d)=(o_(1)^e, o_(2)^e, …)，并按 p 的取值计算前缀累积概率。
2）组合构造（Eq.2）：P(d;α) = {o_(i)^e}_{i=1}^{k*(α)}，其中 k*(α)=inf{k∈ℕ : Σ_{i=1..k} p(o_(i)^e) ≥ 1−α}，α∈(0,1) 为用户指定的概率质量阈值。即：沿评估器排序从前往后取，直到所取候选的生成概率累计达到 1−α，从而在“评估器排名靠前”与“生成器高概率”两种入选机制之间取得互补。
3）人类对齐定义：Def 3.2 评估器对齐 π_e(d)=π*(d)；Def 3.3 生成器对齐，即对任意 i≤j 有 p(o_(i)*) ≥ p(o_(j)*)（人类偏好越高的候选被生成概率越大）。
4）组合覆盖率 def 3.4：c(P) = (组合中属于人类最优排序的候选数)/k，即与人类最优排序的交集比例。
5）理论保证：Corollary 3.5（评估器对齐、任意生成器、任意 α∈(0,1)）⇒ c(P)=1；Proposition 3.6（生成器对齐、任意评估器、α∈(0,1/2)）⇒ 非空组合满足 c(P) > (1−2α)/k*(α) > 0（证明用概率质量交换论证：错选候选的概率总和 ≤ α，故交集质量 ≥1−2α）。
6）实验：(a) 合成仿真，候选空间有限 K∈{10,20,50,100}，人类排序为 (1,…,K)；生成器四类（Aligned、Weakly Aligned、Uniform、Misaligned），评估器以错误率 ε∈{0,0.3,0.5,0.7,1} 参数化（ε=1 为完全反序）；α 从 0 到 1 步长 0.02，40 个随机种子，绘制覆盖率/组合规模随 1−α 的曲线及 95% 置信区间。(b) 真实任务：从 NL4LP 选取 25 个优化问题，用 gpt-5.4-nano 生成 50 个候选模型（自然语言描述 + Python 代码），用归一化 token 对数概率作为生成概率 p(o)；评估器通过执行代码得到输出并结合问题用 gpt-5.4-nano 重复采样 4 次给出 1–100 分并取平均排名，另设“生成器概率排序”的对照评估器；最终用 gpt-5.4 作为 LLM-as-a-judge 评分（输入额外加入数据集给出的真解），以组合内最小分数作为最坏情况下组合质量，与随机采样组合做对比（KDE 图，25 题 × 30 次随机采样）。
AI.result: 合成实验：与 Proposition 3.6 一致，α<0.5 时即便在 Weakly Aligned 生成器下、无论评估器误差 ε 多大，组合均取得正覆盖率；实测覆盖率实际上被 1−α 下界约束（曲线始终高于对角线），比理论界 (1−2α)/k* 更紧。对齐程度决定“覆盖率—组合规模”权衡：固定生成器时评估器误差越小，覆盖率越高且组合更小；固定最差评估器（ε=1）时生成器越对齐覆盖率越高，但代价是组合规模变大。真实任务：两类评估器构造的组合在最坏情形（人选中组合内最差模型）下的评分分布均一致优于随机采样组合；使用 LLM 推理式评估器的组合得分高于仅使用生成器概率排序的组合，说明统一“生成 + 推理评判”双模式带来实际优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是一个免训练、轻量且带保证的框架：把 LLM 同时用作随机生成器与推理评估器，以“评估器排序 + 生成概率阈值 α”构造优化模型组合，使人类偏好对齐只需在生成器或评估器一侧成立即可保证组合含高质量候选，从而支撑有原则的 human-in-the-loop 决策（人在多个候选中审阅后再选定）。局限与未来方向：理论依赖理想化的“人类对齐”与概率可计算假设，实验中评估器错误以 ε 粗粒度刻画、生成概率用 token 对数概率近似；实验规模有限（25 题、单一大模型家族、gpt-5.4 系列），尚未检验组合在更大规模、更异质模型族上的稳定性，也未评估 α 的自适应选取、多样性/冗余度与决策者实际选择行为的交互等。

title: SeDT: Sentence-Transformer Decision-Transformer Conditioning for Multi-Turn Conversation Reliability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance when a task is fully specified in a single turn, yet the same models lose up to 39% of that performance when the identical task is revealed incrementally across multiple turns, a phenomenon documented at scale as Lost in Conversation. Crucially, this collapse is almost entirely a reliability failure; the best case, the aptitude only falls 16%, while the unreliability more than doubles (+112%). We argue that the root cause is structural, a flat conversation history assigns equal implicit weight to every prior turn, giving the model no signal to distinguish a critical constraint from incidental dialog. We present SeDT Sentence-transformer Decision-Transformer, a training-free inference-time method that resolves this by importing return-to-go conditioning from offline reinforcement learning. SeDT annotates each conversation shard with a cumulative relevance score derived from three complementary semantic, lexical, and positional signals and presents the full annotated history to the model at the final turn, without weight changes, without training data, and without discarding context. Evaluated on the Lost-in-Conversation benchmark in three LLMs and three generation tasks, SeDT outperforms the sharded baseline in all nine model-task combinations, with gains up to +37.7% in mean performance P and simultaneous reductions in unreliability in seven of the nine combinations. In short, telling the model which past turns matter is sufficient to substantially recover the performance lost in conversation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeDT方法解决LLM多轮对话中的性能崩溃问题。该方法通过语义、词汇和位置三信号计算累积相关性分数并标注对话分片，使模型能在最终回合识别关键约束。实验证明此训练-free推理方法在9个组合中均有效，最高提升37.7%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在单轮任务中表现优异，但当相同任务跨多轮增量揭示时，性能下降高达39%，且几乎完全由可靠性失败导致（最佳情况下aptitude仅下降16%，但不可靠性增加超过112%）。根因在于对话历史结构扁平化，所有先前回合被赋予同等隐含权重，模型无法区分关键约束与偶然对话。
AI.method: SeDT从离线强化学习中引入return-to-go条件化机制，使用三个互补信号（语义、词汇、位置）计算累积相关性分数，对对话分片进行标注，在最终回合将完整标注后的历史呈现给模型。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和三个生成任务的Lost-in-Conversation基准测试中，SeDT在所有9个模型-任务组合中均优于分片基线，性能提升最高达37.7%，且在7个组合中同时减少不可靠性。
AI.conclusion: SeDT通过无需训练、无需权重更改且不丢弃上下文的推理时方法，在9个模型-任务组合中均优于基线，最高提升37.7%，同时在7个组合中降低不可靠性，证明了"告知模型哪些过去回合重要"足以显著恢复对话中丢失的性能。

title: MuCon: Clipped Muon Updates for LLM Training
summary: Muon-style optimizers take a matrix-valued momentum or preconditioned update $B = U \operatorname{diag}(σ_1,\ldots,σ_r) V^\top$ and replace it with its canonical partial polar factor $\operatorname{Pol}(B) = U V^\top$. This maps every nonzero singular value to one. MuCon is the clipped-Muon variant studied here: it applies singular-value clipping to the same Muon matrix, $D^{\mathrm{MuCon}}\_τ(B) = \operatorname{MClip}\_τ(B) = U \operatorname{diag}\bigl(\min\{σ\_i,τ\}\bigr) V^\top, \qquad τ> 0$. Thus, $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ denotes the mathematical clipping operator, while MuCon denotes the optimizer primitive that substitutes this clipped direction for Muon's polar direction. The Muon/MuCon scaling parameterization used in this work is called $\text{SpectralP}$: it is the hidden-matrix scaling recipe under which polar Muon or clipped MuCon directions are applied. The map $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ is the Frobenius projection onto the spectral-norm ball $\{X : \|X\|_2 \le τ\}$: it leaves singular values at or below $τ$ unchanged and modifies only the violating singular directions. This paper asks when the MuCon clipping step can be approximated without a full dense SVD. We record two exact identities, a polar/absolute-value formula and a scalar-root formulation leading to a rational Newton filter for the clipped positive-semidefinite factor, and identify the numerical obstruction common to both: singular values near the threshold make sign decisions and rational solves ill-conditioned. Matrix-function methods are therefore useful only when paired with stable polar/square-root primitives or explicit regularization near the clipping boundary.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了MuCon剪切操作能否在避免完整密集SVD的前提下进行近似。通过推导极分解和标量根的精确恒等式，揭示了阈值附近奇异值的病态性是主要数值障碍，并指出矩阵函数方法需配合稳定的极分解原语或显式正则化才能可靠运行。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器中的剪切（clipping）操作通常需要完整的密集奇异值分解（SVD），计算成本高昂。该论文旨在探究在何种条件下可以绕过完整SVD来近似MuCon剪切步骤。
AI.method: 给出了两个精确恒等式：极分解/绝对值公式和标量根 formulation，后者引入了剪切正定因子的有理牛顿滤波器。同时分析了两种方法共有的数值障碍：阈值附近的奇异值导致符号决策和有理求解器病态化。
AI.result: 识别出MuCon剪切计算的数值障碍本质：当奇异值接近剪切阈值τ时，符号决策变得病态，导致有理方程组条件数激增。
AI.conclusion: 矩阵函数方法仅在与稳定的极分解/平方根原语或显式正则化结合时才能有效使用；该研究为构建无需完整密集SVD的近似MuCon剪切算法奠定了理论基础。

title: ORCA: An End-to-End Interactive Copilot for Optimized Root Cause Analysis
summary: Causal analysis is a crucial task in many domains, including manufacturing, social science, and medicine. However, despite recent progress, the conceptual and methodological complexity of causal methods makes them largely inaccessible to domain experts. This gap prevents experts from leveraging these advances and hinders researchers who lack access to real-world data for validation. To bridge this divide, we introduce ORCA, a copilot for end-to-end causal analysis. ORCA orchestrates agents to understand the user's goals and guide them through the most appropriate causal analysis workflow, from fully automatic to highly user-guided execution. It features causal discovery, causal effect estimation, explainability and Root-Cause-Analysis (RCA). ORCA evaluates and compares performance, generates key metrics and diagrams, and generates insights through structured reports. We highlight its effectiveness across several real-world use-cases.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一个由LLM驱动、基于多智能体架构的交互式因果分析"副驾驶"系统，目标是让非因果专家也能完成端到端的因果分析工作流（数据清洗→因果发现→效应估计→根因分析→可视化与报告）。系统通过自然语言界面与GUI交互，自动推荐SOTA算法与超参、注入领域先验、估计计算耗时并生成结构化报告，文中以云计算、零售、制造、半导体四个真实案例说明其可用性。论文定位为系统/愿景型工作（发表于Causal NeSy workshop），量化实验评估较弱。
AI.motivation: 因果分析在医疗、制造、经济、遗传、IT网络等领域至关重要，但因果方法的概念与方法论复杂度极高，使得领域专家难以采用；而研究者在缺乏真实数据与真值因果图时也难以验证方法。典型因果应用需要一条长而复杂的流水线（领域描述、数据清洗与预处理、因果发现、效应估计、RCA、可视化、报告），每一阶段都涉及算法选择、超参调优与评估指标等关键技术决策，需要"深度方法论专长+领域知识"的复合能力，这种组合在实践中很少同时具备。此外，因果任务缺乏社区公认的标准化基准与评估流程，真值因果图在实践中几乎不可得（只能依赖合成数据或下游任务评估），RCA基准更加稀缺，因此完全自动化方案难以被验证，实质上要求human-in-the-loop，而现有工具并不支持这一过程。作者由此提出从真实场景中提炼出六项需求：端到端因果工作流、对非专家友好的直观交互与引导、数据安全与隐私、领域知识的注入、可解释性与可追溯性、算法推荐与自动化。
AI.method: 系统整体分为三大支柱：用户输入（数据、领域知识、查询）、对话式助手（多智能体框架）、生成输出（结果、图表、报告）。架构上分三层：(1) 用户交互层——任务管理、聊天服务与LLM主干；(2) 工作流管理层——Request Management Unit通过集中式编排管理工作流状态，把API调用路由到远程LLM，把重算法负载卸载到GPU集群，中央Generation Unit将编排器的高层推理动态翻译为可执行Python脚本；(3) 各功能Agent执行层。关键机制包括：计算时间估计（依据算法理论复杂度、数据维度与可用硬件给出运行时预估，在精度与速度间提供权衡）；安全与隐私（TLS加密通信、认证API、RBAC控制数据与RCA输出访问、每次交互在隔离会话上下文中运行）；知识与数据摄取（上传观测/干预数据及手册、技术报告、知识图谱、数据库等多形态领域知识）；交互式编排（状态管理模块记录每一步及结果，用户可回退并注入新先验而保留全局上下文，LLM依据会话历史保持推理一致性）；数据可视化与结构化报告生成。算法覆盖：预处理与EDA（缺失值处理、编码、多种缩放）；因果发现（静态数据：约束型PC、FCI；评分型GES、XGES、GRaSP；连续型NOTEARS、GOLEM、CORL；函数型LiNGAM、ANM、PNL；LLM-based CausalSteward；时序：PCMCI、NeuralGC Granger因果），基于gcastle库；RCA（图依赖型Traversal、CI-RCA、反事实归因、Score Traversal；无图型RCD、Cholesky Composition、Score Ordering），基于Amazon RCA库。系统原生集成CausalChambers、CausalMan、Petshop、Sockshop、ProRCA等基准数据集与数据生成模拟器（Erdős–Rényi与Scale-Free随机图，线性/非线性函数形式，高斯/Gumbel/均匀加性噪声），并可通过注入hard/soft/单一/多重干预系统合成根因以严格评估RCA与因果可解释性。评估指标包括SHD、归一化SHD，以及RCA的Precision、Recall、F1、Accuracy、NDCG、MRR、MAP@k。算法推荐采用AutoML原则，依据数据集特征与用户偏好自动选择方法并搜索超参。
AI.result: 论文以四个真实用例展示ORCA的有效性与实用性：(1) 云计算服务商——在大量微服务告警洪流中区分症状与根因，自动定位引发故障的具体服务/组件，缩短停机时间；(2) 零售服装公司——针对不同品类与渠道利润率的显著未解释方差，用因果发现建模业务杠杆，并估计折扣率变化对利润率的因果影响；(3) 制造（磁性阀与液压块）——工艺工程师提供部分已知功能关系，ORCA用Cholesky Composition输出根因排序列表，工程师测试前三项后确认"液压块表面粗糙度波动导致密封件无法完全贴合"为泄漏根因；(4) 半导体晶圆厂——在"良率骤降"（yield excursion）中自动检出根因，例如定位两个月前某30分钟窗口内某刻蚀机体的等离子体压力低于目标范围0.2%这一细微超标偏差及其引发缺陷的因果链，从而支持快速纠正行动以保护良率并避免晶圆报废。文中强调系统通过结构化报告汇总各决策、因果图与下游方法，使分析对更广泛受众可复现、可解释、可访问。总体结论是：ORCA通过抽象因果推断的陡峭方法论复杂度，被作者视为首个使非专家也能独立从真实数据中提取因果洞见的同类方案。
AI.conclusion: ORCA通过对话式交互与人机协同工作流，把复杂的因果分析任务（因果发现与RCA）以可导航的形式交付给用户：由系统主动建议下一步、依据数据集特征推荐最优SOTA算法、自动完成超参调优，从而降低门槛、支撑更广泛落地。作者认为这代表同类方案中的首创，可赋能非专家独立地从真实数据中提取因果洞见。局限性方面：该工作主要面向系统与愿景层面（发表于Causal NeSy workshop的立场/系统论文），缺少对照基线的量化实验与端到端误差分析；基准数据集仍以合成/模拟数据为主，真实场景中真值因果图的缺失与评估困难这一核心问题主要通过引入human-in-the-loop与领域知识注入来缓解，尚未从根本上解决；此外AutoML式超参搜索、运行时估计与LLM编排引入的额外开销与可靠性风险未做量化分析。后续工作方向应包括更系统的对比评估、真实工业数据上的验证、以及多智能体协作与推理一致性的更严格度量。

title: Psychological Constructs in Shared Semantic Space
summary: Psychological constructs are often measured in separate instruments, datasets, and research traditions, which makes direct comparison difficult. This paper proposes a framework for making such constructs semantically commensurate by representing and comparing them as directions in a shared word-embedding space. Using Supervised Semantic Differential, we estimate construct-specific semantic gradients from text-outcome associations and project them onto theoretically motivated reference axes. As an initial test case, we use Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) as an affective coordinate system. First, we recover interpretable VAD directions from English word-level affective norms. Second, we project semantic gradients for 27 GoEmotions categories into this space and recover the expected organization of emotions, especially along valence and arousal. Third, we apply the same procedure to Big Five personality domains and facets derived from IPIP-NEO-300 item-factor associations. Domain-level placements are broadly coherent, while facet-level results are more exploratory because they rely on sparse questionnaire text. The results suggest that embedding spaces can support construct-level comparison across otherwise incommensurable psychological measurements, provided that semantic placements are assessed for stability and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用词嵌入空间将心理学构念表示为方向向量，实现跨测量工具的可比性。通过监督语义差异法(SSD)估计构念语义梯度，以VAD(效价、唤醒度、支配性)作为参考轴进行投影测试，在情感分类(GoEmotions)和人格特质(Big Five)数据上验证了该框架的可行性。
AI.motivation: 心理学构念通常在不同的测量工具、数据集和研究传统中进行测量，导致直接比较困难，缺乏统一的可通约性框架。
AI.method: 提出监督语义差异法(Supervised Semantic Differential)：(1)从文本-结果关联中估计构念特异性语义梯度；(2)将语义梯度投影到理论驱动的参考轴上。以效价、唤醒度和支配性(VAD)作为情感坐标系统进行验证。
AI.result: (1)从英语词汇情感norms中恢复了可解释的VAD方向；(2)将27个GoEmotions类别的语义梯度投影到VAD空间，重现了预期的情感组织结构(尤其沿效价和唤醒度)；(3)成功应用于Big Five人格领域和IPIP-NEO-300 facets水平。
AI.conclusion: 词嵌入空间可支持跨测量工具的构念级比较，但需对语义定位的稳定性和可解释性进行评估。该框架为整合不同心理学测量传统提供了方法学基础。

title: Diffuse to Detect: Generative Diffusion Models for Unsupervised IC Anomaly Detection
summary: Latent defect screening is challenged by extremely low failure rates, high-dimensional test data, and absence of labeled anomalies. We propose the first unsupervised anomaly detection framework incorporating a Diffusion Transformer. Raw test measurements are first compressed by an autoencoder, then reshaped into a structured token sequence enriched with sinusoidal and per-device wafer-position embeddings. Anomaly scores are derived from the noise-prediction error over mid-range diffusion timesteps, enabling fast wafer-scale screening without any labeled defects or manual feature engineering. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on industrial 16nm IC test data under extreme class imbalance, offering interpretable failure localization through latent-space reconstruction residuals.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于扩散Transformer的无监督异常检测框架，用于半导体潜在缺陷筛选。通过自编码器压缩原始测试数据，结合正弦位置编码和晶圆位置嵌入生成结构化token序列，利用扩散模型中频时间步的噪声预测误差计算异常分数，实现无需标注缺陷的晶圆级快速筛查，并在16nm工业IC数据上达到最优性能，同时提供可解释的失效定位能力。
AI.motivation: Latent defect screening faces extreme challenges: near-zero failure rates, high-dimensional test data, and absence of labeled anomalies, making traditional supervised approaches infeasible.
AI.method: Autoencoder compression of raw measurements → structured token sequence with sinusoidal and per-device wafer-position embeddings → anomaly scoring via noise-prediction error over mid-range diffusion timesteps.
AI.result: Outperforms existing methods on industrial 16nm IC test data under extreme class imbalance, with interpretable failure localization through latent-space reconstruction residuals.
AI.conclusion: First Diffusion Transformer-based unsupervised anomaly detection for latent defect screening, achieving state-of-the-art performance on industrial 16nm IC data with interpretable failure localization.

title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have become the core backbone of numerous downstream tasks such as question answering and recommender systems. However, despite all this, KGs are often very incomplete. To perform zero-shot knowledge graph completion in unseen KGs, which have different relational vocabularies from those used for pre-training, KG foundation models (KGFMs) receive a wide range of attention. Existing KGFMs often perform training using random negative triples, which are constructed by replacing the head or tail entity of a positive triple with a random entity. However, these negative triples are often constructed with limited quality, providing weak supervision for KGFM training. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective adaptive negative sampling approach, KMAS, to enhance existing KGFMs. KMAS constructs hard negative triples through the updated relation embeddings generated from the existing KGFM's relation encoder. To further adaptively align with the evolving capability of the KGFM during the training process, KMAS adjusts the ratio of hard negative triples dynamically throughout the whole training process: after a warmup phrase, it increases the ratio linearly and then decreases linearly. Extensive experiments are conducted over 44 data sets. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed negative sampling method can enhance many SOTA KGFMs without requiring excessive additional time or memory consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KMAS，一种自适应负采样方法来增强知识图谱基础模型（KGFMs）。KMAS通过关系编码器生成硬负三元组，并动态调整其在训练过程中的比例（预热→线性增加→线性减少），以适应模型能力的演进。在44个数据集上的实验验证了该方法能有效提升多种SOTA KGFMs的性能，且开销较小。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱基础模型采用随机负采样构建训练数据，但这些负三元组质量有限，无法为模型训练提供充分的监督信号。
AI.method: KMAS通过现有KGFM的关系编码器生成更新的关系嵌入，以此构建硬负三元组；训练过程中采用动态调整策略：先进行预热，随后线性增加硬负样本比例，再线性减少，形成自适应的负采样方法。
AI.result: 在44个数据集上的实验表明，该负采样方法能有效增强多种SOTA KGFMs的性能，且未带来过多的时间和内存消耗。
AI.conclusion: KMAS能有效提升多种SOTA知识图谱基础模型的性能，且无需额外的显著时间和内存开销。

title: Generating Logically Consistent Synthetic Supply Chain Data with LLM-Driven Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Synthetic data offers a promising solution to two persistent barriers in supply chain analytics: data scarcity and data privacy. However, for synthetic data to support operational simulation and decision-making, it must do more than reproduce the statistical distributions of real records, and also preserve the \emph{operational logic} that governs supply chain processes, including the temporal orderings, mathematical dependencies, hierarchical taxonomies, and conditional rules that make a record operationally plausible. We consider this logic as the ``physics'' of supply chain data. Existing tabular generative models are primarily optimized for distributional fidelity and downstream predictive utility, and therefore often generate records that appear statistically realistic but violate fundamental operational constraints. This paper introduces \textbf{\textit{TabKG}}, a knowledge-graph-guided framework for logically consistent synthetic supply chain tabular data generation. TabKG constructs a \textbf{\textit{Column Relationship Knowledge Graph (CR-KG)}} to represent data operational dependencies. It uses a multi-LLM ensemble with majority voting to propose candidate relationships from column metadata, validates these relationships against real data to remove hallucinated or unsupported edges, and then uses the validated CR-KG to guide generation. Specifically, TabKG compresses the original table into independent columns, generates these columns using a latent diffusion model, and deterministically reconstructs dependent columns according to the validated relationships, enforcing logical consistency by construction with respect to the discovered operational rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TabKG框架，通过构建列关系知识图谱(CR-KG)并结合多LLM集成与潜在扩散模型，生成既保留统计分布又遵守运营逻辑约束的合成供应链表格数据。
AI.motivation: 合成数据是解决供应链分析中数据稀缺和数据隐私问题的有前景方案，但现有表格生成模型主要优化分布保真度和下游预测效用，生成的记录虽然统计上逼真但往往违反基本操作约束。供应链数据的"物理"特性（包括时序排序、数学依赖、层级分类和条件规则）尚未被有效保留。
AI.method: TabKG构建列关系知识图谱(CR-KG)来表示数据操作依赖关系，使用多LLM集成与多数投票机制从列元数据中提出候选关系，并针对真实数据进行验证以移除幻觉或不支持的边。随后，将原始表格压缩为独立列，使用潜在扩散模型生成，再根据验证后的关系确定性重建依赖列，从而在发现的运营规则上强制执行逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 通过知识图谱验证操作规则并引导生成过程，TabKG能够确保合成数据在统计真实性的同时遵守运营逻辑约束。
AI.conclusion: TabKG provides a novel framework for generating logically consistent synthetic supply chain data by combining knowledge graph validation with latent diffusion models, ensuring both statistical fidelity and operational plausibility.

title: Variational Inference for Evidential Deep Learning
summary: While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) achieve remarkable performance, their tendency to produce overconfident predictions. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) mitigates this by formulating predictions as a Dirichlet distribution over class probabilities to explicitly quantify epistemic uncertainty. However, we found that the conventional EDL suffers from two fundamental limitations: a Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty that only suppresses the evidence of negative classes, producing excessively high evidence therefore decreasing the model's ability to quantify uncertainty, and an absence in theoretical guarantee of setting Dirichlet parameter $α=e+1$. In this paper, we propose a mathematically principled framework, Variational Inference Evidential Deep Learning (VI-EDL). By reformulating evidential learning through the lens of variational inference, we derive an Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), which prevents the evidence from growing excessively. Theoretically, we rigorously establish a generalization bound and reveal how the predicted uncertainty, feature and network complexity affect this bound, and why setting $\boldsymbolα = \mathbf{e} + \mathbf{1}$ can minimize it. Extensive experiments on standard visual and medical datasets demonstrate that VI-EDL achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing excellent performance in out-of-distribution detection, noise detection and autonomous driving scenario. The code is available in https://github.com/seutjw/VI-EDL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VI-EDL（变分推断证据深度学习）：把 Evidential Deep Learning 的证据生成重构为变分推断问题，推导出 Evidence Lower Bound（ELBO）作为训练目标，用对所有类别统一生效的 KL 先验正则替代传统 EDL 只惩罚负类证据的 KL 项，从而抑制正类证据无界增长导致的“幅度诱导的过度自信”；再配合余弦原型证据层硬性上界约束证据幅度。论文还给出一般化界（generalization bound），并严格证明 α=e+1（即先验 λ=1_ K）是最优选择，填补了传统 EDL 的理论空白。实验在 CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、Flowers、MedMNIST（Blood/Path/Tissue/Organ）、BDD100K 上取得 SOTA 的 OOD 检测、噪声检测与自动驾驶异常区分性能。
AI.motivation: 深度网络存在过度自信问题，尤其在 OOD 输入上。EDL 用 Dirichlet 分布建模类别概率以在单次前向中确定性地量化认知不确定性，但作者指出其两大根本缺陷：(1) 标准 EDL 的 KL 惩罚项只在掩蔽真类后惩罚负类证据，正类证据完全不受约束，网络因此走优化捷径，盲目放大特征与权重幅度（甚至把随机噪声映射成巨大虚假证据），造成 evidence 无界增长、削弱不确定性量化能力；(2) α=e+1 的证据到 Dirichlet 参数映射纯属经验启发式，缺乏数学依据。同时现有 EDL 变体（I-EDL、Re-EDL、F-EDL）均继承了这两点，缺乏概率化推导与对证据幅度的结构约束。
AI.method: 1）概率建模与 ELBO 推导：将类别概率 p 视为隐变量，先验取 Dir(p; λ)（约束 λ_k≥1 以避免密度奇异），似然用多项式/伪计数形式 P(e|p)∝∏p_k^{e_k}，由 Dirichlet-Multinomial 共轭性得精确后验 Dir(p; e+λ)；因真实后验不可解，设变分后验 q_φ(p|x)=Dir(p; α)，α=e+λ。由此最大化 log P(y|x) 得到 ELBO：期望负对数似然 + β·KL(q_φ‖P)。用高斯似然 P(y|p)∝exp(−||y−p||²/2σ²) 后，期望负对数似然解析分解为“预测偏置 + 方差”项；KL 用 Gamma/digamma 展开为解析式（仅含 α 的部分为有效项），最终损失 L_VI-EDL = L_MSE + β·D̃_KL。该 KL 对所有类别统一约束，可抑制证据整体膨胀。2）余弦原型证据层：取代最后线性分类头，用 e_k = Softplus(γ·(cos(x̂, r_k) − m)) 生成证据（γ 可学习缩放、m 可学习 margin），使 e_k ∈ [0, Softplus(γ(1−m))]，结构性上界证据幅度，并促使学习紧致的类内表示；OOD 样本因与所有原型余弦相似度低而输出近零证据。3）训练：warm-up 退火 λ_t = min(1, t/E_warmup) 逐步放大正则项，单次前向同时给出预测与认知不确定性 u = K/S。4）理论分析：先证明变分损失关于网络输出的全局 Lipschitz 连续性（对 MSE 与 KL 的梯度分别逐项界），再用 Ledoux–Talagrand 收缩引理结构化展开网络、界定期望 Rademacher 复杂度，最后用 McDiarmid 不等式集中化，得到一般化界（定理 3）。由此导出四条洞见：界随 n 以 O(1/√n) 衰减、K→∞ 时界最小；界关于 ||λ||_1 严格单调递增，故 λ=1_ K（均匀 Dirichlet 先验）最优，从而 α=e+1 得理论正当性；最小不确定性 μ_min 是放大器，需折中；界正比于特征半径 R、权重谱范数与激活 Lipschitz 常数，提示需要架构正则。
AI.result: CIFAR-10：ID ACC 92.32%，OOD AUROC 平均 91.33%、FPR95 平均 46.95%，均优于 EDL/I-EDL/Re-EDL/F-EDL/NatPN/Deep Ensemble；且 EDL 系列基线常因启发式 KL 的优化冲突而 ID 精度明显下降。BloodMNIST（ID 为 BloodMNIST，OOD 为 Path/Tissue/Organ）：ID ACC 89.71/72.01/76.25%，AUROC 平均 75.25%、FPR95 平均 37.40%，大幅领先所有基线；并通过特征幅值核密度可视化说明医学图像域偏移导致 ||x̂|| 偏大、从而使性能低于 CIFAR-10 的原因。噪声检测（CIFAR-10 叠加高斯噪声 σ=0.05/0.10/0.20）：AUROC 平均 80.76%、FPR95 平均 49.64%，最优。自动驾驶（BDD100K，500 雨雾 + 500 正常）：不确定性差 Unc. Diff = 0.1380，为 Re-EDL（0.0298）的 4.63 倍、F-EDL（0.0648）的 2.13 倍，可支持阈值告警与人工接管。消融显示 KL 项与余弦原型层缺一不可（ID ACC 从 92.32% 降至 66.93%/73.87%），且在 β∈[0.002, 0.6] 全区间内 FPR95 始终低于所有 EDL 基线。
AI.conclusion: VI-EDL 通过变分推断为 EDL 提供了概率化的合法基础：ELBO 目标替代启发式项，全局 KL 正则与余弦原型层共同抑制证据幅度无界增长，从根本上缓解过度自信；一般化界不仅为泛化能力提供保证，还回溯性地证明 α=e+1 是理论最优而非经验凑巧，为 EDL 的核心设计给出了统计学习理论层面的解释。大量实验表明其在 OOD 检测、噪声鲁棒性与自动驾驶异常识别上达到当前最优。局限与展望：性能仍受输入特征半径 R 与网络容量影响（医学域偏移下优势收窄），不确定性 μ_min 需人工折中而论文仅建议动态学习且未实现，退火与超参 β 仍需按数据集调节，理论界中的常数项较松、可进一步收紧。

title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Early battery degradation trajectory forecasting (BDTF), which predicts the full-life state-of-health trajectory from early operational data, is critical for battery optimization, manufacturing, and deployment. Battery degradation data exhibit two key characteristics. First, degradation data present a multi-level structure, including regularities shared within aging conditions and trajectory patterns shared across batteries. Second, degradation-related variations in voltage-current profiles are often localized to specific state-of-charge (SOC) intervals. Existing approaches often fail to explicitly model these characteristics. To bridge this gap, we propose BatteryMFormer, a multi-level Transformer for early BDTF. BatteryMFormer integrates (1) an aging-condition-aware decoder that injects aging-condition priors via aging-condition-informed queries and aging-condition-aware attention, (2) a meta degradation pattern memory that learns and retrieves trajectory prototypes to guide long-horizon forecasting, and (3) a dual-view encoder that jointly captures temporal dynamics and SOC-localized variations from voltage and current time series. Extensive experiments on four battery domains show that BatteryMFormer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, marking a significant step toward reliable BDTF. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ruifeng-Tan/BatteryMFormer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BatteryMFormer，一种用于早期电池降解轨迹预测的多层次Transformer模型。该模型通过整合老化条件感知解码器、元降解模式记忆和双视图编码器三个组件，捕获老化条件先验知识、轨迹原型模式以及SOC局部变化特征，在四个电池数据集上均实现了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 电池降解数据存在两个关键特征未被现有方法充分建模：(1)多层次结构特性——包括老化条件内的规律性和跨电池的轨迹模式；(2)降解相关变化通常局限于特定SOC区间。当前方法未能显式建模这些特征，限制了早期预测的准确性。
AI.method: BatteryMFormer包含三个核心组件：(1)老化条件感知解码器，通过老化条件感知查询和老龄化条件感知注意力注入老化条件先验；(2)元降解模式记忆模块，学习并检索轨迹原型以指导长时域预测；(3)双视图编码器，从电压和电流时间序列中联合捕获时序动态和SOC局部变化特征。
AI.result: 在四个电池领域的大规模实验中，BatteryMFormer一致性地优于现有先进基线方法，验证了其对多层次时序建模和SOC局部变化捕获能力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BatteryMFormer在四个电池领域的一致性最优性能表明其向可靠电池降解轨迹预测迈出了重要一步。代码已开源。

title: ContextGuard: Structured Self-Auditing for Context Learning in Language Models
